title.en: Route the customer assistant within budget
title.zh: 在預算內規劃客戶助理路由

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by HKTVmall and not endorsed by it. The assistant needs its daily routing plan before the next shift. Using the supplied pricing policy and daily volume table, choose one complete routing configuration, compute its total daily cost in HKD and its blended latency in ms, then confirm it meets the budget cap and the latency ceiling. Deliver the completed routing decision plus a short written handover of 100 to 180 words in English or Traditional Chinese covering evidence, rejected options and the checks you would run next. All prices, rules and volumes are invented for learning.
brief.zh: 此為受 HKTVmall 啟發的虛構模擬，並未獲其認可。客戶助理需在下一個班次前確定每日路由計劃。請根據提供的定價政策及每日用量表，選出一個完整路由設定，計算其每日總成本（HKD）及混合延遲（ms），並確認符合預算上限與延遲上限。請提交完成的決策，並附上 100 至 180 字（英文或繁體中文）的簡短交接，涵蓋證據、被否決的選項及下一步檢查。所有價格、規則及用量均為學習而虛構。

title.en: Fictional routing pricing and feasibility policy
title.zh: 虛構路由定價及可行性政策

body.en:
Fictional learning simulation for HKTVmall, not an official policy.
Model tiers, unit price per 1,000 tokens and latency per request:
tier-lite: input HKD 0.06, output HKD 0.18, latency 380 ms
tier-standard: input HKD 0.20, output HKD 0.60, latency 900 ms
tier-pro: input HKD 0.55, output HKD 1.65, latency 2100 ms
Rules
R1 Request cost = (input tokens ÷ 1,000 × input price) + (output tokens ÷ 1,000 × output price). Costs are additive across intents.
R2 Blended latency = (sum over intents of requests × tier latency) ÷ total requests. The ceiling is 500 ms.
R3 Daily budget cap is HKD 600.00. Total daily cost must be less than or equal to HKD 600.00.
R4 Refund-dispute requests must use tier-standard or tier-pro. Order-status and product-faq requests may use any tier.
A configuration is feasible only when it satisfies R2, R3 and R4.
body.zh:
此為 HKTVmall 的虛構學習模擬，並非官方政策。
模型層級、每 1,000 token 單價及每請求延遲：
tier-lite：輸入 HKD 0.06、輸出 HKD 0.18、延遲 380 ms
tier-standard：輸入 HKD 0.20、輸出 HKD 0.60、延遲 900 ms
tier-pro：輸入 HKD 0.55、輸出 HKD 1.65、延遲 2100 ms
規則
R1 每請求成本 =（輸入 token ÷ 1,000 × 輸入單價）+（輸出 token ÷ 1,000 × 輸出單價）。各意圖成本相加。
R2 混合延遲 =（各意圖請求數 × 層級延遲之總和）÷ 總請求數。上限為 500 ms。
R3 每日預算上限為 HKD 600.00。每日總成本必須小於或等於 HKD 600.00。
R4 退款爭議請求必須使用 tier-standard 或 tier-pro。訂單狀態及產品常見問題請求可使用任何層級。
只有同時符合 R2、R3 及 R4 的設定方為可行。

title.en: Message from the AI Operations Lead
title.zh: AI 營運主管的訊息

body.en:
From: Choi Ka-yan (fictional), AI Operations Lead.
We are drafting the daily routing plan for the customer assistant. Please pick one complete configuration, show the arithmetic for total cost and blended latency, and state plainly whether the HKD 600.00 cap and the 500 ms ceiling hold. Use only the pricing policy and the volume table supplied here. All records, prices and staff names in this exercise are invented for training and are not HKTVmall figures.
body.zh:
發件人：Choi Ka-yan（虛構），AI 營運主管。
我們正為客戶助理草擬每日路由計劃。請選出一個完整設定，列出總成本及混合延遲的計算過程，並清楚說明 HKD 600.00 上限及 500 ms 上限是否成立。只可使用此處提供的定價政策及用量表。本練習所有記錄、價格及職員姓名均為培訓而虛構，並非 HKTVmall 的數據。

exemplar.en: Fictional simulation evidence. The data-daily-volumes table gives 3,000 order-status, 1,500 product-faq and 500 refund-dispute requests per day. Under policy R1, tier-lite unit costs are HKD 0.054 per order-status request and HKD 0.0852 per product-faq request. Rule R4 forbids tier-lite for refund-dispute, so the cheapest compliant tier is tier-standard at HKD 0.540 per request. The cheapest feasible configuration is therefore order-status tier-lite (3,000 x 0.054 = HKD 162.00), product-faq tier-lite (1,500 x 0.0852 = HKD 127.80) and refund-dispute tier-standard (500 x 0.540 = HKD 270.00), giving HKD 559.80, which satisfies the HKD 600.00 cap with HKD 40.20 headroom. Blended latency is (3,000 x 380 + 1,500 x 380 + 500 x 900) / 5,000 = 432 ms, below the 500 ms ceiling. All-lite would cost HKD 370.80 but breaches R4. Next: verify intent counts hourly and alert at HKD 570.00 spend and 470 ms blended latency.
exemplar.zh: 虛構模擬證據。data-daily-volumes 表列出每日 3,000 個訂單狀態請求、1,500 個產品常見問題請求及 500 個退款爭議請求。按政策 R1，tier-lite 的每請求單價為訂單狀態 HKD 0.054、產品常見問題 HKD 0.0852。規則 R4 禁止退款爭議使用 tier-lite，故最便宜的合規層級為 tier-standard，每請求 HKD 0.540。因此最便宜且可行的設定為訂單狀態用 tier-lite（3,000 × 0.054 = HKD 162.00）、產品常見問題用 tier-lite（1,500 × 0.0852 = HKD 127.80）、退款爭議用 tier-standard（500 × 0.540 = HKD 270.00），合計 HKD 559.80，符合 HKD 600.00 上限，餘額 HKD 40.20。混合延遲為（3,000 × 380 + 1,500 × 380 + 500 × 900）÷ 5,000 = 432 ms，低於 500 ms 上限。全 lite 方案成本 HKD 370.80，但違反 R4。下一步：每小時核實意圖請求數，並在支出達 HKD 570.00 及混合延遲達 470 ms 時警示。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: lite-lite-standard, HKD 559.80, 432 ms, and no rule change permits tier-lite for refund-dispute. The cost and latency arithmetic is accurate and both the HKD 600.00 cap and 500 ms ceiling are confirmed.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：lite-lite-standard、HKD 559.80、432 ms，以及沒有任何規則改動可讓退款爭議使用 tier-lite。成本及延遲計算準確，並確認 HKD 600.00 上限及 500 ms 上限均成立。

feedback.en: You tied the choice to R1 unit costs (0.054, 0.0852, 0.540), to R4 barring tier-lite for refund-dispute, and to the three volume rows, and you explained why all-lite at HKD 370.80 is rejected. Specific and well-evidenced.
feedback.zh: 你把選擇連結至 R1 單價（0.054、0.0852、0.540）、禁止退款爭議使用 tier-lite 的 R4，以及三行用量資料，並解釋為何否決 HKD 370.80 的全 lite 方案。具體且有充分證據。

feedback.en: Hourly intent-count verification plus alert thresholds at HKD 570.00 spend and 470 ms latency are concrete checks that test both caps. To strengthen this, add a recomputation of each intent cost from token counts and a check that no refund-dispute request falls to tier-lite.
feedback.zh: 每小時核實意圖請求數，加上 HKD 570.00 支出及 470 ms 延遲的警示門檻，是測試兩項上限的具體檢查。如要加強，可加入由 token 數重算各意圖成本，並核實沒有退款爭議請求被降至 tier-lite。

feedback.en: You label the work a fictional simulation but do not state that HKTVmall has not endorsed it, that prices and volumes are invented averages, or that no batching, retry overhead or peak-volume evidence was supplied. Add these limits so the plan is clearly scoped to one day at stated averages.
feedback.zh: 你標明此為虛構模擬，但未說明 HKTVmall 並未認可、價格及用量均為虛構平均值，亦未指出未提供批次處理、重試開銷或高峰用量證據。請補上這些限制，令計劃清楚界定為按所述平均值計算的一天。

feedback.en: The handover names the chosen configuration, HKD 559.80, 432 ms, the HKD 40.20 headroom and the rejected all-lite option. It omits an owner or escalation path, so add that a policy change would go to the fictional AI Operations Lead to make it fully actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接列明所選設定、HKD 559.80、432 ms、HKD 40.20 餘額及被否決的全 lite 方案，但未列明負責人或轉交途徑。請補上政策改動須向虛構 AI 營運主管匯報，令交接完全可行。

summary.en: A strong, accurate submission. All decisions and calculations are correct and well explained, with clear evidence links. The main gaps are limited scope and uncertainty notes and a missing escalation owner in the handover.
summary.zh: 整體表現出色且準確。所有決策及計算均正確並解釋清楚，證據連結明確。主要不足在於範圍及不確定性說明有限，以及交接欠缺轉交負責人。

nextSteps.en: Add the missing scope limits (fictional averages, no endorsement, no batching or peak-volume data) and name the escalation path to the AI Operations Lead. Strengthen verification by recomputing each intent cost from token counts and confirming no refund-dispute request uses tier-lite.
nextSteps.zh: 補上欠缺的範圍限制（虛構平均值、未獲認可、無批次或高峰用量數據），並列明向 AI 營運主管轉交的途徑。加強核實：由 token 數重算各意圖成本，並確認沒有退款爭議請求使用 tier-lite。

title.en: Fictional batch inference pricing and feasibility policy
title.zh: 虛構批量推論定價及可行性政策

body.en:
Fictional learning simulation inspired by HKTVmall, not an official policy.
Model unit price per 1,000 tokens and base call latency:
tier-lite: input HKD 0.08, output HKD 0.24, latency 320 ms
tier-standard: input HKD 0.24, output HKD 0.72, latency 780 ms
tier-pro: input HKD 0.60, output HKD 1.80, latency 1850 ms
Approved batching profiles:
profile-p25: batch_size 25 requests, retry_rate 0.03
profile-p50: batch_size 50 requests, retry_rate 0.07
profile-p100: batch_size 100 requests, retry_rate 0.15
Rules
R1 Token cost = (input tokens / 1,000 x input price) + (output tokens / 1,000 x output price). Token costs of all intents add up.
R2 Retry uplift: total daily cost = token cost x (1 + retry_rate) of the chosen profile.
R3 Batch calls per intent = ceil(requests_per_day / batch_size).
R4 Call latency = tier base latency + (batch_size x 3 ms).
R5 Blended per-request latency = sum over intents of (batch calls x call latency x (1 + retry_rate)), divided by total requests per day. The ceiling is 12.00 ms.
R6 Daily budget cap is HKD 700.00. Total daily cost must be less than or equal to HKD 700.00.
R7 Refund-dispute requests must use tier-standard or tier-pro. Order-status and product-faq requests may use any tier.
A configuration is one tier per intent plus one approved batching profile. It is feasible only when it satisfies R5, R6 and R7.
body.zh:
此為受 HKTVmall 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非官方政策。
模型每 1,000 token 單價及基礎呼叫延遲：
tier-lite：輸入 HKD 0.08、輸出 HKD 0.24、延遲 320 ms
tier-standard：輸入 HKD 0.24、輸出 HKD 0.72、延遲 780 ms
tier-pro：輸入 HKD 0.60、輸出 HKD 1.80、延遲 1850 ms
核准批量設定檔：
profile-p25：batch_size 25 個請求、retry_rate 0.03
profile-p50：batch_size 50 個請求、retry_rate 0.07
profile-p100：batch_size 100 個請求、retry_rate 0.15
規則
R1 token 成本 =（輸入 token / 1,000 × 輸入單價）+（輸出 token / 1,000 × 輸出單價）。各意圖的 token 成本相加。
R2 重試加乘：每日總成本 = token 成本 ×（1 + 所選設定檔的 retry_rate）。
R3 每個意圖的批量呼叫次數 = ceil(每日請求數 / batch_size)。
R4 呼叫延遲 = 層級基礎延遲 +（batch_size × 3 ms）。
R5 每請求混合延遲 = 各意圖的（批量呼叫次數 × 呼叫延遲 ×（1 + retry_rate））總和，除以每日總請求數。上限為 12.00 ms。
R6 每日預算上限為 HKD 700.00。每日總成本必須小於或等於 HKD 700.00。
R7 退款爭議請求必須使用 tier-standard 或 tier-pro。訂單狀態及產品常見問題請求可使用任何層級。
一個設定等於每個意圖一個層級，加一個核准批量設定檔。只有同時符合 R5、R6 及 R7 方為可行。

body.en:
From: Choi Ka-yan (fictional), AI Operations Lead.
We are drafting the batch inference plan for the customer assistant. Please pick one complete configuration, show the arithmetic for total daily cost and blended per-request latency, and state plainly whether the HKD 700.00 cap and the 12.00 ms ceiling hold. Rank the alternatives you reject and say why, using the rule identifiers. Use only the pricing policy and the volume table supplied here. All records, prices and staff names in this exercise are invented for training and are not HKTVmall figures.

exemplar.en: Decision: run profile-p50 with tier-lite for intent-order-status and intent-product-faq, and tier-standard for intent-refund-dispute because R7 requires standard or pro. Token cost: order-status 960 x 0.08 plus 360 x 0.24 gives HKD 163.20, product-faq 780 x 0.08 plus 300 x 0.24 gives HKD 134.40, refund-dispute 400 x 0.24 plus 180 x 0.72 gives HKD 225.60. Base total HKD 523.20. The R2 retry uplift of 1.07 gives HKD 559.82, below the HKD 700.00 cap. Batch calls under R3 are 48, 24 and 8. R4 call latency is 470 ms, 470 ms and 930 ms, so the R5 weighted total is 41,280 ms x 1.07 = 44,169.60 ms over 4,000 requests, which is 11.04 ms and below the 12.00 ms ceiling. Rejected: profile-p25 at 18.17 ms breaches the ceiling, profile-p100 is feasible at HKD 601.68 and 7.66 ms but costs more, and tier-pro for refund-dispute reaches HKD 921.91 and breaches the cap. These prices, retry rates and volumes are fictional. Next: verify the 0.07 retry rate against batch logs and rerun if volume shifts. Owner: Choi Ka-yan, AI Operations Lead.

title.en: Specify AI service monitoring for the order-assistant service

brief.en: You are supporting the fictional HKTVmall order-assistant service. The AI Service Quality Lead has supplied four two-hour aggregate windows for 12 October 2026 plus the monitoring policy. managerRole.zh: AI 服務品質主管（虛構）

title.zh: AI 服務監察政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy for the HKTVmall order-assistant service. Time windows are fixed two-hour blocks in Hong Kong time (HKT). Window quality error rate equals quality_errors divided by checked_responses, expressed as a percentage. Alert condition A: window quality error rate strictly greater than 2.00 percent. Alert condition B: window p95 latency strictly greater than 2000 milliseconds. Alert condition C: the four-window aggregate quality error rate strictly greater than 2.00 percent, where aggregate rate equals total quality_errors divided by total checked_responses. Every breached condition raises one alert event. Alert events go to the fictional channel #ai-service-quality and are reviewed by the AI Service Quality Lead. P95 latency values are supplied directly. No live deployment or alert is performed in this exercise.
body.zh: 針對 HKTVmall 訂單助手服務的虛構學習政策。時間視窗為香港時間（HKT）的固定兩小時區塊。視窗品質錯誤率等於 quality_errors 除以 checked_responses，並以百分比表示。警報條件 A：視窗品質錯誤率嚴格大於 2.00 百分比。警報條件 B：視窗 p95 延遲嚴格大於 2000 毫秒。警報條件 C：四個時間視窗的彙總品質錯誤率嚴格大於 2.00 百分比，彙總率等於總 quality_errors 除以總 checked_responses。每個被觸發的條件產生一個警報事件。警報事件發送至虛構頻道 #ai-service-quality，並由 AI 服務品質主管審查。p95 延遲值直接提供。本練習不進行實際部署或發送實際警報。

title.en: Note on triage and review actions (fictional)
title.zh: 分流與審查行動備註（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal note from the AI Service Quality Lead. Every alert event is triaged within the next business day by the AI Service Quality Lead. For condition A or condition C events, the reviewer inspects a sample of 30 checked responses from the affected window or from the aggregate period and records the observed issue themes. For condition B events, the reviewer confirms with the platform team whether the latency budget needs review. Findings are recorded in the weekly AI service quality note. This policy does not authorise model retraining, routing changes or product availability changes.
body.zh: AI 服務品質主管的虛構內部備註。每個警報事件由 AI 服務品質主管在下一個工作日內分流。對於條件 A 或條件 C 事件，審查人會從受影響的時間視窗或彙總期間抽取 30 個 checked responses 作樣本，並記錄觀察到的問題主題。對於條件 B 事件，審查人會與平台團隊確認是否需要檢視延遲預算。審查結果記錄於每週 AI 服務品質備註。本政策不授權重新訓練模型、更改路由或更改產品供應情況。

label.en: Using the four supplied windows, what is the aggregate quality error rate in percent, rounded to two decimal places?
label.zh: 按四個提供的時間視窗，彙總品質錯誤率為多少百分比（四捨五入至兩位小數）？

label.en: Which windows breach alert condition A, a window quality error rate strictly greater than 2.00 percent? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些時間視窗觸發警報條件 A，即視窗品質錯誤率嚴格大於 2.00 百分比？請選取所有適用者。

label.en: Which window breaches alert condition B, a window p95 latency strictly greater than 2000 milliseconds?
label.zh: 哪個時間視窗觸發警報條件 B，即視窗 p95 延遲嚴格大於 2000 毫秒？

label.en: How many alert events are raised in total when all four windows and the aggregate condition are evaluated under the policy?
label.zh: 按政策評估全部四個時間視窗及彙總條件後，合共產生多少個警報事件？

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Specify quality and latency monitoring from synthetic aggregate time windows with explicit alert and review rules.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按合成彙總時間視窗及明確警報與審查規則定義品質及延遲監察。

expectedEvidence.en: States the correct derived values: window rates 1.50 percent (w1, 18/1200), 2.50 percent (w2, 45/1800), 2.50 percent (w3, 60/2400) and 3.00 percent (w4, 27/900). Aggregate rate 150/6300 = 2.38095 percent, reported as 2.38 percent. Condition A breaches are w2, w3 and w4. Condition B breach is w3 only (2100 ms greater than 2000 ms, while 1450 ms, 1720 ms and 1880 ms do not breach). Condition C breaches because 2.38 percent is strictly greater than 2.00 percent. Total alert events are 5 (three for A, one for B, one for C).
expectedEvidence.zh: 須列出正確推算值：視窗比率 1.50 百分比（w1，18/1200）、2.50 百分比（w2，45/1800）、2.50 百分比（w3，60/2400）及 3.00 百分比（w4，27/900）。彙總率 150/6300 = 2.38095 百分比，報告為 2.38 百分比。條件 A 觸發者為 w2、w3、w4。條件 B 觸發者僅為 w3（2100 毫秒大於 2000 毫秒，而 1450、1720、1880 毫秒均不觸發）。條件 C 觸發，因為 2.38 百分比嚴格大於 2.00 百分比。警報事件合共 5 個（條件 A 三個、條件 B 一個、條件 C 一個）。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links each decision to specific supplied records: data-window-metrics rows w1 to w4 for the counts and p95 values, and policy-monitoring-rules for the formula, the strict greater-than comparisons at 2.00 percent and 2000 ms, the aggregate definition and the one-event-per-breached-condition rule. Explains why w2 and w4 breach on rate only, why w3 breaches on both rate and latency, and why w1 breaches nothing.
expectedEvidence.zh: 須把每項決策連結至具體提供記錄：以 data-window-metrics 的 w1 至 w4 資料列取得次數及 p95 值，並以 policy-monitoring-rules 取得公式、2.00 百分比及 2000 毫秒的嚴格大於比較、彙總定義，以及每個被觸發條件產生一個警報事件的規則。須解釋 w2 及 w4 僅在比率上觸發、w3 同時在比率及延遲上觸發、w1 完全沒有觸發的原因。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks: re-derive 18 + 45 + 60 + 27 = 150 over 1200 + 1800 + 2400 + 900 = 6300 to confirm 2.38 percent, confirm that 2.00 percent and 2000 ms themselves do not breach because the comparisons are strict, confirm the windows are non-overlapping fixed two-hour HKT blocks, confirm p95 values are used as supplied without percentile estimation, and confirm no live alert was sent and no routing or retraining change was made.
expectedEvidence.zh: 須提出具體檢查：重新計算 18 + 45 + 60 + 27 = 150 除以 1200 + 1800 + 2400 + 900 = 6300 以確認 2.38 百分比；確認 2.00 百分比及 2000 毫秒本身不觸發，因為比較為嚴格；確認時間視窗為不重疊的固定兩小時 HKT 區塊；確認 p95 值按提供值使用而沒有估算百分位數；確認沒有發送實際警報，亦沒有更改路由或重新訓練。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that all counts are synthetic aggregates, that p95 latency is supplied directly so no percentile is estimated, and that no customer-level cause can be claimed from window totals. Limits the specification to the four supplied windows and the published policy, and notes that no deployment, alert delivery or model change occurs in this exercise.
expectedEvidence.zh: 須承認所有次數均為合成彙總數據、p95 延遲為直接提供故沒有估算百分位數，且不能從視窗總數推論任何客戶層面成因。須把規格限於四個提供時間視窗及已公布政策，並註明本練習不進行部署、實際警報發送或模型更改。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Provides an actionable handover of roughly 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese containing the metric formulas, the four windows and their computed rates and latency values, the alert conditions breached, the total of 5 alert events, the fictional destination #ai-service-quality and review owner the AI Service Quality Lead, the review actions for conditions A, B and C, and the uncertainty plus next checks.
expectedEvidence.zh: 須提供可執行交接，約 100 至 180 個英文詞或相若中文，內容包括指標公式、四個時間視窗及其計算比率與延遲值、被觸發的警報條件、合共 5 個警報事件、虛構發送頻道 #ai-service-quality 及審查責任人 AI 服務品質主管、條件 A、B、C 的審查行動，以及不確定性與下一步檢查。

exemplar.en: Monitoring specification for the fictional HKTVmall order assistant, windows on 2026-10-12. Metric A, window quality error rate = quality_errors / checked_responses x 100. Metric B, window p95 latency in ms, used as supplied. Metric C, aggregate quality error rate = total quality_errors / total checked_responses x 100 across the four windows. Applying data-window-metrics: w1 18/1200 = 1.50 percent and 1450 ms, no breach. w2 45/1800 = 2.50 percent, breaches condition A. w3 60/2400 = 2.50 percent and 2100 ms, breaches A and B. w4 27/900 = 3.00 percent, breaches A. Aggregate 150/6300 = 2.38 percent, breaches C. Total five alert events, routed to #ai-service-quality and reviewed by the AI Service Quality Lead. Review actions: sample 30 checked responses for each A and C event, confirm the latency budget question with the platform team for the B event, and record findings in the weekly quality note. Uncertainty: only synthetic aggregates are available, so no customer-level cause is claimable and no percentile is estimated. Next checks: re-derive 2.38 percent, verify the strict greater-than boundary at exactly 2.00 percent and 2000 ms, and confirm no live alert was sent.
exemplar.zh: 虛構 HKTVmall 訂單助手於 2026-10-12 的監察規格。指標 A：視窗品質錯誤率 = quality_errors ÷ checked_responses × 100。指標 B：視窗 p95 延遲（毫秒），按提供值使用。指標 C：彙總品質錯誤率 = 四個時間視窗的總 quality_errors ÷ 總 checked_responses × 100。套用 data-window-metrics：w1 18/1200 = 1.50 百分比及 1450 毫秒，沒有觸發。w2 45/1800 = 2.50 百分比，觸發條件 A。w3 60/2400 = 2.50 百分比及 2100 毫秒，觸發 A 及 B。w4 27/900 = 3.00 百分比，觸發 A。彙總 150/6300 = 2.38 百分比，觸發 C。合共五個警報事件，發送至 #ai-service-quality，由 AI 服務品質主管審查。審查行動：就每個 A 及 C 事件抽取 30 個 checked responses 作樣本，就 B 事件與平台團隊確認延遲預算問題，並把結果記錄於每週品質備註。不確定性：只有合成彙總數據，不能推論客戶層面成因，亦沒有估算百分位數。下一步檢查：重新推算 2.38 百分比、核實 2.00 百分比及 2000 毫秒的嚴格大於邊界，並確認沒有發送實際警報。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. Window rates 1.50, 2.50, 2.50 and 3.00 percent, aggregate 150/6300 = 2.38 percent, condition A on w2/w3/w4, condition B on w3 at 2100 ms, and five total alert events all match the policy rules.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。視窗比率 1.50、2.50、2.50 及 3.00 百分比，彙總 150/6300 = 2.38 百分比，條件 A 觸發 w2、w3、w4，條件 B 由 w3 的 2100 毫秒觸發，警報事件合共五個，全部符合政策規則。

feedback.en: You tie each rate and latency value to the supplied w1 to w4 rows and explain why w1 breaches nothing while w2 and w4 breach on rate only and w3 breaches on both. Add explicit references to the monitoring policy document for the formula, strict comparisons and one-event-per-breached-condition rule to strengthen traceability.
feedback.zh: 你把每項比率及延遲值連結至提供的 w1 至 w4 資料列，並解釋 w1 沒有觸發、w2 及 w4 僅在比率上觸發、w3 同時觸發的原因。建議明確引用監察政策文件以說明公式、嚴格比較及每個觸發條件產生一個事件的規則，以加強可追溯性。

feedback.en: Re-deriving 2.38 percent from 150/6300, checking the strict greater-than boundary at exactly 2.00 percent and 2000 ms, and confirming no live alert was sent are good concrete checks. Also verify that the four windows are non-overlapping fixed two-hour HKT blocks and that no routing or retraining change was made.
feedback.zh: 以 150/6300 重新推算 2.38 百分比、核實 2.00 百分比及 2000 毫秒的嚴格大於邊界，以及確認沒有發送實際警報，都是具體良好的檢查。建議同時核實四個時間視窗為不重疊的固定兩小時 HKT 區塊，並確認沒有更改路由或重新訓練。

feedback.en: You correctly state that only synthetic aggregates are available, that no customer-level cause is claimable and that no percentile is estimated. Extend this by limiting the specification to the four supplied windows and the published policy, and noting that no model or routing change is authorised.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出只有合成彙總數據、不能推論客戶層面成因，亦沒有估算百分位數。建議進一步把規格限於四個提供時間視窗及已公布政策，並註明本政策不授權更改模型或路由。

feedback.en: The handover covers the formulas, all four windows with rates and latency, the breached conditions, the total of five alert events, the fictional channel and review owner, review actions and next checks, so it is immediately actionable. The 193-word length is fine given the amount of substantive content.
feedback.zh: 交接涵蓋公式、四個時間視窗的比率與延遲、被觸發條件、合共五個警報事件、虛構頻道及審查責任人、審查行動與下一步檢查，可直接執行。193 字的長度配合實質內容，並無問題。

summary.en: A complete and accurate monitoring specification. All four structured answers and the written evidence match the supplied policy and window metrics, with clear derivations and scope caveats. Minor gaps remain in explicit policy citation and in verifying the window structure and the no-change boundary.
summary.zh: 這是一份完整而準確的監察規格。四項結構化答案及書面證據均符合提供政策與時間視窗指標，推算清晰並列明範圍限制。主要小缺口在於未明確引用政策文件，以及未核實時間視窗結構及不更改路由或模型的界線。

nextSteps.en: Add explicit references to the monitoring policy document for the formula and strict comparison rules, and extend the verification checks to confirm the fixed non-overlapping two-hour HKT windows and that no routing or retraining change was made.
nextSteps.zh: 補充對監察政策文件的明確引用，說明公式及嚴格比較規則，並擴充核實檢查，確認固定且不重疊的兩小時 HKT 時間視窗，以及沒有更改路由或重新訓練。

title.en: Define quality and latency monitoring for the order-assistant service
title.zh: 為訂單助手服務定義品質及延遲監察

brief.en: You are supporting the fictional HKTVmall order-assistant service. The AI Service Quality Lead has supplied four unequal two-hour aggregate windows for 2026-11-05 plus the monitoring policy. All records are invented for learning. This exercise is an independent simulation and is not endorsed by HKTVmall. Produce a monitoring specification stating each metric formula, the window definition, every alert condition and the review action, with calculations showing how the supplied windows behave. Finish with a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering decisions, evidence, uncertainty and next checks. Do not deploy anything or send live alerts.
brief.zh: 你正支援虛構的 HKTVmall 訂單助手服務。AI 服務品質主管提供了 2026-11-05 四個大小不一的兩小時彙總時間視窗，以及監察政策。所有記錄均為學習而虛構。本練習為獨立模擬，並未獲得 HKTVmall 認可。請提交監察規格，列明每項指標公式、視窗定義、所有警報條件及審查行動，並以計算展示所提供時間視窗的表現。最後撰寫約 100 至 180 個英文詞（或相若中文）的精簡交接，涵蓋決策、證據、不確定性及下一步檢查。請勿進行部署或發送實際警報。

managerRole.zh: AI 服務品質主管（虛構）

title.zh: AI 服務監察政策（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional learning policy for the HKTVmall order-assistant service. All timestamps are Hong Kong time (HKT). Window quality error rate equals quality_errors divided by checked_responses for the same window, expressed as a percentage. Weighted aggregate error rate equals the total quality_errors across w1 to w4 divided by the total checked_responses across w1 to w4, expressed as a percentage. Round to two decimal places only for reporting, never before comparison.

Alert A: a window rate strictly greater than 2.50 percent. Alert B: a window p95 latency strictly greater than 2200 milliseconds. Alert C: the weighted aggregate rate strictly greater than 2.00 percent. Alert D: at least one qualifying consecutive pair, meaning two adjacent windows in the fixed order w1 to w4 where both windows have a rate strictly greater than 2.00 percent.

Each breached condition raises exactly one alert event. Alert D raises one event even when two pairs qualify. Events go to the fictional channel #ai-service-quality. P95 latency is supplied directly. No deployment and no live alert occurs.
body.zh:
針對 HKTVmall 訂單助手服務的虛構學習政策。所有時間戳均為香港時間（HKT）。視窗品質錯誤率等於同一視窗的 quality_errors 除以 checked_responses，並以百分比表示。加權彙總錯誤率等於 w1 至 w4 的 quality_errors 總和除以 w1 至 w4 的 checked_responses 總和，並以百分比表示。只在報告時四捨五入至兩位小數，比較前不作四捨五入。

警報 A：任何視窗的比率嚴格大於 2.50 百分比。警報 B：任何視窗的 p95 延遲嚴格大於 2200 毫秒。警報 C：加權彙總率嚴格大於 2.00 百分比。警報 D：至少一組合資格連續視窗組合，即在固定次序 w1 至 w4 中相鄰的兩個視窗，而兩者的比率均嚴格大於 2.00 百分比。

每個被觸發的條件產生剛好一個警報事件。即使有兩組合資格組合，警報 D 亦只產生一個事件。事件發送至虛構頻道 #ai-service-quality。p95 延遲直接提供。本練習不進行部署，亦不發送實際警報。

title.zh: 合成時間視窗指標（僅供輸入）

body.en:
Input only table for 2026-11-05, all values synthetic. Columns are window_id, window_start_hkt, window_end_hkt, checked_responses (count), quality_errors (count) and p95_latency_ms (milliseconds, supplied directly). No derived rate and no alert status is pre-filled.

```csv
window_id,window_start_hkt,window_end_hkt,checked_responses,quality_errors,p95_latency_ms
w1,2026-11-05T08:00+08:00,2026-11-05T10:00+08:00,1500,24,1400
w2,2026-11-05T10:00+08:00,2026-11-05T12:00+08:00,2600,65,1750
w3,2026-11-05T12:00+08:00,2026-11-05T14:00+08:00,3200,88,2450
w4,2026-11-05T14:00+08:00,2026-11-05T16:00+08:00,700,21,1950
```

Window sizes are deliberately unequal, so the weighted aggregate rate cannot be computed as a plain average of the four window rates.
body.zh:
2026-11-05 的僅供輸入資料表，全部數值均為合成。欄位為 window_id、window_start_hkt、window_end_hkt、checked_responses（次數）、quality_errors（次數）及 p95_latency_ms（毫秒，直接提供）。表中沒有預先填入任何計算比率或警報狀態。

```csv
window_id,window_start_hkt,window_end_hkt,checked_responses,quality_errors,p95_latency_ms
w1,2026-11-05T08:00+08:00,2026-11-05T10:00+08:00,1500,24,1400
w2,2026-11-05T10:00+08:00,2026-11-05T12:00+08:00,2600,65,1750
w3,2026-11-05T12:00+08:00,2026-11-05T14:00+08:00,3200,88,2450
w4,2026-11-05T14:00+08:00,2026-11-05T16:00+08:00,700,21,1950
```

四個視窗的樣本量刻意不相等，因此加權彙總率不可用四個視窗比率的簡單平均數計算。

title.en: Note on triage and review actions (fictional)
title.zh: 分流與審查行動備註（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal note from the AI Service Quality Lead of the HKTVmall order-assistant service. Every alert event is triaged within the next business day by the AI Service Quality Lead. For alert A or alert C events, the reviewer samples 30 checked responses from each affected window and from the aggregate period, then records the observed issue themes. For alert B events, the reviewer confirms with the platform team whether the latency budget needs review. For alert D events, the reviewer checks the trend across the qualifying pair before closing the event. Findings are recorded in the weekly AI service quality note. This policy authorises no model retraining, no routing change and no product availability change.

exemplar.en:
Scope. Fictional HKTVmall order-assistant monitoring for 2026-11-05, windows w1 to w4, all values synthetic.

Metrics. Window rate equals quality_errors divided by checked_responses. w1 1.60 percent (24/1500), w2 2.50 percent (65/2600), w3 2.75 percent (88/3200), w4 3.00 percent (21/700). Weighted aggregate equals 198/8000 = 2.4750 percent, reported as 2.48 percent because window sizes are unequal.

Alerts, four events. A, w3 and w4 exceed 2.50 percent, while w2 equals exactly 2.50 percent so it does not breach. B, w3 p95 2450 ms exceeds 2200 ms. C, 2.48 percent exceeds 2.00 percent. D, pairs w2-w3 and w3-w4 both qualify and count once.

Review. Log each event in #ai-service-quality and triage within the next business day by the AI Service Quality Lead. For A and C sample 30 checked responses from w3, w4 and the aggregate period. For B confirm the latency budget with the platform team. For D check the trend across the qualifying pair.

Uncertainty. Values are synthetic. P95 is supplied directly, so no percentile estimation is claimed. No retraining, routing or availability change is authorised, and no live alert was sent. Next checks, recompute 198/8000, verify the w2 boundary and confirm D counts once.

指標。視窗比率等於 quality_errors 除以 checked_responses。w1 為 1.60 百分比（24/1500），w2 為 2.50 百分比（65/2600），w3 為 2.75 百分比（88/3200），w4 為 3.00 百分比（21/700）。加權彙總等於 198/8000 = 2.4750 百分比，因視窗大小不一，報告為 2.48 百分比。

警報，共四個事件。A，w3 及 w4 超過 2.50 百分比，而 w2 剛好等於 2.50 百分比，故不觸發。B，w3 的 p95 2450 毫秒超過 2200 毫秒。C，2.48 百分比超過 2.00 百分比。D，w2-w3 及 w3-w4 兩組均符合資格，只計算一次。

審查。把每個事件記錄於 #ai-service-quality，並由 AI 服務品質主管在下一個工作日內分流。對於 A 及 C，從 w3、w4 及彙總期間各抽取 30 個 checked responses 作樣本。對於 B，與平台團隊確認延遲預算。對於 D，檢查該合資格組合的趨勢。

不確定性。數值均為合成。p95 直接提供，故不宣稱作百分位估算。政策不授權重新訓練、更改路由或更改產品供應情況，亦沒有發送實際警報。下一步檢查：重新計算 198/8000，核實 w2 的邊界值，並確認 D 只計算一次。

Alert B applies to w3 at 2450 ms, C applies at 2.48 percent, and D counts once across w2-w3 and w3-w4 for a total of four events.

brief.en: HKTVmall does not endorse this simulation. Our fictional review-flag team froze two model versions against six labelled test records. title.zh: 虛構基準協定

body.en: Fictional benchmark protocol for the HKTVmall review-flag simulation. Positive means the review breaches policy. TP is a positive record predicted positive. FP is a negative record predicted positive. FN is a positive record predicted negative. TN is a negative record predicted negative. Precision = TP / (TP + FP). Recall = TP / (TP + FN). Coverage = records with a positive or negative prediction / all records. If any denominator is zero, that metric is 0.000. Round every metric to three decimals. A version is eligible only when recall is at least 0.500 and coverage is at least 0.900. Rank eligible versions by precision descending, then recall descending, then version id ascending.
body.zh: HKTVmall 評論標記模擬的虛構基準協定。positive 指評論違反政策。TP 為實際 positive 且預測 positive 的記錄。FP 為實際 negative 但預測 positive 的記錄。FN 為實際 positive 但預測 negative 的記錄。TN 為實際 negative 且預測 negative 的記錄。精確度 = TP / (TP + FP)。召回率 = TP / (TP + FN)。覆蓋率 = 有 positive 或 negative 預測的記錄 / 全部記錄。若任何分母為零，該指標為 0.000。所有指標四捨五入至三位小數。版本符合資格的條件為召回率至少 0.500 且覆蓋率至少 0.900。合資格版本按精確度由高至低排名，其後按召回率由高至低，最後按版本編號由小至大。

model-v1 counts: TP 2 (R-01, R-03), FP 2 (R-05, R-06), FN 2 (R-02, R-04), TN 0. Precision = 2 / (2 + 2) = 0.500. Recall = 2 / (2 + 2) = 0.500.

title.zh: 虛構基準協定

body.en: Fictional benchmark protocol for the HKTVmall review-flag simulation. Positive means the review breaches policy. TP is a positive record predicted positive. FP is a negative record predicted positive. FN is a positive record predicted negative. TN is a negative record predicted negative. An abstain prediction is neither positive nor negative and fills no confusion cell. Precision = TP / (TP + FP). Recall = TP / (TP + FN). Coverage = records with a positive or negative prediction divided by all records. If any denominator is zero, that metric is 0.000. Round metrics to three decimals. A version is eligible only when recall is at least 0.500 and coverage is at least 0.900. Rank eligible versions by precision descending, then recall descending, then version id ascending.
body.zh: HKTVmall 評論標記模擬的虛構基準協定。positive 指評論違反政策。TP 為實際 positive 且預測 positive 的記錄。FP 為實際 negative 但預測 positive 的記錄。FN 為實際 positive 但預測 negative 的記錄。TN 為實際 negative 且預測 negative 的記錄。abstain 預測既非 positive 亦非 negative，不計入任何混淆格。精確度 = TP / (TP + FP)。召回率 = TP / (TP + FN)。覆蓋率 = 有 positive 或 negative 預測的記錄除以全部記錄。若任何分母為零，該指標為 0.000。所有指標四捨五入至三位小數。版本符合資格的條件為召回率至少 0.500 且覆蓋率至少 0.900。合資格版本按精確度由高至低排名，其後按召回率由高至低，最後按版本編號由小至大。

title.zh: 固定預測與真實標籤，2026-09-30

body.en:

```csv
record_id,ground_truth,model_v1_prediction,model_v2_prediction
R-01,positive,positive,positive
R-02,positive,positive,negative
R-03,positive,abstain,positive
R-04,negative,positive,positive
R-05,negative,negative,negative
R-06,negative,negative,negative
```

Ground truth holds 3 positive records and 3 negative records. model_v1 returned one abstain and model_v2 returned none.

title.en: Benchmark note from the quality lead

body.en: Fictional benchmark note. Two reviewers adjudicated ground truth before the 2026-09-30 freeze and no record is disputed. model_v1 returned abstain on R-03, so that record fills no confusion cell but still lowers coverage. model_v2 returned a positive or negative prediction for all six records, so its coverage is complete. Six records cannot support a production release decision, so any result applies only to these frozen records.

expectedEvidence.zh: 交接須列明所選版本（model-v2）、混淆計數、精確度、召回率、覆蓋率及門檻結果，指出 R-02 及 R-04 為錯誤記錄，標明六條記錄的局限，並把下一步轉交 AI 品質主管，附以明確的核實行動。

exemplar.en: Evidence and counts. From doc-2, ground truth holds 3 positive records (R-01, R-02, R-03) and 3 negative records (R-04, R-05, R-06). For model-v1: TP=2 (R-01, R-02), FP=1 (R-04), FN=0, TN=2 (R-05, R-06), abstain=1 (R-03). For model-v2: TP=2 (R-01, R-03), FP=1 (R-04), FN=1 (R-02), TN=2 (R-05, R-06), abstain=0. Calculations by the doc-1 protocol: model-v1 precision = 2/3 = 0.667, recall = 2/2 = 1.000, coverage = 5/6 = 0.833. model-v2 precision = 2/3 = 0.667, recall = 2/3 = 0.667, coverage = 6/6 = 1.000. Gate: model-v1 fails because coverage 0.833 is below 0.900 even though recall passes. model-v2 passes recall at least 0.500 and coverage at least 0.900, so the ranking rule selects model-v2. Errors: R-02 and R-04, since R-03 is an abstain for model-v1 and is not an error for model-v2. Limits and next step: this is a fictional six-record freeze, so it shows only a narrower tradeoff, not production quality. Next, the AI Quality Lead should rerun the same protocol on a larger adjudicated sample and confirm the abstain handling rule before any release claim.
exemplar.zh: 證據與計數。根據 doc-2，真實標籤為 3 條 positive 記錄（R-01、R-02、R-03）及 3 條 negative 記錄（R-04、R-05、R-06）。model-v1：TP=2（R-01、R-02）、FP=1（R-04）、FN=0、TN=2（R-05、R-06）、abstain=1（R-03）。model-v2：TP=2（R-01、R-03）、FP=1（R-04）、FN=1（R-02）、TN=2（R-05、R-06）、abstain=0。按 doc-1 協定計算：model-v1 精確度 = 2/3 = 0.667，召回率 = 2/2 = 1.000，覆蓋率 = 5/6 = 0.833。model-v2 精確度 = 2/3 = 0.667，召回率 = 2/3 = 0.667，覆蓋率 = 6/6 = 1.000。門檻：model-v1 雖召回率合格，但覆蓋率 0.833 低於 0.900，故不合格。model-v2 召回率至少 0.500 且覆蓋率至少 0.900，故排名規則選出 model-v2。錯誤記錄：R-02 及 R-04，而 R-03 對 model-v1 屬 abstain，對 model-v2 並非錯誤。局限及下一步：此為虛構的六條記錄固定版本，只顯示較窄的取捨，不代表正式品質。下一步應由 AI 品質主管在更大的已標註樣本上重跑同一協定，並在任何上線聲明前確認 abstain 的處理規則。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct. You show model-v1 precision 0.667 from TP=2 and FP=1, coverage 0.833 from 5 of 6 records, and the gate outcome where model-v1 fails coverage 0.833 below 0.900 while model-v2 passes recall 0.667 and coverage 1.000. The ranking rule correctly selects model-v2 and the error records R-02 and R-04 are right.
feedback.zh: 四個答案全部正確。你展示 model-v1 精確度 0.667（TP=2、FP=1）、覆蓋率 0.833（六條中五條），以及 model-v1 因覆蓋率 0.833 低於 0.900 而不合格、model-v2 以召回率 0.667 及覆蓋率 1.000 合格。排名規則正確選出 model-v2，錯誤記錄 R-02 及 R-04 亦正確。

feedback.en: Counts are tied to named records for both versions and the R-03 abstain is correctly excluded from every confusion cell. You also give precision, recall and coverage with the three-decimal rounding, so the reasoning is traceable. Adding a one-line note that recall for model-v1 is 1.000 would make the gate comparison fully explicit.
feedback.zh: 兩個版本的計數均連結至具體記錄，R-03 的 abstain 亦正確地不計入任何混淆格。你亦列出精確度、召回率及覆蓋率並四捨五入至三位小數，推理可追溯。若補一句 model-v1 召回率為 1.000，資格門檻的比較會更完整。

feedback.en: Your next step, rerunning the same protocol on a larger adjudicated sample and confirming the abstain handling rule with the AI Quality Lead, is concrete and relevant. To strengthen it, add a recount that each version's confusion cells sum to 6 and confirm the recall 0.500 and coverage 0.900 thresholds are inclusive rather than exclusive.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體可行，即在更大的已標註樣本重跑同一協定，並與 AI 品質主管確認 abstain 的處理規則。可再加一項重算，確認每個版本的混淆格總和為 6，並核實召回率 0.500 及覆蓋率 0.900 門檻屬包含式而非排除式。

feedback.en: You correctly limit the result to the fictional six-record freeze and state the selected version is not evidence of production quality. You could also state plainly that these numbers establish no HKTVmall policy or release decision.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把結果限於虛構的六條記錄固定版本，並指出所選版本不代表正式品質。若能同時明言這些數字並不確立任何 HKTVmall 政策或上線決定，會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover names model-v2, gives the confusion counts and metrics with the gate outcome, flags R-02 and R-04, notes the six-record limit and routes the next step to the AI Quality Lead. It is actionable and easy to pick up.
feedback.zh: 交接列明 model-v2、混淆計數及指標與門檻結果，指出 R-02 及 R-04，標明六條記錄的局限，並把下一步轉交 AI 品質主管。內容可行且易於接手。

summary.en: A complete and accurate submission. All four structured answers are correct, every confusion count is tied to named records, and the abstain on R-03 is handled exactly as the protocol requires. The accuracy, evidence and scope sections are strong, and the main gap is a slightly light verification checklist.
summary.zh: 提交完整且準確。四個結構化答案全部正確，每個混淆計數均連結至具體記錄，R-03 的 abstain 亦完全按協定處理。準確度、證據及範圍部分表現良好，主要不足在於核實清單略為單薄。

nextSteps.en: Add a short verification checklist to the handover: recount that each version's confusion cells sum to 6, confirm the abstain fills no cell, verify the three-decimal rounding and the inclusive recall 0.500 and coverage 0.900 thresholds, then rerun the protocol on a larger adjudicated sample before any release claim. Also state explicitly that these six fictional records establish no HKTVmall policy or release decision.
nextSteps.zh: 在交接中加入簡短核實清單：重算每個版本的混淆格總和為 6、確認 abstain 不計入任何格、核實三位小數的四捨五入及召回率 0.500 與覆蓋率 0.900 屬包含式門檻，然後在作出任何上線聲明前於更大的已標註樣本重跑協定。同時明言這六條虛構記錄並不確立任何 HKTVmall 政策或上線決定。

title.en: Audit and Correct a RACI Matrix for Merchant Onboarding Decisions
title.zh: 審查並修正商戶入職決策的 RACI 矩陣

brief.en: This is an independent fictional learning simulation inspired by a Hong Kong delivery platform. It is not endorsed by and does not represent any real company. You are a business analyst on a fictional merchant onboarding programme. A fictional RACI policy and an as-is RACI matrix for three decisions (D1, D2, D3) are supplied. Audit the matrix against the policy, correct every violation, and produce a corrected responsibility matrix plus a validation checklist. Write a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or a comparable Chinese length, covering your corrections, the evidence used and how to verify them. All roles and records are fictional.
brief.zh: 此為受香港配送平台啟發的獨立虛構學習模擬，未經任何真實公司認可，亦不代表任何真實公司。你是虛構商戶入職計劃的商業分析師。已提供虛構 RACI 政策及三項決策（D1、D2、D3）的現狀 RACI 矩陣。請依政策審查矩陣，修正所有違規處，並提交修正後的責任矩陣及核實清單。另以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡短且以證據為本的交接，約 100 至 180 英文字或相若中文長度，說明修正、所用證據及核實方法。所有角色及記錄均為虛構。

title.zh: 虛構審查簡介及交付項目（模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation brief, not a real company instruction. Scope: three merchant onboarding decisions, D1, D2 and D3, each owning one RACI row across four fictional roles. Deliverables: a corrected responsibility matrix showing the final R, A, C and I value in every cell, a validation checklist that proves the corrected matrix satisfies every supplied rule, and a short written handover. The handover must state each violation found, the correction applied, the source record relied on, and the checks that would confirm the correction. Roles, records and the policy are all fictional. No cost totals, no request routing and no service metrics are in scope.
body.zh: 此為虛構模擬簡介，並非真實公司指示。範圍：三項商戶入職決策 D1、D2 及 D3，各在四個虛構角色上擁有一個 RACI 列。交付項目：修正後的責任矩陣，顯示每個儲存格最終的 R、A、C、I 值；核實清單，證明修正後矩陣符合所有提供規則；以及簡短書面交接。交接須列明發現的每項違規、所採修正、所依據的來源記錄，以及可確認修正的檢查。角色、記錄及政策均為虛構。費用總額、請求路由及服務指標均不在範圍內。

title.en: Fictional RACI Policy and Authorized Assignment Table (Simulation)
title.zh: 虛構 RACI 政策及授權指派表（模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation policy, not a real company rule. Label definitions: R (Responsible) performs the work that completes the decision. A (Accountable) owns final approval and is the only role with a veto. C (Consulted) provides input before the decision. I (Informed) receives the outcome after the decision. Rules applying to every decision: exactly one A. At least one R. A and R must be different roles. Authorized assignment table: D1 Fee waiver approval: A=Compliance Officer, R=Operations Analyst, C=Merchant Success Lead, I=Platform Engineer. D2 SLA change approval: A=Merchant Success Lead, R=Operations Analyst, C=Platform Engineer, I=Compliance Officer. D3 Admin access grant: A=Platform Engineer, R=Compliance Officer, C=Operations Analyst, I=Merchant Success Lead. Any cell that differs from this table is a violation.
body.zh: 此為虛構模擬政策，並非真實公司規則。標籤定義：R（負責）執行完成決策的工作。A（當責）擁有最終批准權，且為唯一具否決權的角色。C（諮詢）在決策前提供意見。I（知會）在決策後收到結果。適用於每項決策的規則：僅有一個 A。至少有一個 R。A 與 R 必須為不同角色。授權指派表：D1 費用豁免：A=合規主任，R=營運分析師，C=商戶成功主管，I=平台工程師。D2 服務水平協議變更：A=商戶成功主管，R=營運分析師，C=平台工程師，I=合規主任。D3 管理員權限授予：A=平台工程師，R=合規主任，C=營運分析師，I=商戶成功主管。任何與此表不同的儲存格即屬違規。

exemplar.en: RACI audit handover, fictional merchant onboarding simulation. Sources used: raci-policy (label definitions, rules, authorized assignment table) and raci-matrix (as-is rows D1, D2, D3). Findings. D1 carries two Accountable entries (Merchant Success Lead, Compliance Officer) and no Responsible. D2 carries one Accountable entry but no Responsible. D3 carries two Accountable entries (Compliance Officer, Platform Engineer) and no Responsible. Corrections per the authorized table. D1: Merchant Success Lead A to C, Operations Analyst C to R, Compliance Officer stays A, Platform Engineer stays I. D2: Operations Analyst blank to R, all other cells unchanged. D3: Compliance Officer A to R, Platform Engineer stays A, Operations Analyst stays C, Merchant Success Lead stays I. Validation checklist: each decision has exactly one Accountable, at least one Responsible, and Accountable differs from Responsible, and every cell matches the authorized table. Next step: publish the corrected matrix and re-run this audit. All records are fictional. No real company policy is represented.
exemplar.zh: RACI 審查交接，虛構商戶入職模擬。所用來源：raci-policy（標籤定義、規則、授權指派表）及 raci-matrix（現狀列 D1、D2、D3）。發現。D1 有兩個當責項目（商戶成功主管、合規主任）且無負責。D2 有一個當責項目但無負責。D3 有兩個當責項目（合規主任、平台工程師）且無負責。依授權表修正。D1：商戶成功主管由 A 改為 C，營運分析師由 C 改為 R，合規主任維持 A，平台工程師維持 I。D2：營運分析師由空白改為 R，其餘儲存格不變。D3：合規主任由 A 改為 R，平台工程師維持 A，營運分析師維持 C，商戶成功主管維持 I。核實清單：每項決策僅一個當責、至少一個負責、當責與負責為不同角色，且每個儲存格與授權表一致。下一步：發佈修正後矩陣並重新審查。所有記錄均為虛構。不代表任何真實公司政策。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. Q1 Platform Engineer as D3 Accountable, Q2 Operations Analyst as D2 Responsible, Q3 set-a, and Q4 flagging D1 and D3 all match the authorized assignment table, and you correctly note each of D1, D2 and D3 has no valid Responsible as-is.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。Q1 平台工程師為 D3 當責、Q2 營運分析師為 D2 負責、Q3 選 set-a、Q4 指出 D1 及 D3，均與授權指派表一致，你亦正確指出 D1、D2、D3 現狀均無有效負責角色。

feedback.en: Each correction is tied to the raci-policy authorized table and to the specific as-is rows D1, D2 and D3 in raci-matrix, with the two Accountable and missing Responsible patterns stated clearly. The D2 blank-to-R correction and the D3 Compliance Officer A-to-R change are both justified by the source table.
feedback.zh: 每項修正均連結至 raci-policy 授權表及 raci-matrix 的 D1、D2、D3 現狀列，清楚說明兩個當責及欠缺負責的情況。D2 由空白改為 R 及 D3 合規主任由 A 改為 R 均有來源表支持。

feedback.en: Your checklist covers the three policy rules and full cell-level match to the authorized table, and the next step of publishing the corrected matrix and re-running the audit is concrete. To strengthen it, name who re-runs the audit and when.
feedback.zh: 你的核實清單涵蓋三項政策規則及逐格與授權表比對，發佈修正矩陣並重新審查的下一步亦具體。可再加強之處為指明由誰及何時重新審查。

feedback.en: You clearly state the case is a fictional simulation with no real company policy represented, and you stay within the supplied raci-policy, raci-matrix and audit-brief without inventing roles or rules. Scope limits are honestly stated.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明此為虛構模擬，不代表任何真實公司政策，並把結論限於提供的 raci-policy、raci-matrix 及 audit-brief，沒有虛構角色或規則。範圍限制交代誠實。

feedback.en: The handover is readable at 155 English words, lists the corrected RACI values per decision, the violations, the checklist and a concrete next step, and cites the source IDs. A reader can act on it directly.

summary.en: Full marks. All four decisions are correct, every correction is sourced to the authorized table, and the handover is concise, verifiable and properly bounded to the fictional simulation. No material gaps found.
summary.zh: 滿分。四項決策全部正確，每項修正均有授權表依據，交接簡潔、可核實，並恰當限於虛構模擬。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Add a compact before-and-after table showing the final R, A, C, I value in every cell for D1, D2 and D3 so a reviewer can confirm the corrected matrix at a glance. Also name the owner and target date for re-running the audit.

title.en: Audit and Correct a RACI Matrix for Merchant Programme Approvals

brief.en: This is an independent fictional learning simulation inspired by a Hong Kong delivery platform. It is not endorsed by and does not represent any real company. You are a business analyst on a fictional merchant programme. Deliverables: a corrected responsibility matrix covering all fifteen cells of decisions K1, K2 and K3, a validation checklist proving every row meets the policy, and a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 English words or a comparable Chinese length, naming each correction and the check that confirms it. All roles, records and rules are fictional.
brief.zh: 此為受香港配送平台啟發的獨立虛構學習模擬，未經任何真實公司認可，亦不代表任何真實公司。你是虛構商戶計劃的商業分析師。交付項目：涵蓋決策 K1、K2、K3 全部十五個儲存格的修正後責任矩陣、證明每列符合政策的核實清單，以及以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫的簡短證據為本交接，約 100 至 180 英文字或相若中文長度，列明每項修正及確認該修正的檢查。所有角色、記錄及規則均為虛構。

title.zh: 虛構審查簡介及交付項目（模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation brief, not a real company instruction. Scope: three fictional merchant programme decisions, K1, K2 and K3, each owning one RACI row across five fictional roles: Merchant Requester, Operations Analyst, Compliance Approver, Platform Engineer and Finance Officer. Deliverables: a corrected matrix showing the final R, A, C or I value in every cell, a validation checklist showing that each row satisfies every supplied policy rule, and a short written handover that states each correction, the source record relied on and the checks that confirm it. No cost totals, request routing or service metrics are in scope.
body.zh: 此為虛構模擬簡介，並非真實公司指示。範圍：三項虛構商戶計劃決策 K1、K2 及 K3，各在五個虛構角色上擁有一個 RACI 列：商戶申請人、營運分析師、合規審批人、平台工程師及財務主任。交付項目：修正後矩陣，顯示每個儲存格最終的 R、A、C 或 I 值；核實清單，顯示每列符合所有提供政策規則；以及簡短書面交接，列明每項修正、所依據的來源記錄及確認該修正的檢查。費用總額、請求路由及服務指標均不在範圍內。

title.en: Fictional RACI Policy, Derivations and Separation Rules (Simulation)
title.zh: 虛構 RACI 政策、推導規則及職責分離規則（模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation policy, not a real company rule. Labels: R performs the work that completes the decision. A owns final approval and is the only role with a veto. C gives input before the decision. I receives the outcome after. Every decision row must have exactly one A, exactly one R and exactly one C, and those three roles must differ. The requester recorded in the request register is never A or R, and receives I unless already C. Every remaining role is blank. Approval: K1 payout account change and K3 data export permission, Accountable is Compliance Approver. K2 surcharge rule change, Accountable is Finance Officer. Execution: account and rule changes, Responsible is Operations Analyst. Access grants, Responsible is Platform Engineer. Consultation: K1 Finance Officer, K2 Compliance Approver, K3 Operations Analyst.
body.zh: 此為虛構模擬政策，並非真實公司規則。標籤：R 執行完成決策的工作。A 擁有最終批准權，且為唯一具否決權的角色。C 在決策前提供意見。I 在決策後收到結果。每列決策必須恰好有一個 A、恰好一個 R 及恰好一個 C，且該三個角色必須不同。請求登記冊所載的申請人永不擔任 A 或 R，且除非已是 C，否則獲指派 I。其餘角色一律留空。審批：K1 收款帳戶變更及 K3 資料匯出權限，當責者為合規審批人。K2 附加費規則變更，當責者為財務主任。執行：帳戶及規則變更，負責者為營運分析師。權限授予，負責者為平台工程師。諮詢：K1 財務主任、K2 合規審批人、K3 營運分析師。

exemplar.en: Corrected matrix (blank means no assignment). K1: MerchantRequester=I, OperationsAnalyst=R, ComplianceApprover=A, PlatformEngineer=blank, FinanceOfficer=C. K2: MerchantRequester=blank, OperationsAnalyst=R, ComplianceApprover=C, PlatformEngineer=I, FinanceOfficer=A. title.zh: 例外生命週期及負責人合約

body.en: Fictional simulation. Merchant Operations maintains exception records for delivery requests. Lifecycle states are OPEN, PENDING_HANDOVER, REOPENED, CLOSED and CANCELLED. Terminal end-states are CLOSED and CANCELLED. Owner contract: a CANCELLED record must have assignedQueue = NONE and handoverPending = false. A CLOSED record must have assignedQueue not NONE and handoverPending = false. A PENDING_HANDOVER record must have handoverPending = true and assignedQueue not NONE. Any record whose lastEventAt is after the query time 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT is OUT_OF_SCOPE and must not be counted as a violation. A correction must keep the record's observedState unchanged. Events are reviewed in eventSeq order. The last event at or before query time sets observedState. All timestamps use UTC+08:00.
body.zh: 虛構模擬。商戶營運部為配送請求保留例外記錄。生命週期狀態為 OPEN、PENDING_HANDOVER、REOPENED、CLOSED 及 CANCELLED。終止完成狀態為 CLOSED 及 CANCELLED。負責人合約：CANCELLED 記錄必須 assignedQueue = NONE 且 handoverPending = false。CLOSED 記錄必須 assignedQueue 不為 NONE 且 handoverPending = false。PENDING_HANDOVER 記錄必須 handoverPending = true 且 assignedQueue 不為 NONE。任何 lastEventAt 遲於查詢時間 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT 的記錄屬 OUT_OF_SCOPE，不得計為違規。修正必須保持記錄的 observedState 不變。事件按 eventSeq 順序審閱。在查詢時間或之前的最後事件設定 observedState。所有時間戳使用 UTC+08:00。

title.zh: 核對請求

body.en: Fictional simulation message. From Chloe Yuen, Exception Queue Lead. Please reconcile the attached exception_records.csv against the lifecycle and owner contract. Query time is 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT. Treat any event after that time as out of scope. Return a short handover listing each in-scope cancelled record with pending handover, the total in-scope violation count, the full set of field changes needed so each violating cancelled record satisfies the owner contract, and the next owner action. Do not use real Lalamove data.
body.zh: 虛構模擬訊息。由例外隊列主管 Chloe Yuen 發出。請按生命週期及負責人合約核對隨附 exception_records.csv。查詢時間為 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT。任何遲於該時間的事件均視為範圍外。交回簡短交接，列出每個仍待交接的範圍內已取消記錄、範圍內違規總數、讓每項違規已取消記錄符合負責人合約所需的完整欄位修改，以及下一步負責人行動。不要使用真實 Lalamove 資料。

exemplar.en: Handover to Exception Queue Lead. Query time 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT. Three in-scope CANCELLED records still show pending handover and breach the owner contract: R-1001, R-1005 and R-1006. R-1001 has assignedQueue OPS-A and handoverPending true. R-1005 has assignedQueue OPS-B and handoverPending true. R-1006 has assignedQueue NONE but handoverPending true. The contract requires CANCELLED records to have assignedQueue NONE and handoverPending false. R-1003 is compliant. R-1002 is PENDING_HANDOVER, not cancelled. R-1004 is CLOSED and compliant. R-1007 is excluded because its lastEventAt 2026-10-15T18:30:00+08:00 is after query time, so it is OUT_OF_SCOPE. Total in-scope violations: 3. Complete fixes: for R-1001 and R-1005 set assignedQueue to NONE and handoverPending to false; for R-1006 set handoverPending to false and keep assignedQueue NONE. Next step: apply those changes, then re-run the query at 2026-10-15 18:00 HKT and confirm every CANCELLED row is NONE and false.

body.en: Fictional simulation. Merchant Operations holds exception records for delivery requests. Lifecycle states are OPEN, PENDING_HANDOVER, REOPENED, ASSIGNED, CLOSED and CANCELLED. Terminal end-states are CLOSED and CANCELLED. Owner contract: a REOPENED or ASSIGNED record must have finalOwner other than NONE and handoverPending = false. A PENDING_HANDOVER record must have handoverPending = true and finalOwner = NONE. A CLOSED record must have finalOwner other than NONE and handoverPending = false. A CANCELLED record must have finalOwner = NONE and handoverPending = false. A record violates the contract when it fails any rule that applies to its observedState. Events are read in ascending eventSeq order and the last event at or before the query time sets observedState. Query time is 2026-11-19 17:00 HKT. Any record whose lastEventAt is later than the query time is OUT_OF_SCOPE and is never counted. A correction must keep observedState unchanged. All timestamps use UTC+08:00.
body.zh: 虛構模擬。商戶營運部為配送請求保留例外記錄。生命週期狀態為 OPEN、PENDING_HANDOVER、REOPENED、ASSIGNED、CLOSED 及 CANCELLED。終止完成狀態為 CLOSED 及 CANCELLED。負責人合約：REOPENED 或 ASSIGNED 記錄必須 finalOwner 不為 NONE 且 handoverPending = false。PENDING_HANDOVER 記錄必須 handoverPending = true 且 finalOwner = NONE。CLOSED 記錄必須 finalOwner 不為 NONE 且 handoverPending = false。CANCELLED 記錄必須 finalOwner = NONE 且 handoverPending = false。記錄若不符合其 observedState 適用的任何規則，即屬違反合約。事件按 eventSeq 順序遞增審閱，在查詢時間或之前的最後事件設定 observedState。查詢時間為 2026-11-19 17:00 HKT。任何 lastEventAt 遲於查詢時間的記錄屬 OUT_OF_SCOPE，永不计入。修正必須保持 observedState 不變。所有時間戳使用 UTC+08:00。

exemplar.en: Handover to Marcus Leung, Exception Queue Lead. Evidence from exception_records.csv at query time 2026-11-19 17:00 HKT. Three in-scope records violate the owner contract. E-2001 is REOPENED with finalOwner = NONE, so no final owner was assigned. E-2003 is REOPENED with finalOwner = NONE and handoverPending = true. E-2005 is CANCELLED but still carries finalOwner = OPS-B. Decision and calculations: in-scope violation total is 3 records. Correction for E-2003, keeping observedState = REOPENED, is finalOwner = OPS-A and handoverPending = false. Exclusion: E-2006 is OUT_OF_SCOPE because lastEventAt 2026-11-19T18:45:00+08:00 is later than the query time. E-2002, E-2004 and E-2007 comply with the rules for their states. Risks: no reopening reason codes are supplied, so the cause of the missing final-owner assignments cannot be verified. Next steps: issue corrections for E-2001, E-2003 and E-2005 in eventSeq order, re-run this reconciliation to confirm observedState is unchanged, and add a daily check for REOPENED records with finalOwner = NONE.
exemplar.zh: 交接予例外隊列主管 Marcus Leung。證據來自 exception_records.csv，查詢時間為 2026-11-19 17:00 HKT。三筆範圍內記錄違反負責人合約。E-2001 為 REOPENED 且 finalOwner = NONE，即未分配最終負責人。E-2003 為 REOPENED，finalOwner = NONE 且 handoverPending = true。E-2005 為 CANCELLED 但仍帶有 finalOwner = OPS-B。決策與計算：範圍內違規總數為 3 筆記錄。E-2003 的修正為 finalOwner = OPS-A 及 handoverPending = false，並保持 observedState = REOPENED。排除：E-2006 屬 OUT_OF_SCOPE，因 lastEventAt 2026-11-19T18:45:00+08:00 遲於查詢時間。E-2002、E-2004 及 E-2007 符合其狀態的規則。風險：未提供重新開啟原因碼，無法核實欠缺最終負責人分配的原因。下一步：按 eventSeq 順序為 E-2001、E-2003 及 E-2005 發出修正，重新核對以確認 observedState 不變，並加入每日檢查 REOPENED 且 finalOwner = NONE 的記錄。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: E-2001 and E-2003 are the in-scope REOPENED violations, the in-scope total of 3 correctly adds E-2005 as CANCELLED with finalOwner = OPS-B, E-2003 is fixed by finalOwner = OPS-A with handoverPending = false while keeping REOPENED, and E-2006 is excluded as OUT_OF_SCOPE against the 17:00 HKT boundary.

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to specific rows and clause rules, naming the REOPENED requirement for a non-NONE finalOwner with handoverPending = false, the CANCELLED rule requiring finalOwner = NONE, and the query-time rule for E-2006. E-2002, E-2004 and E-2007 are correctly confirmed as compliant for their observed states.
feedback.zh: 推理緊扣具體記錄行及條款規則，指明 REOPENED 須有非 NONE 最終負責人且 handoverPending = false、CANCELLED 須 finalOwner = NONE，以及 E-2006 的查詢時間規則。E-2002、E-2004 及 E-2007 亦按其 observedState 正確確認為合規。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and named: issuing corrections for E-2001, E-2003 and E-2005 in eventSeq order, re-running the reconciliation to confirm observedState is unchanged, and adding a recurring REOPENED-without-finalOwner check. feedback.zh: 你把結論限於所提供摘錄及查詢時間，並指出沒有重新開啟原因碼，故無法核實欠缺負責人分配的原因。若補上一句說明此為虛構模擬、使用合成記錄而非真實平台資料，範圍限定會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable at 155 English words, listing each violating record with its breach, the total of 3, the exact E-2003 correction, the E-2006 exclusion and a lead-owned next action. A reader could act on it without re-deriving the analysis.

The only minor gap is that the handover does not explicitly state the scenario is a fictional simulation with synthetic records, though it does limit conclusions to the supplied extract.

brief.en: You are a business analyst at a fictional delivery platform inspired by Lalamove. The merchant portal feature has approved requirements and a test evidence log. Link each approved requirement to valid acceptance evidence, identify missing or conflicting trace links, and produce a concise handover. Use the traceability policy and provided CSVs. brief.zh: 你是一位受 Lalamove 啟發的虛構配送平台的商業分析師。商戶平台功能有已批准需求及測試證據記錄。把每項已批准需求連結至有效接納證據，找出缺失或衝突的追溯連結，並撰寫簡潔交接。使用追溯政策及提供的 CSV。所有數據均為虛構，僅供學習。此模擬不獲 Lalamove 認可。

title.zh: 需求追溯政策

body.en: Policy: 1. A requirement is verified only if it has at least one linked test case with status PASS. 2. A link is conflicting if the test case scope does not include the requirement domain. 3. Test cases with status FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN provide no valid acceptance evidence. 4. Only requirements with status APPROVED are in scope. 5. Domains are Onboarding, Pricing, Reporting, Order Management, Profile.
body.zh: 政策：1. 需求僅在至少有一個狀態為 PASS 的連結測試案例時才視為已驗證。2. 若測試案例範圍不包含需求領域，則該連結為衝突。3. 狀態為 FAIL、BLOCKED 或 NOT RUN 的測試案例不提供有效接納證據。4. 僅狀態為 APPROVED 的需求在範圍內。5. 領域包括 Onboarding、Pricing、Reporting、Order Management、Profile。

brief.en: You are a business analyst supporting a fictional merchant portal review inspired by Lalamove. Answer the four questions and write a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words covering decisions, evidence, next steps and scope limits. All records are fictional learning data. This simulation is not endorsed by Lalamove.
brief.zh: 你是一位商業分析師，支援一項受 Lalamove 啟發的虛構商戶平台審查。已批准需求登記冊列明每項需求的現行已批准版本，證據記錄則顯示每個測試案例所對應的需求版本。請依追溯政策判斷哪些需求已獲驗證、哪些證據已過時，以及哪個連結有衝突。回答四條問題，並撰寫約 100 至 180 字（中文相若）的簡潔交接，涵蓋決策、證據、下一步及範圍限制。所有記錄均為虛構學習數據。此模擬不獲 Lalamove 認可。

title.zh: 需求版本追溯政策

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this traceability review. Scope: only requirements with status APPROVED are in scope. Verified: a requirement is verified only when at least one linked test case has status PASS, was executed against the requirement current_version, and has a test_domain equal to the requirement domain. Stale: evidence executed against a requirement version lower than current_version gives no valid acceptance evidence. Conflicting: a link is conflicting when the test_domain differs from the requirement domain, even if the version matches and the status is PASS. Invalid status: FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT RUN give no valid acceptance evidence. Domains: Onboarding, Pricing, Reporting, Order Management, Profile.
body.zh: 本追溯審查的虛構學習政策。範圍：僅狀態為 APPROVED 的需求在範圍內。已驗證：只有當至少一個連結測試案例狀態為 PASS、對需求的 current_version 執行，且其 test_domain 等於需求領域時，該需求才視為已驗證。過時：對低於 current_version 的需求版本執行的證據，不提供有效接納證據。衝突：當 test_domain 與需求領域不同時，即使版本相符且狀態為 PASS，該連結仍屬衝突。無效狀態：FAIL、BLOCKED 及 NOT RUN 不提供有效接納證據。領域：Onboarding、Pricing、Reporting、Order Management、Profile。

exemplar.en: Merchant portal traceability review. Fictional simulation inspired by Lalamove and not endorsed by the company. Sources are the traceability policy, the requirement register and the test evidence log. Verified: REQ-101 through TC-201 at version 3 with an Onboarding domain match. REQ-102 through TC-203 at version 2. REQ-103 through TC-210 at version 4 with a Reporting match. REQ-104 through TC-205 at version 2. REQ-105 through TC-207 at version 1. Not verified: REQ-106, because TC-206 is FAIL and TC-209 is BLOCKED, both at current version 5, so neither gives valid acceptance evidence. Stale evidence: TC-202, executed against REQ-101 version 2 while current version is 3, and TC-204, executed against REQ-103 version 3 while current version is 4. Conflicting link: TC-208 is a Pricing case linked to Reporting requirement REQ-103, so it is invalid even though version 4 matches. Next steps: re-run TC-206 against version 5 for a PASS, re-run TC-204 at version 4, and reassign TC-208. Owner is the business analysis team, escalating the domain mismatch to the test lead. All records are synthetic.
exemplar.zh: 商戶平台追溯審查。此為受 Lalamove 啟發的虛構模擬，不獲該公司認可。來源為追溯政策、需求登記冊及測試證據記錄。已驗證：REQ-101 經 TC-201 於版本 3 執行且 Onboarding 領域相符。REQ-102 經 TC-203 於版本 2。REQ-103 經 TC-210 於版本 4 且 Reporting 相符。REQ-104 經 TC-205 於版本 2。REQ-105 經 TC-207 於版本 1。未驗證：REQ-106，因 TC-206 為 FAIL 而 TC-209 為 BLOCKED，兩者均在現行版本 5，故均不提供有效接納證據。過時證據：TC-202 對 REQ-101 版本 2 執行而現行為版本 3，TC-204 對 REQ-103 版本 3 執行而現行為版本 4。衝突連結：TC-208 為 Pricing 案例卻連結至 Reporting 需求 REQ-103，故即使版本 4 相符仍屬無效。下一步：對版本 5 重新執行 TC-206 取得 PASS、對版本 4 重新執行 TC-204，並重新指派 TC-208。責任方為商業分析團隊，並把領域不符升級至測試主管。所有記錄均為合成數據。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: REQ-106 has no valid evidence, TC-208 is the conflicting link (Pricing case on Reporting REQ-103), TC-202 and TC-204 are the two stale cases, and REQ-106 is resolved by re-running TC-206 at version 5. Verified sets for REQ-101, REQ-102, REQ-104 and REQ-105 are also correctly mapped.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：REQ-106 沒有有效證據、TC-208 屬衝突連結（Pricing 案例卻連結 Reporting 的 REQ-103）、TC-202 及 TC-204 為兩個過時案例，而 REQ-106 須對版本 5 重新執行 TC-206 解決。REQ-101、REQ-102、REQ-104 及 REQ-105 的已驗證對應亦正確。

feedback.en: Reasoning ties each decision to specific records and versions, for example TC-202 against REQ-101 v2 versus current v3, and correctly explains that FAIL and BLOCKED give no acceptance evidence. It would be stronger if it named the policy clauses on stale, conflicting and invalid status explicitly.
feedback.zh: 推理把每項決策連結至具體記錄及版本，例如 TC-202 對 REQ-101 v2 而現行為 v3，並正確說明 FAIL 及 BLOCKED 不提供接納證據。若能明確指出政策中關於過時、衝突及無效狀態的條文會更佳。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and correct: re-run TC-206 at version 5 for a PASS, re-run TC-204 at version 4, and reassign the mislinked TC-208. Ownership sits with the business analysis team and the domain mismatch escalates to the test lead as required.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體且正確：對版本 5 重新執行 TC-206 取得 PASS、對版本 4 重新執行 TC-204，並重新指派錯誤連結的 TC-208。責任方為商業分析團隊，領域不符已按需要升級至測試主管。

feedback.en: The handover clearly states this is a fictional simulation inspired by Lalamove and not endorsed by the company, and notes all records are synthetic. Claims stay limited to the supplied register, evidence log and policy.

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, clearly separating verified requirements, unverified REQ-106, stale evidence, the conflicting link and next actions. The 172-word length sits comfortably within the 100 to 180 word guide.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，清楚分開已驗證需求、未驗證的 REQ-106、過時證據、衝突連結及下一步行動。全文 172 字，穩在 100 至 180 字的指引範圍內。

summary.en: Excellent submission. All four structured answers are correct and the written handover accurately applies the traceability policy with specific record evidence, correct next steps and clear scope limits. No material gaps found.

nextSteps.en: No corrections are required. For a stronger handover you could explicitly name the policy clauses (scope, verified, stale, conflicting, invalid status) behind each decision rather than only the records.

title.en: Prepare an expense timing schedule (prepaid service, equal months)
title.zh: 準備費用時點表（預付服務，月數相等）

brief.en: Independent learning simulation, not endorsed by any real organisation. You support a fictional shared-services accounting team. Using the public policy and the input-only data file, prepare a prepaid expense timing schedule for the reporting period 2026-07 to 2026-09. Show one row per item with the monthly charge, the expense for the period and the closing prepaid balance at 2026-09-30, then give totals. Deliver a finished schedule plus a short English or Traditional Chinese handover of about 100 to 180 words with evidence, decisions, risks and next steps. The Finance Team Lead must review the schedule before posting.
brief.zh: 此為獨立學習模擬，並非任何真實機構認可。你支援一個虛構的共享服務會計團隊。請根據公開政策及只含輸入資料的檔案，為 2026-07 至 2026-09 報告期間編製預付費用時點表。每項列出一行，顯示每月金額、期間費用及 2026-09-30 預付結餘，並列出總數。交付完成時間表，並附約 100 至 180 字英文或繁體中文交接說明，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。時間表須由財務團隊主管覆核後方可入帳。

title.zh: 預付費用確認政策（虛構模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Reporting period covers service months 2026-07, 2026-08 and 2026-09 only. Every prepaid item is charged straight line across its equal service months. Monthly charge = total_prepaid_hkd divided by service_months. A service month is charged to the reporting period when it is one of the three months above. Period expense = monthly charge multiplied by the number of that item's service months inside the period. Closing prepaid balance at 2026-09-30 = total_prepaid_hkd minus every service month up to and including 2026-09. Amounts are in HKD with no rounding and no tax treatment. Mandatory review owner: Finance Team Lead.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。報告期間只涵蓋服務月份 2026-07、2026-08 及 2026-09。每項預付費用按相等服務月數直線分攤。每月金額等於 total_prepaid_hkd 除以 service_months。當某服務月份屬於上述三個月，該月即計入報告期間。期間費用等於每月金額乘以該項目落在期間內的服務月數。2026-09-30 預付結餘等於 total_prepaid_hkd 減去截至 2026-09（含該月）的所有服務月份。金額單位為港元，不設四捨五入，不作稅務處理。強制覆核人：財務團隊主管。

title.zh: 只含輸入資料的預付合約檔案

body.en:
Every value below is an input only, no result is prefilled. total_prepaid_hkd is the whole amount paid in advance, in Hong Kong dollars. service_months is the number of equal monthly service periods covered. first_service_month is the first service month in YYYY-MM form.
```csv
item_id,description,total_prepaid_hkd,service_months,first_service_month
p-01,Cloud platform subscription,48000,24,2026-07
p-02,Equipment maintenance plan,27000,18,2026-07
p-03,Office security monitoring,12000,12,2026-08
p-04,Training licence bundle,9600,6,2026-06
p-05,Courier service retainer,15000,5,2026-09
```
body.zh:
以下每個數值均只是輸入資料，沒有預填任何結果。total_prepaid_hkd 是預先支付的總額，單位為港元。service_months 是所涵蓋相等月度服務期的數目。first_service_month 是首個服務月份，格式為 YYYY-MM。
```csv
item_id,description,total_prepaid_hkd,service_months,first_service_month
p-01,Cloud platform subscription,48000,24,2026-07
p-02,Equipment maintenance plan,27000,18,2026-07
p-03,Office security monitoring,12000,12,2026-08
p-04,Training licence bundle,9600,6,2026-06
p-05,Courier service retainer,15000,5,2026-09
```

title.en: Request from the Finance Team Lead
title.zh: 財務團隊主管的要求

body.en: Please prepare the prepaid expense timing schedule for the period ending 2026-09-30. Use one row per item from the data file and show the monthly charge, the expense for the period and the closing prepaid balance. One contract began before the reporting period, so part of its cost was already charged earlier and is not available to this period. Accrued items are out of scope this cycle. Send the finished schedule and a short handover for my review and sign-off before anything is posted.
body.zh: 請為截至 2026-09-30 的期間編製預付費用時點表。按資料檔案每項一行，顯示每月金額、期間費用及預付結餘。其中一份合約在報告期間之前已開始，部分成本已在較早月份計入，不屬於本期間。本期不處理應計項目。請把完成的時間表及簡短交接說明交給我覆核及簽署，之後才可入帳。

label.en: What total prepaid expense, in HKD, is recognised for the reporting period 2026-07 to 2026-09?
label.zh: 2026-07 至 2026-09 報告期間確認的預付費用總額是多少港元？

label.en: What total closing prepaid balance, in HKD, is reported at 2026-09-30?
label.zh: 2026-09-30 的預付結餘總額是多少港元？

label.en: Which item's service period began before the reporting period, so part of its total prepaid amount was already charged in an earlier period?
label.zh: 哪一項的服務期在報告期間之前已開始，使其部分預付總額已在較早月份計入？

label.en: Which items have a closing prepaid balance at 2026-09-30 strictly below 12,000 HKD? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些項目在 2026-09-30 的預付結餘嚴格低於 12,000 港元？請選出所有適用項目。

exemplar.en: Prepaid expense timing schedule, reporting period 2026-07 to 2026-09, prepared from the input-only data file under the published policy. Monthly charge equals total_prepaid_hkd divided by service_months. p-01 48,000 over 24 months is 2,000 monthly, 3 months in period gives 6,000 expense, closing 42,000. p-02 27,000 over 18 months is 1,500, 3 months gives 4,500, closing 22,500. p-03 12,000 over 12 months is 1,000, only August and September fall in the period so expense is 2,000, closing 10,000. p-04 9,600 over 6 months is 1,600, three months fall in the period so expense is 4,800, and closing is 3,200 after the June month charged in an earlier period. p-05 15,000 over 5 months is 3,000, only September falls in the period so expense is 3,000, closing 12,000. Total period expense 20,300 HKD. Total closing prepaid 89,700 HKD, which reconciles as total paid 111,600 HKD less 21,900 HKD charged to date. Risks: p-04 relies on the earlier June charge and carries no separate opening balance in the file, and p-05 closes at exactly 12,000 HKD so it is excluded from the strictly-below-12,000 list. No accruals are in scope this cycle and no tax treatment is applied. Next step: the Finance Team Lead reviews and signs off before the schedule is posted.
exemplar.zh: 預付費用時點表，報告期間 2026-07 至 2026-09，按已公布政策從只含輸入資料的檔案編製。每月金額等於 total_prepaid_hkd 除以 service_months。p-01 為 48,000 除以 24 個月，每月 2,000，期間內三個月，費用 6,000，結餘 42,000。p-02 為 27,000 除以 18 個月，每月 1,500，三個月費用 4,500，結餘 22,500。p-03 為 12,000 除以 12 個月，每月 1,000，只有八月及九月落在期間內，費用 2,000，結餘 10,000。p-04 為 9,600 除以 6 個月，每月 1,600，三個月落在期間內，費用 4,800，扣除較早月份已計入的六月後結餘 3,200。p-05 為 15,000 除以 5 個月，每月 3,000，只有九月落在期間內，費用 3,000，結餘 12,000。期間費用總額 20,300 港元。預付結餘總額 89,700 港元，核對為已付總額 111,600 港元減去至今已計入的 21,900 港元。風險：p-04 依賴較早的六月計入，檔案未另列期初結餘；p-05 結餘剛好為 12,000 港元，故不列入嚴格低於 12,000 的名單。本期不處理應計項目，亦不作稅務處理。下一步：由財務團隊主管覆核及簽署後才入帳。

feedback.en: All five rows are correct: monthly charges 2,000 / 1,500 / 1,000 / 1,600 / 3,000, period expenses 6,000 / 4,500 / 2,000 / 4,800 / 3,000, and closing balances 42,000 / 22,500 / 10,000 / 3,200 / 12,000. Totals 20,300 HKD expense and 89,700 HKD closing are right, and the structured answers identify p-04 as the prior-period item and p-03 plus p-04 as strictly below 12,000 HKD.

Each monthly charge is tied to total_prepaid_hkd divided by service_months, and you cite the specific timing facts: p-03 starting 2026-08 with only two months in period, p-05 starting 2026-09 with one month, and p-04 starting 2026-06 so one month falls outside. The reasoning is complete and traceable to the supplied data file.

title.en: Prepare an accrued expense timing schedule (services received, invoices not yet received)
title.zh: 準備應計費用時點表（已收服務，未收發票）

brief.en: Independent learning simulation, not endorsed by any real organisation. You support a fictional shared-services accounting team. Using the public policy and the input-only data file, prepare an accrued expense timing schedule for the reporting period 2026-10 to 2026-12. Show one row per item with the monthly amount, the expense for the period and the accrued balance at 2026-12-31, then give totals. Deliver the finished schedule plus a short English or Traditional Chinese handover of about 100 to 180 words covering evidence, decisions, risks and next steps. The Finance Team Lead must review and sign off before posting.
brief.zh: 此為獨立學習模擬，並非任何真實機構認可。你支援一個虛構的共享服務會計團隊。請根據公開政策及只含輸入資料的檔案，為 2026-10 至 2026-12 報告期間編製應計費用時點表。每項列出一行，顯示每月金額、期間費用及 2026-12-31 應計結餘，並列出總數。交付完成的時間表，並附約 100 至 180 字英文或繁體中文交接說明，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。時間表須由財務團隊主管覆核及簽署後方可入帳。

title.zh: 應計費用確認政策（虛構模擬）

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. The reporting period covers service months 2026-10, 2026-11 and 2026-12 only. Each item is a service already received from a supplier, charged evenly over equal monthly service periods. Monthly amount equals total_invoice_hkd divided by service_months. Period expense equals the monthly amount multiplied by the number of that item's service months inside the reporting period. The accrued balance at 2026-12-31 equals the monthly amount multiplied by the service months delivered up to and including 2026-12 that are not yet covered by an invoice received. The column invoiced_through_month shows the last service month covered by a received invoice, and none means no invoice has been received. Amounts are in HKD, no rounding, no tax treatment. Mandatory review owner: Finance Team Lead.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。報告期間只涵蓋服務月份 2026-10、2026-11 及 2026-12。每項均為已從供應商收到的服務，按相等月度服務期平均分攤。每月金額等於 total_invoice_hkd 除以 service_months。期間費用等於每月金額乘以該項目落在報告期間內的服務月數。2026-12-31 應計結餘等於每月金額乘以截至 2026-12（含該月）已交付但尚未由已收發票涵蓋的服務月數。invoiced_through_month 欄顯示已收發票涵蓋的最後服務月份，none 表示尚未收到發票。金額單位為港元，不設四捨五入，不作稅務處理。強制覆核人：財務團隊主管。

title.zh: 只含輸入資料的服務合約檔案

body.en:
Every value below is an input only, no result is prefilled. total_invoice_hkd is the full contract amount for the service, in Hong Kong dollars. service_months is the number of equal monthly service periods. first_service_month is the first service month in YYYY-MM form. invoiced_through_month is the last service month already covered by a supplier invoice received, or none. The simulated cut-off date for accrual is 2026-12-31.
```csv
item_id,description,total_invoice_hkd,service_months,first_service_month,invoiced_through_month
q-01,Cloud data platform service,36000,12,2026-10,none
q-02,Equipment maintenance service,24000,8,2026-11,none
q-03,Office cleaning service,18000,9,2026-09,2026-09
q-04,Training licence service,8000,4,2026-12,none
q-05,Courier service retainer,15000,5,2026-11,2026-11
```
body.zh:
以下每個數值均只是輸入資料，沒有預填任何結果。total_invoice_hkd 是該服務的合約總額，單位為港元。service_months 是相等月度服務期的數目。first_service_month 是首個服務月份，格式為 YYYY-MM。invoiced_through_month 是已收供應商發票涵蓋的最後服務月份，若未收到則為 none。應計模擬截止日為 2026-12-31。
```csv
item_id,description,total_invoice_hkd,service_months,first_service_month,invoiced_through_month
q-01,Cloud data platform service,36000,12,2026-10,none
q-02,Equipment maintenance service,24000,8,2026-11,none
q-03,Office cleaning service,18000,9,2026-09,2026-09
q-04,Training licence service,8000,4,2026-12,none
q-05,Courier service retainer,15000,5,2026-11,2026-11
```

title.en: Request from the Finance Team Lead
title.zh: 財務團隊主管的要求

body.en: Please prepare the accrued expense timing schedule for the period ending 2026-12-31. Use one row per item from the data file and show the monthly amount, the expense for the period and the accrued balance. One contract started before the reporting period, so some of its service relates to earlier months. Treat each contract as running in consecutive months with no suspension. The accrual cut-off is 2026-12-31 and invoices received after that date are ignored for this schedule. Send the finished schedule and a short handover for my review and sign-off before anything is posted.
body.zh: 請為截至 2026-12-31 的期間編製應計費用時點表。按資料檔案每項一行，顯示每月金額、期間費用及應計結餘。其中一份合約在報告期間之前已開始，部分服務屬於較早月份。假設每份合約連續月份執行，並無中斷。應計截止日為 2026-12-31，該日之後收到的發票不計入本表。請把完成的時間表及簡短交接說明交給我覆核及簽署，之後才可入帳。

feedback.en: Concrete checks are proposed: agreeing contract amounts and month counts to supplier contracts, obtaining 2026-12 delivery evidence and routing to the Finance Team Lead for sign-off. feedback.en: You correctly state the consecutive-month assumption and the exclusion of invoices dated after 2026-12-31. You do not explicitly state that the figures rest only on a fictional policy and input-only file, or that tax treatment is out of scope, so scope limiting is only partly covered.

feedback.en: The handover is actionable and complete. It gives the period basis, monthly amounts, 29,000 HKD expense, 26,000 HKD accrual, the q-03 prior-period item, the q-04 and q-05 below-threshold items, source references, risks and the Finance Team Lead sign-off step.

title.en: Review expense submissions: receipts and category caps
title.zh: 審查開支申報：收據與類別上限

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation. You support a small accounting team. Review five synthetic expense claims against Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v3. Apply receipt and category cap rules, record approved eligible amounts and holds with reasons. No reimbursement is processed. Prepare a concise evidence-based written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, target around 100 to 180 words. Cite claim IDs, policy rules and amounts. Owner is Ada Lau, Finance Review Owner (fictional).
brief.zh: 虛構學習模擬。你支援一個小型會計團隊。按《開支資格及審批政策》v3 審查五項合成開支申報。應用收據及類別上限規則，記錄獲批的合資格金額及附理由的暫停項目。不處理任何報銷。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，目標約100至180字。引用申報編號、政策規則及金額。負責人為Ada Lau，財務審查負責人（虛構）。

title.en: Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v3
title.zh: 開支資格及審批政策 v3

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, not an actual company policy. Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v3, effective 1 January 2026. All amounts are HKD. A claim must have an attached original receipt. receipt_attached=no means the whole claim is held and eligible amount is 0. For claims with a receipt, the eligible amount is the lower of the claimed amount and the category cap. Amounts above the cap are held as excess. Category caps: local_transport HKD 300 per claim, client_meal HKD 500 per attendee, office_supplies HKD 800 per claim, conference_fee HKD 2,500 per claim. conference_fee also requires prior_approval=yes. If prior approval is no, the whole claim is held and eligible amount is 0. Review owner: Ms. Ada Lau, Finance Review Owner (fictional). Escalation: Mr. Ken Wong, Finance Manager (fictional).
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，並非實際公司政策。《開支資格及審批政策》v3，2026年1月1日生效。所有金額以港元計。每項申報必須附有正本收據。receipt_attached=no 表示整項申報暫停，合資格金額為0。若申報附有收據，合資格金額為申報金額與類別上限中的較低者。超出上限的金額列作超額暫停。類別上限：local_transport 每項申報300港元，client_meal 每位出席者500港元，office_supplies 每項申報800港元，conference_fee 每項申報2,500港元。conference_fee 另須 prior_approval=yes。若未有事前批准，整項申報暫停，合資格金額為0。審查負責人：Ada Lau女士，財務審查負責人（虛構）。轉交：Ken Wong先生，財務經理（虛構）。

title.zh: 合成開支申報表

body.en:
Input data only, no result or decision is pre-filled. Columns: claim_id is the stable claim identifier. category is the policy category. amount_hkd is the claimed amount in Hong Kong dollars. receipt_attached shows whether an original receipt is present, yes or no. attendee_count is the number of attendees for client meals, blank when not applicable. prior_approval shows whether prior approval is present, yes or no, and is only required for conference_fee. The table lists every claim for review. The blank attendee_count cells are not used for non-client-meal claims.
```csv
claim_id,category,amount_hkd,receipt_attached,attendee_count,prior_approval
C-101,local_transport,260,yes,,no
C-102,client_meal,1600,yes,3,no
C-103,office_supplies,900,no,,no
C-104,conference_fee,2400,yes,,no
C-105,local_transport,320,yes,,no
```
body.zh:
只有原始資料，沒有預填結果或決定。欄位：claim_id 是穩定申報識別碼。category 是政策類別。amount_hkd 是以港元計的申報金額。receipt_attached 顯示是否有正本收據，yes 或 no。attendee_count 是客戶膳食的出席人數，不適用時留空。prior_approval 顯示是否有事前批准，yes 或 no，僅 conference_fee 需要。本表列出所有待審查申報。非客戶膳食申報的 attendee_count 留空儲存格不會使用。
```csv
claim_id,category,amount_hkd,receipt_attached,attendee_count,prior_approval
C-101,local_transport,260,yes,,no
C-102,client_meal,1600,yes,3,no
C-103,office_supplies,900,no,,no
C-104,conference_fee,2400,yes,,no
C-105,local_transport,320,yes,,no
```

title.en: Review instructions from the review owner
title.zh: 審查負責人的審查指示

body.en: From: Ada Lau, Finance Review Owner (fictional). To: Accounting assistant. Please review the five input claims against Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v3. Record approved eligible amounts and all holds with reasons. Do not process any reimbursement. Provide a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, target around 100 to 180 words, covering approved amounts, held amounts and causes, and next checks. Escalate unresolved evidence gaps to Ken Wong, Finance Manager (fictional).
body.zh: 來自：Ada Lau，財務審查負責人（虛構）。致：會計助理。請按《開支資格及審批政策》v3 審查五項原始申報。記錄獲批的合資格金額及所有附理由的暫停項目。不要處理任何報銷。以英文或香港繁體中文提供簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，目標約100至180字，涵蓋獲批金額、暫停金額及原因，以及下一步檢查。未能解決的證據缺口請轉交 Ken Wong，財務經理（虛構）。
