title.en: Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v4
title.zh: 開支資格及審批政策 v4

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, not an actual company policy. Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v4, effective 1 March 2026. All amounts are HKD. Every claim must attach an original receipt, so receipt_attached=no holds the whole claim and the eligible amount is 0. If one receipt_ref appears on more than one claim, the claim with the smallest submission_seq for that receipt_ref is the primary claim and is assessed normally. Every other claim sharing that receipt_ref is held in full as a duplicate, with an eligible amount of 0. A conference_fee claim requires prior_approval=yes, otherwise the whole claim is held and the eligible amount is 0. For assessed claims the eligible amount is the lower of the claimed amount and the category cap, and any amount above the cap is held as excess. Caps: local_transport HKD 300 per claim, client_meal HKD 500 per attendee, office_supplies HKD 800 per claim, conference_fee HKD 2,500 per claim. Review owner: Ms. Priya Nair, Finance Review Owner (fictional). Escalation: Mr. Daniel Cheung, Finance Manager (fictional).
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，並非實際公司政策。《開支資格及審批政策》v4，2026年3月1日生效。所有金額以港元計。每項申報必須附有正本收據，因此 receipt_attached=no 表示整項申報暫停，合資格金額為0。若同一 receipt_ref 出現在多於一項申報，該 receipt_ref 中 submission_seq 最小者為主申報，按正常規則評估。共用同一 receipt_ref 的其他申報一律因重複而全額暫停，合資格金額為0。conference_fee 申報須 prior_approval=yes，否則整項申報暫停，合資格金額為0。經評估的申報，合資格金額為申報金額與類別上限中的較低者，超出上限的部分列作超額暫停。上限：local_transport 每項300港元，client_meal 每位出席者500港元，office_supplies 每項800港元，conference_fee 每項2,500港元。審查負責人：Priya Nair女士，財務審查負責人（虛構）。轉交：Daniel Cheung先生，財務經理（虛構）。

title.zh: 合成開支申報表

body.en:
Input data only. No decision, eligible amount or held amount is pre-filled. claim_id is the stable claim identifier. category is the policy category. amount_hkd is the claimed amount in Hong Kong dollars. receipt_ref is the receipt reference shown on the claim. receipt_attached is yes or no. attendee_count is the number of attendees for client meals and is blank when not applicable. prior_approval is yes or no. submission_seq is the order in which the claim was submitted, where 1 is earliest. All six claims for review are listed.
```csv
claim_id,category,amount_hkd,receipt_ref,receipt_attached,attendee_count,prior_approval,submission_seq
C-201,local_transport,280,R-7001,yes,,no,3
C-202,client_meal,1600,R-7002,yes,3,no,5
C-203,conference_fee,2400,R-7003,yes,,no,2
C-204,office_supplies,900,R-7004,no,,no,4
C-205,local_transport,320,R-7001,yes,,no,1
C-206,conference_fee,2600,R-7005,yes,,yes,6
```
body.zh:
只有原始資料。沒有預填決定、合資格金額或暫停金額。claim_id 是穩定申報識別碼。category 是政策類別。amount_hkd 是以港元計的申報金額。receipt_ref 是申報所示的收據參考。receipt_attached 為 yes 或 no。attendee_count 是客戶膳食的出席人數，不適用時留空。prior_approval 為 yes 或 no。submission_seq 是提交次序，1 為最早。下表列出所有六項待審查申報。
```csv
claim_id,category,amount_hkd,receipt_ref,receipt_attached,attendee_count,prior_approval,submission_seq
C-201,local_transport,280,R-7001,yes,,no,3
C-202,client_meal,1600,R-7002,yes,3,no,5
C-203,conference_fee,2400,R-7003,yes,,no,2
C-204,office_supplies,900,R-7004,no,,no,4
C-205,local_transport,320,R-7001,yes,,no,1
C-206,conference_fee,2600,R-7005,yes,,yes,6
```

title.en: Review instructions from the review owner
title.zh: 審查負責人的審查指示

body.en: From: Priya Nair, Finance Review Owner (fictional). To: Accounting assistant. Please review the six input claims in the synthetic claims table against Expense Eligibility and Approval Policy v4. Watch for duplicate receipt references, missing original receipts and missing prior approval. Record the eligible amount and any held amount, with reasons, for every claim. Do not process any reimbursement. Send a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, target around 100 to 180 words, covering decisions, amounts, missing evidence and next checks. Escalate unresolved evidence gaps to Daniel Cheung, Finance Manager (fictional).
body.zh: 來自：Priya Nair，財務審查負責人（虛構）。致：會計助理。請按《開支資格及審批政策》v4 審查合成申報表中的六項原始申報。留意重複收據參考、欠缺正本收據及欠缺事前批准。為每項申報記錄合資格金額及任何暫停金額，並附理由。不要處理任何報銷。以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔、以證據為本的交接說明，目標約100至180字，涵蓋決定、金額、欠缺證據及下一步檢查。未能解決的證據缺口請轉交Daniel Cheung，財務經理（虛構）。

exemplar.en:
Handover to Priya Nair, Finance Review Owner (fictional). I reviewed the six synthetic claims against Policy v4. No reimbursement was processed.

Approved eligible amounts: C-205 HKD 300 (local_transport capped at 300, HKD 20 held as excess), C-202 HKD 1,500 (client_meal at 500 times 3 attendees, HKD 100 held as excess), C-206 HKD 2,500 (conference_fee cap, prior approval present, HKD 100 held as excess).

Held in full: C-201 HKD 280 as a duplicate of receipt R-7001, because C-205 has the smaller submission_seq and is the primary claim. C-203 HKD 2,400 because prior_approval=no for a conference_fee. C-204 HKD 900 because no original receipt is attached.

Totals: eligible HKD 4,300 and held HKD 3,800, matching the HKD 8,100 claimed.

Missing evidence: original receipt for C-204, prior approval record for C-203, and confirmation that R-7001 was not billed twice. Escalating unresolved items to Daniel Cheung, Finance Manager (fictional).
exemplar.zh:
交接予Priya Nair，財務審查負責人（虛構）。我已按政策 v4 審查六項合成申報，並無處理任何報銷。

獲批合資格金額：C-205 300港元（local_transport 以300為上限，20港元列作超額暫停）、C-202 1,500港元（client_meal 以500乘3位出席者，100港元列作超額暫停）、C-206 2,500港元（conference_fee 上限，已具事前批准，100港元列作超額暫停）。

全額暫停：C-201 280港元，因與收據 R-7001 重複，而 C-205 的 submission_seq 較小，屬主申報。C-203 2,400港元，因 conference_fee 的 prior_approval=no。C-204 900港元，因未附正本收據。

總額：合資格4,300港元，暫停3,800港元，與申報總額8,100港元相符。

欠缺證據：C-204 的正本收據、C-203 的事前批准記錄，以及 R-7001 未被重複收費的確認。未解決事項轉交Daniel Cheung，財務經理（虛構）。

feedback.en: All six claims are decided correctly: C-205 HKD 300 eligible with HKD 20 excess, C-201 held HKD 280 as the duplicate of R-7001, C-202 HKD 1,500 with HKD 100 excess, C-203 held HKD 2,400 for missing prior approval, C-204 held HKD 900 for no original receipt, C-206 HKD 2,500 with HKD 100 excess, giving eligible HKD 4,300 and held HKD 3,800. Your recorded answers match the same totals and zero-eligible set.
feedback.zh: 六項申報的決定全部正確：C-205 合資格300港元、超額20港元；C-201 因 R-7001 重複而暫停280港元；C-202 合資格1,500港元、超額100港元；C-203 因欠事前批准暫停2,400港元；C-204 因欠正本收據暫停900港元；C-206 合資格2,500港元、超額100港元，總額為合資格4,300港元及暫停3,800港元。你填寫的答案與此總額及零合資格組合一致。

feedback.en: Each decision is tied to the relevant policy v4 rule and claim row, including the smallest submission_seq rule for R-7001, prior_approval=no for conference_fee and receipt_attached=no for C-204, with cap arithmetic shown for client_meal (500 x 3) and conference_fee. Reasoning is specific and traceable.
feedback.zh: 每項決定都連結到政策 v4 的相關條文及申報資料列，包括 R-7001 的最小 submission_seq 規則、conference_fee 的 prior_approval=no 及 C-204 的 receipt_attached=no，並展示 client_meal（500乘3）及 conference_fee 的上限計算。推理具體且可追溯。

feedback.en: You name the missing evidence and the escalation route to Daniel Cheung, which is strong. Add explicit next actions such as requesting the C-204 original receipt and the C-203 approval record, and confirming the C-202 attendee count of 3, so the checks read as tasks rather than statements.

feedback.en: You correctly note no reimbursement was processed and flag R-7001 double-billing as unverified. You could also state explicitly that this is a fictional simulation based only on the six supplied claims and Policy v4, with no real company policy or employee involved.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出沒有處理任何報銷，並把 R-7001 是否重複收費列作未經核實。可再明確說明此為虛構模擬，只根據所提供的六項申報及政策 v4，並不涉及任何真實公司政策或員工。

feedback.en: This is a clean, actionable handover at 157 words covering approved amounts, all held amounts with reasons, both totals, missing evidence and the named review owner and escalation contact. It could be strengthened only by turning the missing-evidence list into concrete next checks.
feedback.zh: 這是一份清晰可行的交接，共157字，涵蓋獲批金額、所有附理由的暫停金額、兩項總額、欠缺證據，以及具名審查負責人與轉交對象。唯一可改進之處是把欠缺證據清單轉化為具體的下一步檢查。

summary.en: All decisions, amounts and totals are correct and clearly explained against Policy v4, with duplicate receipt handling, missing approval, missing receipt and cap excess all applied properly. The main improvement is making the verification section actionable and stating the fictional scope more explicitly.
summary.zh: 所有決定、金額及總額均正確，並按政策 v4 清晰解釋，重複收據、欠批准、欠收據及超額上限均處理妥當。主要改善空間在於把核實部分寫成可執行行動，並更明確說明虛構範圍。

nextSteps.en: Convert the missing-evidence list into dated actions, for example request the C-204 original receipt and C-203 approval record and confirm the C-202 attendee count, then state who owns each follow-up before escalating unresolved gaps to Daniel Cheung. Add one line confirming this is a fictional simulation based only on the six supplied claims and Policy v4.
nextSteps.zh: 把欠缺證據清單轉為附時限的行動，例如索取 C-204 正本收據及 C-203 批准記錄，並確認 C-202 出席人數，再列明每項跟進的負責人，然後才把未解決缺口轉交Daniel Cheung。另加一句說明此為虛構模擬，只根據所提供的六項申報及政策 v4。

title.en: Aged receivables review for a fictional distribution desk
title.zh: 虛構分銷部門的逾期應收款審查

brief.en: Independent fictional learning simulation. You support the receivables desk of a fictional distribution business. The credit control policy and the 31 March 2026 unpaid invoice extract are attached. Applying the policy wording exactly, work out the days past due for each invoice, place it in the correct aging bucket, and decide which follow-up document is required and which named reviewer must clear it first. Deliver a finished working file (aging table with bucket, follow-up document and reviewer per invoice) plus a concise evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decisions, calculations, risks and next steps.
brief.zh: 獨立虛構學習模擬。你支援一間虛構分銷公司的應收帳款組。附件包括信貸控制政策及2026年3月31日的未收款發票摘錄。請嚴格按政策文字，計算每張發票的逾期日數，放入正確的帳齡組別，並決定須採用的跟進文件及須先批核的指明覆核人。交付完成工作檔案（每張發票的帳齡組別、跟進文件及覆核人）及約100至180個英文詞或相若中文的簡明證據式交接，涵蓋證據、決策、計算、風險及下一步。

title.zh: 虛構信貸控制政策（學習模擬）

body.en: Fictional credit control policy. This is a learning simulation and not any company's actual policy. Query date for every calculation: 31 March 2026. An invoice is overdue by the number of days from the day after its due date up to and including the query date. Aging buckets: Current 0 days, bucket 1-30 days, bucket 31-60 days, bucket 61-90 days. Follow-up documents by bucket. Current: monitor only, no document. 1-30 days: statement-reminder, send within 5 working days, no reviewer required. 31-60 days: demand-letter, which Credit Control Officer Lo Wing-yu must review before it is sent. 61-90 days: account-review-memo escalated to Finance Manager Chan Ka-ho, who must approve the account hold before the memo takes effect.
body.zh: 虛構信貸控制政策。此為學習模擬，並非任何公司的實際政策。所有計算的查詢日期：2026年3月31日。發票的逾期日數由到期日翌日起計，直至並包括查詢日期。帳齡組別：即期0日、1至30日組、31至60日組、61至90日組。各組別的跟進文件：即期只作監察，無須文件。1至30日：對帳提示單，於5個工作日內發出，無須覆核人。31至60日：催款函，須由信貸控制主任羅詠瑜覆核後方發出。61至90日：帳戶檢討備忘錄上呈財務經理陳嘉豪，帳戶凍結須由其批准後方生效。

title.en: Unpaid invoice extract as at 31 March 2026

title.zh: 虛構信貸控制政策（學習模擬）

body.en: Fictional credit control policy for an independent learning simulation, not any company's actual policy. Query date for every calculation: 30 June 2026. Days past due are counted from the day after the due date up to and including the query date. Outstanding balance_hkd = invoice_amount_hkd minus settled_hkd, and is never below zero. Buckets: Current 0 days, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91 or more days. Follow-up documents. Current: monitor only. 1-30 days: statement-reminder issued within 5 working days, no reviewer. 31-60 days: demand-letter reviewed by Credit Control Officer Tam Ho-yin before sending. 61-90 days: account-review-memo escalated to Finance Manager Yip Sze-wing, who must approve the account hold. 91 or more days: final-notice letter escalated to Finance Director Ms. Ng Pui-shan, who must approve before issue. An invoice with a zero outstanding balance is closed and receives no document. A disputed invoice is still aged and counted as past due, but no follow-up document is issued while the dispute is open, and Dispute Officer Ms. Ho Yan-ting must log the hold.
body.zh: 虛構信貸控制政策，供獨立學習模擬使用，並非任何公司的實際政策。所有計算的查詢日期：2026年6月30日。逾期日數由到期日翌日起計，直至並包括查詢日期。未收餘額_hkd = 發票金額_hkd 減 已收款_hkd，且不會低於零。組別：即期0日、1至30日、31至60日、61至90日、91日或以上。跟進文件。即期：只作監察。1至30日：對帳提示單，於5個工作日內發出，無須覆核人。31至60日：催款函，須由信貸控制主任譚浩賢於發出前覆核。61至90日：帳戶檢討備忘錄上呈財務經理葉思穎，帳戶凍結須由其批准。91日或以上：最後通知書上呈財務總監吳佩珊女士，須由其批准後方發出。未收餘額為零的發票視為結清，不發出任何文件。有爭議的發票仍須計算帳齡並計入逾期，但在爭議未結期間不得發出任何跟進文件，並須由爭議主任何欣婷記錄凍結。

title.zh: 排列生產單元派工次序

brief.en: Independent learning simulation for a fictional Hong Kong job shop. It is not endorsed by any real company and all records are synthetic. The plan day is day 0 and the cell dispatches one job at a time. Using dispatch rule DS-7 and the six input job records, build the full dispatch queue for the cell. Then write a short handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering the ordered job IDs, how each rule key was applied, the arithmetic used, the checks you ran, any uncertainty, and the next step. Suggested length 100 to 180 words.
brief.zh: 這是一個為虛構香港加工工場而設的獨立學習模擬，未獲任何真實公司認可，所有記錄均為虛構。計劃日為第 0 日，生產單元一次只派出一張工單。請按派工規則 DS-7 及六張輸入工單記錄，為該生產單元建立完整派工隊列。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡短交接，內容包括工單編號次序、各排序鍵的套用方式、所用計算、已進行的核實、任何不確定性及下一步。建議長度 100 至 180 字。

title.zh: 虛構派工規則 DS-7

body.en: Learning simulation, not endorsed by any real company. This cell dispatches one job at a time. Build the queue by sorting all listed jobs in this order. Primary key: earliest due day first, where due day is a whole number of relative working days from the plan day, and day 0 is the plan day. Tie-break 1: priority class, P1 before P2 before P3. Tie-break 2: ascending job ID as a text string. All three keys apply in full and in that order. The sequence owner is K. Lau, Planning Lead, who signs off the queue before release. No other ordering rule applies.
body.zh: 學習模擬，未獲任何真實公司認可。本生產單元一次只派出一張工單。請按以下次序為所有已列工單排序。首要排序鍵：到期日最早者先排，到期日為由計劃日起計的相對工作日整數，第 0 日即計劃日。第一項決勝鍵：優先等級，P1 先於 P2，P2 先於 P3。第二項決勝鍵：工單編號按文字遞升排序。三項排序鍵須依此順序完整套用。派工次序負責人為計劃主管 K. Lau，在放行前簽核隊列。不適用任何其他排序規則。

title.zh: 輸入工單記錄（虛構，僅作輸入）

body.en:
Six released job records for one cell. This file is input only and shows no completion order. Columns: job_id is the stable record identifier. due_day is the promised due day in relative working days from the plan day, unit working days. priority_class is P1, P2 or P3, where P1 is the highest class. estimated_run_minutes is the estimated run time, unit minutes.

```csv
job_id,due_day,priority_class,estimated_run_minutes
JOB-4102,3,P2,45
JOB-4107,1,P3,30
JOB-4113,1,P1,25
JOB-4120,4,P1,60
JOB-4126,2,P2,35
JOB-4131,1,P1,50
```
body.zh:
六張已放行並屬同一生產單元的工單記錄。本檔案僅作輸入，不顯示完成次序。欄位說明：job_id 為穩定記錄識別碼。due_day 為由計劃日起計的承諾到期日，單位為工作日。priority_class 為 P1、P2 或 P3，其中 P1 為最高等級。estimated_run_minutes 為預計運行時間，單位為分鐘。

```csv
job_id,due_day,priority_class,estimated_run_minutes
JOB-4102,3,P2,45
JOB-4107,1,P3,30
JOB-4113,1,P1,25
JOB-4120,4,P1,60
JOB-4126,2,P2,35
JOB-4131,1,P1,50
```

title.zh: 計劃主管的便條

body.en: Note from the planning lead, K. Lau. This is a fictional learning exercise, so please use only the six rows in the input file. I need the cell queue for the plan day before I sign it off. Do not add jobs, do not drop jobs, and do not reorder by estimated minutes. If a job looks urgent but its due day is later, the due day still governs. Send me the queue and the short handover in English or Traditional Chinese.
body.zh: 計劃主管 K. Lau 的便條。這是虛構學習練習，請只使用輸入檔案內的六行記錄。我需要計劃日的生產單元隊列，以便簽核。請勿增加工單、刪除工單，或改用預計分鐘數排序。若某工單看似緊急但到期日較晚，仍以到期日為準。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交隊列及簡短交接。

label.en: Which job is dispatched first under rule DS-7?
label.zh: 按規則 DS-7，哪張工單最先派出？

label.en: Within the due-day-1 group, which pair of jobs is ordered by the job-ID tie-break?
label.zh: 在第 1 日到期的組別內，哪一對工單是以工單編號決勝鍵排序？

label.en: Which jobs are dispatched before JOB-4102? Select every job that applies.
label.zh: 哪些工單在 JOB-4102 之前派出？請選出所有適用者。

label.en: What is the total estimated run time, in minutes, of the first three jobs in the dispatch queue?
label.zh: 派工隊列中首三張工單的預計運行時間總和為多少分鐘？

exemplar.en:
Dispatch queue under rule DS-7: JOB-4113, JOB-4131, JOB-4107, JOB-4126, JOB-4102, JOB-4120.
Method. I sorted the six input records by due day first. Three jobs are due on day 1, so the priority tie-break applies: JOB-4113 and JOB-4131 are P1 and JOB-4107 is P3, so both P1 jobs move ahead of JOB-4107. JOB-4113 and JOB-4131 share the same due day and the same class, so the job-ID tie-break puts JOB-4113 first. The remaining jobs are singletons by due day: day 2 JOB-4126, day 3 JOB-4102, day 4 JOB-4120.
Numbers. The first three jobs run 25 + 50 + 30 = 105 estimated minutes.
Verification. I re-checked that all six records appear exactly once and that no later due day precedes an earlier one.
Uncertainty. The run minutes are estimates only and tooling or material availability is not evidenced.
Next step. K. Lau, Planning Lead, signs off the queue before release.
exemplar.zh:
按規則 DS-7 的派工隊列：JOB-4113、JOB-4131、JOB-4107、JOB-4126、JOB-4102、JOB-4120。
方法：先按到期日排序六張輸入工單。有三張工單在第 1 日到期，因此套用優先等級決勝鍵：JOB-4113 及 JOB-4131 為 P1，JOB-4107 為 P3，故兩張 P1 工單排在 JOB-4107 之前。JOB-4113 與 JOB-4131 的到期日及等級相同，故按工單編號決勝鍵，JOB-4113 先排。其餘工單各自佔一個到期日：第 2 日 JOB-4126，第 3 日 JOB-4102，第 4 日 JOB-4120。
數字：首三張工單運行時間為 25 + 50 + 30 = 105 分鐘（估值）。
核實：已重核六張記錄各出現一次，且隊列中沒有較晚到期日排在較早之前。
不確定性：運行分鐘數僅屬估值，未提供模具或物料可用性的證據。
下一步：由計劃主管 K. Lau 在放行前簽核隊列。

feedback.en: All four decisions match rule DS-7 exactly: the queue JOB-4113, JOB-4131, JOB-4107, JOB-4126, JOB-4102, JOB-4120, first job JOB-4113, the 4113/4131 ID tie-break pair, the four jobs ahead of JOB-4102, and 25 + 50 + 30 = 105 minutes. The three sort keys are applied in the correct order on the six input rows.
feedback.zh: 四項決策完全符合規則 DS-7：隊列為 JOB-4113、JOB-4131、JOB-4107、JOB-4126、JOB-4102、JOB-4120，首張為 JOB-4113，編號決勝對為 4113 與 4131，JOB-4102 之前有四張工單，而 25 + 50 + 30 = 105 分鐘。三項排序鍵已按正確次序套用於六行輸入記錄。

feedback.en: You tie each step to the supplied records: the three day-1 jobs, the P1 ahead of P3 call for JOB-4107, the shared day and class driving the job-ID tie-break, and the day-2/3/4 singletons. This is specific and traceable to the input file.
feedback.zh: 你把每一步連繫至提供記錄：三張第 1 日到期工單、P1 先於 P3 故 JOB-4107 排後、相同到期日及等級觸發編號決勝鍵，以及第 2、3、4 日的單一工單。內容具體並可追溯至輸入檔案。

feedback.en: You check that all six records appear once and that due days never decrease down the queue, which tests the main risks of adding, dropping or misordering a job. Naming K. Lau as sign-off owner is correct, though a release trigger or confirmation of feasibility evidence would complete the next step.
feedback.zh: 你核實六張記錄各出現一次，且隊列中到期日不會遞減，正好測試增刪或錯排工單的主要風險。指明 K. Lau 為簽核負責人正確，若再加上放行觸發條件或可行性證據的確認，下一步會更完整。

feedback.en: You state that run minutes are estimates and that tooling or material availability is not evidenced, which correctly bounds the claim to the synthetic scenario. This is the right level of uncertainty for the exercise.
feedback.zh: 你說明運行分鐘數僅屬估值，並指出未提供模具或物料可用性證據，正確地把聲明限於虛構情境。此不確定性程度對本練習而言恰當。

feedback.en: The handover gives the full ordered job IDs, the applied rule keys, the 105-minute figure and the sign-off owner, so a planner can act on it directly. Length and clarity suit a short shift handover.
feedback.zh: 交接列出完整工單次序、所套用排序鍵、105 分鐘數字及簽核負責人，計劃人員可直接據此行動。篇幅及清晰度適合簡短班次交接。

summary.en: A complete and accurate DS-7 dispatch queue with correct answers, clear rule-key reasoning and a bounded uncertainty note. The only minor gap is that the next step names the sign-off owner but not a concrete release trigger or feasibility confirmation.
summary.zh: DS-7 派工隊列完整準確，答案正確，排序鍵推理清晰，並有適度的不確定性說明。唯一小缺口是下一步只列簽核負責人，未提出具體放行觸發條件或可行性確認。

nextSteps.en: Add one concrete release condition, such as confirming cell capacity and tooling for the 105-minute first three jobs before K. Lau signs off, and flag it as an open item to escalate if capacity is unconfirmed.
nextSteps.zh: 補上一項具體放行條件，例如在 K. Lau 簽核前確認生產單元產能及模具足以應付首三張工單的 105 分鐘，並把產能未確認列為需轉交的待辦事項。

title.zh: 排列計劃日派工隊列

brief.en: Independent learning simulation for a fictional Hong Kong production cell. It is not endorsed by any real company and all records are synthetic. The plan day is day 0 and the cell dispatches one job at a time. Using dispatch rule DS-B and the six input job records, build the plan-day queue of eligible jobs. Then write a short handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering the ordered job IDs, the deferred jobs, how each rule key was applied, the arithmetic used, the checks you ran, any uncertainty, and the next step. Suggested length 100 to 180 words.
brief.zh: 這是一個為虛構香港生產單元而設的獨立學習模擬，未獲任何真實公司認可，所有記錄均為虛構。計劃日為第 0 日，生產單元一次只派出一張工單。請按派工規則 DS-B 及六張輸入工單記錄，建立計劃日合資格工單的派工隊列。然後以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡短交接，內容包括工單編號次序、延後工單、各排序鍵的套用方式、所用計算、已進行的核實、任何不確定性及下一步。建議長度 100 至 180 字。

title.zh: 虛構派工規則 DS-B

body.en: Learning simulation, not endorsed by any real company. All records are synthetic. Dispatch rule DS-B for one production cell. Only jobs with ready_state = yes are eligible for the plan-day queue. Jobs with ready_state = no are deferred and are not sequenced. Sequence all eligible jobs in this order. Primary key: earliest promised day first, where promised day is a whole number of relative working days from the plan day and day 0 is the plan day. Tie-break 1: priority class P1 before P2 before P3. Tie-break 2: ascending job ID as a text string. All three keys apply in full and in that order. Queue owner K. Lau, Planning Lead, signs off before release. No other ordering rule applies.
body.zh: 學習模擬，未獲任何真實公司認可。所有記錄均為虛構。本生產單元適用派工規則 DS-B。只有 ready_state = yes 的工單合資格進入計劃日隊列。ready_state = no 的工單會延後，不納入排序。請按以下次序為所有合資格工單排序。首要排序鍵：承諾到期日最早者先排，承諾到期日為由計劃日起計的相對工作日整數，第 0 日即計劃日。第一項決勝鍵：優先等級，P1 先於 P2，P2 先於 P3。第二項決勝鍵：工單編號按文字遞升排序。三項排序鍵須依此順序完整套用。隊列負責人為計劃主管 K. Lau，在放行前簽核。不適用任何其他排序規則。

title.zh: 輸入工單記錄（虛構，僅作輸入）

body.en:
Six released job records for one cell. This file is input only and shows no completion order. Columns: job_id is the stable record identifier. promised_day is the promised due day in relative working days from the plan day, unit working days. ready_state is yes or no, where yes means eligible for the plan-day queue and no means deferred. priority_class is P1, P2 or P3, where P1 is the highest class. estimated_run_minutes is the estimated run time, unit minutes.

```csv
job_id,promised_day,ready_state,priority_class,estimated_run_minutes
JOB-5210,2,yes,P2,40
JOB-5215,1,no,P1,25
JOB-5221,3,yes,P1,55
JOB-5226,1,yes,P3,30
JOB-5232,2,yes,P1,45
JOB-5238,4,no,P2,60
```
body.zh:
六張已放行並屬同一生產單元的工單記錄。本檔案僅作輸入，不顯示完成次序。欄位說明：job_id 為穩定記錄識別碼。promised_day 為由計劃日起計的承諾到期日，單位為工作日。ready_state 為 yes 或 no，yes 表示合資格進入計劃日隊列，no 表示延後。priority_class 為 P1、P2 或 P3，其中 P1 為最高等級。estimated_run_minutes 為預計運行時間，單位為分鐘。

```csv
job_id,promised_day,ready_state,priority_class,estimated_run_minutes
JOB-5210,2,yes,P2,40
JOB-5215,1,no,P1,25
JOB-5221,3,yes,P1,55
JOB-5226,1,yes,P3,30
JOB-5232,2,yes,P1,45
JOB-5238,4,no,P2,60
```

title.zh: 計劃主管的便條

body.en: Note from the planning lead, K. Lau. This is a fictional learning exercise, so please use only the six rows in the input file. I need the plan-day cell queue before I sign it off. Do not add jobs, do not drop jobs, do not sequence not-ready jobs, and do not reorder by estimated minutes. If a job has an early promised day but is not ready, it must wait. Send me the queue and the short handover in English or Traditional Chinese.
body.zh: 計劃主管 K. Lau 的便條。這是虛構學習練習，請只使用輸入檔案內的六行記錄。我需要計劃日的生產單元隊列，以便簽核。請勿增加工單、刪除工單、為未就緒工單排序，或改用預計分鐘數排序。若某工單承諾到期日較早但尚未就緒，必須等候。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交隊列及簡短交接。

label.en: Which job is dispatched first under rule DS-B?
label.zh: 按規則 DS-B，哪張工單最先派出？

label.en: Which jobs are deferred and not sequenced on the plan day? Select every job that applies.
label.zh: 哪些工單會延後，不納入計劃日排序？請選出所有適用者。

label.en: What is the total estimated run time, in minutes, of the first two jobs in the plan-day dispatch queue?
label.zh: 計劃日派工隊列中首兩張工單的預計運行時間總和為多少分鐘？

label.en: Which job is dispatched third under rule DS-B?
label.zh: 按規則 DS-B，哪張工單第三個派出？

expectedEvidence.en: Correct final plan-day queue is JOB-5226, JOB-5232, JOB-5210, JOB-5221. Deferred jobs are JOB-5215 and JOB-5238. First dispatched job is JOB-5226. Third dispatched job is JOB-5210. First two jobs total 30 + 45 = 75 minutes.

expectedEvidence.zh: 引用規則 DS-B。解釋只有 ready_state = yes 的工單合資格，ready_state = no 的工單會延後。套用最早承諾到期日先排，因此第 1 日的 JOB-5226 領先。在第 2 日套用優先等級決勝鍵，因此 P1 的 JOB-5232 先於 P2 的 JOB-5210。指出 JOB-5215 雖然承諾到期日為第 1 日，但因 ready_state 為 no 而被排除。工單編號決勝鍵可用但未需使用。

exemplar.en: Queue for plan day under DS-B: JOB-5226 (promised day 1, ready, P3), JOB-5232 (day 2, ready, P1), JOB-5210 (day 2, ready, P2), JOB-5221 (day 3, ready, P1). JOB-5215 and JOB-5238 are deferred because ready_state is no. The primary key is earliest promised day, so JOB-5226 leads. At day 2, priority tie-break places P1 JOB-5232 before P2 JOB-5210. No job-ID tie-break was needed. First two jobs run 30 + 45 = 75 minutes. Checks: confirmed four eligible rows, two deferred rows, and no reordering by minutes. Next step: ask K. Lau to confirm when JOB-5215 and JOB-5238 become ready for a later queue.
exemplar.zh: 按 DS-B 的計劃日隊列：JOB-5226（承諾日第 1 日、就緒、P3）、JOB-5232（第 2 日、就緒、P1）、JOB-5210（第 2 日、就緒、P2）、JOB-5221（第 3 日、就緒、P1）。JOB-5215 及 JOB-5238 因 ready_state 為 no 而延後。首要排序鍵為最早承諾到期日，因此 JOB-5226 領先。在第 2 日，優先等級決勝鍵令 P1 的 JOB-5232 先於 P2 的 JOB-5210。未需使用工單編號決勝鍵。首兩張工單運行 30 + 45 = 75 分鐘。核實：確認四行合資格、兩行延後，且沒有改用分鐘數排序。下一步：請 K. Lau 確認 JOB-5215 及 JOB-5238 何時就緒，以供日後隊列使用。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: the queue JOB-5226, JOB-5232, JOB-5210, JOB-5221, deferred JOB-5215 and JOB-5238, first job JOB-5226, third job JOB-5210 and the 30 + 45 = 75 minute total. You applied eligibility, earliest promised day and the priority tie-break exactly as DS-B requires.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：隊列為 JOB-5226、JOB-5232、JOB-5210、JOB-5221，延後者為 JOB-5215 及 JOB-5238，首張為 JOB-5226，第三張為 JOB-5210，首兩張合計 30 + 45 = 75 分鐘。你完全按 DS-B 套用合資格條件、最早承諾到期日及優先等級決勝鍵。

feedback.en: You cite DS-B and tie each decision to the actual records, including ready_state for the two deferred jobs and the day-2 priority tie-break between P1 JOB-5232 and P2 JOB-5210. Adding one line noting that JOB-5215 has day 1 but is excluded because it is not ready would make the trap explicit, and the unused job-ID tie-break is already noted.
feedback.zh: 你引用了 DS-B，並把每項決策連結到實際記錄，包括兩張延後工單的 ready_state，以及第 2 日中 P1 JOB-5232 對 P2 JOB-5210 的優先等級決勝鍵。若補一句指出 JOB-5215 雖為第 1 日但因未就緒而被排除，陷阱會更明確，而工單編號決勝鍵未需使用亦已說明。

feedback.en: Your checks confirm four eligible rows, two deferred rows and no reordering by estimated minutes, and you recompute 75 minutes with a clear next step to ask K. Lau about deferred readiness. Stating explicitly that all six input rows were reviewed would close the loop fully.

feedback.zh: 交接只限於隊列內容，並未說明此為虛構學習模擬、記錄均為虛構、未獲任何真實公司認可，也未指出結論僅適用於提供的六行記錄及 DS-B，且不涉及其他排序規則或產能影響。請補上這項範圍及不確定性說明。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable: ordered queue, both deferred jobs, the rule keys used, the 75-minute arithmetic, checks performed and a next step naming K. Lau as the queue owner. A reader could release or escalate from this text alone.
feedback.zh: 交接簡短可行：列出排序後隊列、兩張延後工單、所用排序鍵、75 分鐘計算、已進行的核實，以及指名隊列負責人 K. Lau 的下一步。讀者單憑此內容即可放行或轉交。

summary.en: Strong submission. Every decision and the arithmetic are correct and the reasoning follows DS-B in the right key order. The main gap is the scope and uncertainty statement, which is missing, plus small additions to fully show the six-row review and the early-but-not-ready trap.

title.zh: 審查週期計算規則

body.en: Counting rules for this review cycle. One, count only rows where evidence_status is verified. Two, a row with a non-empty duplicate_of value is a duplicate record, exclude it and use the row it references. Three, category total equals the sum of duration_min over counted rows in that category. Four, highest-impact review means the category with the greatest total counted duration_min. Tie-break one, more counted events. Tie-break two, alphabetical category label. Five, every selected category is handed to the Production Analytics team lead, Ada Cheung, to schedule the review. No repair work is authorised by this exercise.
body.zh: 本審查週期的計算規則。第一，只計算 evidence_status 為 verified 的列。第二，duplicate_of 有值的列屬重複記錄，須排除，並採用其所指向的列。第三，類別總分鐘等於該類別已計算列的 duration_min 總和。第四，最高影響審查指已計算總 duration_min 最大的類別。第一平手規則為已計算事件較多者。第二平手規則為類別標籤字母次序較前。第五，每個獲選類別交予生產分析組主管 Ada Cheung 安排審查。本練習不授權任何維修工作。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

The conditional answer accepts that a verified EV-105 would take Material-shortage to 190 minutes, above Changeover at 135 minutes.
expectedEvidence.zh: 排除理由須由摘錄說明：EV-102 因 duplicate_of 載有 EV-101 而排除，EV-105 因 evidence_status 為 pending 而排除。總數須連繫至具體 duration_min 數值 95、40、120 及 55。條件題答案接受：若 EV-105 獲核實，物料短缺將達 190 分鐘，高於換線的 135 分鐘。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Concrete checks such as re-adding the four counted duration_min values to confirm 310, confirming EV-102 is the only row with a populated duplicate_of, and confirming EV-105 is the only pending row. Next actions include resolving the EV-105 evidence status before the next cycle and closing the duplicate recording at EV-102, with the selected Changeover review handed to Ada Cheung.

description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: A concise handover giving the counted totals, the excluded rows with reasons, the Changeover decision at 135 minutes, the conditional Material-shortage figure of 190 minutes, the named review owner Ada Cheung and clearly separated next steps. expectedEvidence.zh: 簡明交接，列明已計算總數、被排除列及原因、換線以 135 分鐘獲選的決定、物料短缺的條件數值 190 分鐘、點名審查負責人 Ada Cheung，並清楚分列下一步。足以讓同事依摘錄及政策重現數字。

exemplar.en: Evidence base: extract records EV-101 to EV-106 with duration in whole minutes, plus the published counting rules. Counted rows: EV-101 Changeover 95, EV-103 Changeover 40, EV-104 Material-shortage 120, EV-106 Micro-stop 55. Excluded rows: EV-102, a duplicate of EV-101, and EV-105, still pending evidence. Category totals: Changeover 135 minutes across two counted events, Material-shortage 120 minutes across one event, Micro-stop 55 minutes across one event. Total counted downtime is 310 minutes. Decision: Changeover is the highest-impact review at 135 minutes, so no tie-break applies. Risks and limits: these are documentary minutes only, with no root cause or cost established. EV-105 is unverified, so if it is confirmed the Material-shortage total becomes 190 minutes and would take priority. Next steps: hand the Changeover review to Ada Cheung for scheduling, close the duplicate recording at EV-102, and resolve the EV-105 evidence status before the next cycle.
exemplar.zh: 證據基礎：摘錄記錄 EV-101 至 EV-106，時間以整分鐘計，另加已公布的計算規則。已計算列：EV-101 換線 95、EV-103 換線 40、EV-104 物料短缺 120、EV-106 微停機 55。被排除列：EV-102 為 EV-101 的重複記錄，以及 EV-105 證據仍待處理。類別總數：換線 135 分鐘共兩宗已計算事件、物料短缺 120 分鐘共一宗、微停機 55 分鐘共一宗。已計算停機總數為 310 分鐘。決策：換線以 135 分鐘獲選為最高影響審查，故不適用平手規則。風險與限制：此僅為文件式分鐘，未確立根本原因或成本。EV-105 尚未核實，若獲確認，物料短缺總數將為 190 分鐘並會取得優先次序。下一步：把換線審查交予 Ada Cheung 安排、在 EV-102 結束重複記錄，並在下一週期前處理 EV-105 的證據狀態。

feedback.en: All four counted rows and totals are correct: Changeover 135 minutes from EV-101 (95) and EV-103 (40), Material-shortage 120 from EV-104, Micro-stop 55 from EV-106, giving 310 minutes, and Changeover is the highest-impact review with no tie-break needed. The conditional Material-shortage figure of 190 is also right.
feedback.zh: 四個已計算列及總數全部正確：換線由 EV-101（95）及 EV-103（40）合計 135 分鐘，物料短缺由 EV-104 計 120，微停機由 EV-106 計 55，總數 310 分鐘，換線獲選為最高影響審查且無須平手規則。條件題物料短缺 190 分鐘亦正確。

feedback.en: Exclusions are correctly justified by the extract: EV-102 carries duplicate_of EV-101 and EV-105 is still pending. Each total is tied to the specific duration_min values of 95, 40, 120 and 55, so the reasoning is fully traceable.
feedback.zh: 排除理由正確引自摘錄：EV-102 的 duplicate_of 為 EV-101，EV-105 仍屬 pending。每個總數均連繫至具體 duration_min 數值 95、40、120 及 55，推理可完整追溯。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and correctly owned: hand the Changeover review to Ada Cheung, close the duplicate at EV-102 and resolve the EV-105 evidence status. feedback.zh: 下一步具體且責任正確：把換線審查交予 Ada Cheung、在 EV-102 結束重複記錄，並處理 EV-105 的證據狀態。若再加上明確重檢，例如重新相加四個已計算值以確認 310，核實流程會更完整。

feedback.en: Scope is properly limited to documentary minutes with no root cause or cost established, and the unverified EV-105 is flagged as able to change the priority. No repair authority or unsupported outcome is claimed.
feedback.zh: 範圍正確限於文件式分鐘，未確立根本原因或成本，並指出未核實的 EV-105 可能改變優先次序。沒有聲稱維修權限或提出無依據的結論。

feedback.en: The handover at 143 words is clear and reproducible, giving counted totals, excluded rows with reasons, the Changeover decision, the 190-minute conditional figure and the named owner Ada Cheung with separated next steps.
feedback.zh: 交接共 143 字，清晰且可重現，列明已計算總數、被排除列及原因、換線決定、190 分鐘條件數值，以及點名負責人 Ada Cheung，並分列下一步。

summary.en: A fully accurate submission. All structured answers and the written handover match the counting rules, the exclusions are correctly justified and the conditional scenario is handled properly. Only a small addition to the verification checks would strengthen it further.
summary.zh: 提交完全準確。所有結構化答案及書面交接均符合計算規則，排除理由正確，條件情境亦處理妥當。只需略為補充核實檢查，表現會更完善。

nextSteps.en: Add an explicit re-check line such as re-adding 95+40+120+55 to confirm 310 and confirming EV-102 is the only populated duplicate_of row. Consider logging EV-105 as an open evidence gap with a target resolution date before the next cycle.
nextSteps.zh: 可加入明確重檢項目，例如重新相加 95+40+120+55 以確認 310，並確認 EV-102 是唯一填有 duplicate_of 的列。亦可把 EV-105 記錄為待處理證據缺口，並訂下下一週期前的處理日期。

title.zh: 報廢成本集中度檢視

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by a Hong Kong precision-components manufacturer. It is not endorsed by any employer and every record is synthetic. You are covering a first scrap review for the fictional Northline Components operations team. Source TWO lists six scrap records with scrapped units and unit material costs. Source THREE states the calculation, eligibility and concentration rules. Deliver a finished working note in English or Traditional Chinese of around 100 to 180 words covering evidence, calculations, the supported cost concentration, uncertainty and next steps.
brief.zh: 這是一項受香港精密零件製造商啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非任何僱主認可，所有記錄均為合成資料。你正為虛構的 Northline Components 營運團隊處理首次報廢檢視。來源二列出六筆報廢記錄，包括報廢數量及單位材料成本。來源三載明計算、資格及集中度規則。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交約100至180字的完成工作記錄，涵蓋證據、計算、有證據支持的成本集中項目、不確定性及下一步。

title.zh: 任務背景

body.en: Northline Components is a fictional Hong Kong precision-components maker. You cover the operations analytics desk for one week. The team needs a short scrap review before the weekly cost meeting. Source TWO holds the synthetic scrap records. Source THREE holds the rules. No machine, shift, supplier or operator data is supplied. Deliver a finished working note in English or Traditional Chinese of around 100 to 180 words with evidence, calculation method, the supported cost concentration, uncertainty and next steps.
body.zh: Northline Components 是一間虛構的香港精密零件製造商。你代理營運分析崗位一星期。團隊需要在每週成本會議前完成一份簡短報廢檢視。來源二載有合成報廢記錄。來源三載有規則。本個案不提供機器、班次、供應商或操作員資料。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交約100至180字的完成工作記錄，列明證據、計算方法、有證據支持的成本集中項目、不確定性及下一步。

title.en: Synthetic scrap records SR-01 to SR-06
title.zh: 合成報廢記錄 SR-01 至 SR-06

body.en:
Field meanings. record_id is the stable record identifier. category is the part category name. line_status is either scrapped or rework. scrapped_units is a count of units. unit_material_cost_hkd is the material cost in HKD for one unit. Unit cost values are recorded per unit, not per batch.
```csv
record_id,category,line_status,scrapped_units,unit_material_cost_hkd
SR-01,Housing bracket,scrapped,120,45
SR-02,Seal ring,scrapped,300,6
SR-03,Drive shaft,scrapped,40,210
SR-04,Control board,scrapped,30,640
SR-05,Housing bracket,rework,25,45
SR-06,Seal ring,scrapped,90,6
```
body.zh:
欄位含義。record_id 是固定記錄識別碼。category 是零件類別名稱。line_status 為 scrapped 或 rework。scrapped_units 是單位數量。unit_material_cost_hkd 是每單位材料成本，以港元計。單位成本按每件記錄，並非按批次。
```csv
record_id,category,line_status,scrapped_units,unit_material_cost_hkd
SR-01,Housing bracket,scrapped,120,45
SR-02,Seal ring,scrapped,300,6
SR-03,Drive shaft,scrapped,40,210
SR-04,Control board,scrapped,30,640
SR-05,Housing bracket,rework,25,45
SR-06,Seal ring,scrapped,90,6
```

title.zh: 成本、資格及集中度規則

body.en: Material scrap cost rule. For each record, material scrap cost equals scrapped_units multiplied by unit_material_cost_hkd, expressed in HKD. Eligibility rule. Only records with line_status equal to scrapped contribute to the total material scrap cost. Records with line_status equal to rework are excluded from the total and reported separately. Category rule. Records sharing the same category are combined into one category subtotal before the concentration test. Concentration rule. A cost concentration is supported only when one combined category is at least 50.0 per cent of the total material scrap cost. The 50.0 per cent test is inclusive, so a category at exactly 50.0 per cent is supported. Scope limit. No machine, shift, supplier or operator data is supplied, so no production root cause may be stated. Review owner. Wing Lau, Operations Analytics Lead, must sign off the finished working note.
body.zh: 材料報廢成本規則。每筆記錄的材料報廢成本等於 scrapped_units 乘以 unit_material_cost_hkd，以港元計。資格規則。只有 line_status 等於 scrapped 的記錄計入材料報廢成本總額。line_status 等於 rework 的記錄不計入總額，並另行匯報。類別規則。同一類別的記錄會在集中度測試前合併為一個類別小計。集中度規則。只有當某個合併類別佔材料報廢成本總額至少50.0%時，才屬有證據支持的成本集中項目。50.0%測試為包含性，即剛好50.0%亦屬符合。範圍限制。本個案不提供機器、班次、供應商或操作員資料，因此不得陳述任何生產根因。檢視負責人。營運分析主管 Wing Lau 必須簽核完成工作記錄。

exemplar.en: Handover for the fictional Northline Components scrap review. Evidence is source TWO records SR-01 to SR-06 and the rules in source THREE. Method: material scrap cost equals scrapped_units multiplied by unit_material_cost_hkd, applied only to line_status scrapped. SR-05, 25 units of Housing bracket, is rework and is excluded. Totals: SR-01 120 x 45 = 5,400. SR-02 300 x 6 = 1,800. SR-03 40 x 210 = 8,400. SR-04 30 x 640 = 19,200. SR-06 90 x 6 = 540. Total material scrap cost = HKD 35,340. Only Control board meets the inclusive 50.0 per cent test, so the supported concentration is Control board, record SR-04. Uncertainty: no machine, shift, supplier or operator data is supplied, so no production root cause is claimed. title.en: Synthetic scrap records r-101 to r-106
title.zh: 合成報廢記錄 r-101 至 r-106

body.en:
Field meanings. record_id is the stable record identifier. category is the part category name. line_status is either scrapped or rework. scrapped_units is a count of units. unit_material_cost_hkd is the material cost in HKD for one unit. recoverable_eligible is yes or no. recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd is the recoverable offset in HKD for one eligible scrapped unit. Unit values are per unit, not per batch.
```csv
record_id,category,line_status,scrapped_units,unit_material_cost_hkd,recoverable_eligible,recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd
r-101,Housing bracket,scrapped,120,45,yes,8
r-102,Seal ring,scrapped,300,6,no,0
r-103,Drive shaft,scrapped,40,210,yes,15
r-104,Control board,scrapped,30,640,yes,40
r-105,Housing bracket,rework,25,45,yes,8
r-106,Seal ring,scrapped,90,6,no,0
```
body.zh:
欄位含義。record_id 是固定記錄識別碼。category 是零件類別名稱。line_status 為 scrapped 或 rework。scrapped_units 是單位數量。unit_material_cost_hkd 是每單位材料成本，以港元計。recoverable_eligible 為 yes 或 no。recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd 是每個合資格報廢單位的可回收抵扣，以港元計。單位數值按每件記錄，並非按批次。
```csv
record_id,category,line_status,scrapped_units,unit_material_cost_hkd,recoverable_eligible,recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd
r-101,Housing bracket,scrapped,120,45,yes,8
r-102,Seal ring,scrapped,300,6,no,0
r-103,Drive shaft,scrapped,40,210,yes,15
r-104,Control board,scrapped,30,640,yes,40
r-105,Housing bracket,rework,25,45,yes,8
r-106,Seal ring,scrapped,90,6,no,0
```

title.zh: 成本、資格及集中度規則

body.en: Material scrap cost rule. For each scrapped record, gross material scrap cost equals scrapped_units multiplied by unit_material_cost_hkd, expressed in HKD. Recoverable offset rule. Recoverable offset equals scrapped_units multiplied by recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd only when line_status is scrapped and recoverable_eligible is yes. Net scrap cost rule. Net scrap cost equals gross material scrap cost minus recoverable offset. Rework records are excluded from the net total and reported separately. Category rule. Records sharing the same category are combined into one category net subtotal before the concentration test. Concentration rule. A cost concentration is supported only when one combined category is at least 50.0 per cent of the total net material scrap cost. The 50.0 per cent test is inclusive, so a category at exactly 50.0 per cent is supported. Scope limit. No machine, shift, supplier or operator data is supplied, so no production root cause may be stated. Review owner. Wing Lau, Operations Analytics Lead, must sign off the finished working note.
body.zh: 材料報廢成本規則。每筆 scrapped 記錄的報廢總成本等於 scrapped_units 乘以 unit_material_cost_hkd，以港元計。可回收抵扣規則。只有當 line_status 為 scrapped 且 recoverable_eligible 為 yes 時，可回收抵扣等於 scrapped_units 乘以 recoverable_value_per_unit_hkd。淨報廢成本規則。淨報廢成本等於報廢總成本減可回收抵扣。rework 記錄不計入淨總額，並另行匯報。類別規則。同一類別的記錄會在集中度測試前合併為一個類別淨小計。集中度規則。只有當某個合併類別佔材料報廢淨成本總額至少50.0%時，才屬有證據支持的成本集中項目。50.0%測試為包含性，即剛好50.0%亦屬符合。範圍限制。本個案不提供機器、班次、供應商或操作員資料，因此不得陳述任何生產根因。檢視負責人。營運分析主管 Wing Lau 必須簽核完成工作記錄。

title.en: Linear daily pacing and bounded adjustment policy
title.zh: 線性每日進度及有限度調整政策

body.en: Pacing policy. Horizon is 30 days, day indices 1 to 30. Baseline daily cap equals total budget divided by 30. Planned cumulative spend at any query day equals baseline daily cap multiplied by elapsed day index. Actual cumulative spend is the sum of supplied daily spend from day 1 to query day inclusive. Pace ratio equals actual cumulative divided by planned cumulative. Remaining daily requirement equals remaining budget divided by remaining days. A bounded adjustment must stay within plus or minus 20 percent of the baseline daily cap. If the remaining daily requirement falls outside that bound, escalate to the review owner. Review owner: Marketing Operations Lead, Priya Raman.
body.zh: 進度政策。推廣期為30日，日指數由1至30。基準每日上限等於總預算除以30。任何查詢日的計劃累計開支等於基準每日上限乘以已過日指數。實際累計開支為第1日至查詢日（含當日）的每日開支總和。進度比率等於實際累計除以計劃累計。剩餘每日要求等於剩餘預算除以剩餘日數。有限度調整必須維持在基準每日上限的正負20%之內。如剩餘每日要求超出該範圍，須轉交審查負責人。審查負責人：市場營運主管 Priya Raman。

exemplar.en: Handover. Query day 12. Baseline daily cap = HKD 360,000 / 30 = HKD 12,000. Planned cumulative to day 12 = 12 x HKD 12,000 = HKD 144,000. title.en: Weighted-week pacing and bounded adjustment policy
title.zh: 加權週進度及有限度調整政策

body.en: The horizon is 28 days, day indices 1 to 28, grouped into four weeks of seven days. Predeclared weekly budget weights are week 1 15 percent, week 2 20 percent, week 3 30 percent and week 4 35 percent. Planned cumulative spend at the end of any number of completed weeks equals the sum of those completed weeks' weights multiplied by the total budget. Actual cumulative spend is the sum of recorded weekly actual spend up to the query point. Pace ratio equals actual cumulative divided by planned cumulative. Required remaining daily rate equals remaining budget divided by remaining days. A bounded adjustment must stay within plus or minus 10 percent of the predeclared planned daily rate for the remaining days. If the required remaining daily rate falls outside that band, escalate to the review owner, Marketing Operations Lead Wai-Ling Chan, before changing the cap.
body.zh: 推廣期為28日，日指數1至28，分為四個七日週。預先公布的每週預算權重為：第1週15%、第2週20%、第3週30%、第4週35%。任何已完成週數於該週完結時的計劃累計開支，等於已完成週數的權重總和乘以總預算。實際累計開支為查詢時點前已記錄的每週實際開支總和。進度比率等於實際累計除以計劃累計。所需剩餘每日開支率等於剩餘預算除以剩餘日數。有限度調整必須維持在剩餘日數的預先公布計劃每日開支率的正負10%之內。如所需剩餘每日開支率超出該範圍，須先轉交審查負責人市場營運主管 Wai-Ling Chan，才可更改上限。

The predeclared remaining planned daily rate is HKD 273,000 divided by 14 days, which is HKD 19,500, so the plus or minus 10 percent band is HKD 17,550 to HKD 21,450. HKD 20,500 is inside the band, so the bounded adjustment is to raise the daily cap to HKD 20,500 and no escalation is required.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確最終結果：截至第14日完結的計劃累計開支為 HK$147,000（HK$420,000 的15%加20%）。實際累計開支為 HK$133,000（60,000加73,000）。進度比率約 0.90，即低於計劃開支。剩餘預算為 HK$287,000，餘下14日，故所需剩餘每日開支率為 HK$20,500。預先公布的剩餘計劃每日開支率為 HK$273,000 除以14日，即 HK$19,500，正負10%範圍為 HK$17,550 至 HK$21,450。HK$20,500 在範圍之內，故此有限度調整為把每日上限提高至 HK$20,500，並無需轉交。

exemplar.en:
Evidence. The weekly table doc-data-weighted-weeks shows week 1 actual spend HKD 60,000 (W01) and week 2 HKD 73,000 (W02), so actual cumulative spend to the end of day 14 is HKD 133,000. The predeclared weights give 15 percent plus 20 percent, which is 35 percent of the HKD 420,000 budget, so planned cumulative spend is HKD 147,000. The pace ratio is 133,000 divided by 147,000, about 0.90, so the campaign is underspending.

Decision. Remaining budget is HKD 420,000 minus HKD 133,000, which is HKD 287,000 over 14 remaining days, requiring HKD 20,500 per day. The predeclared remaining planned daily rate is HKD 273,000 divided by 14, which is HKD 19,500, so the allowed band is HKD 17,550 to HKD 21,450. HKD 20,500 sits inside the band, so I recommend raising the daily cap to HKD 20,500 and no escalation is needed.

Risks and next steps. Weeks 3 and 4 actuals are not yet recorded and no creative or audience change is assumed. Wai-Ling Chan to approve the revised cap and I will recheck cumulative spend every three days.

決策。剩餘預算為 HK$420,000 減 HK$133,000，即 HK$287,000，餘下14日，需要每日 HK$20,500。預先公布的剩餘計劃每日開支率為 HK$273,000 除以14，即 HK$19,500，故允許範圍為 HK$17,550 至 HK$21,450。HK$20,500 在範圍之內，故我建議把每日上限提高至 HK$20,500，並無需轉交。

風險及下一步。第3及第4週實際數字尚未記錄，亦不假設任何創意或受眾改動。Wai-Ling Chan 審批修訂後上限，我將每三日覆核累計開支。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: planned cumulative HKD 147,000 (35 percent of HKD 420,000), actual cumulative HKD 133,000, pace ratio about 0.90 (underspending), and the bounded cap raise to HKD 20,500, which sits inside the HKD 17,550 to HKD 21,450 band with no escalation needed. The arithmetic is consistent throughout.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：計劃累計 HK$147,000（HK$420,000 的35%）、實際累計 HK$133,000、進度比率約0.90（低於計劃開支），以及把上限提高至 HK$20,500，該值落在 HK$17,550 至 HK$21,450 範圍內，無需轉交。運算前後一致。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable: it states the pace conclusion, both cumulative figures, the HKD 20,500 required daily rate, the band, the escalation decision and the named owner Wai-Ling Chan plus a next check. A reader could act on it without further explanation.

The main gaps are thinner verification checks and an implicit rather than explicit statement of the synthetic, limited scope of the evidence.

title.zh: 找出最大漏斗流失

brief.en: You are a marketing analyst in a fictional Hong Kong online learning team. This is an independent learning simulation with synthetic records. Use FUNNEL-POL-01 and FUNNEL-DATA-01 to complete a working file and a concise handover. Calculate both adjacent-stage conversion rates and both drop-off counts. Identify the largest drop-off by absolute unique-user loss. State the priority transition. Do not claim cause. Name the review owner. Keep all claims within the March 2026 cohort and the supplied records.
brief.zh: 你是虛構香港網上學習團隊的市場營銷分析師。這是使用合成記錄的獨立學習模擬。請使用 FUNNEL-POL-01 及 FUNNEL-DATA-01 完成工作檔案及簡潔交接。計算兩個相鄰階段轉換率及兩個流失數。按唯一使用者絕對流失找出最大流失。說明優先處理的轉換。不要聲稱因果關係。列明審核負責人。所有聲明限於 2026 年 3 月隊列及提供記錄之內。

title.zh: 漏斗計量政策 FUNNEL-POL-01

body.en: Funnel policy FUNNEL-POL-01. Cohort is unique users whose first landing visit is between 2026-03-01 00:00 and 2026-03-31 23:59 Hong Kong time. Stages are ordered S1 landing visitors, S2 signup completed, S3 activation completed. Adjacent-stage conversion rate equals later-stage unique users divided by earlier-stage unique users, shown as a percentage to one decimal place. Drop-off count equals earlier-stage unique users minus later-stage unique users. Largest drop-off is the adjacent transition with the greatest drop-off count in unique users, not the lowest percentage conversion. If tied, the earlier transition is selected. Counts show association only.
body.zh: 漏斗政策 FUNNEL-POL-01。隊列是指在 2026-03-01 00:00 至 2026-03-31 23:59 香港時間內首次到訪著陸頁的唯一使用者。階段順序為 S1 著陸頁訪客、S2 完成註冊、S3 完成啟用。相鄰階段轉換率等於後一階段唯一使用者數除以早一階段唯一使用者數，以百分比顯示並四捨五入至小數後一位。流失數等於早一階段唯一使用者數減後一階段唯一使用者數。最大流失是指唯一使用者流失數最大的相鄰轉換，並非百分比轉換最低者。若出現相同數值，選較早的轉換。計數僅顯示關聯。

title.zh: 隊列資料摘錄 FUNNEL-DATA-01

body.en:
Data extract FUNNEL-DATA-01. Values are unique users for the March 2026 cohort. Unit is unique users. No solved rates or losses are shown.
```csv
stage_id,stage_name,unique_users,unit
S1,landing_visitors,8400,unique users
S2,signup_completed,2520,unique users
S3,activation_completed,1890,unique users
```
Row S1 means 8,400 unique users reached the landing stage. Row S2 means 2,520 unique users completed signup. Row S3 means 1,890 unique users completed activation. Counts are unique users, not events. No other stages are in scope.
body.zh:
資料摘錄 FUNNEL-DATA-01。數值為 2026 年 3 月隊列的唯一使用者。單位是唯一使用者。沒有預先列出任何計算結果。
```csv
stage_id,stage_name,unique_users,unit
S1,landing_visitors,8400,unique users
S2,signup_completed,2520,unique users
S3,activation_completed,1890,unique users
```
S1 列代表 8,400 名唯一使用者到達著陸階段。S2 列代表 2,520 名唯一使用者完成註冊。S3 列代表 1,890 名唯一使用者完成啟用。計數是唯一使用者，不是事件。沒有其他階段在範圍內。

title.zh: 主管備註

body.en: From Cheryl Lam, marketing analytics lead. Please complete the working file and a short handover. Follow FUNNEL-POL-01 and use FUNNEL-DATA-01 only. The priority area is the adjacent transition with the largest absolute drop-off in unique users. Do not claim cause. Note any missing evidence and any tie handling. Review owner is Cheryl Lam. This is a synthetic learning simulation for Hong Kong learners.
body.zh: 來自市場分析主管 Cheryl Lam。請完成工作檔案及簡短交接。依從 FUNNEL-POL-01 並只使用 FUNNEL-DATA-01。優先處理範圍是按唯一使用者絕對流失最大的相鄰轉換。不要聲稱因果關係。列明任何缺失證據及相同數值處理。審核負責人是 Cheryl Lam。這是為香港學習者而設的合成學習模擬。

exemplar.zh: FUNNEL-DATA-01 交接，2026 年 3 月隊列。依 FUNNEL-POL-01，著陸頁至註冊轉換率為 2,520 除以 8,400 = 30.0%。註冊至啟用轉換率為 1,890 除以 2,520 = 75.0%。著陸頁至註冊流失為 8,400 減 2,520 = 5,880 名唯一使用者。註冊至啟用流失為 2,520 減 1,890 = 630 名唯一使用者。最大絕對流失是著陸頁至註冊。優先處理範圍是著陸頁至註冊轉換。下一步是檢查階段追蹤及隊列界線，然後檢視著陸頁清晰度，但不聲稱因果關係。審核負責人是 Cheryl Lam。所有發現限於提供的 2026 年 3 月合成隊列。

feedback.zh: 四項決定全部正確。你得出 30.0% 及 75.0% 轉換率、5,880 及 630 流失數，並正確選出著陸頁至註冊為最大絕對流失。

feedback.en: Calculations are tied to FUNNEL-DATA-01 counts and FUNNEL-POL-01 definitions, and you justify the drop-off choice by absolute loss. Add a line stating the largest drop-off is not the lowest percentage, to fully show the policy distinction.
feedback.zh: 計算已連繫 FUNNEL-DATA-01 計數及 FUNNEL-POL-01 定義，並以絕對流失解釋最大流失的選擇。可再補一句說明最大流失並非百分比最低者，以完整展示政策分別。

feedback.en: You propose checking stage tracking and cohort boundaries and name Cheryl Lam as review owner. Adding a re-check of the two calculations against the raw CSV would strengthen verification.
feedback.zh: 你提出檢查階段追蹤及隊列界線，並列明 Cheryl Lam 為審核負責人。若再加入根據原始 CSV 覆核兩個計算，核實會更穩固。

feedback.en: You limit findings to the synthetic March 2026 cohort and avoid claiming cause. State explicitly that the counts show association only and note missing evidence beyond the three stages.
feedback.zh: 你把發現限於 2026 年 3 月合成隊列，並避免聲稱因果。可明確指出計數僅顯示關聯，並說明三個階段以外的缺失證據。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and complete with both rates, both drop-offs, the priority transition, owner and next step. Another analyst could act on it directly.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔完整，包含兩個轉換率、兩個流失數、優先轉換、負責人及下一步，另一分析師可直接跟進。

summary.en: A strong, accurate submission. All decisions and calculations are correct, evidence is tied to the supplied records and the handover is actionable. Minor additions on association-only wording and a calculation re-check would complete the picture.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀且準確。所有決定及計算均正確，證據連繫到提供記錄，交接可行。若補充僅顯示關聯的措辭及計算覆核，會更完整。

nextSteps.en: Add one sentence noting the counts show association only and that the largest drop-off is not the lowest percentage, and include a step to re-verify both calculations against the raw CSV.
nextSteps.zh: 補一句說明計數僅顯示關聯，以及最大流失並非百分比最低者，並加入根據原始 CSV 重新核對兩個計算的步驟。

title.zh: 找出最大漏斗流失

brief.en: You are a marketing analyst in a fictional Hong Kong online learning team. This is an independent learning simulation with synthetic records. Use FUNNEL-POL-02 and FUNNEL-DATA-02 to complete a working file and a concise handover. Calculate both adjacent-stage conversion rates and both drop-off counts. Identify the largest drop-off by absolute unique-user loss. State the priority transition. Do not claim cause. Name the review owner. Keep all claims within the April 2026 cohort and the supplied records.
brief.zh: 你是虛構香港網上學習團隊的市場營銷分析師。這是使用合成記錄的獨立學習模擬。請使用 FUNNEL-POL-02 及 FUNNEL-DATA-02 完成工作檔案及簡潔交接。計算兩個相鄰階段轉換率及兩個流失數。按唯一使用者絕對流失找出最大流失。說明優先處理的轉換。不要聲稱因果關係。列明審核負責人。所有聲明限於 2026 年 4 月隊列及提供記錄之內。

title.zh: 漏斗計量政策 FUNNEL-POL-02

body.en: Funnel measurement policy FUNNEL-POL-02. The cohort is unique users whose first trial start is between 2026-04-01 00:00 and 2026-04-30 23:59 Hong Kong time. Stages are ordered S1 trial started, S2 active use completed, S3 renewal completed. Adjacent-stage conversion rate equals later-stage unique users divided by earlier-stage unique users, shown as a percentage to one decimal place. Drop-off count equals earlier-stage unique users minus later-stage unique users. Largest drop-off is the adjacent transition with the greatest drop-off count in unique users, not the lowest percentage conversion. If tied, the earlier transition is selected. Counts show association only, not cause.
body.zh: 漏斗計量政策 FUNNEL-POL-02。隊列是指在 2026-04-01 00:00 至 2026-04-30 23:59 香港時間內首次開始試用的唯一使用者。階段順序為 S1 開始試用、S2 完成活躍使用、S3 完成續訂。相鄰階段轉換率等於後一階段唯一使用者數除以早一階段唯一使用者數，以百分比顯示並四捨五入至小數後一位。流失數等於早一階段唯一使用者數減後一階段唯一使用者數。最大流失是指唯一使用者流失數最大的相鄰轉換，並非百分比轉換最低者。若出現相同數值，選較早的轉換。計數僅顯示關聯，並非因果。

title.zh: 隊列資料摘錄 FUNNEL-DATA-02

body.en:
Data extract FUNNEL-DATA-02. Values are unique users for the April 2026 cohort. Unit is unique users. No solved rates or losses are shown.
```csv
stage_id,stage_name,unique_users,unit
S1,trial_started,20000,unique users
S2,active_use_completed,10000,unique users
S3,renewal_completed,1500,unique users
```
Row S1 means 20,000 unique users started a trial. Row S2 means 10,000 unique users completed active use. Row S3 means 1,500 unique users completed renewal. Counts are unique users, not events. No other stages are in scope.
body.zh:
資料摘錄 FUNNEL-DATA-02。數值為 2026 年 4 月隊列的唯一使用者。單位是唯一使用者。沒有預先列出任何計算結果。
```csv
stage_id,stage_name,unique_users,unit
S1,trial_started,20000,unique users
S2,active_use_completed,10000,unique users
S3,renewal_completed,1500,unique users
```
S1 列代表 20,000 名唯一使用者開始試用。S2 列代表 10,000 名唯一使用者完成活躍使用。S3 列代表 1,500 名唯一使用者完成續訂。計數是唯一使用者，不是事件。沒有其他階段在範圍內。

title.zh: 主管備註

body.en: From Vivian Ho, marketing analytics lead. Please complete the working file and a short handover. Follow FUNNEL-POL-02 and use FUNNEL-DATA-02 only. The priority area is the adjacent transition with the largest absolute drop-off in unique users. Do not claim cause. Note any missing evidence and any tie handling. Review owner is Vivian Ho. This is a synthetic learning simulation for Hong Kong learners.
body.zh: 來自市場分析主管 Vivian Ho。請完成工作檔案及簡短交接。依從 FUNNEL-POL-02 並只使用 FUNNEL-DATA-02。優先處理範圍是按唯一使用者絕對流失最大的相鄰轉換。不要聲稱因果關係。列明任何缺失證據及相同數值處理。審核負責人是 Vivian Ho。這是為香港學習者而設的合成學習模擬。

label.en: What is the trial-to-active-use conversion rate in percent, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 由試用至活躍使用的轉換率是多少，以百分比表示並四捨五入至小數後一位？

label.en: What is the active-use-to-renewal conversion rate in percent, rounded to one decimal place?
label.zh: 由活躍使用至續訂的轉換率是多少，以百分比表示並四捨五入至小數後一位？

label.en: Which adjacent transition is the largest drop-off by absolute unique-user loss?
label.zh: 哪個相鄰轉換按唯一使用者絕對流失計是最大流失？

label.en: Trial started to active use completed
label.zh: 開始試用至完成活躍使用

label.en: Active use completed to renewal completed
label.zh: 完成活躍使用至完成續訂

label.en: Which statements are supported by the supplied records and policy? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些陳述獲提供記錄及政策支持？請選出所有適用者。
試用至活躍使用流失 10,000 名唯一使用者。
活躍使用至續訂流失 8,500 名唯一使用者。

label.en: Active-use-to-renewal has a lower conversion rate than trial-to-active-use.
label.zh: 活躍使用至續訂的轉換率低於試用至活躍使用。
最大流失是活躍使用至續訂。
續訂至試用的轉換率是 20.0%。

title.en: Match a message to an opt-in audience segment
title.zh: 為選擇加入的受眾群配對訊息

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation, not endorsed by any organisation. You are on a synthetic audience insights team preparing a first message test for an opt-in app audience. Read the opt-in survey extract, the message approval policy and the four candidate messages. Decide which segment and need qualify under the policy, which single message may be released, and how far the second segment is from the base threshold. Deliver a short handover of about 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese covering your decision, the record evidence, the calculation method, the limits of the evidence and the next verification step. All records, staff and copy are synthetic.
brief.zh: 虛構學習模擬，並非任何機構認可。你是合成受眾洞察團隊成員，正為選擇加入的應用程式受眾籌備首次訊息測試。請閱讀選擇加入調查摘錄、訊息審批政策及四則候選訊息。判斷哪個受眾群及需求符合政策、哪一則訊息可發布，以及第二個受眾群距離基本門檻多遠。提交約100至180英文詞或相若中文的簡短交接，涵蓋你的決策、記錄證據、計算方法、證據限制及下一步核實。所有記錄、人員及文案均為合成。

title.zh: 選擇加入調查摘錄（合成數據）

body.en:
Fictional learning data. Field period 4 to 18 March 2026. Each record counts opt-in members in one segment whose FIRST-choice need is the listed need. segment_opt_in_members is the segment's total opt-in base, repeated on each row. Units: members (people). No member-level identifiers are stored.

```csv
record_id,segment_id,need_id,members_ranking_first,segment_opt_in_members
n-01,seg-early,need-speed,216,480
n-02,seg-early,need-price,168,480
n-03,seg-early,need-planning,96,480
n-04,seg-late,need-planning,162,360
n-05,seg-late,need-price,108,360
n-06,seg-late,need-speed,90,360
```

Human explanation. seg-early base 480: 216 need-speed plus 168 need-price plus 96 need-planning equals 480. seg-late base 360: 162 need-planning plus 108 need-price plus 90 need-speed equals 360. Need labels: need-speed means the delivery arrives before 7am, need-price means a lower weekly cost, need-planning means a weekly meal planning tool. Both segments are opt-in app audiences.
body.zh:
虛構學習數據。調查期為2026年3月4日至18日。每列記錄某受眾群中把所列需求列為第一選擇的選擇加入會員人數。segment_opt_in_members 是該受眾群的選擇加入總人數，於每列重複。單位：人。不儲存會員層面識別資料。

```csv
record_id,segment_id,need_id,members_ranking_first,segment_opt_in_members
n-01,seg-early,need-speed,216,480
n-02,seg-early,need-price,168,480
n-03,seg-early,need-planning,96,480
n-04,seg-late,need-planning,162,360
n-05,seg-late,need-price,108,360
n-06,seg-late,need-speed,90,360
```

body.en: Fictional learning policy. It applies only to opt-in app audiences. All thresholds are inclusive of the stated boundary. Rule 1: a segment qualifies only if its segment_opt_in_members is at least 400. Rule 2: the segment's top-ranked need must be ranked first by at least 40.0 percent of that segment's opt-in members. Rule 3: if two or more segments qualify, choose the higher top-need share. If those shares are equal, escalate to the review owner. Rule 4: the released message must address the qualifying need and must contain no prohibited claim. Prohibited claims: comparative superiority, price or discount guarantees, health or medical outcomes, absolute promises such as never or always, member testimonials or member counts. Mandatory review owner: Priya Raman, Compliance Lead (fictional role). No release without this owner's confirmation.
body.zh: 虛構學習政策。只適用於選擇加入的應用程式受眾。所有門檻均包含所述界線。規則1：受眾群的 segment_opt_in_members 至少達400，方為符合資格。規則2：該受眾群排名最高的需求，須由該群至少40.0%的選擇加入會員列為第一選擇。規則3：若多於一個受眾群符合資格，選最高需求佔比者。若佔比相同，轉交審核負責人。規則4：發布訊息須針對符合資格的需求，且不得包含違禁聲明。違禁聲明：比較性優越聲明、價格或折扣保證、健康或醫療成效、諸如「永不」或「總是」的絕對承諾、會員見證或會員人數。強制審核負責人：Priya Raman，合規主管（虛構職位）。未經該負責人確認不得發布。

title.zh: 訊息審批政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy. It applies only to opt-in panel evidence. All thresholds are inclusive of the stated boundary. Rule 1: a topic qualifies only if its combined evidence_strength_score across all its evidence rows is at least 12 points. Rule 2: the topic must also have at least two distinct evidence_id rows. If two topics qualify, choose the one with higher combined evidence_strength_score. If equal, escalate.

title.en: Fictional complaint taxonomy, routing owners, precedence rules and priority rule
title.zh: 虛構投訴分類表、負責團隊、優先次序規則及優先級規則

body.en:
Fictional Klook-style triage policy for this learning simulation.
Categories, defined by the guest's primary defect:
- booking: any defect in the reservation itself, including confirmation or voucher not delivered, reschedule or cancellation request not processed, operator cancellation, date or time error, no-show dispute.
- billing: any dispute about money, including duplicate charge, incorrect amount, refund not received, currency or promo dispute, payment taken without a completed booking.
- listing: any defect on the published product page, including wrong meeting point, wrong inclusions, outdated photo, inaccurate availability display, wrong guide language.
Routing owners: booking goes to Booking Support Team (BST). billing goes to Payments and Refunds Team (PRT). listing goes to Content Operations Team (COT). Every ticket has exactly one accountable owner.
Precedence rules:
R1 If a ticket disputes a charge, refund or amount and also reports a booking defect, it is billing.
R2 If a ticket reports a product-page defect and disputes no charge, refund or amount, it is listing, even when a booking detail is also mentioned.
R3 If a product-page defect caused the guest to be refused entry or service and a charge or refund is now disputed, it is billing, and the page defect is tagged as a linked defect for COT. A linked-defect tag never changes the accountable owner.
R4 A ticket that disputes only a charge, refund or amount is billing even when a booking reference is quoted.
Priority: any ticket where the guest states they had already reached the meeting point or venue and were refused entry or service is Priority 1. All other tickets are Priority 2.
Field note: page_defect_claimed, at_venue_and_refused and charge_or_refund_disputed are the authoritative coded flags, and the summary line records the same facts in short form.
body.zh:
本學習模擬專用的虛構 Klook 風格分流政策。
類別（按旅客主要問題界定）：
- booking（預訂）：預訂本身的問題，包括確認信或憑證未送達、改期或取消申請未處理、營運商取消、日期或時間錯誤、缺席爭議。
- billing（帳務）：任何金錢爭議，包括重複收費、金額錯誤、退款未收到、貨幣或優惠碼爭議、未完成預訂卻已收款。
- listing（商品頁）：已發佈商品頁的問題，包括集合點錯誤、包含項目錯誤、相片過時、可預訂狀態顯示不準、導遊語言錯誤。
負責團隊：booking 交予 Booking Support Team（BST）。billing 交予 Payments and Refunds Team（PRT）。listing 交予 Content Operations Team（COT）。每張工單只有一個負責團隊。
優先次序規則：
R1 若工單爭議收費、退款或金額，並同時提及預訂問題，歸為 billing。
R2 若工單提及商品頁問題，且沒有爭議任何收費、退款或金額，歸為 listing，即使同時提及預訂細節。
R3 若商品頁問題導致旅客被拒絕入場或服務，且現正爭議收費或退款，歸為 billing，並把商品頁問題標記為 linked defect 交予 COT。linked defect 標記不會改變負責團隊。
R4 只爭議收費、退款或金額的工單歸為 billing，即使引用了預訂編號。
優先級：凡旅客表示已到達集合點或場地並被拒絕入場或服務，即為 Priority 1。其餘工單為 Priority 2。
欄位說明：page_defect_claimed、at_venue_and_refused 及 charge_or_refund_disputed 為權威編碼標記，summary 行以簡短形式記錄同一批事實。

title.en: Fictional complaint taxonomy, routing owners, precedence rules and priority rule
title.zh: 虛構投訴分類表、負責團隊、優先次序規則及優先級規則

body.en:
Fictional Klook-style triage policy for this learning simulation.
Categories, defined by the guest's primary defect:
- booking: a defect in the reservation itself, including confirmation or voucher not delivered, reschedule or cancellation request not processed, operator cancellation, date or time error, no-show dispute.
- billing: a dispute about money, including duplicate charge, incorrect amount, refund not received, currency or promo dispute, payment taken without a completed booking.
- listing: a defect on the published product page, including wrong meeting point, wrong inclusions, outdated photo, inaccurate availability display, wrong guide language.
Routing owners: booking goes to Booking Support Team (BST). billing goes to Payments and Refunds Team (PRT). listing goes to Content Operations Team (COT). Every ticket has exactly one accountable owner.
Precedence rules:
P1 If a ticket disputes a charge, refund or amount and also reports a listing defect, it is billing. The listing defect is tagged as a linked defect for COT. A linked-defect tag never changes the accountable owner.
P2 If a ticket reports a listing defect and disputes no charge, refund or amount, it is listing, even when a booking detail is also mentioned.
P3 If a ticket reports only a booking defect and disputes no charge, refund or amount, it is booking.
P4 If a ticket disputes a charge, refund or amount and reports no listing defect, it is billing, even when a booking reference or booking defect is also mentioned.
Priority: Priority 1 if the guest states they had already reached the meeting point or venue and were refused entry or service, or if the disputed amount is 1000 HKD or more. All other tickets are Priority 2.
Field note: page_defect_claimed, at_venue_and_refused and charge_or_refund_disputed are the authoritative coded flags. The summary line records the same facts in short form.
body.zh:
本學習模擬專用的虛構 Klook 風格分流政策。
類別（按旅客主要問題界定）：
- booking（預訂）：預訂本身的問題，包括確認信或憑證未送達、改期或取消申請未處理、營運商取消、日期或時間錯誤、缺席爭議。
- billing（帳務）：任何金錢爭議，包括重複收費、金額錯誤、退款未收到、貨幣或優惠碼爭議、未完成預訂卻已收款。
- listing（商品頁）：已發佈商品頁的問題，包括集合點錯誤、包含項目錯誤、相片過時、可預訂狀態顯示不準、導遊語言錯誤。
負責團隊：booking 交予 Booking Support Team（BST）。billing 交予 Payments and Refunds Team（PRT）。listing 交予 Content Operations Team（COT）。每張工單只有一個負責團隊。
優先次序規則：
P1 若工單爭議收費、退款或金額，並同時提及商品頁問題，歸為 billing。商品頁問題會標記為 linked defect 交予 COT。linked defect 標記不會改變負責團隊。
P2 若工單提及商品頁問題，且沒有爭議任何收費、退款或金額，歸為 listing，即使同時提及預訂細節。
P3 若工單只提及預訂問題，且沒有爭議任何收費、退款或金額，歸為 booking。
P4 若工單爭議收費、退款或金額，且沒有提及商品頁問題，歸為 billing，即使同時提及預訂編號或預訂問題。
優先級：凡旅客表示已到達集合點或場地並被拒絕入場或服務，或爭議金額達 1000 HKD 或以上，即為 Priority 1。其餘工單為 Priority 2。
欄位說明：page_defect_claimed、at_venue_and_refused 及 charge_or_refund_disputed 為權威編碼標記。summary 行以簡短形式記錄同一批事實。

expectedEvidence.zh: 正確結果：T-6011 billing PRT Priority 1、T-6012 booking BST Priority 2、T-6013 listing COT Priority 2、T-6014 billing PRT Priority 1 並有 linked defect 交予 COT、T-6015 billing PRT Priority 2、T-6016 listing COT Priority 1、T-6017 booking BST Priority 2，PRT 爭議金額合計 1450 + 750 + 520 = 2720 HKD。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the CSV flags and policy rules P1 to P4 and the priority rule. T-6014 uses P1 because charge_or_refund_disputed=yes and page_defect_claimed=yes, so PRT owns it and COT gets a linked-defect tag. T-6013 and T-6016 use P2 because charge_or_refund_disputed=no, so COT owns them. T-6011 and T-6015 use P4 because they dispute money and show no page defect. T-6012 and T-6017 use P3 because they report booking defects only.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 CSV 標記及政策 P1 至 P4 與優先級規則。T-6014 用 P1，因 charge_or_refund_disputed=yes 且 page_defect_claimed=yes，故 PRT 負責並把 linked defect 標記交予 COT。T-6013 及 T-6016 用 P2，因 charge_or_refund_disputed=no，故由 COT 負責。T-6011 及 T-6015 用 P4，因爭議金錢且無商品頁問題。T-6012 及 T-6017 用 P3，因只提及預訂問題。

expectedEvidence.en: Checks: confirm every ticket has exactly one owner, verify disputed_amount_hkd values sum to 2720 for PRT tickets T-6011, T-6014 and T-6015, confirm Priority 1 for T-6011 due to the 1000 HKD amount threshold and for T-6014 and T-6016 due to venue refusal, and confirm the linked-defect tag on T-6014 does not change owner.
expectedEvidence.zh: 核對：確認每張工單只有一個負責團隊、核實 PRT 工單 T-6011、T-6014 及 T-6015 的 disputed_amount_hkd 合計為 2720、確認 T-6011 因金額達 1000 HKD 而 T-6014 及 T-6016 因到場被拒而屬 Priority 1，並確認 T-6014 的 linked defect 標記不改變負責團隊。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states owner and priority for each ticket, gives PRT disputed total 2720 HKD with addition 1450 + 750 + 520, flags T-6014 as linked defect for COT, and lists checks run.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接列出每張工單的負責團隊與優先級、PRT 爭議合計 2720 HKD 及加數 1450 + 750 + 520、標示 T-6014 為 COT 的 linked defect，並列出已做的核對。

exemplar.en:
Handover for queue extract T-6011 to T-6017. All records are fictional learning material.
T-6011 duplicate charge, HKD 1450, is billing under P4. Owner PRT. Priority 1 because the disputed amount is 1000 HKD or more.
T-6012 reschedule not processed is booking under P3. Owner BST. Priority 2.
T-6013 wrong meeting point with no charge dispute is listing under P2. Owner COT. Priority 2.
T-6014 wrong inclusions caused refusal and the guest disputes HKD 750. P1 applies, so it is billing with owner PRT and Priority 1. The page defect is a linked defect for COT and does not change owner.
T-6015 voucher not delivered and card charged with refund requested is billing under P4. Owner PRT. Priority 2.
T-6016 wrong guide language caused refusal with no charge dispute. P2 applies, so owner COT and Priority 1 due to venue refusal.
T-6017 operator cancellation is booking under P3. Owner BST. Priority 2.
PRT disputed total is 1450 + 750 + 520 = 2720 HKD.
Checks run: each ticket mapped to one owner, priority rule applied to T-6011, T-6014 and T-6016, and the linked-defect tag on T-6014 confirmed not to change ownership.
exemplar.zh:
隊列摘錄 T-6011 至 T-6017 的交接。所有紀錄均為虛構學習材料。
T-6011 重複收費 HKD 1450，按 P4 屬 billing。負責團隊 PRT。因爭議金額達 1000 HKD 或以上，屬 Priority 1。
T-6012 改期未獲處理，按 P3 屬 booking。負責團隊 BST。Priority 2。
T-6013 集合點錯誤且無爭議收費，按 P2 屬 listing。負責團隊 COT。Priority 2。
T-6014 包含項目錯誤導致被拒，旅客爭議 HKD 750。P1 適用，故屬 billing，負責團隊 PRT，Priority 1。商品頁問題為 COT 的 linked defect，不改變負責團隊。
T-6015 憑證未送達且已收費並要求退款，按 P4 屬 billing。負責團隊 PRT。Priority 2。
T-6016 導遊語言錯誤導致被拒且無爭議收費。P2 適用，負責團隊 COT，並因到場被拒而屬 Priority 1。
T-6017 營運商取消，按 P3 屬 booking。負責團隊 BST。Priority 2。
PRT 爭議合計為 1450 + 750 + 520 = 2720 HKD。
已做核對：每張工單對應一個負責團隊、對 T-6011、T-6014 及 T-6016 套用優先級規則，並確認 T-6014 的 linked defect 標記不改變負責團隊。

feedback.en: Every ticket is classified, owned and prioritised correctly: T-6011 billing PRT Priority 1, T-6012 booking BST Priority 2, T-6013 listing COT Priority 2, T-6014 billing PRT Priority 1, T-6015 billing PRT Priority 2, T-6016 listing COT Priority 1, T-6017 booking BST Priority 2, and the PRT disputed total of 2720 HKD matches the queue extract. The linked-defect tag on T-6014 is correctly kept separate from ownership.
feedback.zh: 所有工單的分類、負責團隊及優先級均正確：T-6011 billing PRT Priority 1、T-6012 booking BST Priority 2、T-6013 listing COT Priority 2、T-6014 billing PRT Priority 1、T-6015 billing PRT Priority 2、T-6016 listing COT Priority 1、T-6017 booking BST Priority 2，而 PRT 爭議合計 2720 HKD 亦與隊列摘錄一致。T-6014 的 linked defect 標記亦正確地與負責團隊分開處理。

feedback.en: Each decision is tied to the right precedence rule P1 to P4 with the matching coded flags, including P1 on T-6014 for charge_or_refund_disputed=yes with page_defect_claimed=yes, P2 on T-6013 and T-6016, and P4 on T-6011 and T-6015. The Priority 1 reasons are correctly distinguished, the 1000 HKD threshold for T-6011 and venue refusal for T-6014 and T-6016.
feedback.zh: 每項決策均連結到正確的 P1 至 P4 規則及對應編碼標記，包括 T-6014 因 charge_or_refund_disputed=yes 及 page_defect_claimed=yes 而用 P1、T-6013 及 T-6016 用 P2、T-6011 及 T-6015 用 P4。Priority 1 的理由亦正確區分，T-6011 為 1000 HKD 門檻，T-6014 及 T-6016 為到場被拒。

feedback.en: The checks run are concrete and cover the one-owner-per-ticket rule, the priority rule for T-6011, T-6014 and T-6016, and confirmation that the T-6014 linked-defect tag does not move ownership. Adding the explicit PRT sum re-check of 1450 plus 750 plus 520 would make the verification even tighter.
feedback.zh: 已做的核對具體，涵蓋每張工單一個負責團隊、對 T-6011、T-6014 及 T-6016 套用優先級規則，以及確認 T-6014 的 linked defect 標記不改變負責團隊。如再加列 PRT 金額重新核對 1450 加 750 加 520，核實會更嚴密。

feedback.en: You correctly state that all records are fictional learning material and keep the analysis inside the supplied queue extract and policy. The handover does not flag what is still missing, for example receipts or operator notes that would confirm the disputed amounts and the venue refusals.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出所有紀錄均為虛構學習材料，並把分析限於提供的隊列摘錄及政策之內。交接未指出仍欠缺的證據，例如可確認爭議金額及到場被拒的收據或營運商備註。

feedback.en: The handover lists each ticket's owner and priority, shows the PRT total with its addition 1450 + 750 + 520 = 2720 HKD, flags T-6014 as a COT linked defect, and records the checks performed, so the next owner can act without rereading the extract.
feedback.zh: 交接列出每張工單的負責團隊與優先級，展示 PRT 合計的加數 1450 + 750 + 520 = 2720 HKD，標示 T-6014 為 COT 的 linked defect，並記錄已做的核對，接手的同事無須重讀摘錄即可行動。

summary.en: All four structured answers and the written handover are correct and fully traceable to the queue extract and policy rules. The only gap is that missing evidence such as receipts or operator notes is not named, while the verification list could add the explicit PRT sum re-check.
summary.zh: 四項結構化答案及書面交接全部正確，並可完整追溯至隊列摘錄及政策規則。唯一不足是未點名欠缺的證據，例如收據或營運商備註，而核對清單亦可加列 PRT 金額的重新核對。

nextSteps.en: Add a short line naming what is still unverified, such as receipts and operator notes for the disputed amounts and venue refusals, and state that the PRT sum was re-added as 1450 plus 750 plus 520. No wording changes are needed on the classifications, owners or priorities.
nextSteps.zh: 加一短句點明仍未核實的項目，例如爭議金額及到場被拒所涉的收據與營運商備註，並註明 PRT 金額已重新加總為 1450 加 750 加 520。分類、負責團隊及優先級無須修改。

title.en: Revise an outdated date-change support article
title.zh: 修訂過時的日期更改支援文章

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional Klook-style travel support team. A public-facing draft article on changing a booking date is outdated. Revise it against the approved Policy v3.2 and the verification checklist. Deliver a corrected article section plus a concise evidence-based handover explaining the outdated lines, the calculation for booking K-2107, the approval owner, and what cannot be confirmed. Do not resolve any other booking ticket. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Klook and is not endorsed by it.
brief.zh: 你在支援一個虛構的 Klook 風格旅遊支援團隊。一篇關於更改預訂日期的公開草稿文章已過時。請按獲批的 Policy v3.2 及核實清單修訂。交付修訂後的文章段落，以及簡潔且以證據為本的交接，說明過時行、預訂 K-2107 的計算、批准負責人，以及無法確認的事項。不要處理任何其他預訂工單。此為受 Klook 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非獲 Klook 認可。

title.en: Approved Booking Date Change Policy v3.2
title.zh: 獲批預訂日期更改政策 v3.2

body.en: FICTIONAL SIMULATION. This is not an official Klook policy. Approved rules for date changes: Requests must be submitted at least 48 hours before the original experience start time. The new date must be within 90 days of the original date. A change administration fee of HKD 80 applies per booking. If the new date price is higher, the customer pays the price difference. If the new date price is lower, no refund or credit is given for the difference. A change is confirmed only after the administration fee and any price difference are paid. Approved article steps: 1 Confirm request timing and 90-day window. 2 Collect booking reference and new date. 3 Check availability. 4 Quote HKD 80 plus any higher price difference. 5 Send payment link. 6 Confirm change after payment.
body.zh: 虛構模擬。此非 Klook 官方政策。獲批日期更改規則：申請必須在原本體驗開始時間至少 48 小時前提交。新日期必須在原本日期起 90 天內。每張預訂收取 HKD 80 更改行政費。若新日期價格較高，客戶支付差額。若新日期價格較低，差額不設退款或信用額。只有在行政費及任何差額付清後，更改才獲確認。獲批文章步驟：1 確認申請時間及 90 天期限。2 收集預訂編號及新日期。3 檢查供應情況。4 報價 HKD 80 加任何較高價格差額。5 發送付款連結。6 付款後確認更改。

title.zh: 核實清單及批准負責人

body.en: FICTIONAL SIMULATION. Before publishing the corrected article: A. Compare every line with Policy v3.2. B. Replace or remove any line that contradicts policy. C. Verify the worked example for K-2107 uses the formula HKD 80 plus the higher new-date price difference. D. Obtain approval from the Customer Operations Content Lead, fictional owner M. Chan. E. Legal review is required only if the policy wording itself changes. Support agents may prepare the draft but cannot publish. Do not resolve any other live booking ticket in this task.
body.zh: 虛構模擬。發布修訂文章前：A. 將每一行與 Policy v3.2 比較。B. 替換或移除任何違反政策的行。C. 核實 K-2107 的示例使用公式 HKD 80 加較高的新日期價格差額。D. 取得客戶營運內容主管批准，虛構負責人為 M. Chan。E. 只有在政策措辭本身改變時才需要法律審查。支援人員可準備草稿但不可發布。此任務不要處理任何其他現行預訂工單。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Draft lines L1, L2 and L5 contradict Policy v3.2. L1 says 24 hours but policy requires at least 48 hours. L2 allows 12 months free changes but policy allows 90 days and charges HKD 80. L5 promises 50% refund for a lower new-date price but policy gives no refund or credit. L4 is not contradicted. Calculation for K-2107: request is 5 days before start, so the 48-hour rule is met. New date price HKD 1,460 is higher than HKD 1,280 by HKD 180. Total payable is HKD 80 administration fee plus HKD 180 difference, HKD 260. Corrected article should quote HKD 80 plus any higher price difference, confirm the 90-day window, and state no refund for lower prices. Before publication, compare every line with Policy v3.2, verify the K-2107 calculation, and obtain approval from Content Lead M. Chan. Legal review is needed only if policy wording changes. I did not resolve any other booking ticket. This is a fictional simulation and does not represent official Klook policy.

Chan 批准。只有政策措辭改變時才需法律審查。我沒有處理任何其他預訂工單。此為虛構模擬，不代表 Klook 官方政策。

title.zh: 獲批退款政策 v2.4

body.en: FICTIONAL SIMULATION. This is not an official Klook policy. Approved refund rules: a refund equals the amount paid minus the cancellation fee. Cancellation fee tiers, measured by days before the experience start time: 14 or more days, HKD 60. 7 to 13 days, HKD 180. 1 to 6 days, HKD 320. On the start date or later, no refund. Refund statuses: Received, then Under Review within 3 business days of complete documents, then Approved, then Paid within 7 to 10 business days after approval. Refunds return to the original payment method. The public article must explain all four statuses.
body.zh: 虛構模擬。此非 Klook 官方政策。獲批退款規則：退款額等於已付金額減取消費。取消費級別按距離體驗開始時間的日數計算：14 天或以上為 HKD 60。7 至 13 天為 HKD 180。1 至 6 天為 HKD 320。開始當日或之後不設退款。退款狀態：Received，然後在文件齊全後 3 個工作天內轉為 Under Review，再轉為 Approved，並在批准後 7 至 10 個工作天內轉為 Paid。退款退回原本付款方式。公開文章必須說明全部四個狀態。

exemplar.en: Handover. Decision: revise the refund article before publication and do not publish it myself. Evidence: Refund Policy v2.4 shows refunds equal amount paid minus cancellation fee, with tiers HKD 60 at 14 or more days, HKD 180 at 7 to 13 days, HKD 320 at 1 to 6 days and no refund on the start date or later. Line R1 is wrong because it promises payment within 48 hours, while policy requires Under Review within 3 business days of complete documents and Paid within 7 to 10 business days after approval. Line R3 is wrong because the fee is tiered, not a flat HKD 50. Lines R2 and R4 match policy. Corrected section: add the four statuses Received, Under Review, Approved and Paid with both timelines, and remove R1 and R3. Calculation for K-5521: 9 days before start falls in the 7 to 13 day tier, so fee is HKD 180 and refund is 2400 minus 180 equals HKD 2220. Next steps: apply the corrected lines, re-check the status wording and the arithmetic, then request approval from J. Lau, Customer Operations Content Lead. Legal review only if policy wording changes. K-5522 and all other tickets stay out of scope, and payment timing is a fictional business-day estimate, not a guarantee.

title.en: Prioritise the Klook booking support queue

brief.en: You are covering the Klook booking support queue as an independent learning simulation, inspired by Klook but not endorsed by it, with fictional policies. The duty lead needs a finished-file handover before the next shift. Using the response window policy and the ticket extract, calculate every ticket's response deadline and remaining window at the fixed query time, rank the queue, and flag anything needing escalation. Deliver a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decisions, risks and next steps.

title.zh: 預訂支援回覆時限政策（虛構）

body.en: This policy is fictional learning material for the simulation. The queue query time is fixed at 2026-11-04 14:00 Hong Kong time. Response windows run from created_at only: urgent 2 hours, high 6 hours, standard 12 hours. A ticket is breached when the query time is later than its response deadline. Priority order places breached tickets first, most overdue first, then unbreached tickets with the smallest remaining window first. Tie-break: when two tickets share the same overdue duration or the same remaining window, work the earlier created_at first. Escalate any ticket overdue by more than 60 minutes to the duty lead.
body.zh: 本政策為此模擬的虛構學習材料。隊列查詢時間固定為香港時間 2026-11-04 14:00。回覆時限只由 created_at 起計：urgent 2 小時、high 6 小時、standard 12 小時。當查詢時間遲於回覆期限，即屬已逾期。排序規則為先處理已逾期的個案，逾期最久者優先，之後未逾期的個案以剩餘時限最短者優先。決勝規則：若兩個個案逾期時長相同或剩餘時限相同，先處理 created_at 較早者。任何逾期超過 60 分鐘的個案須轉交值班主管。
