brief.en: You cover the Klook booking support queue in an independent learning simulation inspired by Klook and not endorsed by it. All policies, tickets, staff and numbers are fictional. The queue query time is fixed at 2026-11-04 14:00 Hong Kong time. Using the response window policy and the ticket extract, work out each ticket's deadline and its remaining or overdue minutes, rank the whole queue, and flag anything that must be escalated. Deliver a concise handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, covering evidence, decisions, risks and next steps.
brief.zh: 你以獨立學習模擬形式處理 Klook 預訂支援隊列，此模擬受 Klook 啟發但未獲其認可。所有政策、個案、人員及數字均屬虛構。隊列查詢時間固定為香港時間 2026-11-04 14:00。請按回覆時限政策及個案摘錄，計算每個個案的回覆期限及其剩餘或逾期分鐘，排列整個隊列次序，並標示須轉交審核的個案。請提交約 100 至 180 個英文詞（或相若中文）的簡潔交接，涵蓋證據、決策、風險及下一步。

title.en: Booking Support Response Window and Pause Policy (fictional)
title.zh: 預訂支援回覆時限及暫停政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this simulation, not a real Klook policy. The queue query time is fixed at 2026-11-04 14:00 Hong Kong time. Base response windows from created_at are critical 3 hours, high 9 hours and normal 20 hours. Accumulated pause minutes, meaning time a ticket sat in awaiting-customer hold, extend the deadline, so deadline = created_at + base window + paused_minutes. Breached means the query time is later than the deadline. Priority order places breached tickets first, most overdue first, then unbreached tickets with the smallest remaining window first. If two tickets share the same remaining window, work the earlier created_at first, then the lower ticket_id. Escalate any ticket whose remaining window is 30 minutes or less, including tickets already overdue.
body.zh: 本政策為此模擬的虛構學習材料，並非 Klook 真實政策。隊列查詢時間固定為香港時間 2026-11-04 14:00。由 created_at 起計的基本回覆時限為：critical 3 小時、high 9 小時、normal 20 小時。累計暫停分鐘（即個案停留在等候客戶回覆狀態的時間）會延長期限，因此 deadline = created_at + 基本時限 + paused_minutes。查詢時間遲於期限即屬已逾期。優先次序為先處理已逾期的個案，逾期最久者優先，之後未逾期的個案以剩餘時限最短者優先。若兩個個案的剩餘時限相同，先處理 created_at 較早者，其後以較細的 ticket_id 為先。任何剩餘時限為 30 分鐘或以下的個案均須轉交審核，包括已逾期的個案。

title.en: Ticket extract with accumulated pause minutes
title.zh: 含累計暫停分鐘的個案摘錄

exemplar.en: Evidence. All five rows come from the fictional ticket extract and all times are Hong Kong time at the fixed query time 2026-11-04 14:00. Method. deadline = created_at + base window + paused_minutes, with base windows critical 3 hours, high 9 hours, normal 20 hours. T-5202 was created 05:45, so 05:45 plus 3 hours plus 55 paused minutes gives 09:40, which is 260 minutes overdue. T-5201 was created 09:10, so 09:10 plus 3 hours plus 140 paused minutes gives 14:30, leaving exactly 30 minutes. T-5204 was created 06:00, so 06:00 plus 9 hours plus 65 paused minutes gives 16:05, leaving 125 minutes. T-5205 was created 12:50, so 12:50 plus 3 hours plus 15 paused minutes also gives 16:05, leaving 125 minutes. T-5203 was created 07:30, so 07:30 plus 20 hours plus 240 paused minutes gives 2026-11-05 07:30, leaving 1050 minutes. Order. T-5202 first as the only breached case, then T-5201, then T-5204 before T-5205 because both leave 125 minutes and T-5204 was created earlier, then T-5203. Escalation. T-5202 is overdue and T-5201 sits exactly on the 30 minute threshold, which the policy includes, so both go to the duty lead now. Risks. The extract has no owner, contact history or pause reason column, so I assumed the recorded paused_minutes are complete and final. Next steps. Send the two escalation tickets to the duty lead, then work the order above, and ask the next shift to re-add the windows before taking over.

You show the deadline formula and the per-ticket arithmetic, apply critical, high and normal base windows to the extract, and justify T-5204 ahead of T-5205 by the earlier created_at tie-break. Reasoning is traceable to the policy and the CSV records.

title.zh: 預測評估及選擇政策

body.en: Absolute error for one period equals the absolute difference between actual orders and forecast orders. Mean absolute error (MAE) equals the sum of the period absolute errors divided by the number of periods evaluated. Maximum absolute error is the largest single period absolute error. Two accuracy gates apply and both must pass, MAE must be 100 orders or less, maximum absolute error must be 250 orders or less. Supported forecast is the forecast that passes both gates with the lower MAE. Tie-break order, lower maximum absolute error, then lower total absolute error, then the lexicographically smaller forecast id. Comparability rule, MAE may only be compared across periods of equal length in days. Periods of different length must be normalised to a per-day error before comparison. No forecasting model is trained in this exercise.
body.zh: 單一期間的絕對誤差等於實際訂單與預測訂單之差的絕對值。平均絕對誤差（MAE）等於各期絕對誤差之和除以已評估期數。最大絕對誤差為單一期間絕對誤差的最大值。兩項準確度關卡均須通過，MAE 須為 100 張訂單或以下，最大絕對誤差須為 250 張訂單或以下。有證據支持的預測為同時通過兩項關卡而 MAE 較低者。平手處理次序為最大絕對誤差較低者，其後為總絕對誤差較低者，其後為預測編號按字母序較前者。可比較性規則，MAE 只可在以天數計長度相同的期間之間比較。長度不同的期間須先轉換為每日誤差再作比較。本練習不訓練任何預測模型。

title.en: Forecast evaluation and selection policy with bias gates
title.zh: 設有偏差關卡的預測評估及選擇政策

body.en: Definitions. Signed error for one period equals forecast orders minus actual orders. Bias equals the mean of the signed errors across the evaluated periods. Absolute bias is the absolute value of bias. Mean absolute error (MAE) equals the sum of the period absolute errors divided by the number of periods evaluated, where a period absolute error is the absolute value of the signed error. Maximum absolute error is the largest single period absolute error. Accuracy gates. Both gates must pass. Gate 1, absolute bias must be 60 orders or less. Gate 2, maximum absolute error must be 180 orders or less. Supported forecast. A forecast is supported only if it passes both gates. If both forecasts pass both gates, the supported forecast is the one with the lower MAE. If MAEs are equal, the tie-break order is lower maximum absolute error, then lower absolute bias, then lexicographically smaller forecast id. Comparability. Bias and MAE may only be compared across periods of equal length in days. Periods of different length must be normalised to a per-day error before comparison. No forecasting model is trained in this exercise.
body.zh: 定義。單一期間的帶符號誤差等於預測訂單減實際訂單。偏差等於已評估期間帶符號誤差的平均數。絕對偏差為偏差的絕對值。平均絕對誤差（MAE）等於各期絕對誤差之和除以已評估期數，其中每期絕對誤差為帶符號誤差的絕對值。最大絕對誤差為單一期間絕對誤差的最大值。準確度關卡。兩項關卡均須通過。關卡一，絕對偏差須為 60 張訂單或以下。關卡二，最大絕對誤差須為 180 張訂單或以下。有證據支持的預測。預測只有在同時通過兩項關卡時方為有證據支持。若兩個預測均通過兩項關卡，MAE 較低者為有證據支持的預測。若 MAE 相同，平手處理次序為最大絕對誤差較低者，其後為絕對偏差較低者，其後為預測編號按字母序較前者。可比較性。偏差及 MAE 只可在以天數計長度相同的期間之間比較。長度不同的期間須先轉換為每日誤差再作比較。本練習不訓練任何預測模型。

description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Calculate defined forecast errors and select the supported forecast under a fixed rule.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。計算明確定義的預測誤差，並按固定規則選擇有證據支持的預測。

expectedEvidence.en: Forecast A signed errors are -100, -100, -100, -100, -100, so bias is -100 orders and absolute bias is 100 orders, which exceeds the 60-order bias gate, so Forecast A fails gate 1. Forecast A absolute errors are 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, so maximum absolute error is 100 orders, which passes gate 2. Forecast B signed errors are +60, +80, -80, -40, +60, so bias is +16 orders and absolute bias is 16 orders. Forecast B absolute errors are 60, 80, 80, 40, 60, so maximum absolute error is 80 orders and MAE is 64 orders. Forecast B passes both gates. The supported forecast is forecast-b only. Accept -100 for the bias of Forecast A and 80 for the maximum absolute error of Forecast B.
expectedEvidence.zh: 預測 A 的帶符號誤差為 -100、-100、-100、-100、-100，因此偏差為 -100 張訂單，絕對偏差為 100 張訂單，超出 60 張訂單的偏差關卡，故預測 A 未通過關卡一。預測 A 的絕對誤差為 100、100、100、100、100，最大絕對誤差為 100 張訂單，通過關卡二。預測 B 的帶符號誤差為 +60、+80、-80、-40、+60，因此偏差為 +16 張訂單，絕對偏差為 16 張訂單。預測 B 的絕對誤差為 60、80、80、40、60，最大絕對誤差為 80 張訂單，MAE 為 64 張訂單。預測 B 通過兩項關卡。有證據支持的預測僅為 forecast-b。預測 A 偏差接受 -100，預測 B 最大絕對誤差接受 80。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links each calculation to forecast-nt04-data period rows P1 to P5 and to the policy definitions. States signed error equals forecast orders minus actual orders, so bias is the mean of the five signed errors. Notes that gate 1 tests absolute bias 100 against the 60-order limit while gate 2 tests maximum absolute error against the 180-order limit, and that both thresholds are inclusive.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把每項計算連結至 forecast-nt04-data 的 P1 至 P5 期間列及政策定義。說明帶符號誤差等於預測訂單減實際訂單，因此偏差為五個帶符號誤差的平均數。指出關卡一以絕對偏差 100 對比 60 張訂單上限，關卡二以最大絕對誤差對比 180 張訂單上限，而兩個門檻均包含上限。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as recomputing each signed error from the CSV rows, re-summing the five signed errors and dividing by five to confirm bias, confirming both gate thresholds are inclusive, confirming every period is 7 days before comparing bias or MAE, and re-running both gates on a sixth 7-day period when available.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如從 CSV 各列重新計算每項帶符號誤差、重新加總五個帶符號誤差並除以五以確認偏差、確認兩項關卡門檻均包含上限、在比較偏差或 MAE 前確認每個期間均為 7 天，以及在取得第六個 7 天期間時重新套用兩項關卡。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States the records are fictional synthetic learning data covering one hub zone and five periods only. Avoids causal claims about courier demand and avoids claiming a trained model or generalisation to other zones, longer horizons or currency effects.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明資料為僅涵蓋一個樞紐區域及五個期間的虛構合成學習記錄。避免就配送需求作因果判斷，避免聲稱已訓練模型，亦避免推廣至其他區域、較長預測期或金額影響。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states the decision forecast-b, cites the bias values plus the maximum absolute error figures of 100 orders for A and 80 orders for B, names one uncertainty and one next check, and assigns the next check to an analytics owner such as Cherry Lam, analytics team lead.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明決策為 forecast-b，引用偏差數值及預測 A 的 100 張訂單與預測 B 的 80 張訂單最大絕對誤差，列出一項不確定性及一項下一步檢查，並把下一步檢查指派予分析負責人，例如分析團隊主管 Cherry Lam。

exemplar.en: Evidence. Five 7-day periods for zone NT-HUB-04, synthetic records. Signed error equals forecast minus actual. Forecast A signed errors are -100, -100, -100, -100, -100, so bias is -100 orders and absolute bias is 100 orders. Forecast A absolute errors are 100 each, so maximum absolute error is 100 orders and MAE is 100 orders. Forecast B signed errors are +60, +80, -80, -40, +60, so bias is +16 orders and absolute bias is 16 orders. Forecast B absolute errors are 60, 80, 80, 40, 60, so maximum absolute error is 80 orders and MAE is 64 orders. Gates. Gate 1 allows absolute bias of 60 orders or less. Forecast A records 100, so it fails. Forecast B records 16, so it passes. Gate 2 allows maximum absolute error of 180 orders or less. Forecast A records 100 and Forecast B records 80, so both pass gate 2. Decision. Forecast B is the only supported forecast because only it passes both gates. Uncertainty. Only five periods and one hub zone are supplied, so the result may not generalise to other zones or later weeks. Next check. Recompute every signed error from the CSV and re-apply both gates on a sixth 7-day period when data arrive. Owner, Cherry Lam, analytics team lead.
exemplar.zh: 證據。區域 NT-HUB-04 的合成五個 7 天期間記錄。帶符號誤差等於預測減實際。預測 A 的帶符號誤差為 -100、-100、-100、-100、-100，因此偏差為 -100 張訂單，絕對偏差為 100 張訂單。預測 A 的絕對誤差各為 100，因此最大絕對誤差為 100 張訂單，MAE 為 100 張訂單。預測 B 的帶符號誤差為 +60、+80、-80、-40、+60，因此偏差為 +16 張訂單，絕對偏差為 16 張訂單。預測 B 的絕對誤差為 60、80、80、40、60，因此最大絕對誤差為 80 張訂單，MAE 為 64 張訂單。關卡。關卡一允許絕對偏差為 60 張訂單或以下。預測 A 為 100，未通過。預測 B 為 16，通過。關卡二允許最大絕對誤差為 180 張訂單或以下。預測 A 為 100，預測 B 為 80，兩者均通過關卡二。決策。預測 B 是唯一有證據支持的預測，因只有它同時通過兩項關卡。不確定性。僅提供五個期間及一個樞紐區域，結果未必可推廣至其他區域或較後星期。下一步檢查。從 CSV 重新計算每項帶符號誤差，並在取得第六個 7 天期間時重新套用兩項關卡。負責人為分析團隊主管 Cherry Lam。

feedback.en: All defined errors are correct. Forecast A signed errors of -100 each give a bias of -100 orders and an absolute bias of 100 orders that fails the 60-order gate, while Forecast B gives +16 orders bias and a maximum absolute error of 80 orders, so forecast-b is the only supported method. Your selected statements also match the records.
feedback.zh: 所有定義的誤差均正確。預測 A 每期帶符號誤差為 -100，偏差為 -100 張訂單，絕對偏差 100 張訂單未通過 60 張訂單關卡；預測 B 偏差為 +16 張訂單，最大絕對誤差 80 張訂單，因此 forecast-b 是唯一有證據支持的方法。你所選的陳述亦與記錄一致。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to the P1 to P5 rows of the period study and to the policy definitions, including the rule that signed error equals forecast minus actual and that both gate thresholds are inclusive. The reasoning for why A fails gate 1 but passes gate 2 is clearly shown.
feedback.zh: 你把每項數字連結至期間研究的 P1 至 P5 列及政策定義，包括帶符號誤差等於預測減實際，以及兩項關卡門檻均包含上限。你亦清楚說明 A 為何未通過關卡一但通過關卡二。

feedback.en: Your next check is concrete: recompute the signed errors from the CSV and re-apply both gates on a sixth 7-day period, with Cherry Lam named as owner. You could also note confirming that every period is 7 days before comparing bias or MAE.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步檢查具體可行：從 CSV 重新計算帶符號誤差，並在取得第六個 7 天期間時重新套用兩項關卡，並指名 Cherry Lam 為負責人。你亦可補上在比較偏差或 MAE 前確認每個期間均為 7 天。

feedback.en: You state the records are synthetic and limited to one hub zone and five periods, and you avoid causal claims about courier demand or generalising to other zones and later weeks. This keeps the conclusion within the supplied evidence.
feedback.zh: 你說明資料為合成記錄，且僅涵蓋一個樞紐區域及五個期間，並避免就配送需求作因果判斷或推廣至其他區域及較後星期。結論因此保持在提供證據範圍內。

feedback.en: The handover states the decision forecast-b, cites the bias values and the maximum absolute errors of 100 for A and 80 for B, and names one uncertainty plus one next check with an owner. It is directly actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接列明決策為 forecast-b，引用偏差數值及 A 的 100 與 B 的 80 最大絕對誤差，並列出一項不確定性及一項附負責人的下一步檢查。內容可直接付諸實行。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every calculation, gate decision and selected statement is correct, and the handover is clear and well bounded to the synthetic five-period single-zone evidence. No accuracy or reasoning gaps were found.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。所有計算、關卡決定及所選陳述均正確，交接清晰並適切限於合成五期間單一區域的證據。未發現準確度或推理上的缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Extend the same method by confirming the 7-day equality across periods before any bias or MAE comparison, and record what a sixth 7-day period would need to show before re-running both gates. You may also note that bias and MAE are order-based and say nothing about the cost or service impact of the chosen forecast.
nextSteps.zh: 可延伸同一方法，在比較偏差或 MAE 前先確認各期間均為 7 天，並記錄第六個 7 天期間需顯示甚麼才值得重新套用兩項關卡。你亦可指出偏差及 MAE 以訂單計算，並未反映所選預測的成本或服務影響。

title.zh: 審查訂單與商戶主檔連結

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by foodpanda Hong Kong. It is not endorsed by foodpanda, and every record is fictional. You are auditing a synthetic weekly order extract. Two supplied tables share the key merchant_id. Produce the reconciled matched-order value and the platform commission for the week, then write a 100 to 180 word handover. State the join rule you applied, which records were retained, excluded or duplicated, and one verification step. Use only the supplied rules and values.
brief.zh: 本練習為受 foodpanda 香港啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非獲 foodpanda 認可，所有記錄均屬虛構。你正審查一份合成的每週訂單摘錄。提供的兩份資料表共用 merchant_id 鍵值。請計出本週已對帳的配對訂單金額及平台佣金，然後撰寫 100 至 180 字的交接說明。說明所套用的連結規則、哪些記錄被保留、排除或重複，以及一項核實步驟。只可使用提供的規則及數值。

title.zh: 每週連結審查任務

body.en: Fictional learning assignment. The weekly merchant reconciliation for the week of 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07 was drafted by an intern who joined the two extracts without checking key uniqueness. Deliverables: the reconciled matched order value, the platform commission total, and a short written handover naming the join rule used, the duplicate-key exception, the unmatched order, and one verification step. All amounts are HKD.
body.zh: 虛構學習任務。2026-06-01 至 2026-06-07 一週的商戶對帳初稿由一名實習生完成，他未有檢查鍵值唯一性便把兩份摘錄連結。交付項目：已對帳的配對訂單金額、平台佣金總額，以及一份簡短交接說明，列明所用的連結規則、重複鍵值異常、未配對訂單，以及一項核實步驟。所有金額均以港幣計。

title.zh: 對帳規則及指標定義

body.en: Rule J1: join orders to merchant_master on exact merchant_id equality, inner join for all totals. Rule J2: merchant_master may hold duplicate merchant_id rows. Before joining, keep exactly one row per merchant_id, the row with the most recent updated_at. Log each discarded row as a duplicate-key exception. Rule J3: an order whose merchant_id has no retained merchant_master row is unmatched. Exclude it from merchant-level totals and report it separately with its order count and order value. Rule J4: a merchant_master row with no matched order must still appear in the coverage report with zero matched orders. Metric M1: platform commission per merchant equals that merchant's matched order value times commission_rate_pct divided by 100, reported to two decimals.
body.zh: 規則 J1：以 merchant_id 完全相等把 orders 連結至 merchant_master，所有總額使用內連結。規則 J2：merchant_master 可能含重複的 merchant_id 記錄。連結前，每個 merchant_id 只保留一列，即 updated_at 最新的那一列。每列被捨棄的記錄須記錄為重複鍵值異常。規則 J3：若訂單的 merchant_id 沒有獲保留的 merchant_master 列，該訂單即為未配對。須把它排除於商戶層總額之外，並單獨報告其訂單數目及訂單金額。規則 J4：沒有配對訂單的 merchant_master 列仍須出現在覆蓋報告中，配對訂單數為零。指標 M1：每商戶平台佣金等於該商戶的配對訂單金額乘以 commission_rate_pct 再除以 100，報告至兩位小數。

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly applies J1 to J4 and M1: the retained M-01 row is the 2026-05-19 row at 22 percent, matched order value is 1,155 HKD from six orders (O-1001 to O-1006), and total commission is 211.30 HKD (85.80 + 40.50 + 64.00 + 21.00). Shows that listing both M-01 rows would inflate the matched value to 1,545 HKD and must not be used.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確套用 J1 至 J4 及 M1：獲保留的 M-01 列為 2026-05-19 的 22% 一列，配對訂單金額為 1,155 港元（來自 O-1001 至 O-1006 六張訂單），佣金總額為 211.30 港元（85.80 + 40.50 + 64.00 + 21.00）。指出若同時保留兩列 M-01 會把配對金額膨脹至 1,545 港元，絕不可採用。

exemplar.en: Matched order value for the week is 1,155 HKD and platform commission is 211.30 HKD, using the merchant master deduplicated under rule J2. The merchant_master extract held six rows for five distinct merchant_id values. M-01 appeared twice, at 18 percent updated 2026-03-04 and 22 percent updated 2026-05-19, so I retained the 2026-05-19 row and logged the 2026-03-04 row as a duplicate-key exception. Keeping both, as an unchecked inner join would, inflates the join to eight rows and 1,545 HKD. Matched merchants: M-01 390 HKD at 22 percent gives 85.80, M-02 270 at 15 percent gives 40.50, M-03 320 at 20 percent gives 64.00, M-04 175 at 12 percent gives 21.00. Order O-1007 carries merchant_id M-09, which has no retained master row, so its 260 HKD is excluded from these totals and reported as one unmatched order. Merchant M-05 has no matched order and is reported at zero matched orders and zero commission. Next step: re-run the join with a uniqueness assertion on merchant_id, confirm the six matched orders total 1,155 HKD in the weekly dashboard, and escalate the missing M-09 master record to the merchant onboarding owner.
exemplar.zh: 本週配對訂單金額為 1,155 港元，平台佣金為 211.30 港元，並已按規則 J2 為商戶主檔去重。merchant_master 摘錄共有六列，涵蓋五個不同的 merchant_id。M-01 出現兩次，分別為 2026-03-04 更新的 18% 及 2026-05-19 更新的 22%，因此我保留 2026-05-19 一列，並把 2026-03-04 一列記錄為重複鍵值異常。若兩列都保留（即未經檢查的內連結），連結會膨脹至八列及 1,545 港元。配對商戶：M-01 390 港元按 22% 得 85.80，M-02 270 按 15% 得 40.50，M-03 320 按 20% 得 64.00，M-04 175 按 12% 得 21.00。訂單 O-1007 的 merchant_id 為 M-09，沒有獲保留的主檔列，其 260 港元已排除於上述總額之外，並報告為一張未配對訂單。商戶 M-05 沒有配對訂單，報告為零配對訂單及零佣金。下一步：以 merchant_id 唯一性斷言重跑連結、確認每週儀表板顯示六張配對訂單合共 1,155 港元，並把缺失的 M-09 主檔記錄轉交商戶入職負責人。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You retained the 2026-05-19 M-01 row at 22 percent, reported 1,155 HKD matched value from six orders, 211.30 HKD commission, and correctly excluded and reported O-1007 while keeping M-05 as a zero row.

title.zh: 審查服務事件與外送員主檔連結

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by foodpanda Hong Kong. It is not endorsed by foodpanda, and every record is fictional. You are auditing a synthetic weekly service-event extract. Two supplied tables share the key courier_id. Produce the total matched delivery fee, the total rider payout for the week, and a 100 to 180 word handover. Report unmatched events separately. State the join rule you applied, which records were retained, excluded or unmatched, and one verification step. Use only the supplied rules and values. All amounts are HKD.
brief.zh: 本練習為受 foodpanda 香港啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非獲 foodpanda 認可，所有記錄均屬虛構。你正審查一份合成的每週服務事件摘錄。提供的兩份資料表共用 courier_id 鍵值。請計出配對送遞費總額、本週外送員薪酬總額，並撰寫 100 至 180 字的交接說明。未配對事件須單獨報告。說明所套用的連結規則、哪些記錄被保留、排除或未配對，以及一項核實步驟。只可使用提供的規則及數值。所有金額均以港幣計。

title.zh: 每週服務事件連結審查任務

body.en: Fictional learning assignment. The weekly service-event reconciliation for the week of 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-12 was drafted by an intern who joined the two extracts without checking key matching. Deliverables: the total matched delivery fee, the total rider payout, and a short written handover naming the join rule used, the unmatched event exception, the zero-event courier coverage row, and one verification step. All amounts are HKD.
body.zh: 虛構學習任務。2026-07-06 至 2026-07-12 一週的服務事件對帳初稿由一名實習生完成，他未有檢查鍵值配對便把兩份摘錄連結。交付項目：配對送遞費總額、外送員薪酬總額，以及一份簡短交接說明，列明所用的連結規則、未配對事件異常、零事件外送員覆蓋列，以及一項核實步驟。所有金額均以港幣計。

title.zh: 對帳規則及指標定義

body.en: Rule J1: join service_events to courier_master on exact courier_id equality, inner join for all courier-level totals. Rule J2: a service_event whose courier_id has no retained courier_master row is unmatched. Exclude it from courier-level totals and report it separately with its event count and delivery-fee sum. Rule J3: a courier_master row with no matched service_event must still appear in the coverage report with zero matched events and zero delivery fee. Rule J4: before joining, verify courier_id uniqueness in courier_master. If duplicate courier_id rows exist, keep only the row with the most recent updated_at and log each discarded row as a duplicate-key exception. Metric M1: rider payout per courier equals that courier's matched delivery_fee_hkd sum times payout_rate_pct divided by 100, reported to two decimals.
body.zh: 規則 J1：以 courier_id 完全相等把 service_events 連結至 courier_master，所有外送員層總額使用內連結。規則 J2：若服務事件的 courier_id 沒有獲保留的 courier_master 列，該事件即為未配對。須把它排除於外送員層總額之外，並單獨報告其事件數目及送遞費總和。規則 J3：沒有配對服務事件的 courier_master 列仍須出現在覆蓋報告中，配對事件數及送遞費均為零。規則 J4：連結前，須檢查 courier_master 的 courier_id 唯一性。若存在重複的 courier_id 列，只保留 updated_at 最新的一列，並把每列被捨棄的記錄記錄為重複鍵值異常。指標 M1：每名外送員的薪酬等於該外送員的配對 delivery_fee_hkd 總和乘以 payout_rate_pct 再除以 100，報告至兩位小數。

expectedEvidence.zh: 可行交接說明列明決策、證據、總額、未配對異常及覆蓋列。列明下一步及就 C-19 對應向資料負責人上報。

exemplar.en: Evidence: service_events has 7 events totalling 255 HKD. courier_master has 5 unique courier_id rows. Applying rule J1 inner join on courier_id retains events E-2001 to E-2006 for couriers C-11 to C-14. Matched delivery fees are C-11 70 HKD (42+28), C-12 57 HKD (35+22), C-13 50 HKD, C-14 18 HKD, totalling 195 HKD. Rider payout under M1 is 70x80% = 56.00, 57x75% = 42.75, 50x82% = 41.00, 18x78% = 14.04, totalling 153.79 HKD. Rule J2: event E-2007 (courier C-19, 60 HKD) is unmatched, excluded from courier totals and reported separately as 1 event worth 60 HKD. Rule J3: C-15 has zero matched events and zero payout, and must appear in the coverage report. No duplicate-key exception is logged because courier_id values are unique. Next steps: recheck row counts before and after join, confirm matched 195 plus unmatched 60 equals total 255, and escalate C-19 mapping to the data owner. Claims limited to this fictional extract.
exemplar.zh: 證據：service_events 有 7 宗事件，總值 255 港元。courier_master 有 5 列唯一 courier_id 記錄。套用規則 J1 以 courier_id 作內連結，保留外送員 C-11 至 C-14 的事件 E-2001 至 E-2006。配對送遞費為 C-11 70 港元（42+28）、C-12 57 港元（35+22）、C-13 50 港元、C-14 18 港元，合共 195 港元。根據 M1，外送員薪酬為 70x80% = 56.00、57x75% = 42.75、50x82% = 41.00、18x78% = 14.04，合共 153.79 港元。規則 J2：事件 E-2007（外送員 C-19，60 港元）未配對，排除於外送員總額之外，並單獨報告為 1 宗價值 60 港元的事件。規則 J3：C-15 的配對事件數及薪酬均為零，必須在覆蓋報告中出現。由於 courier_id 值均唯一，不會記錄任何重複鍵值異常。下一步：重新檢查連結前後列數、確認配對 195 加未配對 60 等於總額 255，並就 C-19 對應向資料負責人上報。聲明限於此虛構摘錄。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. Matched delivery fee 195 HKD, rider payout 153.79 HKD, E-2007 excluded and reported as 1 unmatched event worth 60 HKD, and C-15 shown with zero events and zero payout. Per-courier arithmetic (56.00, 42.75, 41.00, 14.04) is accurate and no records are duplicated or lost.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。配對送遞費 195 港元、外送員薪酬 153.79 港元、E-2007 排除並單獨報告為 1 宗價值 60 港元的未配對事件，C-15 亦以零事件及零薪酬顯示。每名外送員的計算（56.00、42.75、41.00、14.04）準確，沒有記錄被重複或遺失。

feedback.en: You cite specific records and connect them to the rules: E-2001 to E-2006 retained under J1, E-2007 with courier C-19 absent from courier_master, and payout rates 80, 75, 82 and 78 applied per courier. The link from J1 inner join to retained rows and the matched count of 6 against total 255 HKD is clearly explained.
feedback.zh: 你引用了具體記錄並連結至規則：J1 下保留 E-2001 至 E-2006，E-2007 的外送員 C-19 不在 courier_master，並按每名外送員套用薪酬率 80、75、82 及 78。J1 內連結至獲保留列，以及配對 6 宗對比總值 255 港元的關係說明清晰。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete: rechecking row counts before and after the join, confirming 195 plus 60 equals 255, and escalating the C-19 mapping to the data owner. Consider also stating the courier_id uniqueness check explicitly as a pre-join step to fully mirror rule J4.
feedback.zh: 你的檢查具體：重新核對連結前後列數、確認 195 加 60 等於 255，並就 C-19 對應向資料負責人上報。可再明確把 courier_id 唯一性檢查列為連結前步驟，以完整對應規則 J4。

feedback.en: You limit claims to this fictional extract and note no duplicate-key exception this week because courier_id values are unique. The absent C-19 master record is treated as a data gap rather than a performance judgement, which is the right framing.
feedback.zh: 你把聲明限於此虛構摘錄，並說明本週 courier_id 值均唯一故無重複鍵值異常。欠缺 C-19 主檔記錄被視為資料缺口而非績效判斷，定位正確。

feedback.en: The handover is actionable and well structured, covering decisions, evidence, totals, the unmatched exception and the coverage row. Ownership is clear with next steps and escalation of the C-19 mapping to the data owner, at 162 words within the 100 to 180 word guide.
feedback.zh: 交接說明可行且結構清晰，涵蓋決策、證據、總額、未配對異常及覆蓋列。責任歸屬明確，列明下一步及就 C-19 對應向資料負責人上報，全篇 162 字，符合 100 至 180 字指引。

summary.en: Strong complete submission. Every decision is correct, the reasoning cites specific records and applied rates, and the handover is clear and within the suggested length. The only minor enhancement is stating the pre-join uniqueness check explicitly.
summary.zh: 提交完整且表現出色。所有決策正確，推理引用具體記錄及套用率，交接清晰並符合建議長度。唯一可稍作補充之處，是明確列出連結前的唯一性檢查。

nextSteps.en: Add an explicit pre-join courier_id uniqueness statement to fully cover rule J4. Otherwise no further changes are needed, as the totals, unmatched handling and coverage row already match the supplied rules.
nextSteps.zh: 明確加入連結前的 courier_id 唯一性陳述，以完整涵蓋規則 J4。除此之外無需其他修改，總額、未配對處理及覆蓋列已符合提供規則。

title.en: Specify the completed-order on-time rate metric
title.zh: 定義完成訂單準時率指標

brief.en: You are covering the foodpanda Hong Kong analytics desk in a fictional learning exercise. The operations lead wants the weekly completed-order on-time rate for 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08 Hong Kong time, built from the supplied synthetic extract. Confirm the inclusion rules, state the denominator, calculate the rate, and name every excluded record with its reason. Finish with a short written handover covering your calculation, the display specification and two verification checks you would run before publishing. Independent learning simulation, not endorsed by foodpanda.
brief.zh: 你在這個虛構學習練習中暫代 foodpanda 香港分析崗位。營運主管要求以提供的虛構摘錄，計算 2026-03-02 至 2026-03-08（香港時間）該週的完成訂單準時率。請確認納入規則、說明分母、計算比率，並列出每一筆被排除的記錄及其原因。最後提交簡短書面交接，涵蓋你的計算、顯示規格，以及發佈前會做的兩項核實檢查。本練習為獨立學習模擬，未獲 foodpanda 認可。

title.zh: 準時配送指標定義（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, created for this exercise and not endorsed by foodpanda. Metric: completed-order on-time rate for the week 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08 Hong Kong time (HKT). Include an order only when completed_at is on or after 2026-03-02 00:00:00 HKT and at or before 2026-03-08 23:59:59 HKT, channel is delivery, status is COMPLETED, is_test is no, and cancelled_after_accept is no. An included order is on time when actual_minutes is less than or equal to promised_minutes. Exclude every other record.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，為本練習而設，未獲 foodpanda 認可。指標：2026-03-02 至 2026-03-08（香港時間，HKT）該週的完成訂單準時率。僅當 completed_at 為 2026-03-02 00:00:00 HKT 或之後，且為 2026-03-08 23:59:59 HKT 或之前，channel 為 delivery，status 為 COMPLETED，is_test 為 no，cancelled_after_accept 為 no 時，方可納入該訂單。納入訂單在 actual_minutes 小於或等於 promised_minutes 時屬準時。其他記錄一律排除。

title.zh: 顯示規格及覆核政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning simulation. Display the on-time rate as a percentage with one decimal place, rounded half up, shown beside the denominator count. A footnote must list every exclusion reason. Refresh the tile daily at 09:00 HKT. The analytics team owns the tile. Escalate to the team lead when a recomputed rate differs by more than 0.5 percentage points from the published value. The source extract contains synthetic records only, so it cannot support claims about real customers, riders or merchants.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬。準時率以百分比顯示，保留一位小數，四捨五入，並在分母數目旁展示。註腳須列出每項排除原因。圖表每日 09:00 HKT 更新。分析團隊為圖表負責人。當重新計算的比率與已發佈值相差超過 0.5 個百分點時，須向團隊主管上報。原始摘錄只載有虛構記錄，因此不能支持關於真實客戶、外送員或商戶的論述。

label.en: How many orders form the denominator of the on-time rate for this week? State the number of orders only.
label.zh: 本週準時率的分母由多少張訂單組成？只填訂單數目。

label.en: What is the completed-order on-time rate for this week, expressed as a percentage with one decimal place?
label.zh: 本週完成訂單準時率為多少？以百分比表示，並保留一位小數。

label.en: Which time-window rule matches the metric brief?
label.zh: 哪項時間範圍規則與指標簡介一致？

label.en: Include 2026-03-02 00:00:00 through 2026-03-08 23:59:59 HKT, inclusive of both ends
Exclude 2026-03-02 00:00:00 and include the rest of the week
Include every order completed up to 2026-03-09 00:00:00
Apply the same clock times in UTC instead of HKT
label.zh: 以同一鐘面時間但改用 UTC 而非 HKT 套用

label.en: Which order IDs must be excluded from the on-time rate? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 哪些訂單編號必須從準時率中排除？選出所有適用者。

expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明列明指標及週次，給出分母 6、分子 3 及比率 50.0%，逐項列出被排除訂單及原因，說明保留一位小數的顯示規格，並提出下一步及超過 0.5 個百分點時向團隊主管上報。

exemplar.en: Metric: completed-order on-time rate, week 2026-03-02 00:00:00 to 2026-03-08 23:59:59 HKT, from the order-events extract. Applying the metric brief gives a denominator of 6 orders: HK-1001, HK-1002, HK-1004, HK-1006, HK-1008 and HK-1010. Excluded: HK-1003 (pickup channel), HK-1005 (CANCELLED, cancelled_after_accept yes), HK-1007 (is_test yes) and HK-1009 (completed 2026-03-09 00:00:00, outside the window). An included order is on time when actual_minutes is less than or equal to promised_minutes. On time: HK-1001 (27 of 30), HK-1004 (35 of 35, boundary row) and HK-1008 (19 of 20). Late: HK-1002, HK-1006 and HK-1010. Rate is 3 divided by 6 = 50.0 percent, displayed with one decimal place beside the denominator. Verification: recompute the denominator with an independent filter, re-check HK-1001 and HK-1008 at the boundaries, and confirm all timestamps are HKT. The records are synthetic. Escalate any difference above 0.5 percentage points to the team lead.
exemplar.zh: 指標：完成訂單準時率，週次為 2026-03-02 00:00:00 至 2026-03-08 23:59:59 HKT，資料來自 order-events 摘錄。按指標簡介套用後，分母為 6 張訂單：HK-1001、HK-1002、HK-1004、HK-1006、HK-1008 及 HK-1010。被排除：HK-1003（pickup 渠道）、HK-1005（CANCELLED，cancelled_after_accept 為 yes）、HK-1007（is_test 為 yes）及 HK-1009（於 2026-03-09 00:00:00 完成，超出時間範圍）。納入訂單在 actual_minutes 小於或等於 promised_minutes 時屬準時。準時：HK-1001（27 對 30）、HK-1004（35 對 35，邊界資料）及 HK-1008（19 對 20）。遲到：HK-1002、HK-1006 及 HK-1010。比率為 3 除以 6 = 50.0%，顯示時保留一位小數，並列於分母旁。核實：以獨立篩選重新計算分母，覆核邊界的 HK-1001 及 HK-1008，並確認所有時間戳為 HKT。記錄為虛構。若差異超過 0.5 個百分點，向團隊主管上報。

feedback.en: Correct throughout. Denominator is 6 orders, numerator 3, rate 50.0 percent, window inclusive of both ends in HKT, and all four exclusions match the brief.

feedback.en: Every exclusion is tied to a specific row and reason, and you list the on-time and late rows with their minute pairs including the 35 of 35 boundary case. Strong audit trail.
feedback.zh: 每項排除均緊扣具體資料列及原因，你亦列出準時與遲到資料及其分鐘對照，包括 35 對 35 的邊界個案。稽核線索清晰。

feedback.zh: 以獨立方式重算分母、覆核 HK-1001 及 HK-1008 邊界，以及確認 HKT，均屬具體。發佈前可再加測小於或等於規則及一位小數捨入檢查。

feedback.en: You correctly note the records are synthetic and reference the 0.5 percentage point escalation threshold. State explicitly that the extract cannot support claims about real customers, riders or merchants, and avoid attributing causes for the late orders.

title.en: Specify the weekly active merchant count metric

brief.en: You cover the foodpanda Hong Kong analytics desk in this fictional learning simulation, which is inspired by the company and not endorsed by it. The operations lead wants the weekly distinct active merchant metric for 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12 Hong Kong time, built from the supplied synthetic extract. Confirm the inclusion rules, state the deduplication rule, give the number of included events, calculate the distinct active merchant count, and name every excluded event_id with its reason. Finish with a short written handover covering your calculation, the display specification and two verification checks you would run before publishing.
brief.zh: 你在這個虛構學習模擬中暫代 foodpanda 香港分析崗位，本模擬受該公司啟發，但未獲其認可。營運主管要求以提供的虛構摘錄，計算 2026-04-06 至 2026-04-12（香港時間）該週的不同活躍商戶指標。請確認納入規則、說明去重規則、給出納入活動數目、計算不同活躍商戶數目，並列出每個被排除的 event_id 及其原因。最後提交簡短書面交接，涵蓋你的計算、顯示規格，以及發佈前會做的兩項核實檢查。

title.zh: 每週活躍商戶指標定義（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, created for this exercise and not endorsed by foodpanda. Metric: distinct active merchant count for the week 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12 Hong Kong time (HKT). Include an event only when event_date is on or after 2026-04-06 00:00:00 HKT and at or before 2026-04-12 23:59:59 HKT, event_type is ORDER_ACCEPTED or MENU_UPDATE, status is CONFIRMED, and is_test is no. Exclude every other record. If the same event_id appears more than once, keep the record with the earliest event_date, then the smallest row order as supplied, and exclude the later repeats. Only repeated event_id values are deduplicated. A record whose event_id is unique is retained even when its other fields are identical to another record. A merchant is active when it has at least one included event. The active merchant count is the number of distinct merchant_id values among included events.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，為本練習而設，未獲 foodpanda 認可。指標：2026-04-06 至 2026-04-12（香港時間，HKT）該週的不同活躍商戶數目。僅當 event_date 為 2026-04-06 00:00:00 HKT 或之後，且為 2026-04-12 23:59:59 HKT 或之前，event_type 為 ORDER_ACCEPTED 或 MENU_UPDATE，status 為 CONFIRMED，且 is_test 為 no 時，方可納入該活動。其他記錄一律排除。如相同 event_id 出現多於一次，保留 event_date 最早、其後為提供列序最小者，並排除較後重複項。只有重複出現的 event_id 值須去重。event_id 唯一的記錄須予保留，即使其其他欄位與另一記錄完全相同。當商戶有至少一項納入活動時，該商戶即屬活躍。活躍商戶數目為納入活動中不同 merchant_id 值的數目。

body.en: Fictional learning simulation. Deduplicate by merchant_id for the active merchant count. Display the count as a whole number beside the included event count. A footnote must list every exclusion reason. Refresh the tile daily at 09:00 HKT. The analytics team owns the tile. Escalate to the team lead when a recomputed count differs from the published value. exemplar.en: Handover for the weekly active merchant metric, week 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12 HKT. I applied an inclusive window from 2026-04-06 00:00:00 through 2026-04-12 23:59:59 HKT with event_type ORDER_ACCEPTED or MENU_UPDATE, status CONFIRMED and is_test no. Four records are excluded: E-2003 has status PENDING, E-2005 has is_test yes, E-2007 has status CANCELLED and E-2012 has event_date 2026-04-13, outside the window. No event_id repeats in the extract, so the earliest-date deduplication branch removes nothing. E-2013 and E-2014 carry unique event_ids, so they stay even though their other fields match E-2001 and E-2006. The included set is E-2001, E-2002, E-2004, E-2006, E-2008, E-2009, E-2010, E-2011, E-2013, E-2014 and E-2015, which is 11 events. Deduplicating by merchant_id gives M-101, M-102, M-105, M-107, M-108, M-109 and M-111, so the distinct active merchant count is 7. Display 7 as a whole number beside the included event count of 11, with a footnote listing every exclusion reason and a daily 09:00 HKT refresh. The analytics team owns the tile. Escalate to the team lead if a recomputed count differs from the published value. The synthetic records cannot support claims about real merchants.

The inclusive HKT window and the type, status and is_test conditions are applied correctly.

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to specific records: you explain each exclusion reason, note that no event_id repeats so the earliest-date branch removes nothing, and justify why E-2013 and E-2014 stay despite matching other rows. The merchant dedup of M-101 and M-102 is shown clearly.
feedback.zh: 推理緊扣具體記錄：你解釋每項排除原因，指出沒有 event_id 重複故最早日期分支不移除任何記錄，並說明 E-2013 及 E-2014 雖與其他列相同仍獲保留。M-101 及 M-102 的商戶去重亦清楚展示。

title.zh: UTM 分類政策 v1.2（虛構）

body.en: Fictional UTM taxonomy policy v1.2 for the Harbour Tea Co. audit. Normalise raw values by trimming whitespace then lowercasing. Approved sources are google, facebook, instagram, newsletter and linkedin. Approved mediums are cpc, paid-social, email and organic-social. Source aliases map Google, google.com and goog to google, FB, facebook.com and meta to facebook, IG and instagram to instagram, eDM to newsletter, and Linkedin and linked-in to linkedin. Medium aliases map ppc and paidsearch to cpc, paid, paidsocial and social-paid to paid-social, edm and newsletter to email, and organic and social-organic to organic-social. Approved combinations are google+cpc, facebook+paid-social, instagram+paid-social, newsletter+email and linkedin+organic-social. A record missing utm_source or utm_medium is unclassified. A normalised pair not in the approved combinations is invalid-combination. A blank utm_campaign is retained and labelled (not set). Do not invent sessions, spend or impact.
body.zh: 虛構 UTM 分類政策 v1.2，用於 Harbour Tea Co. 審查。正規化方式為先去除空白再轉小寫。核准來源為 google、facebook、instagram、newsletter 及 linkedin。核准媒介為 cpc、paid-social、email 及 organic-social。來源別名將 Google、google.com 及 goog 對應至 google，FB、facebook.com 及 meta 對應至 facebook，IG 及 instagram 對應至 instagram，eDM 對應至 newsletter，Linkedin 及 linked-in 對應至 linkedin。媒介別名將 ppc 及 paidsearch 對應至 cpc，paid、paidsocial 及 social-paid 對應至 paid-social，edm 及 newsletter 對應至 email，organic 及 social-organic 對應至 organic-social。核准組合為 google+cpc、facebook+paid-social、instagram+paid-social、newsletter+email 及 linkedin+organic-social。缺少 utm_source 或 utm_medium 的記錄列為未分類。正規化後組合不在核准組合內者列為無效組合。空白 utm_campaign 會保留並標示為 (not set)。不得虛構作次數、支出或影響。

title.zh: 推廣追蹤分類政策 v2.1（虛構）

body.en: Fictional campaign tracking taxonomy policy v2.1 for the Sai Kung Coffee Roasters audit. Normalise raw utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign by trimming whitespace then lowercasing. Approved sources: google, facebook, instagram, newsletter, linkedin. Approved mediums: cpc, paid-social, email, organic-social. Approved combinations: google+cpc, facebook+paid-social, instagram+paid-social, newsletter+email, linkedin+organic-social. Missing utm_source or utm_medium is unclassified and quarantined. A blank utm_campaign is retained and labelled (not set) when the source-medium combination is approved. Missing campaign_id while utm_campaign is non-blank is flagged missing-campaign-id and retained for backfill. A blank utm_campaign with a non-empty campaign_id is orphan-campaign-id and quarantined. Duplicate campaign label: the same normalised utm_campaign maps to two or more distinct non-empty campaign_id values. All records sharing that label are duplicate-conflict and quarantined until one canonical campaign_id is confirmed. Do not invent campaign IDs, spend or impact. Escalate all quarantined and missing-campaign-id records to Karis Wong, Analytics Lead, before publication.

title.zh: 排期政策 SP-42（虛構）

body.en: Fictional FIMMICK learning simulation, no real client or spend. Week W-42 has five working days, Day1 to Day5. The shared bilingual writer pool holds 20.0 writer-hours in W-42. Overtime and freelance support are unavailable. Every scheduled item must publish in English and Traditional Chinese, and an item costs its en_hours plus its zh_hours of writer time. Schedule items by ascending priority number, priority 1 first. Within one priority level, take the earlier deadline_day first. Add an item whenever it still fits the remaining writer-hours. Editor review costs 0.5 hours per language per item against a 12.0 review-hour pool. Each item needs one brand lead approval before publication.
body.zh: 虛構 FIMMICK 學習模擬，不涉及真實客戶或開支。第 W-42 週有五個工作天，即第1天至第5天。共享雙語寫手池在 W-42 有 20.0 寫手小時。不可加班，亦無自由職業支援。每個排期項目必須以英文及繁體中文發佈，項目成本等於其 en_hours 加 zh_hours 的寫手時間。項目按 priority 數字由小至大排序，priority 1 優先。同一 priority 內先取較早的 deadline_day。只要項目仍能放入剩餘寫手小時，便應加入。編輯審閱為每個語言每項目 0.5 小時，審閱池為 12.0 小時。每個項目發佈前需一次品牌主管批核。

title.en: Review capacity and cadence policy W-51 (fictional)

body.en: Fictional FIMMICK learning simulation. No real client, account or publication. Week W-51 has five working days, Day1 to Day5. The shared review pool holds 9.0 reviewer-hours for the week. Production effort is not modelled. Every item consumes its review_hours from the shared pool. Required channel cadence: the schedule must include exactly one newsletter item, at least one social item and at least one blog item. A channel may hold at most two items. Schedule by ascending priority number, priority 1 first. Within one priority, take the earlier deadline_day first. If deadline_day is equal, take the smaller item_id. Add every item that still fits remaining review hours and keeps all cadence rules true. Items that do not fit are unscheduled.
body.zh: 虛構 FIMMICK 學習模擬。不涉及真實客戶、帳戶或發佈。第 W-51 週有五個工作天，即第1天至第5天。共享審閱池在該週有 9.0 審閱小時。製作工作量不予建模。每個項目從共享池消耗其 review_hours。渠道節奏要求：排期必須包含恰好一個 newsletter 項目、至少一個 social 項目及至少一個 blog 項目。每個渠道最多可容納兩個項目。按 priority 數字由小至大排序，priority 1 優先。同一 priority 內先取較早的 deadline_day。若 deadline_day 相同，取較小的 item_id。只要項目仍能放入剩餘審閱小時，且使所有渠道節奏規則保持成立，便應加入。無法放入的項目為未排期。

title.en: Harbour Goods email onboarding funnel review
title.zh: Harbour Goods 電郵引導漏斗檢視

brief.en: Fictional client brief for FIMMICK. Harbour Goods asks for a lifecycle funnel review of four email onboarding cohorts. Use only supplied records. Do not access real accounts. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. Include aggregate stage progression, largest absolute drop-off, chosen bounded intervention with estimated incremental first orders, and one next verification step. Identify source records and state assumptions. Owner for next test is lifecycle marketing lead. Escalation is client analytics lead.
brief.zh: FIMMICK 的虛構客戶簡報。Harbour Goods 要求檢視四個電郵引導群組的生命週期漏斗。只可使用提供的記錄。不得存取真實帳戶。以英文或繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據為本交接。包括合計階段進度、最大絕對流失、所選有限度介入及其估計新增首張訂單，以及一項下一步核實步驟。指出來源記錄並說明假設。下一項測試負責人為 lifecycle marketing lead。上報對象為 client analytics lead。

title.zh: 生命週期漏斗量度政策

body.en: Fictional policy for Harbour Goods. Eligible contact means marketing consent plus valid email in the cohort file. Cohorts are disjoint by signup week. Do not combine cohorts for step conversion unless the brief asks for an aggregate. Stage progression rate = stage count divided by eligible contacts. Step conversion = later stage count divided by immediately previous stage count. Absolute drop-off = previous stage count minus later stage count. Round percentages to one decimal place. Only one intervention may be selected per cycle. Intervention cost must be within HKD 40,000. Estimated incremental orders apply the intervention uplift to the incomplete or unsent contacts at that step, then apply existing downstream step conversions. Highest estimated incremental orders within budget wins. Channel campaign metrics are out of scope. Interventions: I1 Profile prompt, cost HKD 12,000, target welcome_sent to profile_completed, uplift +10% of incomplete profiles. I2 Browse nudge, cost HKD 25,000, target profile_completed to catalogue_browsed, uplift +12% of non-browsers. I3 Order reminder, cost HKD 9,000, target catalogue_browsed to first_order, uplift +20% of non-orderers. I4 Welcome resend, cost HKD 35,000, target eligible contacts to welcome_sent, uplift +5% of unsent.
body.zh: Harbour Goods 的虛構政策。合資格聯絡人指群組檔案中具市場推廣同意及有效電郵者。群組按登記週互不重疊。除非簡報要求合計，否則不得合併群組計算步驟轉換。階段進度比率 = 階段數目除以合資格聯絡人。步驟轉換 = 後一階段數目除以緊接前一階段數目。絕對流失 = 前一階段數目減後一階段數目。百分比四捨五入至一位小數。每個週期只可選一項介入。介入成本必須在 HKD 40,000 內。估計新增訂單先把介入提升幅度應用於該步驟的未完成或未發送聯絡人，再套用現有下游步驟轉換。預算內估計新增訂單最高者勝出。渠道活動指標不在範圍內。介入：I1 Profile prompt，成本 HKD 12,000，目標 welcome_sent 至 profile_completed，提升未完成檔案 10%。I2 Browse nudge，成本 HKD 25,000，目標 profile_completed 至 catalogue_browsed，提升未瀏覽者 12%。I3 Order reminder，成本 HKD 9,000，目標 catalogue_browsed 至 first_order，提升未下單者 20%。I4 Welcome resend，成本 HKD 35,000，目標合資格聯絡人至 welcome_sent，提升未發送者 5%。

Next verification: run a two-week holdout test on cohort C-2409, confirm consent eligibility and monitor complaint rate. Owner: lifecycle marketing lead. Escalate to client analytics lead if C-2409 counts are incomplete. Assumptions: supplied uplifts are fictional estimates. No real account accessed.
exemplar.zh: 交接：Harbour Goods 電郵引導漏斗檢視。來源：群組 CSV C-2405 至 C-2408 及政策 LFP-1。合資格聯絡人合計 = 4500。首張訂單階段進度 = 512 / 4500 = 11.4%。最大絕對流失 = welcome_sent 至 profile_completed，4241 - 2756 = 1485 人。建議有限度介入：I3 Order reminder，成本 HKD 9,000，在 HKD 40,000 內。估計新增首張訂單 = catalogue_browsed 未下單者的 20% = 0.20 x (1455 - 512) = 188.6 張。I2 估計 54.9 張，I1 估計 27.6 張，I4 估計 1.6 張，因此 I3 勝出。下一步核實：對群組 C-2409 進行兩週對照測試，確認同意資格並監察投訴率。負責人：lifecycle marketing lead。若 C-2409 數目不完整，上報 client analytics lead。假設：提供的提升幅度為虛構估計。沒有存取真實帳戶。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You summed eligible contacts to 4500, computed first_order progression as 512/4500 = 11.4%, identified welcome_sent to profile_completed as the largest absolute drop-off (4241 minus 2756 = 1485), and selected I3 Order reminder with 0.20 x (1455 minus 512) = 188.6 incremental orders, correctly beating I2, I1 and I4.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。你合計合資格聯絡人為 4500，計算 first_order 進度為 512/4500 = 11.4%，找出 welcome_sent 至 profile_completed 為最大絕對流失（4241 減 2756 = 1485），並選出 I3 Order reminder，估算 0.20 乘（1455 減 512）= 188.6 張新增訂單，正確勝過 I2、I1 及 I4。

feedback.zh: 你提出對群組 C-2409 進行兩週對照測試、確認同意資格、監察投訴率，並列明 lifecycle marketing lead 及上報 client analytics lead。若能明確加一項檢查確認介入保持在 HKD 40,000 預算內，核實步驟會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable. It states the decision I3, the 11.4% progression, the 1485 drop-off, 188.6 estimated orders, HKD 9,000 cost, the C-2409 next test, owner and escalation, with a readable structure and no hidden assumptions.

title.zh: Skyline Ledger 試用至續約漏斗檢視

brief.en: Fictional client brief for FIMMICK. Skyline Ledger requests a trial-to-renewal lifecycle review of cohorts T-2501 to T-2504. Use only supplied records. Do not access real accounts. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. Include aggregate stage progression, largest absolute drop-off, one bounded intervention within HKD 40,000 with estimated incremental renewals, and one next verification step. Identify source records and state assumptions. Owner for next test is lifecycle marketing lead. Escalation is client analytics lead.
brief.zh: FIMMICK 的虛構客戶簡報。Skyline Ledger 要求檢視群組 T-2501 至 T-2504 的試用至續約生命週期。只可使用提供的記錄。不得存取真實帳戶。以英文或繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據為本交接。包括合計階段進度、最大絕對流失、一項 HKD 40,000 內的有限度介入及其估計新增續約，以及一項下一步核實步驟。指出來源記錄並說明假設。下一項測試負責人為 lifecycle marketing lead。上報對象為 client analytics lead。

title.zh: 試用至續約漏斗量度政策

body.en: Fictional policy for Skyline Ledger. Eligible trial means valid work email plus marketing consent in the cohort file, and trial started within the cohort week. Cohorts are disjoint by trial start week. Do not combine cohorts for step conversion unless the brief asks for an aggregate. Stage progression rate = stage count divided by eligible trials. Step conversion = later stage count divided by immediately previous stage count. Absolute drop-off = previous stage count minus later stage count. Round percentages to one decimal place. Only one intervention may be selected per cycle. Intervention cost must be within HKD 40,000. Estimated incremental renewals apply the intervention uplift to the incomplete or unconverted trials at that step, then apply existing downstream step conversions to renewal_paid. Highest estimated incremental renewals within budget wins. Channel campaign metrics are out of scope. Interventions: I1 Setup assist, cost HKD 15,000, target eligible trials to setup_completed, uplift +8% of incomplete setups. I2 Workspace prompt, cost HKD 28,000, target setup_completed to workspace_created, uplift +10% of non-workspace. I3 Subscribe nudge, cost HKD 20,000, target workspace_created to subscription_started, uplift +15% of non-subscribers. I4 Renewal reminder, cost HKD 12,000, target subscription_started to renewal_paid, uplift +25% of non-renewers.
body.zh: Skyline Ledger 的虛構政策。合資格試用指群組檔案中具有效工作電郵及市場推廣同意，且試用於該群組週內開始。群組按試用開始週互不重疊。除非簡報要求合計，否則不得合併群組計算步驟轉換。階段進度比率 = 階段數目除以合資格試用。步驟轉換 = 後一階段數目除以緊接前一階段數目。絕對流失 = 前一階段數目減後一階段數目。百分比四捨五入至一位小數。每個週期只可選一項介入。介入成本必須在 HKD 40,000 內。估計新增續約先把介入提升幅度應用於該步驟的未完成或未轉換試用，再套用現有下游步驟轉換至 renewal_paid。預算內估計新增續約最高者勝出。渠道活動指標不在範圍內。介入：I1 Setup assist，成本 HKD 15,000，目標合資格試用至 setup_completed，提升未完成設定 8%。I2 Workspace prompt，成本 HKD 28,000，目標 setup_completed 至 workspace_created，提升未建立工作區 10%。I3 Subscribe nudge，成本 HKD 20,000，目標 workspace_created 至 subscription_started，提升未訂閱 15%。I4 Renewal reminder，成本 HKD 12,000，目標 subscription_started 至 renewal_paid，提升未續約 25%。

title.en: Fictional HKW-31 revised timetable and batch release policy
title.zh: 虛構 HKW-31 修訂時間表及批次發佈政策

body.en: Fictional learning simulation for Enviro Labs, not endorsed by the company. Project HKW-31 is a synthetic monitoring programme for a fictional client. Each batch schedules 3 sites (S1, S2, S3) at parameter zinc_mgL, so each batch has 3 scheduled results and the four batches have 12. Revised timetable: the client requested a revision on 2026-09-02 because its site was unavailable, so batch B2 moved from scheduled week 40 to revised week 42. All other batches keep their scheduled weeks. Release rule: a batch is release-ready only if all 3 scheduled results are present and its QA review decision is recorded as pass. A batch missing 1 or 2 results is incomplete, preliminary only. A batch missing all 3 results is not reportable. If all 3 results are present but QA review is blank or not recorded, the batch is pending QA and not releasable. The missing-results rule is applied before the QA rule. Any client trend statement requires all four batches to be release-ready. Weeks, thresholds and QA outcomes are fictional and not legal standards.
body.zh: 此為 Enviro Labs 的虛構學習模擬，未獲公司認可。項目 HKW-31 是為虛構客戶而設的合成監測計劃。每個批次預定 3 個場地（S1、S2、S3），參數為 zinc_mgL，即每批次 3 個預定結果，四個批次共 12 個。修訂時間表：客戶於 2026-09-02 因其場地未能使用而要求修訂，批次 B2 由預定第 40 週改為修訂第 42 週。其餘批次維持預定週次。發佈規則：批次只有具備全部 3 個預定結果，且其 QA 覆核決定記錄為 pass，才可發佈。缺少 1 或 2 個結果的批次屬不完整，僅供初步參考。缺少全部 3 個結果的批次不可報告。如 3 個結果齊全但 QA 覆核空白或未記錄，該批次屬待 QA，不可發佈。缺少結果規則先於 QA 規則應用。任何客戶趨勢陳述須四個批次全部可發佈。週次、門檻及 QA 結果均為虛構，並非法定標準。

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Enviro Labs, not endorsed by it. You support a fictional client review of synthetic monitoring records for synthetic site LM-7. All records, thresholds and rules here are invented for training and are not legal or official standards.
brief.zh: 這是受環境化驗有限公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你協助虛構客戶覆核合成場地 LM-7 的合成監測紀錄。請把文件監測計劃與交回樣本紀錄比對，套用虛構覆蓋規則，匯報地點覆蓋缺口。以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據式交接。此處所有紀錄、門檻及規則均為培訓虛構，並非法定或官方標準。

title.en: Fictional coverage rules for the LM-7 review
title.zh: LM-7 覆核的虛構覆蓋規則

body.en:
These fictional rules apply only to this training simulation. They are not legal, official or company policy.

Coverage credit. A planned location earns coverage credit only if at least one returned record meets all four conditions.
1. The record station_id matches a station_id listed in the monitoring plan.
2. The record sample_date falls within the planned window, inclusive of both window dates.
3. The record field_check value is valid.
4. The record lab_acceptance value is accepted.

A record that fails any condition earns no coverage credit. A record from a station_id not listed in the plan covers no planned location. A planned location with zero coverage credit is a location coverage gap. Every coverage gap requires a re-sample request.
body.zh:
此等虛構規則只適用於本培訓模擬，並非法定、官方或公司政策。

覆蓋計分。計劃內地點只有在至少一筆交回紀錄同時符合以下四項條件時，才獲覆蓋計分。
1. 紀錄的 station_id 與監測計劃所列的 station_id 相同。
2. 紀錄的 sample_date 位於計劃時段之內，並包含時段的起訖日期。
3. 紀錄的 field_check 值為 valid。
4. 紀錄的 lab_acceptance 值為 accepted。

任何一項不符的紀錄不獲覆蓋計分。未列於計劃的 station_id 紀錄不覆蓋任何計劃內地點。覆蓋計分為零的計劃內地點屬於地點覆蓋缺口。每個覆蓋缺口均須提出重採樣要求。

title.en: Time coverage gap check for synthetic site LM-12
title.zh: 合成場地 LM-12 的時間覆蓋缺口核查

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Enviro Labs, not endorsed by it. You support a fictional client review of synthetic monitoring records for synthetic site LM-12. Compare the documentary monitoring plan against the returned sample records, apply the fictional coverage rules, and report time coverage gaps (planned station-period combinations with no qualifying record) and location coverage gaps (stations with zero coverage credit). Deliver a concise evidence-based written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All records, thresholds and rules here are invented for training and are not legal or official standards.
brief.zh: 這是受環境化驗有限公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你協助虛構客戶覆核合成場地 LM-12 的合成監測紀錄。請把文件監測計劃與交回樣本紀錄比對，套用虛構覆蓋規則，匯報時間覆蓋缺口（無合格紀錄的計劃站點時段組合）及地點覆蓋缺口（覆蓋計分為零的站點）。以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據式交接。此處所有紀錄、門檻及規則均為培訓虛構，並非法定或官方標準。

title.en: Fictional coverage rules for the LM-12 review
title.zh: LM-12 覆核的虛構覆蓋規則

body.en:
These fictional rules apply only to this training simulation. They are not legal, official or company policy.

Coverage credit. A planned station-period combination earns coverage credit only if at least one returned record meets all four conditions.
1. The record station_id matches the station_id of the planned combination.
2. The record sample_date falls within the planned window, inclusive of both window dates.
3. The record field_check value is valid.
4. The record lab_acceptance value is accepted.

A record that fails any condition earns no coverage credit for that combination. A record from a station_id not listed in the plan covers no planned combination. A planned station-period combination with zero coverage credit is a time coverage gap. A station_id with zero coverage credit across all its planned periods is a location coverage gap. Every coverage gap requires a re-sample request.
body.zh:
此等虛構規則只適用於本培訓模擬，並非法定、官方或公司政策。

覆蓋計分。計劃內站點時段組合只有在至少一筆交回紀錄同時符合以下四項條件時，才獲覆蓋計分。
1. 紀錄的 station_id 與該計劃組合的 station_id 相同。
2. 紀錄的 sample_date 位於計劃時段之內，並包含時段的起訖日期。
3. 紀錄的 field_check 值為 valid。
4. 紀錄的 lab_acceptance 值為 accepted。

任何一項不符的紀錄不為該組合取得覆蓋計分。未列於計劃的 station_id 紀錄不覆蓋任何計劃組合。覆蓋計分為零的計劃站點時段組合屬於時間覆蓋缺口。所有計劃時段均無覆蓋計分的 station_id 屬於地點覆蓋缺口。每個覆蓋缺口均須提出重採樣要求。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that all rules, records and thresholds are fictional training assumptions, not legal or official standards. States that no field collection instructions or health or safety judgments are given. Limits claims to the supplied synthetic LM-12 records and does not infer causes of missing records.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認所有規則、紀錄及門檻均為虛構培訓假設，並非法定或官方標準。說明不提供現場採集指示或健康安全判斷。把聲明限於提供的合成 LM-12 紀錄，不推斷缺失紀錄的成因。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.

expectedEvidence.en: Handover is concise, structured with evidence, decisions, risks and next steps. Names the monitoring team lead for escalation and states that each gap requires a re-sample request. Avoids unsupported conclusions.

exemplar.en:
Evidence: I compared the LM-12 monitoring plan against the returned records. Planned station-period combinations: S01-P1, S01-P2, S02-P1, S02-P2, S03-P1, S03-P2, S04-P1, S04-P2. Qualifying records: R-201 covers S01-P1, R-204 covers S03-P2, R-206 covers S04-P2. Non-qualifying: R-202 fails field_check, R-203 fails lab_acceptance, R-205 is outside both windows, R-207 is from unplanned station S05.

Decisions: Five time coverage gaps exist: S01-P2, S02-P1, S02-P2, S03-P1, S04-P1. S02 is the only location coverage gap. Each gap requires a re-sample request.

Risks and uncertainty: These rules and records are fictional training assumptions, not legal standards. No field collection advice is given. Missing records may have unknown causes.

Next steps: Re-run field_check for R-202, re-test lab_acceptance for R-203, verify R-205 date and S05 plan status, and raise re-sample requests for all five time gaps and station S02. Escalate to the monitoring team lead.
exemplar.zh:

決策：共有五個時間覆蓋缺口：S01-P2、S02-P1、S02-P2、S03-P1、S04-P1。S02 是唯一地點覆蓋缺口。每個缺口均須提出重採樣要求。

風險與不確定性：此等規則及紀錄均為虛構培訓假設，並非法定標準。不提供現場採集建議。缺失紀錄原因不明。

下一步：為 R-202 重驗 field_check，為 R-203 重驗 lab_acceptance，核實 R-205 日期及 S05 計劃狀態，並就所有五個時間缺口及站點 S02 提出重採樣要求。上報監測團隊主管。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: 5 time coverage gaps (S01-P2, S02-P1, S02-P2, S03-P1, S04-P1), the exact gap set, no-credit records R-202, R-203, R-205 and R-207, and S02 as the only location coverage gap. You applied the four coverage conditions consistently across the plan and returned records.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：5 個時間覆蓋缺口（S01-P2、S02-P1、S02-P2、S03-P1、S04-P1）、完整缺口組合、不計分紀錄 R-202、R-203、R-205 及 R-207，以及 S02 為唯一地點覆蓋缺口。你一致地把四項覆蓋條件套用於計劃及交回紀錄。

Each gap is tied to the absence of a qualifying record, which makes the reasoning fully traceable.

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and test the stated requirements: re-run field_check for R-202, re-test lab_acceptance for R-203, verify the R-205 date and S05 plan status, and raise re-sample requests for all five time gaps and station S02. This covers every gap found.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體並能測試所述要求：為 R-202 重驗 field_check、為 R-203 重驗 lab_acceptance、核實 R-205 日期及 S05 計劃狀態，並就所有五個時間缺口及站點 S02 提出重採樣要求，涵蓋所有已發現缺口。

summary.en: An accurate and complete handover. All structured decisions match the coverage rules, the 140-word write-up traces each conclusion to specific records and plan rows, and the scope limits are stated. No material gaps found.

nextSteps.en: No corrective action required. If you extend the review, keep tying each re-sample request to the specific failed condition so the client can act on it directly.

brief.en: Enviro Labs is an environmental testing laboratory. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Enviro Labs and is not endorsed by the company. A fictional client, Ho Chung Works, has sent 11 synthetic operational discharge records for the FY2026 Q1 inventory reconciliation. Using only the supplied scope policy and the records table, classify every record and reconcile the supported NH3-N mass proxy. Produce a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All rules are fictional and are not legal discharge standards.

title.en: FY2026 Q1 discharge inventory scope rules (fictional)
title.zh: 二零二六財年第一季排放盤點範圍規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this simulation. It is not a legal discharge standard. Inventory period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31 inclusive. In-scope parameters and required units: COD mg/L, TSS mg/L, NH3-N mg/L. QA flags: valid, estimated, void. A record is included only when its sample date is inside the inventory period, its parameter is in scope, its unit equals the required unit, and its QA flag is valid. When a record fails more than one test, report one reason using this priority: qa-not-valid, then out-of-period, then out-of-scope-parameter, then unit-mismatch. Supported mass proxy in kg = value in mg/L multiplied by discharge volume in m3, divided by 1000.
body.zh: 本情境的虛構學習政策，並非法定排放標準。盤點期：2026-01-01 至 2026-03-31（包括首尾兩日）。範圍內參數及規定單位：COD 毫克／升、TSS 毫克／升、NH3-N 毫克／升。品質保證標記：valid、estimated、void。只有當樣本日期在盤點期內、參數在範圍內、單位等於規定單位，且品質保證標記為 valid 時，該記錄方會納入。若記錄同時不符合多項條件，只須報告一個原因，優先次序為：qa-not-valid、然後 out-of-period、然後 out-of-scope-parameter、然後 unit-mismatch。支持質量代理（公斤）＝數值（毫克／升）乘以排放量（立方米），再除以 1000。

title.en: Client request from Ho Chung Works (fictional)

body.en: Dear Enviro Labs team, this exercise is an independent learning simulation and is not an endorsement by Enviro Labs. Ho Chung Works (fictional facility) submits 11 synthetic operational discharge records for the FY2026 Q1 inventory. Please classify each record under your supplied scope policy and reconcile the supported NH3-N mass proxy in kg. We need a short evidence-based handover within about 100 to 180 words, listing the included records, each exclusion reason and the calculation method. These scenario thresholds are not legal discharge standards.
body.zh: 環境化驗團隊：本練習為獨立學習模擬，並非環境化驗有限公司的認可。虛構設施「蠔涌工程」提交 11 筆虛構營運排放記錄，用於二零二六財年第一季盤點。請按所提供的範圍政策為每筆記錄分類，並以公斤核對獲支持的 NH3-N 質量代理。我們需要約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據為本交接紀錄，列明納入的記錄、每項排除原因及計算方法。這些情境門檻並非法定排放標準。

about.en: Enviro Labs lists environmental testing, including water and soil analysis, among its laboratory services.

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Classify synthetic source records under explicit inventory categories and reconcile supported totals.

expectedEvidence.en: Included set is exactly HKM-001, HKM-002, HKM-003 and HKM-008 (4 of 11 records). Reasons reported: HKM-004 out-of-period, HKM-005 out-of-scope-parameter, HKM-006 unit-mismatch, HKM-007 qa-not-valid, HKM-009 out-of-period, HKM-010 out-of-scope-parameter, HKM-011 qa-not-valid. HKM-006 correct selection is unit-mismatch. HKM-011 correct selection is qa-not-valid because the priority rule applies qa-not-valid before out-of-period. NH3-N supported mass proxy is 6.4 x 125 / 1000 plus 8.1 x 100 / 1000 = 0.800 plus 0.810 = 1.610 kg.
expectedEvidence.zh: 納入集合須為 HKM-001、HKM-002、HKM-003 及 HKM-008（11 筆中的 4 筆）。原因：HKM-004 為 out-of-period，HKM-005 為 out-of-scope-parameter，HKM-006 為 unit-mismatch，HKM-007 為 qa-not-valid，HKM-009 為 out-of-period，HKM-010 為 out-of-scope-parameter，HKM-011 為 qa-not-valid。HKM-006 的正確選擇為 unit-mismatch。HKM-011 的正確選擇為 qa-not-valid，因優先次序將 qa-not-valid 置於 out-of-period 之前。NH3-N 獲支持質量代理為 6.4 x 125 / 1000 加 8.1 x 100 / 1000 = 0.800 加 0.810 = 1.610 公斤。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Each decision is tied to the specific CSV row and the scope policy test that it fails or passes, for example HKM-006 has QA flag valid, sample date 2026-03-11 inside the period and parameter COD in scope, so only the µg/L unit against the required mg/L fails. HKM-011 is dated 2026-04-01 and has QA flag estimated, so two tests fail and the stated priority governs. The 1.610 kg total is shown to come from the two NH3-N rows with their own volumes, not from all NH3-N rows or from an assumed average.
expectedEvidence.zh: 每項決定須連結至具體 CSV 列及所符合或不符合的政策條件，例如 HKM-006 的品質保證標記為 valid、樣本日期 2026-03-11 在期內、參數 COD 在範圍內，只有 µg/L 單位不符合規定 mg/L。HKM-011 日期為 2026-04-01 且品質保證標記為 estimated，兩項條件同時不符，須依所述優先次序處理。1.610 公斤總量須說明取自兩筆 NH3-N 記錄及其各自排放量，而非全部 NH3-N 列或假設平均值。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Concrete checks are proposed, such as re-reading all 11 rows against the four inclusion tests, re-applying the priority order to HKM-011 and HKM-006, confirming the period boundary 2026-03-31 inclusive and 2026-04-01 outside, re-checking the unit arithmetic mg/L x m3 / 1000 = kg on both NH3-N rows, and asking the client to re-analyse the estimated-flag samples in mg/L.
expectedEvidence.zh: 須提出具體檢查，例如把全部 11 列重新對照四項納入條件、對 HKM-011 及 HKM-006 重新套用優先次序、確認 2026-03-31 為期內而 2026-04-01 為期外、在兩筆 NH3-N 記錄上覆核單位運算 mg/L x m3 / 1000 = kg，並要求客戶以 mg/L 重新化驗帶 estimated 標記的樣本。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: The handover states that the rules and thresholds are fictional scenario assumptions and are not legal discharge standards, that no regulatory compliance or enforcement conclusion is drawn, that only the 11 supplied synthetic records are covered, and that no load or record outside the supplied table is assumed. Any residual uncertainty, such as the estimated-flag samples or the µg/L record, is named rather than treated as resolved.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接須說明規則與門檻屬虛構情境假設，並非法定排放標準，不作出任何法規合規或執法結論，範圍只涵蓋所提供的 11 筆虛構記錄，亦不假設表外任何負荷或記錄。任何剩餘不確定性（例如 estimated 標記樣本或 µg/L 記錄）須明確指出，而非當作已解決。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: A concise handover of roughly 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese, in English or Traditional Chinese, stating the included set, each exclusion reason, the 1.610 kg calculation with method and units, and clear next steps such as requesting re-analysis or unit correction from the client, with the Environmental Data team lead as the escalation point.
expectedEvidence.zh: 約 100 至 180 英文字或相若香港繁體中文的簡潔交接，以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫，列明納入集合、各項排除原因、1.610 公斤的計算方法及單位，並提出清晰下一步，例如要求客戶重新化驗或更正單位，並以環境資料團隊主管為轉交對象。

exemplar.en: Handover, FY2026 Q1 discharge inventory, Ho Chung Works (synthetic records). Classification: 4 of 11 records are supported for the inventory, HKM-001 (COD), HKM-002 (TSS), HKM-003 (NH3-N) and HKM-008 (NH3-N). Exclusion reasons: HKM-004 and HKM-009 out-of-period, HKM-005 and HKM-010 out-of-scope-parameter, HKM-006 unit-mismatch because COD is reported in µg/L while the required unit is mg/L, HKM-007 and HKM-011 qa-not-valid. HKM-011 is dated 2026-04-01 and would also be out-of-period, but the priority rule reports qa-not-valid first. Reconciled total: NH3-N supported mass proxy = 6.4 x 125 / 1000 plus 8.1 x 100 / 1000 = 0.800 plus 0.810 = 1.610 kg. Next steps: ask the client to re-analyse the estimated-flag samples, request HKM-006 in mg/L, and confirm the 2026-03-31 inclusive period boundary with the Environmental Data team lead. These rules are fictional scenario thresholds, not legal discharge standards.

brief.en: Enviro Labs is an environmental testing laboratory. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Enviro Labs and is not endorsed by the company. A fictional client, Sha Chau Monitoring Cooperative, has sent 12 synthetic ambient water quality records for the May to June 2026 monitoring-region reconciliation. Using only the supplied boundary policy and records table, classify every record and reconcile the supported NO3-N load proxy for region R2 in grams. Produce a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. All rules are fictional and are not legal water quality standards.
brief.zh: 環境化驗有限公司是環境測試化驗所。本練習為受該公司啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。虛構客戶「沙洲監測合作社」提交了 12 筆虛構環境水質記錄，用於二零二六年五月至六月監測區域核對。只可按所提供的邊界政策及記錄表，為每筆記錄分類，並以克核對區域 R2 獲支持的 NO3-N 負荷代理。請以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔證據為本交接紀錄。所有規則均為虛構，並非法定水質標準。

title.zh: 監測區域邊界及納入規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this simulation. It is not a legal water quality standard. Monitoring regions and station prefixes: R1 Tuen Mun uses TM-, R2 Sha Chau uses SC-, R3 Lantau North uses LN-. Region assignment is by station_id prefix only. claimed_region is not authoritative. Any other station prefix is out-of-region. Monitoring period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-30 inclusive. In-scope parameters and required units: NO3-N mg/L, TSS mg/L. DO is out of scope. QA flags: valid, estimated, void. A record is included only when its station prefix maps to R1, R2 or R3, its sample date is inside the period, its parameter is in scope, its unit equals the required unit, and its QA flag is valid. Exclusion priority when a record fails more than one test: qa-not-valid, then out-of-period, then out-of-region, then unit-mismatch, then out-of-scope-parameter. Supported NO3-N load proxy in grams for one region = sum over included NO3-N records in that region of value in mg/L multiplied by sample_volume_L, divided by 1000.
body.zh: 本情境的虛構學習政策，並非法定水質標準。監測區域及測站前綴：R1 屯門使用 TM-，R2 沙洲使用 SC-，R3 大嶼山北使用 LN-。區域歸屬只按 station_id 前綴決定。claimed_region 並非權威。任何其他測站前綴均屬 out-of-region。監測期：2026-05-01 至 2026-06-30（包括首尾兩日）。範圍內參數及規定單位：NO3-N 毫克／升、TSS 毫克／升。DO 不在範圍內。品質保證標記：valid、estimated、void。只有當測站前綴對應 R1、R2 或 R3，樣本日期在監測期內，參數在範圍內，單位等於規定單位，且品質保證標記為 valid 時，該記錄方會納入。若記錄同時不符合多項條件，排除原因優先次序為：qa-not-valid、然後 out-of-period、然後 out-of-region、然後 unit-mismatch、然後 out-of-scope-parameter。某一區域的支持 NO3-N 負荷代理（克）＝該區域所有納入 NO3-N 記錄的數值（毫克／升）乘以 sample_volume_L，再除以 1000。

exemplar.en: Handover for Sha Chau region R2 monitoring reconciliation, May to June 2026. Sources used: monitoring-region boundary policy and synthetic records MR-001 to MR-012. Region R2 is defined only by station prefix SC-. Claimed_region does not control assignment. Included R2 records are MR-001, MR-003, MR-005 and MR-011. MR-001 and MR-003 are NO3-N valid in period at mg/L. MR-005 is TSS valid in period at mg/L. MR-011 is NO3-N valid in period at mg/L. Excluded: MR-008 out-of-region because WB-01 has no supplied prefix, MR-012 qa-not-valid because void, MR-006 unit-mismatch because µg/L, MR-007 qa-not-valid because estimated, MR-009 out-of-period because 2026-07-02, MR-010 out-of-scope-parameter because DO, MR-004 out-of-period because 2026-04-28, MR-002 region R1. Supported R2 NO3-N load proxy is 2.955 g, calculated as (2.4*500/1000) + (1.8*600/1000) + (1.5*450/1000). This is a fictional scenario result, not a legal water quality conclusion. Next steps: verify station prefix mapping with field log, confirm sample_volume_L units, and ask client to resubmit MR-006 in mg/L and MR-007 with valid QA. Acknowledge uncertainty: no lab method or detection limit supplied.
exemplar.zh: 沙洲區域 R2 監測核對交接，二零二六年五月至六月。所用來源：監測區域邊界政策及虛構記錄 MR-001 至 MR-012。區域 R2 只按測站前綴 SC- 界定。claimed_region 不控制歸屬。納入 R2 的記錄為 MR-001、MR-003、MR-005 及 MR-011。MR-001 及 MR-003 為監測期內有效的 mg/L NO3-N。MR-005 為監測期內有效的 mg/L TSS。MR-011 為監測期內有效的 mg/L NO3-N。排除：MR-008 因 WB-01 沒有提供前綴而屬 out-of-region，MR-012 因 void 而屬 qa-not-valid，MR-006 因 µg/L 而屬 unit-mismatch，MR-007 因 estimated 而屬 qa-not-valid，MR-009 因 2026-07-02 而屬 out-of-period，MR-010 因 DO 而屬 out-of-scope-parameter，MR-004 因 2026-04-28 而屬 out-of-period，MR-002 屬區域 R1。獲支持的 R2 NO3-N 負荷代理為 2.955 克，計算為 (2.4*500/1000) + (1.8*600/1000) + (1.5*450/1000)。此為虛構情境結果，並非法律水質結論。下一步：以現場記錄核實測站前綴對應，確認 sample_volume_L 單位，並請客戶以 mg/L 重新提交 MR-006 及以 valid 重新提交 MR-007。承認不確定性：未提供化驗方法或偵測限。

title.en: Cash schedule and minimum balance rules
title.zh: 現金表及最低結餘規則

body.en: All figures are fictional and for learning only. This simulation is inspired by Lalamove but not endorsed by it. Rules: 1. For each period, closing cash = opening cash + receipts - payments. 2. Opening cash for the first period is given. For later periods, opening cash equals the prior period's closing cash. 3. Minimum closing balance is 40,000 HKD. A period is compliant if its closing cash is greater than or equal to 40,000 HKD. 4. Shortfall for a period = max(0, 40,000 - closing cash). 5. Report total shortfall as the sum of period shortfalls. 6. Receipts and payments are positive amounts. Payments reduce cash. 7. Do not recommend borrowing or lending. Only calculate and flag.
body.zh: 所有數字均為虛構，僅供學習。此模擬受 Lalamove 啟發，但不獲其認可。規則：1. 每期期末現金 = 期初現金 + 收款 - 付款。2. 第一期期初現金已提供。其後期初現金等於上一期期末現金。3. 最低期末結餘為 40,000 港元。若期末現金大於或等於 40,000 港元，該期為合規。4. 每期短缺 = max(0, 40,000 - 期末現金)。5. 總短缺為各期短缺之和。6. 收款及付款均為正數。付款減少現金。7. 不要建議借款或貸款。只計算並標示。

title.en: Cash schedule rules and sign conventions
title.zh: 現金表規則及正負號約定

body.en:
Fictional rules for this learning simulation only, merchant MK-014.
1. For each period, closing cash = opening cash + receipts - payments.
2. Opening cash for P1 is 95,000 HKD. Opening cash for P2 equals P1 closing cash. Opening cash for P3 equals P2 closing cash.
3. Sign convention: receipts increase cash and payments decrease cash. Every amount in the data table is a positive magnitude in HKD.
4. Minimum closing balance is 50,000 HKD. A period is compliant when closing cash is greater than or equal to 50,000 HKD.
5. Period shortfall = max(0, 50,000 - closing cash). Total shortfall is the sum of the period shortfalls.
6. The one-time payment of 75,000 HKD is dated in P2 only. The delayed customer receipt of 80,000 HKD is dated in P3 only.
7. Calculate and flag only. Do not recommend borrowing, lending or any real treasury action.
body.zh:
本學習模擬專用的虛構規則，商戶 MK-014。
1. 每期期末現金 = 期初現金 + 收款 - 付款。
2. P1 期初現金為 95,000 港元。P2 期初現金等於 P1 期末現金。P3 期初現金等於 P2 期末現金。
3. 正負號約定：收款增加現金，付款減少現金。資料表中每項金額均為以港元計的正數。
4. 最低期末結餘為 50,000 港元。期末現金大於或等於 50,000 港元時，該期為合規。
5. 每期短缺 = max(0, 50,000 - 期末現金)。總短缺為各期短缺之和。
6. 75,000 港元的一次性付款僅列於 P2。延遲的 80,000 港元客戶收款僅列於 P3。
7. 只作計算及標示。不要建議借款、貸款或任何真實財資行動。

exemplar.en:
Evidence: fictional merchant MK-014 data in data-cash-inputs and the rules in policy-cash-rules. Opening cash is 95,000 HKD and the minimum closing balance is 50,000 HKD, met when closing cash is at least 50,000 HKD.

Method: closing cash = opening cash + receipts - payments, and each closing balance becomes the next opening balance.
P1: 95,000 + 38,000 - 30,000 = 103,000 HKD, compliant.
P2: 103,000 + 38,000 - 30,000 - 75,000 one-time payment = 36,000 HKD, shortfall 50,000 - 36,000 = 14,000 HKD.
P3: 36,000 + 38,000 + 80,000 delayed receipt - 30,000 = 124,000 HKD, compliant.
Total shortfall is 14,000 HKD, from P2 only.

Risks: the delayed 80,000 HKD receipt is the only reason P3 recovers. If it slipped again, P3 closing would be 44,000 HKD and would breach the floor.

Next steps: confirm the P3 receipt date with the merchant, re-run the three periods if it moves, and pass the P2 shortfall of 14,000 HKD to the fictional finance team lead. All figures are fictional and no financing action is proposed.
exemplar.zh:
證據：data-cash-inputs 的虛構商戶 MK-014 資料，以及 policy-cash-rules 的規則。期初現金為 95,000 港元，最低期末結餘為 50,000 港元，期末現金達 50,000 港元或以上即為合規。

方法：期末現金 = 期初現金 + 收款 - 付款，每期期末結餘成為下期期初結餘。
P1：95,000 + 38,000 - 30,000 = 103,000 港元，合規。
P2：103,000 + 38,000 - 30,000 - 75,000 一次性付款 = 36,000 港元，短缺 50,000 - 36,000 = 14,000 港元。
P3：36,000 + 38,000 + 80,000 延遲收款 - 30,000 = 124,000 港元，合規。
總短缺為 14,000 港元，僅來自 P2。

風險：延遲的 80,000 港元收款是 P3 回穩的唯一原因。若再延遲，P3 期末現金將為 44,000 港元並低於下限。

下一步：向商戶確認 P3 收款日期，若日期變動則重算三個期間，並把 P2 的 14,000 港元短缺告知虛構財務團隊主管。所有數字均為虛構，亦沒有提出任何融資行動。

The chaining of each closing balance into the next opening balance, the P2-only one-time payment and the P3-only delayed receipt are all applied correctly.

title.zh: 分配共享支援服務成本

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional Lalamove-inspired shared services review. A pooled merchant support platform cost of HKD 52,750 must be allocated to three service teams using logged support minutes as the declared driver. brief.zh: 你正支援一項以 Lalamove 為靈感的虛構共享服務檢視。商戶支援平台共同成本池 HKD 52,750 須按聲明的支援分鐘基準分配至三個服務團隊。請閱讀政策及數據摘錄，應用四捨五入及核对規則，然後撰寫簡潔交接。本項目是以 Lalamove 為靈感的獨立學習模擬，並非由 Lalamove 認可。

title.en: Cost allocation policy for shared merchant support pool
title.zh: 商戶支援共同成本池分配政策

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this simulation. The declared allocation driver is logged support minutes by service team. Only minutes recorded under team IDs T-01, T-02 and T-03 count. For each team, raw allocation equals pool amount multiplied by team minutes divided by total team minutes. Round each raw allocation to the nearest whole HKD. If rounded allocations do not sum to the pool, assign any residual to the team with the largest absolute fractional remainder, then continue by descending fractional remainder until reconciled. No professional accounting advice is provided.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構學習政策。聲明的分配基準為各服務團隊記錄的支援分鐘。僅計算團隊 ID T-01、T-02 及 T-03 下記錄的分鐘。每隊的原始分配額等於成本池金額乘以該隊分鐘，再除以團隊總分鐘。把每隊原始分配額四捨五入至最接近的整數 HKD。如四捨五入後的分配額合計不等於成本池，便把任何餘額分配給絕對小數部分最大的團隊，然後按小數部分由大到小繼續分配，直至核对完成。本政策不提供專業會計意見。

brief.en: Fictional Lalamove-inspired shared services review. A pooled merchant API gateway cost of HKD 78,600 must be allocated across merchant segments using API usage units as the declared driver. One segment is an exempt category and receives no allocation. Read the policy, the data extract and the finance review note, apply the rounding and residual rules, and confirm that the allocations reconcile to the pool. Prepare a concise English or Traditional Chinese handover with your figures, evidence, assumptions and next checks. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by Lalamove and is not endorsed by it.
brief.zh: 以 Lalamove 為靈感的虛構共享服務檢視。商戶 API 閘道共同成本池 HKD 78,600 須按聲明的 API 使用單位基準分配至各商戶區隔。其中一個區隔屬豁免類別，不獲分配。請閱讀政策、數據摘錄及財務檢視備註，應用四捨五入及餘額規則，並確認分配額與成本池核对相符。請以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，列明數字、證據、假設及下一步檢查。本項目為以 Lalamove 為靈感的獨立學習模擬，並非由 Lalamove 認可。

title.en: Shared API gateway cost allocation policy
title.zh: 共享 API 閘道成本分配政策

body.en: Fictional learning policy for this simulation. The declared allocation driver is API usage units by merchant segment. Only segments flagged exempt_flag = no are chargeable, and exempt segments receive zero allocation. Exempt categories are declared in the data extract. A chargeable segment raw allocation equals pool amount multiplied by segment usage units divided by total chargeable usage units. Round each raw allocation to the nearest whole HKD. If the rounded allocations do not equal the pool, assign the residual HKD to the chargeable segment with the largest absolute fractional remainder, then continue in descending order until reconciled. No professional accounting advice is provided.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構學習政策。聲明的分配基準為各商戶區隔的 API 使用單位。只有 exempt_flag = no 的區隔須計費，豁免區隔獲零分配。豁免類別於數據摘錄中聲明。可計費區隔的原始分配額等於成本池金額乘以該區隔使用單位，再除以可計費使用單位總數。把每個原始分配額四捨五入至最接近的整數 HKD。如四捨五入後分配額不等於成本池，便把餘額 HKD 分配給絕對小數部分最大的可計費區隔，然後按小數部分由大到小繼續，直至核对完成。本政策不提供專業會計意見。
