exemplar.en: Allocation of POOL-612 (HKD 78,600) uses the declared driver of API usage units. Segment S-04 carries exempt_flag = yes, so the chargeable base is 8,000 units (S-01 3,232 plus S-02 2,438 plus S-03 2,330). The rate is HKD 78,600 divided by 8,000, that is HKD 9.825 per chargeable unit. Raw allocations are S-01 HKD 31,754.40, S-02 HKD 23,953.35 and S-03 HKD 22,892.25. After rounding to whole HKD the total is HKD 78,599, a shortfall of HKD 1. Under the policy the residual goes to the chargeable segment with the largest absolute fractional remainder, which is S-01 at 0.40, so S-01 becomes HKD 31,755. Final allocations are S-01 HKD 31,755, S-02 HKD 23,953, S-03 HKD 22,892 and S-04 HKD 0, reconciling to HKD 78,600. Next steps, ask the shared services finance lead to confirm the S-04 exempt declaration and re-run the allocation if any usage_units or exempt_flag value changes. All values are synthetic and this is not professional accounting advice.
exemplar.zh: POOL-612（HKD 78,600）按聲明的 API 使用單位基準分配。區隔 S-04 的 exempt_flag = yes，故可計費基準為 8,000 單位（S-01 3,232 加 S-02 2,438 加 S-03 2,330）。分配率為 HKD 78,600 除以 8,000，即每可計費單位 HKD 9.825。原始分配額為 S-01 HKD 31,754.40、S-02 HKD 23,953.35 及 S-03 HKD 22,892.25。四捨五入至整數 HKD 後合計為 HKD 78,599，差額 HKD 1。按政策，餘額分配給絕對小數部分最大的可計費區隔，即小數部分 0.40 的 S-01，故 S-01 成為 HKD 31,755。最終分配額為 S-01 HKD 31,755、S-02 HKD 23,953、S-03 HKD 22,892 及 S-04 HKD 0，合計核对為 HKD 78,600。下一步，請共享服務財務主管確認 S-04 的豁免聲明，並在任一 usage_units 或 exempt_flag 數值改變時重新分配。所有數值均為合成，並不構成專業會計意見。

feedback.en: All figures are correct. You use the 8,000 chargeable units, the HKD 9.825 rate, the raw allocations 31,754.40, 23,953.35 and 22,892.25, the rounded total of HKD 78,599, the HKD 1 residual to S-01 and the final reconciliation to HKD 78,600.
feedback.zh: 所有數字均正確：可計費 8,000 單位、分配率 HKD 9.825、原始分配額 31,754.40、23,953.35 及 22,892.25、四捨五入合計 HKD 78,599、HKD 1 餘額歸入 S-01，最終核对至 HKD 78,600。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to the supplied records, citing POOL-612, the row-level usage units and the S-04 exempt_flag, and you justify the residual by the largest fractional remainder rule rather than the largest balance.
feedback.zh: 你把每個數字連結至提供記錄，引用 POOL-612、各列使用單位及 S-04 的 exempt_flag，並以最大小數部分規則而非最大餘額解釋餘額處理，推理充分。

feedback.en: You sensibly ask the shared services finance lead to confirm the S-04 exempt declaration and to re-run the allocation if any usage_units or exempt_flag changes. Add an explicit arithmetic check, such as re-adding 31,755 plus 23,953 plus 22,892 to confirm HKD 78,600, and a trigger date for re-issuing figures.
feedback.zh: 你請共享服務財務主管確認 S-04 豁免聲明，並在使用單位或豁免標記改變時重新分配，做法合理。建議加入明確算術覆核，例如重新加總 31,755 加 23,953 加 22,892 以確認 HKD 78,600，並訂明重新發出數字的時點。

feedback.en: You state the values are synthetic and not professional accounting advice, which is good. Extend this to note no real company figures are used, that this is a fictional Lalamove-inspired simulation, and that a change to the exempt category would alter the base and every allocation.
feedback.zh: 你已說明數值為合成且不構成專業會計意見，表現良好。請補充並非真實公司數據、屬以 Lalamove 為靈感的虛構模擬，並指出豁免類別一旦改變，基準及每項分配額均會改變。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable, giving the final allocation table, the HKD 78,600 reconciliation, the residual treatment, named source references and the finance lead as owner for the exempt declaration.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，列出最終分配表、HKD 78,600 核对、餘額處理、具名來源引用，並以財務主管為確認豁免聲明的負責人。

summary.zh: 分配完整且準確。基準、分配率、原始及四捨五入金額、歸入 S-01 的餘額及最終核对均正確且有充分證據，交接亦可行。補強明確算術覆核及範圍表述即可達最高水平。

Broaden the scope note to confirm no real company data is used and that altering the exempt category changes the base and every allocation.
nextSteps.zh: 加入簡短算術覆核，把 31,755、23,953、22,892 及 S-04 的零分配重新加總以證明 HKD 78,600，並訂明使用單位或豁免標記改變時重新發出數字的觸發條件。擴充範圍說明，確認並非真實公司數據，並指出豁免類別改變會影響基準及每項分配額。

title.zh: 情境輸入數據

body.en:
Scenario inputs for the fictional bakery delivery operation. Deliveries per month are demand forecasts before applying the capacity limit. All monetary values are in HKD.
```csv
scenario_id,price_per_delivery_hkd,deliveries_per_month,variable_cost_per_delivery_hkd,fixed_cost_month_hkd
baseline,50,1000,35,10000
price_increase,55,950,35,10000
price_decrease,45,1050,35,10000
demand_surge,50,1200,35,10000
demand_drop,50,800,35,10000
```
body.zh:
虛構麵包店配送業務的情境輸入。每月配送量為應用容量限制前的需求預測。所有金額均以港元為單位。
```csv
scenario_id,price_per_delivery_hkd,deliveries_per_month,variable_cost_per_delivery_hkd,fixed_cost_month_hkd
baseline,50,1000,35,10000
price_increase,55,950,35,10000
price_decrease,45,1050,35,10000
demand_surge,50,1200,35,10000
demand_drop,50,800,35,10000
```

title.zh: 利潤與容量規則

body.en: Profit formula: Profit = (Price - Variable Cost) × Actual Deliveries − Fixed Cost. Actual Deliveries = min(Demand, Capacity). Capacity limit = 1,100 deliveries per month. Break-even deliveries = Fixed Cost ÷ (Price - Variable Cost), rounded up to the nearest whole delivery. All figures are fictional and for learning only. No investment or tax advice is provided.
body.zh: 利潤公式：利潤 = (價格 - 變動成本) × 實際配送量 − 固定成本。實際配送量 = min(需求, 容量)。容量限制 = 每月 1,100 次配送。盈虧平衡配送量 = 固定成本 ÷ (價格 - 變動成本)，向上取整至最接近的整數配送量。所有數據均為虛構，僅供學習之用。不提供投資或稅務建議。

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly calculates baseline profit as HKD 5,000 ( (50-35)*1000 - 10000 ). Correctly calculates price_increase profit as HKD 9,000 ( (55-35)*950 - 10000 ). Identifies price_increase as the highest-profit scenario within capacity. For multi-select, selects options a and b as correct. Does not select c or d.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確計算基線利潤為 5,000 港元（ (50-35)*1000 - 10000 ）。正確計算價格上升情境利潤為 9,000 港元（ (55-35)*950 - 10000 ）。在容量限制內識別價格上升為最高利潤情境。多選題選取選項 a 及 b 為正確。不選取 c 或 d。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites specific source values: baseline price HKD 50, deliveries 1000, variable cost HKD 35, fixed cost HKD 10000 from the scenario data table. References the profit formula and capacity limit of 1,100 from the rules document. Explains that demand_surge is capped at 1,100 deliveries because 1200 > 1100. Shows break-even calculation 10000/15 = 666.67 rounded to 667.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用具體來源數值：情境數據表中的基線價格 50 港元、配送量 1000、變動成本 35 港元、固定成本 10000 港元。引用規則文件中的利潤公式及容量限制 1,100。解釋需求激增因 1200 > 1100 而設上限為 1,100 次配送。展示盈虧平衡計算 10000/15 = 666.67，向上取整為 667。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes checks such as recalculating profits with the formula, verifying that demand_surge actual deliveries are min(1200, 1100) = 1100, confirming break-even rounding up to 667, and cross-checking all scenario inputs for consistency.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查，例如以公式重新計算利潤、驗證需求激增的實際配送量為 min(1200, 1100) = 1100、確認盈虧平衡向上取整為 667，以及交叉核對所有情境輸入的一致性。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that all figures are fictional and for learning only. Does not claim real Lalamove or bakery performance. Limits conclusions to the supplied scenarios and rules. States that no investment or tax advice is given.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認所有數據均為虛構，僅供學習之用。不聲稱代表真實 Lalamove 或麵包店的表現。結論僅限於所提供的情境及規則。聲明不提供投資或稅務建議。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a clear handover recommending the price_increase scenario based on highest profit HKD 9,000 within capacity. Includes evidence from calculations and suggests next steps like validating demand elasticity with actual data and monitoring capacity.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫清晰交接，建議採用價格上升情境，因其在容量內利潤最高為 9,000 港元。包含計算證據，並建議下一步如以實際數據驗證需求彈性及監控容量。

exemplar.en: Based on the supplied scenario inputs and rules, I calculated monthly profits using Profit = (Price - Variable Cost) × min(Demand, 1100) − Fixed Cost. Baseline profit is HKD 5,000. The price_increase scenario yields HKD 9,000, the highest within the 1,100-delivery capacity limit. The demand_surge scenario is capped at 1,100 deliveries, giving HKD 6,500. The price_decrease scenario has the lowest profit at HKD 500. Break-even at baseline price requires 667 deliveries (fixed cost HKD 10,000 ÷ contribution HKD 15, rounded up). I recommend prioritising the price_increase scenario. Next steps: validate demand elasticity assumptions with actual sales data, monitor delivery capacity, and review variable costs quarterly. All figures are fictional for this simulation.
exemplar.zh: 根據提供的情境輸入及規則，我以公式「利潤 = (價格 - 變動成本) × min(需求, 1100) − 固定成本」計算每月利潤。基線利潤為 5,000 港元。價格上升情境產生 9,000 港元，在 1,100 次配送容量限制內為最高。需求激增情境因上限為 1,100 次配送，利潤為 6,500 港元。價格下降情境利潤最低，為 500 港元。基線價格下的盈虧平衡需要 667 次配送（固定成本 10,000 港元 ÷ 貢獻 15 港元，向上取整）。我建議優先考慮價格上升情境。下一步：以實際銷售數據驗證需求彈性假設、監控配送容量，並每季檢視變動成本。所有數據均為此模擬的虛構內容。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. Baseline profit HKD 5,000, price_increase HKD 9,000, price_increase chosen as the best bounded outcome, and options a and b selected with c and d correctly left out. The demand_surge cap at 1,100 is applied correctly.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。基線利潤 5,000 港元、價格上升 9,000 港元、選出價格上升為最佳有限度結果，並正確只選 a 及 b，未選 c 及 d。需求激增上限 1,100 次的應用正確。

feedback.en: You cite the supplied price HKD 50/55, variable cost HKD 35, fixed cost HKD 10,000 and the 1,100 capacity limit, and show the break-even figure of 667 from 10,000 ÷ 15 rounded up. Adding the demand_drop and price_decrease profit comparisons would make the cross-scenario reasoning even stronger.
feedback.zh: 你引用了提供的價格 50/55 港元、變動成本 35 港元、固定成本 10,000 港元及 1,100 次容量限制，並展示盈虧平衡 667 次（10,000 ÷ 15 向上取整）。若補上需求下降及價格下降情境的利潤對比，跨情境推理會更完整。

feedback.en: Next steps cover validating demand elasticity with actual sales data, monitoring capacity and quarterly variable cost review, which are concrete and relevant. A specific recalculating check, such as confirming min(1200, 1100) = 1100 and the 667 rounding, would tighten the verification.
feedback.zh: 下一步包括以實際銷售數據驗證需求彈性、監控容量及每季檢視變動成本，具體且相關。若能加入明確重算檢查，例如確認 min(1200, 1100) = 1100 及 667 次的取整，核實會更嚴謹。

feedback.en: You state the figures are fictional for this simulation and limit conclusions to the supplied scenarios. You do not claim real platform or bakery performance, though an explicit note that no investment or tax advice is given would complete the scope statement.
feedback.zh: 你說明數據為此模擬的虛構內容，並把結論限於所提供情境。你沒有聲稱代表真實平台或麵包店表現，若明確註明不提供投資或稅務建議，範圍聲明會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover gives a clear recommendation for price_increase with supporting HKD 9,000 evidence and actionable next steps. Naming an owner, such as the finance lead, or an escalation point for capacity constraints would make it fully actionable.
feedback.zh: 交接清楚建議採用價格上升情境，並以 9,000 港元證據支持，下一步亦可執行。若列明負責人（例如財務主管）或容量限制的轉交點，可執行性會更高。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every calculation, selection and comparison matches the supplied rules, and the write-up ties decisions back to specific source values with a clear recommendation. The only gaps are minor: no explicit no-advice disclaimer and no named owner or escalation in the handover.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有計算、選項及比較均符合提供的規則，說明亦把決策連繫到具體來源數值並提出清晰建議。僅有少數小缺口：未明確註明不提供建議的聲明，以及交接中未列明負責人或轉交點。

nextSteps.en: Add one short line stating that no investment or tax advice is given, and name who owns the price_increase follow-up plus when the capacity monitor should be reviewed. You could also add the demand_drop and price_decrease profit lines to show the full comparison in one view.
nextSteps.zh: 補上一句聲明不提供投資或稅務建議，並列明價格上升方案的跟進負責人及容量監控的檢視時間。亦可加入需求下降及價格下降的利潤數字，讓對比更一目了然。

body.en:
Scenario inputs for the fictional delivery operation. All monetary values are in HKD. Capacity is fixed at 1200 deliveries per month. Utilization rate is the proportion of capacity used. Variable cost is per delivery. Fixed cost is per month.
```csv
scenario_id,price_per_delivery_hkd,capacity_deliveries,utilization_rate,variable_cost_per_delivery_hkd,fixed_cost_month_hkd
baseline,45,1200,0.70,28,15000
high_util,45,1200,0.85,28,15000
low_cost,45,1200,0.70,25,15000
high_util_low_cost,45,1200,0.85,25,15000
low_util,45,1200,0.55,28,15000
```
body.zh:
虛構配送業務的情境輸入。所有金額均以港元為單位。容量固定為每月 1200 次配送。使用率為容量使用比例。變動成本為每次配送成本。固定成本為每月成本。
```csv
scenario_id,price_per_delivery_hkd,capacity_deliveries,utilization_rate,variable_cost_per_delivery_hkd,fixed_cost_month_hkd
baseline,45,1200,0.70,28,15000
high_util,45,1200,0.85,28,15000
low_cost,45,1200,0.70,25,15000
high_util_low_cost,45,1200,0.85,25,15000
low_util,45,1200,0.55,28,15000
```
此表列出五個虛構情境的價格、容量、使用率、變動成本及固定成本，供計算利潤之用。

title.zh: 利潤與盈虧平衡規則

body.en: Profit formula: Profit = (Price − Variable Cost) × Actual Deliveries − Fixed Cost. Actual Deliveries = Capacity × Utilization Rate. Break-even deliveries = Fixed Cost ÷ (Price − Variable Cost), rounded up to the nearest whole delivery. All figures are fictional and for learning only. No investment or tax advice is provided.
body.zh: 利潤公式：利潤 = (價格 − 變動成本) × 實際配送量 − 固定成本。實際配送量 = 容量 × 使用率。盈虧平衡配送量 = 固定成本 ÷ (價格 − 變動成本)，向上取整至最接近的整數配送量。所有數據均為虛構，僅供學習之用。不提供投資或稅務建議。

exemplar.en: Evidence: From the scenario inputs CSV, capacity is 1,200 deliveries per month and fixed cost is HKD 15,000. Baseline has utilization 0.70 and variable cost HKD 28, giving 840 deliveries and a profit of (45 − 28) × 840 − 15,000 = −720 HKD. The high_util_low_cost scenario has utilization 0.85 and variable cost HKD 25, giving 1,020 deliveries and profit (45 − 25) × 1,020 − 15,000 = 5,400 HKD. Decision: The high_util_low_cost scenario yields the highest profit, followed by high_util (2,340 HKD) and low_cost (1,800 HKD). Baseline and low_util produce losses. Correct statements are a and b. Risks: Results are bounded by the fictional inputs and assume no other changes. Next steps: Verify calculations with a second analyst, test a 90% utilization and HKD 26 variable cost scenario, and confirm capacity assumptions with operations.
exemplar.zh: 證據：從情境輸入 CSV，容量為每月 1,200 次配送，固定成本為 15,000 港元。基線使用率 0.70，變動成本 28 港元，實際配送量 840 次，利潤為 (45 − 28) × 840 − 15,000 = −720 港元。高使用率低成本情境使用率 0.85，變動成本 25 港元，實際配送量 1,020 次，利潤為 (45 − 25) × 1,020 − 15,000 = 5,400 港元。決策：高使用率低成本情境利潤最高，其次為高使用率（2,340 港元）及低成本（1,800 港元）。基線及低使用率產生虧損。正確陳述為 a 及 b。風險：結果受虛構輸入限制，並假設其他條件不變。下一步：由第二位分析師核實計算、測試使用率 90% 及變動成本 26 港元的情境，並與營運部門確認容量假設。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: baseline profit -720 HKD, high_util_low_cost profit 5,400 HKD, best scenario high-util-low-cost, and true statements a and b. The formula (45 - 28) x 840 - 15,000 and (45 - 25) x 1,020 - 15,000 match the supplied rules exactly.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：基線利潤 -720 港元、高使用率低成本情境利潤 5,400 港元、最高利潤情境為高使用率低成本，以及正確陳述 a 及 b。公式 (45 - 28) × 840 - 15,000 及 (45 - 25) × 1,020 - 15,000 完全符合提供規則。

feedback.en: You cite specific CSV values (1,200 capacity, 15,000 fixed cost, 0.70 and 0.85 utilization, 28 and 25 variable cost) and show the profit formula application. Adding why baseline is a loss (contribution 17 x 840 below fixed cost) would sharpen the reasoning, but the evidence link is clear.
feedback.zh: 你引用了具體 CSV 數值（容量 1,200、固定成本 15,000、使用率 0.70 及 0.85、變動成本 28 及 25），並展示利潤公式應用。若能補充基線虧損原因（貢獻 17 × 840 低於固定成本）會更佳，但證據連結已清晰。

feedback.en: Concrete checks are proposed: second-analyst recalculation, a 90% utilization with 26 HKD variable cost test, and confirming capacity assumptions with operations. These directly test the stated requirements and match the expected verification approach.
feedback.zh: 你提出了具體檢查：由第二位分析師重新計算、測試使用率 90% 及變動成本 26 港元的情境，以及與營運部門確認容量假設。這些直接測試聲明要求，符合預期的核實方式。

feedback.en: You state results are bounded by fictional inputs and assume no other changes, which limits the claim appropriately. It would be stronger to note explicitly that data are for learning only and that no investment or tax advice is given.
feedback.zh: 你聲明結果受虛構輸入限制並假設其他條件不變，適當地限定了聲明。若明確指出數據僅供學習及不提供投資或稅務建議會更完整。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable with evidence, a decision ranking, and next steps. Naming the finance team lead or an escalation owner would make ownership clearer for the reader.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，包含證據、決策排名及下一步。若列明財務團隊主管或轉交對象，責任歸屬會對讀者更清晰。

summary.en: A strong, accurate submission with all four decisions correct and clear reasoning tied to the scenario CSV. Scope is bounded but the learning-only and no-advice caveats could be stated explicitly, and ownership could be named.
summary.zh: 這是一份準確而紮實的提交，四項決策全部正確，推理清晰並緊扣情境 CSV。範圍已限定，但可明確指出僅供學習及不提供建議，並列明責任歸屬。

nextSteps.en: State the learning-only and no-advice caveat explicitly, add one line explaining the baseline loss via contribution below fixed cost, and name the finance team lead as the handover owner.

Our design system reviewer flagged the Button style map as drifting from the published token contract. Read the token contract, the token value table and the current getButtonStyle function. Deliver the complete corrected function plus a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Proposed verification cases are required. No code is executed in this exercise.

title.en: Simulated policy DS-07 button state and token contract
title.zh: 模擬政策 DS-07 Button 狀態及標記合約

body.en: Fictional simulator policy DS-07. Every Button state must resolve to a published token and never to a raw hex value. Rules. default uses --color-action-bg on --color-action-fg. hover uses --color-action-bg-hover on --color-action-fg. focus-visible keeps the default background and adds outline 2px solid --color-focus-ring with outline-offset --space-1, and no state may set outline to none. disabled uses --color-disabled-bg on --color-disabled-fg with cursor not-allowed and must not use opacity. Padding is --space-2 vertical and --space-4 horizontal over a 2px transparent border. All values are fictional.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策 DS-07。每個 Button 狀態必須套用已發布標記，不得使用原始十六進制色值。規則如下。default 使用 --color-action-bg 配 --color-action-fg。hover 使用 --color-action-bg-hover 配 --color-action-fg。focus-visible 保留 default 背景，加上 outline 2px solid --color-focus-ring，outline-offset 為 --space-1，任何狀態均不得把 outline 設為 none。disabled 使用 --color-disabled-bg 配 --color-disabled-fg，cursor 為 not-allowed，且不得使用 opacity。padding 為垂直 --space-2、水平 --space-4，外框為 2px transparent。所有數值均屬虛構。

title.en: Simulated policy DS-12 Alert severity, token and label contract
title.zh: 模擬政策 DS-12 Alert 嚴重程度、標記及標籤合約

body.en: Fictional simulator policy DS-12. This is an independent learning simulation, not an Oursky policy. Rules. Every Alert severity must resolve to a published token from the token table and never to a raw hex value. Each severity paints its own background, text colour and a 1px solid border using that severity's own tokens. info and success use role 'status'. warning and danger use role 'alert'. Because the role already carries the live region behaviour, the returned map must not set ariaLive for any severity. The returned labelKey must be the label table key for the same severity. Every severity returns exactly background, color, border, role and labelKey. Padding and rounded corners come from the stylesheet, never from the map. The corrected module must be self-contained, so it keeps the supplied AlertSeverity type, TOKENS and LABELS constants in the same file. All values are fictional.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策 DS-12，屬獨立學習模擬，並非 Oursky 政策。規則如下。每個 Alert 嚴重程度必須套用標記表中已發布的標記，不得使用原始十六進制色值。每個嚴重程度以本身標記設定背景、文字顏色及 1px solid 外框。info 及 success 使用 role 'status'。warning 及 danger 使用 role 'alert'。由於角色本身已帶有即時區域行為，回傳對應不得為任何嚴重程度設定 ariaLive。回傳的 labelKey 必須是同一嚴重程度在標籤表中的鍵。每個嚴重程度只回傳 background、color、border、role 及 labelKey。內距及圓角來自樣式表，不得由對應提供。修正後的模組必須可獨立執行，因此須在同一檔案保留提供的 AlertSeverity 類型、TOKENS 及 LABELS 常數。所有數值均屬虛構。

body.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky-inspired navigation review. All rules are synthetic. Navigation items that navigate to a URL must be native anchors with an href. Native anchors with href activate with Enter, not Space. A native button activates with Enter and Space but must be used for actions, not navigation. A focusable span or div with tabindex and onclick does not natively activate on Enter or Space unless a keyboard handler is explicitly registered. Exactly one navigation item may carry aria-current="page", matching the current page. The helper normalizes both pathname and route.path by trimming, lowercasing, and removing trailing slashes except for "/". It returns the matching route id, or "not-found", or "ambiguous".

title.en: Fictional in-page navigation and skip-target acceptance rules
title.zh: 虛構頁內導覽及跳至內容目標接納規則

body.en:
Fictional simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by Oursky. All rules are synthetic.

Skip-target contract: A skip control that moves focus to page content must be a native anchor with an href pointing to the target fragment. Activating a native anchor with href uses Enter, not Space. The target element must have tabindex='-1' so it can receive focus. A plain focusable div or span with tabindex and onclick does not natively activate on Enter or Space unless a keyboard handler is explicitly registered. A native button activates with Enter and Space but must be used for actions, not navigation.

In-page navigation contract: In-page navigation links that navigate to a section must be native anchors with href to the fragment. Exactly one in-page navigation link may carry aria-current='true', and it must match the active section from the helper. When no section is active, no link may carry aria-current='true'.

Helper contract: getActiveSectionId(scrollY, sections) returns a section id string, or 'above-first', or 'ambiguous', or 'not-found'. Sections are sorted by top ascending. If scrollY is less than the smallest top, return 'above-first'. Otherwise compute the highest top value that is less than or equal to scrollY. If two or more sections share that highest qualifying top value, return 'ambiguous'. Otherwise return the id of the section at that highest qualifying top. Thresholds are inclusive.
body.zh:
受 Oursky 啟發的虛構模擬，並非 Oursky 認可。所有規則均屬虛構。

跳至內容目標合約：把焦點移至頁面內容的跳至內容控制項，必須是帶 href 並指向目標片段的原生錨點。帶 href 的原生錨點以 Enter 啟動，不以 Space 啟動。目標元素必須有 tabindex='-1' 才能接收焦點。帶 tabindex 及 onclick 的普通可聚焦 div 或 span，除非明確註冊鍵盤處理器，否則不會以 Enter 或 Space 原生啟動。原生按鈕以 Enter 及 Space 啟動，但只可用於動作，不可用於導覽。

頁內導覽合約：導覽至區段的頁內導覽連結，必須是帶 href 指向片段的原生錨點。只允許一個頁內導覽連結帶 aria-current='true'，並須符合輔助函數的當前區段。沒有當前區段時，任何連結均不可帶 aria-current='true'。

輔助函數合約：getActiveSectionId(scrollY, sections) 回傳區段 id 字串，或 'above-first'，或 'ambiguous'，或 'not-found'。區段按 top 升序排列。若 scrollY 小於最小 top，回傳 'above-first'。否則計算小於或等於 scrollY 的最高 top 值。若兩個或以上區段共用該最高合格 top 值，回傳 'ambiguous'。否則回傳該最高合格 top 值對應的區段 id。門檻為包含式。以上規則只供本虛構模擬使用。

title.zh: 公開表格合約（虛構）

body.en: Fictional public table contract for this review. ROWS holds five rows with fields id, name, sizeKiB (unit: one kibibyte) and status. sortKey is 'id' or 'sizeKiB'. sortDir is 'asc' or 'desc' and applies only to the sortKey comparison, never to the tie-break. Rows whose sortKey values are equal always order by id ascending, in both directions. status filters rows: 'all' keeps every row, 'ready' or 'queued' keeps only matching rows. page is 1-based. lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize)), where total counts rows after filtering. Action 'setSort' always returns page 1, even when sortKey and sortDir are unchanged. Action 'setStatus' keeps the current page only when it is at most lastPage, otherwise it returns lastPage. Action 'setPage' returns the requested page unchanged, even beyond lastPage. reduceTableState and resolveTableState must not mutate ROWS or the incoming state, and every case must return a new object. The corrected module must be one complete self-contained file that keeps the types and ROWS in the same module scope with no imports.
body.zh: 本次審查的虛構公開表格合約。ROWS 存放五列，欄位為 id、name、sizeKiB（單位：1 kibibyte）及 status。sortKey 為 'id' 或 'sizeKiB'。sortDir 為 'asc' 或 'desc'，只套用於 sortKey 的比較，永不套用於相同值的次序處理。sortKey 值相同的列，兩個方向都一律按 id 升序排列。status 篩選列：'all' 保留全部列，'ready' 或 'queued' 只保留相符的列。page 由 1 開始。lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize))，total 為篩選後的列數。動作 'setSort' 一律回傳 page 1，即使 sortKey 及 sortDir 沒有改變。動作 'setStatus' 只在現有 page 不超過 lastPage 時保留，否則回傳 lastPage。動作 'setPage' 原樣回傳要求的 page，即使超出 lastPage。reduceTableState 及 resolveTableState 不得改動 ROWS 或傳入的 state，每個分支都必須回傳新物件。修正後的模組須為單一完整自足檔案，型別與 ROWS 保留在同一模組作用域，且不引入任何 import。

title.zh: 公開表格合約（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional public table contract for this review.

ROWS holds six rows with fields id, name, sizeKiB (unit: one kibibyte) and status.

sortKey is 'id' or 'sizeKiB'. sortDir is 'asc' or 'desc' and applies only to the sortKey comparison, never to the tie-break. Rows whose sortKey values are equal always order by id ascending, in both directions.

status filters rows: 'all' keeps every row, 'ready' or 'queued' keeps only matching rows.

page is 1-based. lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize)), where total counts rows after filtering.

Action 'setSort' always returns page 1, even when sortKey and sortDir are unchanged.

Action 'setStatus' keeps the current page only when it is at most lastPage, otherwise it returns lastPage.

Action 'setPage' returns the requested page unchanged, even beyond lastPage.

resolveTableState clamps the effective page to lastPage before slicing, so rows never comes back empty merely because page exceeds lastPage.

reduceTableState and resolveTableState must not mutate ROWS or the incoming state, and every case must return a new object. The corrected module must be one complete self-contained file keeping the types, ROWS and both functions in one module scope with no imports.
body.zh:
本次審查的虛構公開表格合約。

ROWS 存放六列，欄位為 id、name、sizeKiB（單位：1 kibibyte）及 status。

sortKey 為 'id' 或 'sizeKiB'。sortDir 為 'asc' 或 'desc'，只套用於 sortKey 的比較，永不套用於相同值的次序處理。sortKey 值相同的列，兩個方向都一律按 id 升序排列。

status 篩選列：'all' 保留全部列，'ready' 或 'queued' 只保留相符的列。

page 由 1 開始。lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize))，total 為篩選後的列數。

動作 'setSort' 一律回傳 page 1，即使 sortKey 及 sortDir 沒有改變。

動作 'setStatus' 只在現有 page 不超過 lastPage 時保留，否則回傳 lastPage。

動作 'setPage' 原樣回傳要求的 page，即使超出 lastPage。

resolveTableState 切片前會把實際使用的 page 收緊至 lastPage，因此頁數超出 lastPage 時 rows 不會傳回空陣列。

reduceTableState 及 resolveTableState 不得改動 ROWS 或傳入的 state，每個分支都必須回傳新物件。修正後的模組須為單一完整自足檔案，型別、ROWS 及兩個函數保留在同一模組作用域，且不引入任何 import。

title.zh: 修正審核事件建立函數

brief.en: You are a full-stack developer at a fictional commerce platform inspired by SHOPLINE. A pure event builder buildAuditEvent currently returns an array and emits events for validation failures and duplicates. It also copies request fields instead of canonical result fields. Your task: fix the builder to emit exactly one audit event only for accepted transactions, using result fields eventId, merchantId, sku, priceCents, currency. Return null for validation_failed and duplicate. Deliver a corrected code patch, proposed tests, and a concise handover.
brief.zh: 你是受 SHOPLINE 啟發的虛構商貿平台的全端開發員。一個純事件建立函數 buildAuditEvent 目前回傳陣列，並為驗證失敗及重複交易產生事件。它亦複製請求欄位而非正規交易結果欄位。你的任務：修正該建立函數，使只有 accepted 交易產生恰好一個審核事件，並使用交易結果的 eventId、merchantId、sku、priceCents、currency。對於 validation_failed 及 duplicate 回傳 null。提交修正程式碼、建議測試及簡潔交接。

title.zh: 虛構審核事件政策

body.en: Fictional audit event policy: The buildAuditEvent function is a pure builder. For a transaction result with status accepted, it must return exactly one AuditEvent. The eventId, merchantId, sku, priceCents, and currency fields must be copied from the transaction result. The note field may come from the original request. For any other status, including validation_failed and duplicate, the function must return null. No event may be emitted for validation failures or duplicates. The returned event must not reuse request fields for any of the five canonical fields.
body.zh: 虛構審核事件政策：buildAuditEvent 函數為純建立函數。對於狀態為 accepted 的交易結果，它必須回傳恰好一個 AuditEvent。eventId、merchantId、sku、priceCents 及 currency 欄位必須複製自交易結果。note 欄位可來自原始請求。對於任何其他狀態，包括 validation_failed 及 duplicate，函數必須回傳 null。驗證失敗或重複交易不得產生任何事件。回傳事件不得為五個正規欄位重用請求欄位。

brief.en: Learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE. It is not endorsed by SHOPLINE. You are a full-stack developer on a fictional commerce platform. A pure builder buildAuditEvent currently returns an array, duplicates confirmed price changes and also emits events for unchanged results. Repair the builder so a confirmed change is represented exactly once with fields taken from the caller supplied transaction result, and so unchanged and validation_failed results return null. Deliver a complete corrected TypeScript file, proposed tests, and a concise written handover with evidence and limits.
brief.zh: 本學習模擬受 SHOPLINE 啟發，但未獲 SHOPLINE 認可。你是虛構商貿平台的全端開發員。純建立函數 buildAuditEvent 目前回傳陣列，重複表示已確認的價格改動，並為未改動的結果產生事件。請修正該建立函數，使已確認改動只被表示一次，且欄位取自呼叫者提供的交易結果，並使 unchanged 及 validation_failed 結果回傳 null。請提交完整修正後的 TypeScript 檔案、建議測試，以及附有證據及限制的簡潔書面交接。

title.zh: 虛構審核事件政策

body.en: Fictional audit event policy for this learning simulation. It is not an official SHOPLINE policy. A confirmed change is a price update transaction whose status is 'updated'. The pure builder buildAuditEvent must return exactly one AuditEvent for a confirmed change and null in every other case, which includes 'unchanged' and 'validation_failed'. The returned event must take eventId, merchantId, sku, oldPriceCents, newPriceCents and currency from the caller supplied transaction result. The optional note may come from the original request. A confirmed change must never be represented by two separate events, and an unchanged or failed result must never produce an event. Prices are integer cents and currency is an uppercase three letter code.
body.zh: 本學習模擬的虛構審核事件政策。此非 SHOPLINE 官方政策。已確認改動是指狀態為 'updated' 的價格更新交易。純建立函數 buildAuditEvent 必須為已確認改動回傳恰好一個 AuditEvent，並在所有其他情況回傳 null，包括 'unchanged' 及 'validation_failed'。回傳事件必須從呼叫者提供的交易結果取得 eventId、merchantId、sku、oldPriceCents、newPriceCents 及 currency。可選的 note 可來自原始請求。已確認改動不得由兩個獨立事件表示，未改動或驗證失敗的結果不得產生任何事件。價格為整數分，currency 為大寫三字母代碼。

title.zh: 快取可接納性及選擇政策（虛構）

body.en:
Cache admissibility and selection policy (fictional).
Independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE, not endorsed by it. All rules and records are fictional. A cached response is admissible only when all four conditions hold. The record tenantId must equal the requesting tenantId. The record path must equal the requested path. The record storedAt must be less than or equal to now. The record expiresAt must be strictly greater than now, so a record whose expiresAt equals now is already expired. Among admissible records, select the latest storedAt. If two share a storedAt, select the higher version. Return recordId null when nothing is admissible.
body.zh:
快取可接納性及選擇政策（虛構）。
本練習為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲該公司認可。所有規則及記錄均為虛構。只有在四項條件全部成立時，快取回應才可被接納。記錄的 tenantId 必須等於請求的 tenantId。記錄的 path 必須等於請求的 path。記錄的 storedAt 必須小於或等於 now。記錄的 expiresAt 必須嚴格大於 now，因此 expiresAt 等於 now 的記錄已經到期。在所有可接納記錄中，選取 storedAt 最遲的一筆。若兩筆的 storedAt 相同，選取 version 較高的一筆。若無任何記錄可被接納，回傳 recordId 為 null。

title.en: Fictional cache admissibility and selection policy
title.zh: 虛構快取可接納性及選擇政策

body.en:
Fictional cache admissibility and selection policy. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE and is not endorsed by it. All rules are fictional.

A cached response is admissible only when all four conditions hold.
1. record.tenantId equals the requesting tenantId exactly.
2. record.path equals the requested path exactly.
3. record.storedAt is less than or equal to now.
4. record.expiresAt is strictly greater than now, so a record whose expiresAt equals now is already expired.

Among all admissible records select the one with the latest storedAt. If two admissible records share the same storedAt, select the higher version. version breaks ties only and never overrides storedAt. If no record is admissible the function must return { hit: false, recordId: null }.
body.zh:
虛構快取可接納性及選擇政策。本練習為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲該公司認可。所有規則均為虛構。

只有在四項條件全部成立時，快取回應才可被接納。
1. record.tenantId 與請求的 tenantId 完全相同。
2. record.path 與請求的 path 完全相同。
3. record.storedAt 小於或等於 now。
4. record.expiresAt 嚴格大於 now，因此 expiresAt 等於 now 的記錄已經到期。

在所有可接納記錄中，選取 storedAt 最遲的一筆。若兩筆可接納記錄的 storedAt 相同，選取 version 較高的一筆。version 僅用於打破同分，絕不覆蓋 storedAt。若無任何記錄可被接納，函數必須回傳 { hit: false, recordId: null }。

expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體測試及預期結果，至少包括：now 2026-05-09T09:30:00.000Z、tenant-a /cart 預期 recordId 為 cr-106；tenant-b /cart 預期 cr-103；tenant-a /orders 預期 cr-105；沒有相符記錄的租戶預期 hit 為 false、recordId 為 null；以及 expiresAt 等於 now 的相等邊界個案，預期該記錄被排除。

expectedEvidence.zh: 提供簡潔的英文或繁體中文交接，指出缺少 tenantId 檢查，展示修正後的守衛程式碼行，引用記錄識別碼作為證據，列出測試及預期結果，並提出明確下一步，例如在合併前與模組負責人確認修正。

exemplar.en:
Defect. selectCacheEntry never reads tenantId, so the loop admits cr-103, a tenant-b record, for a tenant-a request.

Patch (replacing the guard block).
if (record.tenantId !== tenantId) continue
if (record.path !== path) continue
if (record.storedAt > now) continue
if (record.expiresAt <= now) continue

Evidence at now = '2026-05-09T09:30:00.000Z', tenantId 'tenant-a', path '/cart'. cr-103 fails the tenant rule. cr-104 fails the expiry rule because its expiresAt equals now. cr-105 fails the path rule, it is /orders. cr-107 is written after now. The admissible set is cr-101, cr-102 and cr-106. cr-102 and cr-106 share storedAt 09:20, so version 8 selects cr-106. The current code returns cr-103.

Tests. tenant-a /cart expects cr-106. tenant-b /cart expects cr-103. tenant-a /orders expects cr-105. tenant-c /cart expects { hit: false, recordId: null }.

Limitations. Fixtures and the stated policy only, no code executed, no cache write path or clock skew evidence. I would confirm the patch with the cache module owner before merge.
exemplar.zh:
缺陷。selectCacheEntry 從未讀取 tenantId，因此迴圈在 tenant-a 請求時接納了屬於 tenant-b 的 cr-103。

修正（替換守衛區塊）。
if (record.tenantId !== tenantId) continue
if (record.path !== path) continue
if (record.storedAt > now) continue
if (record.expiresAt <= now) continue

在 now = '2026-05-09T09:30:00.000Z'、tenantId 'tenant-a'、path '/cart' 下的證據。cr-103 不符租戶規則。cr-104 不符到期規則，因其 expiresAt 等於 now。cr-105 不符路徑規則，它是 /orders。cr-107 的寫入時間遲於 now。可接納集合為 cr-101、cr-102 及 cr-106。cr-102 與 cr-106 的 storedAt 同為 09:20，version 8 使 cr-106 被選中。現行程式碼回傳 cr-103。

測試。tenant-a /cart 預期 cr-106。tenant-b /cart 預期 cr-103。tenant-a /orders 預期 cr-105。tenant-c /cart 預期 { hit: false, recordId: null }。

限制。僅限快照及所述政策，並未執行程式碼，亦無快取寫入路徑或時鐘偏移的證據。我會在合併前與快取模組負責人確認修正。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: the corrected guard is guard-complete with tenantId, path, storedAt <= now and expiresAt strictly greater than now, the corrected result is cr-106, the current output is cr-103, and cr-104 is the record excluded only at the expiry equality boundary. The exact four guard lines are supplied in full.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：修正守衛為 guard-complete，包含 tenantId、path、storedAt 不遲於 now 及 expiresAt 嚴格大於 now；修正後結果為 cr-106；現行輸出為 cr-103；cr-104 是僅在到期時間相等邊界被排除的記錄。四行守衛程式碼完整提供。

feedback.en: Strong record-level reasoning: cr-103 is tenant-b, cr-104 expires exactly at now, cr-105 is /orders, cr-107 is written after now, and cr-102 and cr-106 share storedAt 09:20 with version 8 selecting cr-106. The admissible set cr-101, cr-102, cr-106 is stated explicitly.
feedback.zh: 記錄層面的推理紮實：cr-103 屬 tenant-b，cr-104 剛好在 now 到期，cr-105 為 /orders，cr-107 在 now 之後寫入，而 cr-102 與 cr-106 的 storedAt 同為 09:20，version 8 令 cr-106 被選中。可接納集合 cr-101、cr-102、cr-106 已明確列出。

feedback.en: Tests cover tenant-a /cart expecting cr-106, tenant-b /cart expecting cr-103, tenant-a /orders expecting cr-105, and a tenant with no match expecting { hit: false, recordId: null }. Adding an explicit equality-boundary test that asserts cr-104 is excluded when expiresAt equals now would make the expiry edge directly verifiable, since it currently appears only in the evidence section.
feedback.zh: 測試涵蓋 tenant-a /cart 預期 cr-106、tenant-b /cart 預期 cr-103、tenant-a /orders 預期 cr-105，以及無相符記錄的租戶預期 { hit: false, recordId: null }。若加一個明確的相等邊界測試，斷言 expiresAt 等於 now 時 cr-104 被排除，到期邊界便可直接驗證，因為目前該點僅出現在證據部分。

feedback.en: Scope is properly bounded to the fictional fixtures and stated policy, with an explicit note that no code was executed and that the cache write path and clock skew are outside the evidence. Real merchant data and production behaviour are implied by the same caveat.
feedback.zh: 範圍恰當地限於虛構快照及所述政策，並明確註明並未執行程式碼，且快取寫入路徑及時鐘偏移不在證據範圍內。真實商戶資料及正式環境行為亦由此同一保留涵蓋。

feedback.en: Concise and actionable: the missing tenantId check is named, the corrected guard lines are shown, record ids back the claim, tests list expected results, and the next step is to confirm the patch with the cache module owner before merge.
feedback.zh: 簡潔且可行：指出缺少 tenantId 檢查，展示修正後的守衛程式碼行，以記錄識別碼支持結論，測試列出預期結果，下一步是在合併前與快取模組負責人確認修正。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced patch handover. All four structured decisions and the guard replacement are correct, and the reasoning cites the specific fixture records that drive each exclusion and the version tie-break. The only gap is that the expiry equality edge is argued in the evidence rather than asserted as its own test case.
summary.zh: 這是一份準確且證據充分的修正交接。四項結構化決策及替代守衛全部正確，推理亦引用具體快照記錄，說明每項排除原因及 version 同分打破規則。唯一不足是到期相等邊界只在證據中論述，未作為獨立測試個案斷言。

nextSteps.en: Add one explicit test asserting that for now equal to a record's expiresAt the record is excluded, for example cr-104 at 2026-05-09T09:30:00.000Z, and confirm the patch with the cache module owner before merge.
nextSteps.zh: 新增一個明確測試，斷言當 now 等於某記錄的 expiresAt 時該記錄被排除，例如 cr-104 在 2026-05-09T09:30:00.000Z，並在合併前與快取模組負責人確認修正。

title.en: Align the client search mapper and empty-result handler
title.zh: 對齊客戶端搜尋映射及空結果處理

brief.en: Fictional SHOPLINE simulation, not an official SHOPLINE task. A merchant-facing product search screen sends requests to GET /api/v2/search. The client mapper and response handler were reviewed together and one defect was reported for empty result sets. Read search-contract, client-code and fixture-requests. Then answer the four questions, and produce a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese containing the corrected handleResponse code as exact replacement lines, the mapper output for the fixtures you must derive, proposed tests, and any limits of your review. No code execution, network calls or database access are available.
brief.zh: 虛構 SHOPLINE 模擬，並非 SHOPLINE 官方任務。商戶端產品搜尋畫面會向 GET /api/v2/search 發出請求。客戶端映射與回應處理經一同審閱後，就空結果回報了一項缺陷。閱讀 search-contract、client-code 及 fixture-requests，然後回答四條問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文提交簡潔交接，內容包括修正 handleResponse 的確切替換程式碼、須自行推導的映射輸出、建議測試及審閱限制。不提供程式碼執行、網絡呼叫或資料庫存取。

title.zh: 虛構搜尋 API 合約 v2

body.en: Fictional SHOPLINE simulation rules. Endpoint GET /api/v2/search. Query parameters: q is optional text, page is a positive integer defaulting to 1, pageSize is an integer from 1 to 50 defaulting to 20, and sort is one of relevance, price_asc or price_desc defaulting to relevance. mapQuery must trim leading and trailing whitespace from q. If the trimmed q is empty, the request object must omit q entirely. Response body has total, page, pageSize and items, where each item has id, title and priceHkd. A response with total 0 and items [] is valid and must map to view state { kind: 'empty' }.
body.zh: 虛構 SHOPLINE 模擬規則。端點為 GET /api/v2/search。查詢參數：q 為可選文字，page 為正整數，預設 1，pageSize 為 1 至 50 的整數，預設 20，sort 為 relevance、price_asc 或 price_desc 其中之一，預設 relevance。mapQuery 必須去除 q 的前後空白。若去除空白後 q 為空，請求物件必須完全省略 q。回應主體有 total、page、pageSize 及 items，每個 item 有 id、title 及 priceHkd。total 為 0 且 items 為 [] 的回應屬有效空結果，必須映射為檢視狀態 { kind: 'empty' }。

title.en: Fictional client mapper and response handler
title.zh: 虛構客戶端映射及回應處理
虛構原始請求測試資料（只有輸入）

body.en:
Fictional input-only CSV. Columns: id, q, page, pageSize, sort. Units: page counts pages as an integer, pageSize counts items as an integer. Values are raw client inputs before mapping. No expected outputs are stored here.

```csv
id,q,page,pageSize,sort
R-01,"  wired earbuds  ",2,20,price_asc
R-02,"",1,20,relevance
R-03,"  smart watch",0,80,price_desc
```
body.zh:
虛構輸入專用 CSV。欄位：id、q、page、pageSize、sort。單位：page 以整數計算頁數，pageSize 以整數計算項目數。數值為映射前的原始客戶端輸入，此處不儲存任何預期輸出。

```csv
id,q,page,pageSize,sort
R-01,"  wired earbuds  ",2,20,price_asc
R-02,"",1,20,relevance
R-03,"  smart watch",0,80,price_desc
```

label.en: Fixture R-01 has q '  wired earbuds  ', page 2, pageSize 20, sort 'price_asc'. Under search-contract, which object does mapQuery return?
label.zh: 測試資料 R-01 的 q 為 '  wired earbuds  '，page 為 2，pageSize 為 20，sort 為 'price_asc'。按 search-contract，mapQuery 會回傳哪個物件？

label.en: { q: '  wired earbuds  ', page: 2, pageSize: 20, sort: 'price_asc' }
label.zh: { q: '  wired earbuds  ', page: 2, pageSize: 20, sort: 'price_asc' }

label.en: Fixture R-03 has q '  smart watch', page 0, pageSize 80, sort 'price_desc'. Under search-contract, which object does mapQuery return?
label.zh: 測試資料 R-03 的 q 為 '  smart watch'，page 為 0，pageSize 為 80，sort 為 'price_desc'。按 search-contract，mapQuery 會回傳哪個物件？

label.en: { q: '  smart watch', page: 1, pageSize: 50, sort: 'price_desc' }
label.zh: { q: '  smart watch', page: 1, pageSize: 50, sort: 'price_desc' }

label.en: Under search-contract, how many of the fixture rows R-01, R-02 and R-03 produce a mapped request object that omits the q property?
label.zh: 按 search-contract，測試資料列 R-01、R-02 及 R-03 之中，有多少列映射後的請求物件會省略 q 屬性？

label.en: Which complete change set repairs handleResponse so a valid empty result returns { kind: 'empty' } and every non-empty result keeps the supplied results shape?
label.zh: 哪一組完整改動可修正 handleResponse，使有效空結果回傳 { kind: 'empty' }，而所有非空結果保留提供的 results 形狀？

label.en: Add an early return when res.total === 0 and leave the existing results branch unchanged.
label.zh: 當 res.total === 0 時加入提前回傳，並保持現有 results 分支不變。

label.en: Wrap the whole function body in try and catch, returning { kind: 'empty' } from catch.
label.zh: 把整個函式主體包在 try 與 catch 中，並由 catch 回傳 { kind: 'empty' }。

label.en: Remove the count field from the results branch.

title.en: Fictional Search API Contract v3, cursor and availability

body.en: Fictional SHOPLINE simulation rules, not official SHOPLINE policy. Endpoint GET /api/v3/catalog/search. mapQuery trims term and cursor. A trimmed empty term omits term. A trimmed empty cursor omits cursor, which asks for the first page. limit is an integer from 1 to 40. When the supplied limit value falls outside that range for any reason, the request uses 15. availability is in_stock, preorder or any and defaults to any for any other value. sort is relevance, price_asc or price_desc and defaults to relevance. The response carries items, nextCursor and unavailableFilters. handleResponse returns { kind: 'empty' } when items is empty. Otherwise it returns kind results with firstId, count equal to items.length, nextCursor, and availabilityApplied false when unavailableFilters contains 'availability'. The only documented member of unavailableFilters is 'availability'.
body.zh: 虛構 SHOPLINE 模擬規則，並非 SHOPLINE 官方政策。端點為 GET /api/v3/catalog/search。mapQuery 會去除 term 及 cursor 的前後空白。去除空白後 term 為空時省略 term。去除空白後 cursor 為空時省略 cursor，代表要求第一頁。limit 為 1 至 40 的整數。若提供的 limit 值因任何原因超出此範圍，請求一律使用 15。availability 為 in_stock、preorder 或 any，其他值一律預設為 any。sort 為 relevance、price_asc 或 price_desc，其他值預設為 relevance。回應包含 items、nextCursor 及 unavailableFilters。當 items 為空，handleResponse 回傳 { kind: 'empty' }。否則回傳 kind results，內含 firstId、等於 items.length 的 count、nextCursor，以及當 unavailableFilters 包含 'availability' 時為 false 的 availabilityApplied。unavailableFilters 唯一有文件記載的成員為 'availability'。

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by STC, not endorsed by it. You are a laboratory analyst planning documentary review batches for fictional reports. title.zh: 虛構審查排程政策

body.en: Fictional review scheduling rules for this simulation. Review duration for a batch is reports multiplied by minutes_per_report. Daily review capacity is 150 minutes starting at 09:00. A batch must be reviewed in one continuous block. If remaining capacity that day is less than the batch duration, the batch moves to the next working day at 09:00. Order batches by earliest deadline_day first. If deadlines are equal, lower batch_id first. A batch is late if it completes after 17:00 on its deadline_day. Completing on the deadline_day is on time. All dates, batches and capacities are fictional.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構審查排程規則。批次審查時長為 reports 乘以 minutes_per_report。每日審查容量為 150 分鐘，由 09:00 開始。批次必須以連續區塊審查。若當日剩餘容量少於批次時長，該批次移至下一個工作天 09:00。按最早 deadline_day 排序。若截止日相同，較低 batch_id 優先。若批次在 deadline_day 的 17:00 之後完成，則屬逾期。在 deadline_day 當天完成屬按時。所有日期、批次及容量均為虛構。

exemplar.en: Handover: Review order follows EDF with tie-break by batch_id. Durations: B-01=60, B-02=75, B-03=60, B-04=100, B-05=120 minutes. Day 1 (150 min capacity): B-01 09:00-10:00, B-02 10:00-11:15. Day 2: B-03 09:00-10:00. B-04 does not fit (100>90 remaining) so moves to Day 3. Day 3: B-04 09:00-10:40. B-05 does not fit (120>50) so moves to Day 4. Day 4: B-05 09:00-11:00. On-time: B-01, B-02, B-03. Late: B-04 (deadline D2, done D3), B-05 (deadline D3, done D4). Total review time = 415 min. Total unused capacity = 15+90+50+30 = 185 min. Next step: confirm capacity assumption and any new urgent batches. Data are fictional.

feedback.en: All decisions are correct: B-01 reviewed first, on-time batches B-01/B-02/B-03, total review 415 minutes, and total unused capacity 185 minutes. Durations, day-by-day capacity and the continuous-block moves for B-04 and B-05 are all applied accurately.
feedback.zh: 所有決策均正確：B-01 最先審查、按時批次 B-01/B-02/B-03、總審查 415 分鐘、總未使用容量 185 分鐘。各批時長、逐日容量，以及 B-04 與 B-05 因連續區塊限制而延後，全部應用準確。

feedback.en: Reasoning is well tied to the policy and CSV, citing EDF, batch_id tie-break, 150-minute capacity and the specific durations. It clearly explains why B-04 moves to Day 3 (100>90) and B-05 to Day 4 (120>50). Naming the 17:00 completion rule would strengthen the on-time evidence.
feedback.zh: 推理與政策及 CSV 緊密連結，引用最早截止日優先、按批次編號排序、150 分鐘容量及具體時長，並清楚解釋 B-04 移至第 3 天（100>90）、B-05 移至第 4 天（120>50）。若同時點明 17:00 完成規則，按時的證據會更充分。

feedback.en: The handover includes a concrete next step to confirm the capacity assumption and any new urgent batches. It would be stronger with an explicit check such as recalculating durations or re-simulating daily capacity, and confirming the deadline-day boundary.
feedback.zh: 交接包含具體下一步，即確認容量假設及任何新增緊急批次。若能加入明確檢查，例如重新計算時長、重新模擬每日容量，以及核實截止日當天完成的邊界，會更完善。

feedback.en: The handover states the data are fictional, which limits the claims appropriately. It does not note that no real laboratory or certification decision is involved, and the capacity-and-order assumption could be flagged as an explicit uncertainty.
feedback.zh: 交接指出資料為虛構，恰當地限制了聲明範圍。惟未說明不涉及真實實驗室或認證決定，而容量與順序的假設亦可標明為明確的不確定性。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable, giving review order, on-time and late batches, both totals, and the evidence sources. A reader could act on it directly.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，列明審查順序、按時與逾期批次、兩項總數及證據來源，讀者可直接據此行動。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced handover. Decision accuracy and reasoning are essentially complete, with the main gaps being limited verification checks and thin scope or uncertainty wording.
summary.zh: 這是一份準確且證據充分的交接。決策準確度及推理基本完整，主要不足在於核實檢查有限，以及範圍與不確定性的表述較單薄。

nextSteps.en: Add a short verification check such as recalculating durations and re-simulating daily capacity to confirm the 185-minute unused figure. Extend the scope note to state no real laboratory or certification decision is involved and flag the capacity assumption as an uncertainty.

title.zh: 規劃優先審查批次

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by STC, not endorsed by it. You are a laboratory analyst planning documentary review batches for fictional reports. Use the supplied policy and CSV. Determine the review order, which batches are late, and unused reserved capacity. Then write a concise handover (about 100-180 words) in English or Traditional Chinese. Include your decisions, evidence and next steps. No real laboratory work is involved. All data are fictional.
brief.zh: 這是一項受 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由 STC 認可。你是化驗分析員，為虛構報告規劃文件審查批次。使用提供的政策及 CSV。確定審查順序、哪些批次逾期，以及未使用的預留容量。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，包括你的決策、證據及下一步。不涉及真實實驗室工作。所有資料均為虛構。

title.zh: 虛構優先審查排程政策

body.en: Fictional rules for this simulation. Review duration for a batch equals reports multiplied by minutes_per_report. Each working day has 240 minutes total capacity. The first 60 minutes each day is a reserved slot that may only be used by URGENT priority batches. The remaining 180 minutes is general capacity for any priority. Order batches by priority: URGENT first, then HIGH, then NORMAL. Within the same priority, order by earliest deadline_day first. If deadlines are equal, lower batch_id first. For each batch in that order, assign it to the earliest working day where it fits. An URGENT batch fits if its duration is at most remaining reserved plus remaining general capacity that day. A HIGH or NORMAL batch fits if its duration is at most remaining general capacity that day. URGENT batches consume reserved capacity first, then general. A batch is late if it is scheduled on a working day greater than its deadline_day. Completing on the deadline_day is on time. All dates, batches and capacities are fictional.
body.zh: 本模擬的虛構規則。批次審查時長等於 reports 乘以 minutes_per_report。每個工作天總容量為 240 分鐘。每天首 60 分鐘為預留時段，只供 URGENT 優先批次使用。其餘 180 分鐘為一般容量，任何優先級均可使用。按優先級排序：URGENT 最先，然後 HIGH，然後 NORMAL。同一優先級內，按最早 deadline_day 排序。若截止日相同，較低 batch_id 優先。按此順序為每個批次分配至最早能容納的工作天。URGENT 批次若其時長不超過當天剩餘預留加剩餘一般容量，則可容納。HIGH 或 NORMAL 批次若其時長不超過當天剩餘一般容量，則可容納。URGENT 批次先使用預留容量，再使用一般容量。若批次被安排在工作天大於其 deadline_day，則屬逾期。在 deadline_day 當天完成屬按時。所有日期、批次及容量均為虛構。

exemplar.en: Handover for fictional batch review scheduling. Decisions: Day 1 schedule B-11 (50 min, URGENT), B-13 (60 min, URGENT), B-12 (60 min, HIGH). Day 2 schedule B-15 (100 min, HIGH). Day 3 schedule B-14 (150 min, NORMAL). B-14 is late because it is scheduled on day 3 while its deadline is day 2. All others are on time. Evidence: CSV shows B-11=2*25=50, B-12=3*20=60, B-13=4*15=60, B-14=5*30=150, B-15=1*100=100. Policy orders URGENT first, then HIGH, then NORMAL, and gives 60 reserved minutes for URGENT only. Total review time is 420 minutes. Unused reserved capacity is 120 minutes. Risks: data are fictional and priority may change. Next steps: confirm schedule with team lead and flag late B-14 for possible deadline adjustment.
exemplar.zh: 虛構批次審查排程交接。決策：第 1 天安排 B-11（50 分鐘，URGENT）、B-13（60 分鐘，URGENT）、B-12（60 分鐘，HIGH）。第 2 天安排 B-15（100 分鐘，HIGH）。第 3 天安排 B-14（150 分鐘，NORMAL）。B-14 逾期，因其安排於第 3 天而截止日為第 2 天。其餘均按時。證據：CSV 顯示 B-11=2*25=50、B-12=3*20=60、B-13=4*15=60、B-14=5*30=150、B-15=1*100=100。政策按 URGENT、HIGH、NORMAL 排序，並為 URGENT 提供 60 分鐘預留。總審查時間為 420 分鐘。未使用預留容量為 120 分鐘。風險：資料為虛構，優先級可能變更。下一步：與團隊主管確認排程，並標示 B-14 逾期，以便調整截止日。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct: first batch B-11, on-time batches B-11, B-12, B-13 and B-15, total review time 420 minutes and unused reserved capacity 120 minutes. Your day-by-day schedule also matches the policy, with B-14 correctly flagged as late.

feedback.en: You ground every decision in the supplied records, showing each duration calculation such as B-11=2*25=50 and B-14=5*30=150, and citing the URGENT then HIGH then NORMAL ordering rule with the 60-minute reserved slot for URGENT only. You explain clearly why B-14 is late (day 3 versus deadline day 2).
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結至提供記錄，展示各時長計算如 B-11=2*25=50 及 B-14=5*30=150，並引用 URGENT、HIGH、NORMAL 的排序規則及只供 URGENT 的 60 分鐘預留時段。你清楚解釋 B-14 為何逾期（第 3 天對比截止日第 2 天）。

feedback.en: Your next step of confirming with the team lead and flagging late B-14 is useful, but the verification is thin. Add concrete checks such as recalculating each duration from reports * minutes_per_report, confirming the daily 240-minute cap and 60-minute URGENT reserve, and verifying no batch is split across days.

feedback.en: This is a clear, concise handover at 131 words that lists the per-day schedule, identifies late B-14, and gives the total time and unused reserved capacity. Naming who owns the escalation would sharpen it further.

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional quality-control review at an independent testing organisation. Apply the rule to the consecutive records, decide whether the RUN-FLAG review flag applies, and explain the evidence. title.zh: 虛構品控連續趨勢規則 QCR-04

body.en: Fictional learning-simulation rule QCR-04 for control material CND-50. The centerline is 50.0 µS/cm. A review flag named RUN-FLAG is raised when 8 or more consecutive QC observations are all strictly above the centerline (> 50.0) or all strictly below (< 50.0). Only records sharing the same material_lot and the same channel count as consecutive. A value equal to the centerline is neither above nor below and breaks the run. Record order is the run_index column. This policy is fictional and is not an STC procedure.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬規則 QCR-04，適用於控制物料 CND-50。中心線為 50.0 µS/cm。當 8 個或以上連續品控觀測值全部嚴格高於中心線（> 50.0），或全部嚴格低於中心線（< 50.0），即發出名為 RUN-FLAG 的審查標記。只有 material_lot 及 channel 相同的記錄才可視為連續。數值等於中心線既非高於亦非低於，會中斷連續序列。記錄順序以 run_index 欄為準。本政策屬虛構，並非 STC 程序。

Includes applicable ownership or escalation.

exemplar.en: I reviewed the synthetic QC log for control material CND-88 against fictional rule QCR-05. The log contains 12 records for lot L-99, channel CH-B, in run_index order. Applying the monotonic trend rule, I found a strictly increasing run of 6 consecutive observations from QC-201 to QC-206 (values 10.0, 10.5, 11.2, 11.8, 12.1, 12.9 µS/cm). Because this meets the threshold of 6 or more, TREND-FLAG is raised. Record QC-207 (12.4 µS/cm) breaks the increasing trend as it is lower than QC-206. The longest strictly decreasing run is 4 observations (QC-208 to QC-211). The flagged run range is QC-201 to QC-206, run length 6. No records were inferred. Next steps: confirm the run_index sequencing and lot/channel consistency, and have the QC lead review the flag. This is a fictional exercise, not an STC procedure.
exemplar.zh: 我根據虛構規則 QCR-05 審查了 CND-88 控制物料的合成品控記錄。該記錄包含 12 項 L-99 批次、CH-B 通道的記錄，按 run_index 次序排列。應用單調趨勢規則後，我發現由 QC-201 至 QC-206 的 6 個連續觀測值構成嚴格遞增序列（數值為 10.0、10.5、11.2、11.8、12.1、12.9 µS/cm）。由於這符合 6 個或以上的門檻，因此發出 TREND-FLAG。記錄 QC-207（12.4 µS/cm）中斷遞增趨勢，因其低於 QC-206。最長的嚴格遞減序列為 4 個觀測值（QC-208 至 QC-211）。被標記的序列範圍為 QC-201 至 QC-206，長度為 6。沒有推斷任何記錄。下一步：確認 run_index 排序及批次/通道一致性，並由品控主管審查該標記。此為虛構練習，並非 STC 程序。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You identified the strictly increasing run QC-201 to QC-206 with values 10.0, 10.5, 11.2, 11.8, 12.1, 12.9 µS/cm, gave the run length as 6, explained that QC-207 (12.4) breaks the trend, and reported the longest strictly decreasing run as 4 observations (QC-208 to QC-211). This matches fictional rule QCR-05 exactly.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。你找出嚴格遞增序列 QC-201 至 QC-206（10.0、10.5、11.2、11.8、12.1、12.9 µS/cm），連續長度為 6，並說明 QC-207（12.4）中斷趨勢，以及最長嚴格遞減序列為 4 個觀測值（QC-208 至 QC-211），完全符合虛構規則 QCR-05。

feedback.en: You linked each conclusion to specific records and values from the supplied log, cited the run_index order and the lot L-99 and channel CH-B consistency, and applied the threshold of 6 from QCR-05 to justify raising TREND-FLAG. The contrast between the qualifying 6-point increasing run and the non-qualifying 4-point decreasing run is clear.
feedback.zh: 你把每個結論連繫到記錄中的具體記錄及數值，引用了 run_index 次序以及批次 L-99 與通道 CH-B 的一致性，並以 QCR-05 的 6 個門檻解釋發出 TREND-FLAG 的理由。你清楚對比符合門檻的 6 點遞增序列與不符合的 4 點遞減序列。

feedback.en: Your next steps cover confirming run_index sequencing, checking lot and channel consistency, and QC lead review, which are concrete and relevant. To strengthen it, add an independent recalculation of the monotonic runs and an explicit check of the boundary record QC-212, and note what would happen if the threshold or sequencing were wrong.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步涵蓋核實 run_index 次序、檢查批次與通道一致性及品控主管審查，具體且相關。可再補上獨立重算單調序列、明確檢查邊界記錄 QC-212，以及說明若門檻或排序有誤時的影響。

feedback.en: You correctly state the exercise is fictional, the log is synthetic, and that no records were inferred, and you avoid any real certification claim. You could also record the explicit assumption that run_index is authoritative and that QCR-05 was supplied in full.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出此為虛構練習、記錄為合成，且沒有推斷任何缺失記錄，亦沒有聲稱真實認證結果。你可再列明 run_index 具權威性及 QCR-05 已完整提供這兩項假設。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, giving the decision (TREND-FLAG raised), the evidence (QC-201 to QC-206, length 6), the calculation method, the uncertainty limit and the escalation to the QC lead. No changes needed.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明決策（發出 TREND-FLAG）、證據（QC-201 至 QC-206，長度 6）、計算方法、不確定性限制及轉交品控主管，無需修改。

summary.en: An accurate and well-evidenced submission. All four structured decisions match QCR-05, and the written handover explains the flagged run, the breaking record QC-207, the longest decreasing run and the scope limits clearly enough for a QC lead to act on.
summary.zh: 提交準確且證據充分。四項結構化決策均符合 QCR-05，書面交接清楚說明被標記序列、中斷記錄 QC-207、最長遞減序列及範圍限制，足以讓品控主管跟進。

nextSteps.en: Add an independent recalculation of the monotonic runs, an explicit check of boundary record QC-212, and a note on the effect if run_index or the threshold of 6 were incorrect. Also state the assumptions that run_index is authoritative and that QCR-05 is fully supplied.
nextSteps.zh: 補上獨立重算單調序列、明確檢查邊界記錄 QC-212，並說明若 run_index 或 6 個門檻有誤時的影響。同時列明 run_index 具權威性及 QCR-05 已完整提供這兩項假設。

title.en: Report display precision review, worksheet RPT-4417
title.zh: 報告顯示精度審查，工作紙 RPT-4417

brief.en: You are supporting a laboratory analyst in a fictional STC learning simulation, not an endorsed STC activity. Worksheet RPT-4417 holds five already established synthetic raw results. Using public policy RPT-POL-07 only, produce a corrected report display column, keep the raw-result column unchanged, and write a short handover. No averaging, no unit conversion, no calibration and no QC acceptance or release decision are in scope. Explain each rounding step and name the evidence you used.
brief.zh: 你在一項虛構的 STC 學習模擬中支援化驗分析員，此模擬並非 STC 認可活動。工作紙 RPT-4417 載有五個已確立的合成原始結果。只按公開政策 RPT-POL-07，製作更正後的報告顯示欄，原始結果欄保持不變，並撰寫簡短交接。範圍不包括平均計算、單位換算、校正及品質控制接納或放行決定。請解釋每個修約步驟並列明所用證據。

title.en: Fictional display and rounding policy RPT-POL-07, revision 3
title.zh: 虛構顯示及修約政策 RPT-POL-07 第 3 版

body.en: Fictional simulation policy for this exercise. Scope. RPT-POL-07 fixes how an already established raw result is written in the report display column. It does not change the raw value, does not average replicates, does not convert units and does not decide quality-control acceptance or release. Decimal places. Moisture content is displayed to 2 decimal places. Ash content is displayed to 3 decimal places. Rounding. For positive values only, read the digit immediately after the last displayed place. If that digit is 5 or more, raise the last displayed digit by one, round half up. If that digit is 4 or less, keep the last displayed digit unchanged. Trailing zeros. Every displayed value shows exactly the number of decimal places set for its analyte, so trailing zeros are kept.
body.zh: 本練習的虛構模擬政策。範圍。RPT-POL-07 規定已確立的原始結果如何寫入報告顯示欄。政策不改變原始數值、不平均重複測定、不換算單位，亦不決定品質控制接納或放行。小數位。水分含量顯示至 2 個小數位。灰分含量顯示至 3 個小數位。修約。只適用於正值，讀取最後顯示位之後緊接的一位數字。該數字為 5 或以上時，最後顯示位加一，即四捨五入。該數字為 4 或以下時，最後顯示位不變。尾隨零。每個顯示值須完全按其分析項的小數位數顯示，因此保留尾隨零。

Policy RPT-POL-07 revision 3 sets moisture content at 2 decimal places and ash content at 3 decimal places, with round half up on positive values and trailing zeros kept. Corrected report display column, raw-result column unchanged. SM-2401 moisture raw 12.348 displays as 12.35, because the third decimal is 8. SM-2402 moisture raw 7.6 displays as 7.60, the trailing zero kept. SM-2403 ash raw 0.4249 displays as 0.425, because the fourth decimal is 9. Raw-result column remains 12.348, 7.6, 0.4249, 3.0501 and 9.995. Uncertainty and scope. The extract is synthetic and this review covers display precision only. No averaging, no unit conversion and no quality-control acceptance or release decision is made. Next step, a second analyst rechecks the five display strings against RPT-POL-07, then the worksheet format goes to the team lead.

brief.en: You are supporting a laboratory analyst in a fictional STC learning simulation, an independent exercise not endorsed by STC. Worksheet RPT-6320 holds six already established synthetic raw results. Using public policy SIG-POL-12 only, produce the corrected report display column, leave the raw-result column unchanged, and write a short handover naming the clause behind each step. No averaging, no unit conversion, no calibration, and no quality-control acceptance or release decision are in scope.
brief.zh: 你在一項虛構的 STC 學習模擬中支援化驗分析員，此模擬為獨立練習，並非 STC 認可活動。工作紙 RPT-6320 載有六個已確立的合成原始結果。只按公開政策 SIG-POL-12，製作更正後的報告顯示欄，原始結果欄保持不變，並撰寫簡短交接，列明每個步驟所依據的條文。範圍不包括平均計算、單位換算、校正及品質控制接納或放行決定。

title.en: Fictional display and precision policy SIG-POL-12, revision 2
title.zh: 虛構顯示及精度政策 SIG-POL-12 第 2 版

body.en: Fictional simulation policy, all rules public. Scope: SIG-POL-12 fixes only how an established raw result is written in the report display column. It does not change the raw value, does not average replicate readings, does not convert units and does not decide quality-control acceptance or release. Significant digits: every displayed value shows exactly 3 significant digits. Leading zeros that position the decimal point are not significant. Trailing zeros needed to keep 3 significant digits are kept. Rounding: for positive values only, read the digit immediately after the third significant digit. If it is 5 or more, raise that third digit by one and carry if it reaches ten. Otherwise keep it unchanged. Notation: if the rounded magnitude is below 0.001, or at or above 10000, write scientific notation with exactly one digit before the decimal point, exactly two after it, then E and the exponent as a plain integer, for example 4.83E-4. Otherwise write a plain decimal value.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策，所有規則均屬公開。範圍：SIG-POL-12 只規定已確立的原始結果如何寫入報告顯示欄。政策不改變原始數值、不平均重複測定、不換算單位，亦不決定品質控制接納或放行。有效數字：每個顯示值須剛好顯示 3 個有效數字。用於定位小數點的開頭零並非有效數字。為保持 3 個有效數字所需的尾隨零須保留。修約：只適用於正值，讀取第三個有效數字之後緊接的一位數字。該數字為 5 或以上時，第三個有效數字加一，若達十則進位。否則維持不變。記法：若修約後的量值低於 0.001 或達 10000 或以上，須以科學記號顯示，小數點前剛好一位、小數點後剛好兩位，之後寫 E 及以普通整數表示的指數，例如 4.83E-4。其他情況以普通小數顯示。

title.zh: 釐清 LX-40 外殼組裝文件

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT, not endorsed by ASMPT. You are a mechanical design engineer reviewing the LX-40 low-load enclosure assembly record. Use policy LX40-POL-03 and the step record CSV to reconcile the sequence and documentary verification. Identify the first step that is not accepted complete, calculate the torque shortfall, list required corrective actions, and choose the immediate disposition. Do not give real machinery or safety instructions. Produce a concise evidence-based handover. Duration 20 minutes.
brief.zh: 此為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非由 ASMPT 認可。你是機械設計工程師，正審查 LX-40 低負載外殼組裝記錄。請使用政策 LX40-POL-03 及步驟記錄 CSV，核對組裝次序及文件核實要求。找出首個未獲接納完成的步驟，計算扭力差額，列出所需糾正措施，並選擇即時處理方式。不要提供真實機械或安全指示。請提交簡潔且具證據支持的交接說明。時長 20 分鐘。

title.zh: 組裝政策 LX40-POL-03

body.en: Fictional simulation for learning only. Assembly policy LX40-POL-03 applies to the low-load LX-40 enclosure. Sequence: S1 bracket mount, S2 cable routing, S3 label check, S4 enclosure closure, S5 final inspection IP-2. Each step may start only when its prerequisite step is accepted complete. Accepted complete means status complete, evidence document present, verified yes, and for S4 torque 0.5 N·m to 0.7 N·m inclusive. S5 requires S4 accepted complete, so closure must precede inspection. A failed step must be reworked, its evidence re-verified, and any downstream step completed while the prerequisite was not accepted must be repeated.
body.zh: 此為僅供學習的虛構模擬。組裝政策 LX40-POL-03 適用於低負載 LX-40 外殼。次序：S1 支架安裝、S2 線纜布線、S3 標籤檢查、S4 外殼閉合、S5 最終檢查 IP-2。每個步驟僅可在其前置步驟獲接納完成後開始。獲接納完成指狀態為 complete、具證據文件、verified 為 yes，而 S4 扭力為 0.5 N·m 至 0.7 N·m（含上下限）。S5 要求 S4 獲接納完成，因此外殼閉合必須先於檢查。失敗步驟必須重做，其證據必須重新核實，而任何在前置步驟未獲接納時已完成的下游步驟必須重做。

title.zh: 組裝政策 CAB-LBL-07

body.en: Fictional simulation for learning only. Policy CAB-LBL-07 applies to the MX-20 cable harness assembly. Sequence: S1 harness routing, S2 cable label check, S3 continuity test, S4 cover handover, S5 documentation review. Each step may start only when its prerequisite step is accepted complete. A step is accepted complete only when status is complete, an evidence document is present, verified is yes, and step-specific criteria are met: S2 requires label_count exactly 12 and legible yes. S3 requires resistance_ohm at most 0.5. S4 requires S2 and S3 accepted complete. S5 requires S4 accepted complete. A failed step must be reworked, its evidence re-verified, and any downstream step completed while the prerequisite was not accepted must be repeated.
body.zh: 此為僅供學習的虛構模擬。政策 CAB-LBL-07 適用於 MX-20 線纜束組裝。次序：S1 線纜布線、S2 線纜標籤檢查、S3 連續性測試、S4 外蓋交接、S5 文件審查。每個步驟僅可在其前置步驟獲接納完成後開始。步驟獲接納完成僅指狀態為 complete、具證據文件、verified 為 yes，且符合步驟特定準則：S2 要求 label_count 恰好為 12 且 legible 為 yes。S3 要求 resistance_ohm 最多為 0.5。S4 要求 S2 及 S3 獲接納完成。S5 要求 S4 獲接納完成。失敗步驟必須重做，其證據必須重新核實，而任何在前置步驟未獲接納時已完成的下游步驟必須重做。

title.en: Estimate mass and material cost for bracket BRK-101
title.zh: 估算支架 BRK-101 的質量及材料成本

brief.en: You are a mechanical design engineer at ASMPT (fictional simulation, not endorsed). A new bracket design BRK-101 needs a mass and material cost estimate before review. Use the supplied policy and data table. Calculate the net volume, mass in grams, and material cost in HKD. Check against the acceptance limits. Prepare a concise handover (around 100-180 words) stating the calculated mass, cost, pass/fail, evidence, risks, and verification steps. Do not use external data.
brief.zh: 你是 ASMPT 的機械設計工程師（虛構模擬，未經認可）。新支架設計 BRK-101 需要在審查前進行質量及材料成本估算。使用提供的規則及數據表。計算淨體積、質量（克）及材料成本（港元）。檢查是否達到接納標準。準備一份簡潔交接（約100-180字），說明計算質量、成本、合格/不合格、證據、風險及核實步驟。不要使用外部數據。

title.zh: 質量及成本估算規則

body.en:
Mass and Cost Estimation Rules (fictional simulation).
1. Net volume = (outer length × outer width × thickness) − (cutout length × cutout width × thickness). Dimensions in mm.
2. Net volume cm³ = net volume mm³ ÷ 1000.
3. Mass g = net volume cm³ × density g/cm³.
4. Mass kg = mass g ÷ 1000.
5. Material cost HKD = mass kg × price HKD/kg.
6. Round mass to nearest 0.01 g. Round cost to nearest 0.01 HKD.
7. Acceptance: mass ≤ 150.00 g AND cost ≤ 8.00 HKD.
8. Use nominal values only. No waste factor. No tolerance stack-up.
body.zh:
質量及成本估算規則（虛構模擬）。
1. 淨體積 = （外長 × 外寬 × 厚度）−（切口長 × 切口寬 × 厚度）。尺寸以毫米為單位。
2. 淨體積 cm³ = 淨體積 mm³ ÷ 1000。
3. 質量 g = 淨體積 cm³ × 密度 g/cm³。
4. 質量 kg = 質量 g ÷ 1000。
5. 材料成本 HKD = 質量 kg × 價格 HKD/kg。
6. 質量四捨五入至最接近的 0.01 g。成本四捨五入至最接近的 0.01 HKD。
7. 接納標準：質量 ≤ 150.00 g 且成本 ≤ 8.00 HKD。
8. 僅使用標稱值。無損耗因子。無公差疊加。

title.zh: 支架輸入數據

body.en:
Bracket input data (fictional simulation).
```csv
part_id,outer_length_mm,outer_width_mm,thickness_mm,cutout_length_mm,cutout_width_mm,material,density_g_per_cm3,price_hkd_per_kg
BRK-101,120.0,80.0,6.0,40.0,30.0,Aluminium 6061,2.70,45.00
```
Cutout is rectangular and goes fully through the thickness, centered. All dimensions in mm. Density and price are for raw material. No waste factor applied.
body.zh:

```csv
BRK-101,120.0,80.0,6.0,40.0,30.0,Aluminium 6061,2.70,45.00
```
切口為矩形，貫穿厚度，居中。所有尺寸以毫米為單位。密度及價格為原材料數據。無損耗因子。

title.en: Mass and Material Cost Estimation Rules
title.zh: 質量及材料成本估算規則

body.en:
Mass and material cost estimation rules (fictional simulation).
1. Part volume mm³ = length mm × width mm × thickness mm.
2. Total finished volume mm³ = sum of all part volumes.
3. Finished mass g = total finished volume cm³ × density g/cm³.
4. Material volume mm³ = total finished volume mm³ × (1 + waste_factor).
5. Material mass kg = material volume cm³ × density g/cm³ ÷ 1000.
6. Material cost HKD = material mass kg × price HKD/kg.
7. Round finished mass to nearest 0.01 g. Round material cost to nearest 0.01 HKD.
8. Acceptance: finished mass ≤ 300.00 g AND material cost ≤ 20.00 HKD.
9. Use nominal dimensions only. No tolerance stack-up.
body.zh:
質量及材料成本估算規則（虛構模擬）。
1. 零件體積 mm³ = 長 mm × 寬 mm × 厚 mm。
2. 總完成體積 mm³ = 所有零件體積之和。
3. 完成質量 g = 總完成體積 cm³ × 密度 g/cm³。
4. 材料體積 mm³ = 總完成體積 mm³ × (1 + 損耗因子)。
5. 材料質量 kg = 材料體積 cm³ × 密度 g/cm³ ÷ 1000。
6. 材料成本 HKD = 材料質量 kg × 價格 HKD/kg。
7. 完成質量四捨五入至最接近的 0.01 g。材料成本四捨五入至最接近的 0.01 HKD。
8. 接納標準：完成質量 ≤ 300.00 g 且材料成本 ≤ 20.00 HKD。
9. 僅使用標稱尺寸。無公差疊加。

title.zh: 虛構低負荷材料選擇政策

body.en: This is a fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT, not an ASMPT policy or endorsement. Panel envelope is 300 mm by 200 mm. Baseline acceptance gates are density <= 1500 kg/m3, material cost <= 45 HKD/kg, and available thickness from 2.5 mm to 4.0 mm inclusive. Volume V = 0.300 m x 0.200 m x (t_mm / 1000) m. Mass = density x V. Panel material cost = mass x cost per kg. Rank eligible options by lowest panel material cost. If tied, lower density wins. Revised gate: minimum thickness 3.0 mm, maximum still 4.0 mm. Use only thicknesses listed in the data table. Report final money values to 2 decimals, keep full precision in calculations.
body.zh: 此為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非 ASMPT 政策或認可。面板外形為 300 mm x 200 mm。基線接納門檻為密度 <= 1500 kg/m3、材料成本 <= 45 HKD/kg，以及可用厚度由 2.5 mm 至 4.0 mm 包含在內。體積 V = 0.300 m x 0.200 m x (t_mm / 1000) m。質量 = 密度 x V。面板材料成本 = 質量 x 每公斤成本。合資格選項按最低面板材料成本排名。若相同，密度較低者優先。修訂門檻：最低厚度 3.0 mm，最高仍為 4.0 mm。只可使用資料表所列厚度。最終金額報告至 2 位小數，計算時保留完整精度。

exemplar.en: Decision: select M3 PETG-R3 at 2.5 mm for the baseline. Policy gates are density <= 1500 kg/m3, cost <= 45 HKD/kg, and thickness 2.5 mm to 4.0 mm inclusive. From the fictional data table, M3 has density 1270 kg/m3, cost 31 HKD/kg, and available 2.5 mm. Volume is 0.300 x 0.200 x 0.0025 = 0.00015 m3. Mass is 1270 x 0.00015 = 0.1905 kg. Material cost is 0.1905 x 31 = 5.9055 HKD, the lowest eligible baseline cost. M2 at 2.5 mm costs 6.552 HKD. Under the revised minimum 3.0 mm gate, select M2 ABS-G5 at 3.0 mm. Its cost is 7.8624 HKD, lower than M1 at 3.0 mm, 8.0712 HKD. M4 is excluded because its 55 HKD/kg cost exceeds the 45 HKD/kg gate. Risks: fictional data, no load-bearing certification. Next steps: confirm supplier density, price and 2.5 mm or 3.0 mm stock, then run a fit check. Handover to design lead.

title.en: Dimensional stability and price material selection
title.zh: 尺寸穩定性與價格材料選擇

brief.en: You are supporting a fictional ASMPT-inspired learning simulation, not an ASMPT task or endorsement. A low-load electronics enclosure cover uses a 300 mm panel. Temperature varies by 60 K. Review the fictional policy and candidate data. Apply dimensional stability and price gates, rank eligible materials, and calculate dimensional change for the selected material. Also decide the best option after tightening the dimensional limit to 0.20 mm. Produce a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese with decision, calculations, risks, uncertainty and next steps. No real design certification or fabrication is involved.
brief.zh: 你正支援一個受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非 ASMPT 任務或認可。一個低負荷電子外殼蓋使用 300 mm 面板。溫度變化為 60 K。查閱虛構政策及候選資料。應用尺寸穩定性及價格門檻，排名合資格材料，並計算所選材料的尺寸變化。亦要在尺寸限制收緊至 0.20 mm 後決定最佳選項。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接，包含決策、計算、風險、不確定性及下一步。不涉及真實設計認證或製造。

title.en: Fictional dimensional stability and price policy
title.zh: 虛構尺寸穩定性與價格政策

body.en: This is a fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT, not an ASMPT policy or endorsement. Panel length L = 300 mm. Temperature excursion DeltaT = 60 K. Allowed dimensional change DeltaL_max = 0.25 mm. Material coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) alpha in ppm/K. Formula: DeltaL_mm = L_mm * alpha_ppm * DeltaT_K * 0.000001. Baseline gates: DeltaL <= 0.25 mm and material cost <= 40.00 HKD per kg. Rank eligible materials by lowest cost per kg. If tied, lower CTE wins. Revised gate: DeltaL_max = 0.20 mm, cost gate unchanged. Use only listed materials. Report final money values to 2 decimals. No certification or load-bearing assurance is provided.
body.zh: 此為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非 ASMPT 政策或認可。面板長度 L = 300 mm。溫度變化 DeltaT = 60 K。允許尺寸變化 DeltaL_max = 0.25 mm。材料熱膨脹係數 (CTE) alpha 以 ppm/K 為單位。公式：DeltaL_mm = L_mm * alpha_ppm * DeltaT_K * 0.000001。基線門檻：DeltaL <= 0.25 mm 及材料成本 <= 40.00 HKD 每公斤。合資格材料按最低每公斤成本排名。若相同，CTE 較低者優先。修訂門檻：DeltaL_max = 0.20 mm，成本門檻不變。只可使用所列材料。最終金額報告至 2 位小數。不提供認證或承載保證。
