brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by ASMPT, not endorsed by ASMPT. You support a paper-only 3.3 V sensor interface board, SIM-3V3B, whose five modules run in exactly one of five exclusive operating modes at a time. Using the supplied rail rules, module current table and mode activation table, work out the typical current for every mode, identify the worst-case mode, test it against the acceptance limit, answer the four questions, then write a short handover in English or Traditional Chinese covering calculations, decision, evidence, risks and next checks. No hardware has been modified.
brief.zh: 本學習模擬以 ASMPT 為靈感，並非 ASMPT 認可。你負責一張只作紙上審閱的 3.3 V 傳感器介面板 SIM-3V3B，其五個模組每次只運行於五個互斥模式之一。請按提供的電源規則、模組電流表及模式啟動表，計算每個模式的典型電流，找出最差模式，對照接納上限，回答四條問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡短交接，涵蓋計算、決策、證據、風險及下一步核查。硬件未有任何改動。

title.zh: SIM-3V3B 電源預算規則（虛構）

body.en: Fictional internal rule for the SIM-3V3B 3.3 V rail only. No mains voltage and no safety approval are involved. Rule 1: the five modules M1 to M5 operate in exactly one of five exclusive modes at any time. Rule 2: the typical current budget for a mode is the arithmetic sum of the typical currents of the modules marked yes in that mode, and inactive modules draw 0 mA. Rule 3: the acceptance limit is 80 percent of the LDO-3V3 continuous rating. Rule 4: the peak current for a mode is the sum of the peak currents of the active modules, and it is compared only with the absolute LDO-3V3 rating. Rule 5: re-check when any active-mode typical current changes by more than 5 mA. LDO-3V3 continuous rating is 500 mA and absolute peak rating is 600 mA.
body.zh: 此為只適用於 SIM-3V3B 3.3 V 電源的虛構內部規則，不涉及市電電壓或安全認證。規則一：M1 至 M5 五個模組每次只運行於五個互斥模式之一。規則二：某模式的典型電流預算為該模式中標示 yes 的模組典型電流之算術總和，未啟動模組耗電 0 mA。規則三：接納上限為 LDO-3V3 連續額定值的 80%。規則四：某模式的峰值電流為該模式中啟動模組峰值電流之總和，只與 LDO-3V3 絕對額定值比較。規則五：任何啟動模式的典型電流變化超過 5 mA 時，須重新核查。LDO-3V3 連續額定值為 500 mA，絕對峰值額定值為 600 mA。

title.zh: 虛構固件提案備註

body.en: Fictional note from a simulation colleague, paper review only. The M3 radio transceiver firmware proposal would raise the M3 typical current from the table value to 175 mA in every mode where M3 is active. The proposal does not change any other module, the mode activation table, the LDO-3V3 ratings or the rail rules. Please confirm whether every exclusive mode still meets the acceptance limit after the change, and state the largest M3 typical current that would still meet it. No hardware has been modified.

exemplar.en: Fictional review of SIM-3V3B, ASMPT-inspired, not endorsed. Evidence: rail rule gives 80 percent of 500 mA = 400 mA acceptance limit. Module table: M1 55 mA, M2 85 mA, M3 140 mA, M4 20 mA, M5 25 mA. Mode table: S1 idle = 55+20 = 75 mA. S2 sense = 55+85+20 = 160 mA. S3 radio_tx = 85+140+20 = 245 mA. S4 radio_rx = 85+140 = 225 mA. S5 debug = 85+25 = 110 mA. Highest typical is S3 at 245 mA, so headroom is 155 mA. All modes meet the 400 mA typical limit. Peak check: S3 peak = 110+190+20 = 320 mA, below the 600 mA absolute rating, headroom 280 mA. M1 peak is 70 mA. Firmware proposal raising M3 typical to 175 mA gives S3 = 85+175+20 = 280 mA, still within 400 mA. Largest M3 typical to keep S3 at or below 400 mA is 295 mA. Risks: values are design assumptions, not bench data. Next steps: confirm mode scheduling with firmware, verify worst-case M3 typical with bench measurement, and re-check if any active-mode typical current changes by more than 5 mA. Owner: hardware team lead.
exemplar.zh: SIM-3V3B 虛構審閱，以 ASMPT 為靈感，並非認可。證據：電源規則由 500 mA 的 80% 得出 400 mA 接納上限。模組表：M1 55 mA、M2 85 mA、M3 140 mA、M4 20 mA、M5 25 mA。模式表：S1 idle = 55+20 = 75 mA。S2 sense = 55+85+20 = 160 mA。S3 radio_tx = 85+140+20 = 245 mA。S4 radio_rx = 85+140 = 225 mA。S5 debug = 85+25 = 110 mA。最高典型為 S3 的 245 mA，餘量為 155 mA。全部模式符合 400 mA 典型上限。峰值檢查：S3 峰值 = 110+190+20 = 320 mA，低於 600 mA 絕對額定值，餘量 280 mA。M1 峰值為 70 mA。固件提案把 M3 典型提高至 175 mA，S3 = 85+175+20 = 280 mA，仍低於 400 mA。保持 S3 不高於 400 mA 的最大 M3 典型為 295 mA。風險：數值為設計假設而非實測。下一步：與固件確認模式排程、以實驗室量測核實最差情況 M3 典型，以及任何啟動模式典型電流變化超過 5 mA 時重新核查。負責人：硬件團隊主管。

feedback.en: All numbers are correct. Mode typicals 75/160/245/225/110 mA, highest 245 mA with 155 mA headroom, the 295 mA M3 limit under the 175 mA proposal, and the peak set 320 mA, 280 mA headroom and M1 70 mA all match the supplied rule and tables.
feedback.zh: 所有數值正確。各模式典型值 75/160/245/225/110 mA、最高 245 mA 及 155 mA 餘量、175 mA 提案下 295 mA 的 M3 上限，以及峰值 320 mA、280 mA 餘量與 M1 70 mA 均符合提供的規則及表格。

feedback.en: You tie each figure to the module current table, the mode activation table and the rail rule, and you derive the 400 mA limit from 80 percent of 500 mA. Add a brief note that inactive modules draw 0 mA to make the mode sums fully explicit.
feedback.zh: 你把每個數值連繫到模組電流表、模式啟動表及電源規則，並由 500 mA 的 80% 推導出 400 mA 上限。可補一句未啟動模組耗電 0 mA，令各模式總和更完整。

feedback.en: Confirming mode scheduling with firmware, bench-verifying the worst-case M3 typical and the 5 mA re-check trigger are good concrete checks. Add an LDO-3V3 thermal derating check at the 320 mA peak to cover the remaining risk.
feedback.zh: 與固件確認模式排程、以實驗室量測核實最差情況 M3 典型，以及超過 5 mA 的重新核查觸發條件都是具體檢查。請補上在 320 mA 峰值下 LDO-3V3 的熱降額檢查，以涵蓋餘下風險。

feedback.en: You correctly flag the currents as design assumptions rather than bench data. Also state that no hardware was modified and that no real safety approval is involved, so the conclusions stay inside the paper review.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出電流屬設計假設而非實測。請同時說明硬件未有任何改動，且不涉及真實安全認證，令結論限於紙上審閱。

feedback.en: The handover gives evidence, calculations, the decision that all modes meet the limit, risks and next checks, and names the hardware team lead as owner. It reads as an actionable review note.
feedback.zh: 交接列出證據、計算、全部模式符合上限的決策、風險及下一步檢查，並指明硬件團隊主管為負責人，屬可行的審閱備註。

summary.en: Your review is accurate and well evidenced. The mode budgets, highest typical, headroom and M3 limit are all correct, and the peak statements are right. The handover is clear, with the main gaps being a thermal derating check and an explicit scope statement about untouched hardware.
summary.zh: 你的審閱準確且證據充分。各模式預算、最高典型、餘量及 M3 上限全部正確，峰值陳述亦無誤。交接清晰，主要缺漏是熱降額檢查，以及對硬件未改動的明確範圍聲明。

nextSteps.en: Add an LDO-3V3 thermal derating check at the 320 mA peak, state that no hardware was modified and no real safety approval applies, and note that inactive modules draw 0 mA in your mode sums. Send the note to Ada Cheung for bench confirmation.
nextSteps.zh: 補上 320 mA 峰值下 LDO-3V3 的熱降額檢查，說明硬件未有任何改動且不涉及真實安全認證，並在模式總和中註明未啟動模組耗電 0 mA。把備註交予 Ada Cheung 作實驗室確認。

brief.en: SHOPLINE commerce interface simulation. You cover a fictional roadmap planning cycle for a simulated merchant feature register. The feature table, the planning rules and the capacity ceiling are supplied. Read them, then decide which features enter this cycle and in what order they are built. Deliverable: answer the four questions and write a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering your chosen set, the arithmetic behind it, rejected alternatives, risks and next steps. This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE and is not endorsed by the company. Internal records are fictional.
brief.zh: SHOPLINE 商貿介面模擬。你負責一個虛構的路線圖規劃週期，對象是一份模擬商戶功能清單。功能表、規劃規則及成本上限均已提供。請閱讀後決定哪些功能進入本週期及其開發次序。交付內容：回答四條問題，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡短證據為本交接，涵蓋你所選組合、背後計算、被否決的替代方案、風險及下一步。本練習是受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。內部記錄均屬虛構。

title.zh: 模擬路線圖規劃規則

body.en:
Fictional simulation rules for the SHOPLINE commerce roadmap exercise. Internal learning assumptions only, not real SHOPLINE policy.

Roadmap capacity this cycle is 15 cost_points. This is a hard ceiling. No contingency, buffer or approval may be added.

A feature may be selected only when every prerequisite listed in its prerequisite_ids is selected too, applied transitively. The closure cost of a feature is its own cost_points plus the cost_points of all prerequisites it requires.

Selection objective is the feasible set with the highest total value_score_points. If two feasible sets tie on total value, prefer the lower total cost_points. If still tied, prefer the set containing the smallest feature_id.

Sequencing rule. Place a feature only after all of its prerequisites. Among features whose prerequisites are already placed, the higher value_score_points goes first. If those tie, the smaller feature_id goes first.
body.zh:
SHOPLINE 商貿路線圖練習的虛構模擬規則。僅屬內部學習假設，並非 SHOPLINE 真實政策。

本週期路線圖容量為 15 cost_points。此為硬性上限。不得加入任何應急儲備、緩衝或額外批准。

只有當某功能的 prerequisite_ids 所列的每一項前置功能均被選中（並按遞移關係計算）時，該功能才可被選中。某功能的前置封閉成本，等於其自身 cost_points 加上其所需全部前置功能的 cost_points。

選取目標是 value_score_points 總值最高的可行組合。若兩個可行組合總值相同，取 total cost_points 較低者。若仍然相同，取包含最小 feature_id 的組合。

排序規則。功能必須排在其所有前置功能之後。在前置功能已排定的功能之中，value_score_points 較高者先排。若相同，feature_id 較小者先排。

label.en: Which complete feature set maximises total value_score_points within the 15 cost-point ceiling while satisfying prerequisite closure?
label.zh: 在 15 成本分上限下並滿足前置封閉性，哪一個完整功能組合的 value_score_points 總值最高？

label.en: What is the total value_score_points of the maximum-value feasible feature set?
label.zh: 最高價值可行功能組合的 value_score_points 總值是多少？

label.en: Which sequence correctly orders the features of the maximum-value feasible set?
label.zh: 哪一個次序正確排列最高價值可行組合的功能？

label.en: What is the total cost_points of the full prerequisite closure of F-LOY, meaning F-LOY plus every prerequisite it requires transitively?
label.zh: F-LOY 的完整前置封閉成本是多少 cost_points，即 F-LOY 加上其按遞移關係所需的全部前置功能？

about.en: SHOPLINE supplies unified commerce software including e-commerce, social commerce, point-of-sale and customer relationship management.

expectedEvidence.en: Selects F-BASE, F-POS and F-SOC for the maximum-value set, total cost 4+6+5=15 within the 15-point hard ceiling, total value 10+16+12=38. Correct sequence is F-BASE then F-POS then F-SOC. Correct F-LOY closure cost is 4+5+7+4=20 points. Rejects F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY (value 37) and F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL (value 36) as lower, and rejects F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM as costing 17 and breaching the ceiling.
expectedEvidence.zh: 選出 F-BASE、F-POS、F-SOC 為最高價值組合，總成本 4+6+5=15，未超過 15 分硬上限，總值 10+16+12=38。正確次序為 F-BASE 之後 F-POS 之後 F-SOC。F-LOY 前置封閉成本為 4+5+7+4=20 分。否決 F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY（總值 37）及 F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL（總值 36），並否決成本 17 分、超出上限的 F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links each answer to specific register rows and the planning rules, quoting the supplied costs and value scores, showing the 15-point capacity check and the 38-point value sum, explaining that F-POS and F-SOC both require F-BASE, and noting the tie-break rules are not needed because no tie occurs.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把每個答案連結至清單具體列及規劃規則，引用所提供的成本與價值分，展示 15 分容量檢查與 38 分總值計算，說明 F-POS 與 F-SOC 均以 F-BASE 為前置，並指出因沒有同分情況故不需動用決勝規則。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.

expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如從清單重新核算總成本與總值、重新推導次優組合以確認 38 為最大值、逐項核實所選功能的前置封閉性、按排序規則覆核次序，並在評審前將任何容量或前置條件改動上呈路線圖規劃主管。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise English or Traditional Chinese handover stating the chosen set and sequence, the arithmetic (15 points, 38 value points, F-LOY closure 20 points), the rejected alternatives, the key risk that synthetic scores may shift, and clear next steps with the roadmap planning owner as the follow-up contact.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔交接，列明所選組合與次序、計算（15 分成本、38 價值分、F-LOY 封閉 20 分）、被否決的替代方案、合成分數可能變動的主要風險，以及以路線圖規劃主管為跟進聯絡人的清晰下一步。

exemplar.en:
Decision. The feasible set that maximises value within the 15 cost-point ceiling is F-BASE, F-POS and F-SOC. Cost is 4+6+5=15 and value is 10+16+12=38. Build sequence is F-BASE, then F-POS, then F-SOC, because F-POS and F-SOC both require F-BASE and F-POS scores higher.

Evidence. The register gives F-POS 16 and F-SOC 12. Lower-value feasible alternatives are F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY at 37 and F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL at 36. F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM costs 17 and breaches the ceiling. F-LOY closure costs 4+5+7+4=20, so it cannot fit this cycle.

Risks. Value scores are synthetic research placeholders and any capacity or prerequisite change would reorder the plan.

Next steps. Recount costs and closure, recheck the ordering rule, and route any capacity change to the roadmap planning owner.
exemplar.zh:
決策。在 15 成本分上限下價值最高的可行組合為 F-BASE、F-POS 及 F-SOC。成本為 4+6+5=15，價值為 10+16+12=38。開發次序為 F-BASE，然後 F-POS，再排 F-SOC，因為 F-POS 與 F-SOC 均以 F-BASE 為前置，而 F-POS 分數較高。

證據。清單顯示 F-POS 為 16 分、F-SOC 為 12 分。較低價值的可行替代為 F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY（37 分）及 F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL（36 分）。F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM 成本 17 分，超出上限。F-LOY 前置封閉成本為 4+5+7+4=20 分，本週期無法容納。

風險。價值分屬合成研究暫用值，任何容量或前置條件改動都會改變排序。

下一步。重新核算成本與封閉性，覆核排序規則，並將任何容量改動交由路線圖規劃主管處理。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. F-BASE, F-POS and F-SOC cost 4+6+5=15 within the hard ceiling, total 38 value points, the sequence F-BASE then F-POS then F-SOC respects prerequisites and value ordering, and the F-LOY closure is 20 points. You also correctly reject F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY at 37, F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL at 36 and the 17-point F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM set.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。F-BASE、F-POS 及 F-SOC 成本為 4+6+5=15，未超硬上限，總值 38 分，次序 F-BASE、F-POS、F-SOC 同時符合前置與價值排序，F-LOY 封閉成本亦為 20 分。你亦正確否決總值 37 的 F-BASE+F-POS+F-PAY、總值 36 的 F-BASE+F-SOC+F-ANL 及成本 17 分超限的 F-BASE+F-POS+F-CRM。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to the register rows and planning rules, quoting the F-POS 16 and F-SOC 12 value scores, showing the 15-point capacity check and the 38-point sum, and explaining that both selected features depend on F-BASE. The runner-up values 37 and 36 and the 17-point breach are cited as explicit comparisons, which is exactly the required evidence.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結到清單列與規劃規則，引用 F-POS 16 分及 F-SOC 12 分，展示 15 分容量檢查與 38 分總和，並說明兩個入選功能均依賴 F-BASE。文中亦以 37 分、36 分次優組合及 17 分超限作為明確比較，證據充分。

feedback.en: Next steps cover recounting costs and closure, rechecking the ordering rule and routing capacity changes to the roadmap planning owner, which is concrete and usable. To strengthen it, add an explicit re-derivation of the runner-up sets to confirm 38 is the true maximum and a per-feature prerequisite closure check before the review.
feedback.zh: 下一步涵蓋重新核算成本與封閉性、覆核排序規則，並把容量改動轉交路線圖規劃主管，具體可行。若要更強，可加入明確重新推導次優組合以確認 38 為真正最大值，以及評審前逐項核實前置封閉性。

feedback.en: You correctly flag that the value scores are synthetic research placeholders and that a capacity or prerequisite change would reorder the plan. You could also state explicitly that no real SHOPLINE policy or merchant outcome is claimed and that delivery duration is outside scope.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出價值分屬合成研究暫用值，並說明容量或前置條件改動會改變排序。亦可再明確指出不主張任何 SHOPLINE 真實政策或商戶結果，且交付時長不在範圍內。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and complete at 133 English words, stating the chosen set and sequence, the arithmetic including the F-LOY 20-point closure, the rejected alternatives, the synthetic-score risk and next steps with the planning owner named. It is ready to action.

title.zh: 模擬路線圖規劃規則

body.en:
Fictional simulation rules for the SHOPLINE commerce roadmap exercise. Internal learning assumptions only.

Capacity is 20 cost_points, a hard ceiling. No contingency may be added.

A bundle is selectable only if every prerequisite in its prerequisite_ids is also selected, transitively. Closure cost equals the bundle's cost plus all its prerequisites' costs.

Choose the feasible set with the highest total value_score_points. If tied, prefer lower total cost. If still tied, prefer the set with the smallest bundle_id.

Sequencing. Place a bundle after all its prerequisites. Among available bundles, higher value_score_points first. If tied, smaller bundle_id first.
body.zh:
SHOPLINE 商貿路線圖練習的虛構模擬規則。僅屬內部學習假設。

容量為 20 cost_points，此為硬性上限。不得加入任何應急儲備。

只有當某組合的 prerequisite_ids 所列的每一項前置組合均被選中（並按遞移關係計算）時，該組合才可被選中。前置封閉成本等於該組合自身成本加上其所需全部前置組合的成本。

選取 value_score_points 總值最高的可行組合。若總值相同，取 total cost 較低者。若仍然相同，取包含最小 bundle_id 的組合。

排序。組合必須排在其所有前置組合之後。在可用組合中，value_score_points 較高者先排。若相同，bundle_id 較小者先排。

exemplar.en: Chosen set: M-CORE, M-CRM, M-SOC. Total value 45 points, total cost 19 points within the 20-point ceiling. title.en: CSV Export v1 Retirement Gate Policy (Fictional)
title.zh: CSV 匯出 v1 退場門檻政策（虛構）

body.en: This fictional policy governs the proposed retirement of CSV Export v1 on 2027-03-31. All conditions below must be met for retirement to proceed. Cohort readiness: each cohort must have migrated_to_v2 / merchants_total >= 0.80. Critical blockers: each cohort must have zero open critical blockers. Overall readiness: total migrated_to_v2 / total merchants_total >= 0.90. Communication: each cohort must have days_notice_before_retirement >= 45. Noncritical blockers are recorded but do not block the gate. The Head of Merchant Platform must approve before retirement. If any condition fails, retirement is deferred.
body.zh: 本虛構政策規管擬於 2027-03-31 退場的 CSV 匯出 v1。所有條件必須全部達成方可退場。群組準備度：每個群組的 migrated_to_v2 / merchants_total 必須 >= 0.80。嚴重阻礙：每個群組的未解決嚴重阻礙必須為零。整體準備度：總 migrated_to_v2 / 總 merchants_total 必須 >= 0.90。溝通：每個群組的 days_notice_before_retirement 必須 >= 45。非嚴重阻礙僅作記錄，不阻擋門檻。商戶平台主管必須在退場前批准。任何條件未達成，退場即延後。

exemplar.en: Decision: Defer the retirement of CSV Export v1 beyond 2027-03-31. Evidence: Overall migration readiness is 82.5% (3465/4200), below the 90% gate. Cohort C-03 fails readiness at 75% (600/800) and has only 40 days notice, below the 45-day requirement. C-02 and C-05 each have open critical blockers (1 and 2 respectively). Only C-01 and C-04 meet all cohort-level conditions. Risks: Merchant confusion if retirement proceeds without meeting gates. Next steps: Prioritise clearing critical blockers, send new communication to C-03 at least 45 days before any new date, and re-run the gate with the Head of Merchant Platform for approval.
exemplar.zh: 決定：將 CSV 匯出 v1 的退場延後至 2027-03-31 之後。證據：整體遷移準備度為 82.5%（3465/4200），低於 90% 門檻。群組 C-03 準備度為 75%（600/800）未達標，且僅有 40 天通知，低於 45 天要求。C-02 及 C-05 分別有 1 個及 2 個未解決嚴重阻礙。只有 C-01 及 C-04 符合所有群組層級條件。風險：若在未達門檻下退場，可能造成商戶混亂。下一步：優先清除嚴重阻礙，向 C-03 重新發送通知並確保至少 45 天前送達，再與商戶平台主管重新審核門檻並取得批准。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: 82.5% overall (3465/4200), C-03 as the only cohort below 80% (75%), 2 cohorts meeting all cohort-level conditions (C-01, C-04), and option-b. Rules are applied accurately throughout.
feedback.zh: 四項決定全部正確：整體 82.5%（3465/4200）、C-03 為唯一低於 80% 的群組（75%）、2 個群組符合所有群組層級條件（C-01、C-04），並選項乙。規則應用準確。

feedback.en: Strong linkage between conclusions and the data. You cite C-03 (600/800, 40 days), C-02 and C-05 blocker counts, and the 3465/4200 totals, and tie each to the relevant gate condition.
feedback.zh: 結論與數據連結緊密。您引用 C-03（600/800，40 天）、C-02 及 C-05 的阻礙數目，以及 3465/4200 總數，並各自連繫到相應門檻條件。

feedback.en: Next steps cover clearing critical blockers, re-sending C-03 notice at least 45 days ahead, re-running the gate and obtaining Head of Merchant Platform approval. Add an explicit re-check that each cohort has zero critical blockers and that readiness is recalculated before any new date.
feedback.zh: 下一步涵蓋清除嚴重阻礙、至少 45 天前重新通知 C-03、重新執行門檻及取得商戶平台主管批准。建議補充明確覆核每個群組的嚴重阻礙為零，並在任何新日期前重新計算準備度。

feedback.en: Conclusions stay within the supplied data and rules, which is good. However, the handover does not state that the scenario and policy are fictional or that the conclusion is limited to these assumptions, so scope is only implied.
feedback.zh: 結論限於提供的數據及規則，表現良好。但交接未說明情境及政策屬虛構，亦未表明結論僅限於這些假設，因此範圍只是隱含。

feedback.en: Clear, actionable handover of about 101 words covering the deferral decision, key evidence, risk of merchant confusion and next steps with the Head of Merchant Platform as approver. Ownership and escalation are explicit.
feedback.zh: 約 101 字的交接清晰可行，涵蓋延後決定、關鍵證據、商戶混亂風險及以商戶平台主管為批准者的下一步。責任及轉交明確。

summary.en: A near-complete response: all four decisions are correct and the handover is clear and well-evidenced within the suggested length. The main gap is an explicit statement that the scenario is fictional and that conclusions are bounded to the supplied policy and data.

nextSteps.en: Add one sentence noting the scenario and policy are fictional learning assumptions so claims are explicitly bounded, and specify a verification check that recalculates readiness and confirms zero critical blockers per cohort before setting any new retirement date.

title.en: Plan the LSG-v1 Notification Channel Sunset
title.zh: 規劃 LSG-v1 通知渠道退場

brief.en: You are a product manager in a fictional SHOPLINE learning simulation, independent of and not endorsed by SHOPLINE. Legacy SMS Gateway notifications (LSG-v1) are proposed for retirement on 2027-06-30 in favour of Notify v2. Review the fictional retirement gate policy, the cohort migration table and the replacement readiness log. Answer the four questions, then write a concise handover of roughly 100 to 180 words in English or Traditional Chinese covering decision, evidence, risks and next steps. All internal policies and records are fictional learning assumptions.
brief.zh: 您是在虛構 SHOPLINE 學習模擬中的產品經理，該模擬獨立運作且未獲 SHOPLINE 認可。舊有短訊閘道通知（LSG-v1）擬於 2027-06-30 退場，由 Notify v2 取代。請審閱虛構退場門檻政策、群組遷移表及替代準備日誌。回答四條問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，涵蓋決定、證據、風險及下一步。所有內部政策及記錄均為虛構學習假設。

title.zh: LSG-v1 退場門檻政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional policy governing the proposed retirement of the Legacy SMS Gateway notification channel (LSG-v1) on 2027-06-30. Every condition below must pass for retirement to proceed. Cohort readiness: migrated_to_notify_v2 / merchants_total >= 0.85 for every cohort. Critical blockers: open_critical_blockers = 0 for every cohort. Overall readiness: total migrated_to_notify_v2 / total merchants_total >= 0.92. Communication: days_notice_before_retirement >= 60 for every cohort. Replacement readiness: every check in the replacement readiness log must have status pass. Approval owner: the Head of Merchant Platform must approve before retirement. open_noncritical_blockers are recorded but never block the gate. If any condition fails, retirement is deferred. All figures and teams are fictional learning assumptions.
body.zh: 本虛構政策規管擬於 2027-06-30 退場的舊有短訊閘道通知渠道（LSG-v1）。以下每項條件必須全部通過方可退場。群組準備度：每個群組的 migrated_to_notify_v2 / merchants_total 必須 >= 0.85。嚴重阻礙：每個群組的 open_critical_blockers 必須 = 0。整體準備度：總 migrated_to_notify_v2 / 總 merchants_total 必須 >= 0.92。溝通：每個群組的 days_notice_before_retirement 必須 >= 60。替代準備：替代準備日誌中每項檢查的 status 必須為 pass。批准責任人：商戶平台主管必須在退場前批准。open_noncritical_blockers 僅作記錄，不阻擋門檻。任何條件未通過，退場即延後。所有數字及團隊均為虛構學習假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Overall readiness is 4380 / 5000 = 0.876, i.e. 87.6%, below the 92% requirement. The cohorts failing the 85% readiness threshold are N-02 (800 / 1000 = 80.0%) and N-04 (500 / 600 = 83.3%). Exactly 1 cohort (N-01: 94.0%, zero critical blockers, 75 days notice) meets all three cohort-level conditions. The correct gate decision is option-b: cohort readiness, critical blockers (N-03 has 1, N-05 has 3), overall readiness, communication notice (N-04 has 55 days) and replacement readiness (R-03 fail, R-04 pending) all fail, so retirement is deferred.
expectedEvidence.zh: 整體準備度為 4380 / 5000 = 0.876，即 87.6%，低於 92% 要求。未達 85% 群組準備度門檻者為 N-02（800 / 1000 = 80.0%）及 N-04（500 / 600 = 83.3%）。僅 1 個群組（N-01：94.0%、零嚴重阻礙、75 天通知期）同時符合三項群組層級條件。正確門檻決定為 option-b：群組準備度、嚴重阻礙（N-03 有 1 個、N-05 有 3 個）、整體準備度、溝通通知期（N-04 只有 55 天）及替代準備（R-03 為 fail、R-04 為 pending）全部未通過，故退場延後。

expectedEvidence.en: Links each conclusion to a specific supplied record: the per-cohort rows in notification-channel-migration for readiness, critical blockers and days_notice_before_retirement, and rows R-03 and R-04 in replacement-readiness-log for replacement readiness. Shows the arithmetic per cohort (for example 470 / 500 = 94.0%) and the totals 4380 and 5000. States that open_noncritical_blockers are recorded only and never block the gate. Names the Head of Merchant Platform as the approval owner recorded in R-04.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把每項結論連結至具體提供記錄：notification-channel-migration 的各群組列用於準備度、嚴重阻礙及 days_notice_before_retirement，而 replacement-readiness-log 的 R-03 及 R-04 列用於替代準備。展示每個群組的運算（例如 470 / 500 = 94.0%）及總數 4380 與 5000。指出 open_noncritical_blockers 僅作記錄，從不阻擋門檻。並指出 R-04 所記錄的批准責任人為商戶平台主管。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions: Merchant Platform to clear and re-count the open critical blockers in N-03 and N-05 with owner and date; Merchant Growth to close the opt-in gaps in N-02 and N-04; Platform Security to resolve R-03 audit log retention parity and re-run parity verification; request and record Head of Merchant Platform approval only after R-03 passes; confirm with Platform Reliability that the R-01 delivery parity pass still holds; extend N-04 notice so days_notice_before_retirement reaches 60; then re-run the full gate with freshly dated figures before any new retirement date is set.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步：商戶平台須清理並重新點算 N-03 及 N-05 的未解決嚴重阻礙，並記錄負責人及日期；Merchant Growth 須填補 N-02 及 N-04 的 opt-in 差距；平台安全須解決 R-03 審計日誌保留對等並重跑對等驗證；只有在 R-03 通過後才申請並記錄商戶平台主管批准；向 Platform Reliability 確認 R-01 交付對等仍然通過；延長 N-04 通知期至 days_notice_before_retirement 達 60；其後以最新數據重跑整個門檻，才設定新的退場日期。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.

expectedEvidence.en: Labels the work as a fictional SHOPLINE learning simulation that is not endorsed by SHOPLINE and not actual policy. Limits claims to the supplied two data documents and policy, does not invent missing owner names, cost figures or merchant identities, and notes that days_notice_before_retirement is supplied directly so no calendar arithmetic is required. Acknowledges that noncritical blockers do not block the gate and that no product shutdown has occurred.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把工作標明為未獲 SHOPLINE 認可的虛構 SHOPLINE 學習模擬，並非實際政策。聲明只限於提供的兩份數據文件及政策，不杜撰缺失的負責人姓名、成本數字或商戶身份，並指出 days_notice_before_retirement 為直接提供，故無須日曆運算。承認非嚴重阻礙不阻擋門檻，且並無任何產品實際停運。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes an actionable handover with a clear deferral decision, the evidence behind it, the calculation method, and ownership or escalation: Merchant Platform for critical blockers and the pending R-04 approval, Merchant Growth for readiness gaps, Platform Security for R-03. Keeps the recommendation bounded to the fictional scenario and states what must be re-measured before resubmitting the gate.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明延後的明確決定、支持證據、計算方法，以及責任或轉交：商戶平台負責嚴重阻礙及待處理的 R-04 批准、Merchant Growth 負責準備度差距、平台安全負責 R-03。建議僅限於該虛構情境，並說明重新提交門檻前必須重新量度的項目。

exemplar.en: Decision: defer the LSG-v1 retirement beyond 2027-06-30. No gate condition family passes. Overall readiness is 4380 / 5000 = 87.6%, below the 92% requirement. Cohort readiness fails for N-02 (800 / 1000 = 80.0%) and N-04 (500 / 600 = 83.3%), both under 85%, while N-01 is 94.0%, N-03 is 90.0% and N-05 is 90.0%. Critical blockers fail because N-03 holds 1 and N-05 holds 3 against a required zero, so only N-01 meets all three cohort-level conditions. Communication fails because N-04 has 55 days notice, below 60. Replacement readiness fails because R-03 audit log retention parity is fail and R-04 Head of Merchant Platform approval is still pending. Noncritical blockers are recorded only. Next steps: Merchant Platform to clear N-03 and N-05 blockers and obtain the R-04 approval after R-03 passes, Merchant Growth to close the N-02 and N-04 opt-in gaps, Platform Security to re-run R-03 parity, then re-measure the gate with fresh figures. This is a fictional simulation, not SHOPLINE policy.
exemplar.zh: 決定：把 LSG-v1 退場延後至 2027-06-30 之後。沒有任何門檻條件類別通過。整體準備度為 4380 / 5000 = 87.6%，低於 92% 要求。群組準備度方面，N-02（800 / 1000 = 80.0%）及 N-04（500 / 600 = 83.3%）均低於 85% 而未通過，而 N-01 為 94.0%、N-03 為 90.0%、N-05 為 90.0%。嚴重阻礙未通過，因 N-03 有 1 個、N-05 有 3 個，而要求為零，故僅 N-01 同時符合三項群組層級條件。溝通未通過，因 N-04 只有 55 天通知期，低於 60。替代準備未通過，因 R-03 審計日誌保留對等為 fail，而 R-04 商戶平台主管批准仍為 pending。非嚴重阻礙僅作記錄。下一步：商戶平台清理 N-03 及 N-05 的阻礙，並在 R-03 通過後取得 R-04 批准；Merchant Growth 填補 N-02 及 N-04 的 opt-in 差距；平台安全重跑 R-03 對等驗證；其後以最新數據重新量度門檻。本個案為虛構模擬，並非 SHOPLINE 政策。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: overall readiness 4380 / 5000 = 87.6%, failing cohorts N-02 (80.0%) and N-04 (83.3%), exactly one cohort meeting all three conditions, and option-b as the complete failing condition families. The deferral call follows directly from the policy.
feedback.zh: 四項決定全部正確：整體準備度 4380 / 5000 = 87.6%、未達標群組為 N-02（80.0%）及 N-04（83.3%）、僅一個群組符合全部三項條件，以及以 option-b 指出所有未通過的條件類別。延後決定與政策一致。

feedback.en: You anchor each conclusion to specific records, showing per-cohort arithmetic and citing R-03 fail and R-04 pending with the Head of Merchant Platform approval owner noted. You correctly state that noncritical blockers are recorded only and do not block the gate. Adding the N-03 and N-05 readiness ratios would round out the per-cohort evidence.
feedback.zh: 你把每項結論連結至具體記錄，展示各群組運算，並引用 R-03 為 fail、R-04 為 pending，同時指出商戶平台主管為批准責任人。你正確指出非嚴重阻礙僅作記錄，不阻擋門檻。若補上 N-03 及 N-05 的準備度比率，群組證據會更完整。

feedback.en: Your next steps assign real owners for the N-03 and N-05 blockers, the N-02 and N-04 opt-in gaps and the R-03 parity rerun, and you sequence R-04 approval after R-03 passes. Add two checks: confirm the N-04 notice period reaches 60 days, and confirm the R-01 delivery parity pass still holds before re-measuring the whole gate.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步為 N-03 及 N-05 阻礙、N-02 及 N-04 opt-in 差距及 R-03 對等重跑指派了明確負責團隊，並安排 R-03 通過後才處理 R-04 批准。可補兩項檢查：確認 N-04 通知期達 60 天，以及確認 R-01 交付對等仍然通過，然後重新量度整個門檻。

feedback.en: You clearly label the work as a fictional simulation rather than SHOPLINE policy, and you avoid inventing owner names, costs or merchant identities beyond the supplied records. The limitation to the two data documents and the policy is well handled.
feedback.zh: 你清楚標明此為虛構模擬而非 SHOPLINE 政策，並無在提供記錄之外杜撰負責人姓名、成本或商戶身份。把範圍限於兩份數據文件及政策，處理妥當。

feedback.en: The handover states a clear deferral decision, the supporting numbers, the failing families and the ownership split across Merchant Platform, Merchant Growth and Platform Security. It is concise and actionable for the Product Lead. No further change is needed.
feedback.zh: 交接清楚列明延後決定、支持數字、未通過類別，以及商戶平台、Merchant Growth 與平台安全之間的責任分工。內容簡潔且對產品主管可行。無須再修改。

summary.en: Correct and complete on every graded decision, with strong evidence linkage and a clear fictional-scope caveat. The handover is actionable and the proposed verification work is sensible. The only gap is that the N-04 notice period and the R-01 parity check are not explicitly named as items to re-confirm before rerunning the gate.
summary.zh: 所有評分決定均正確完整，證據連結紮實，並清楚標明虛構範圍。交接可行，核實工作合理。唯一不足是未明確把 N-04 通知期及 R-01 對等檢查列為重跑門檻前須再確認的項目。

nextSteps.en: Add two verification items: confirm N-04 reaches 60 days notice and confirm R-01 delivery parity still passes, then rerun the full gate with freshly dated figures before proposing any new retirement date.
nextSteps.zh: 補上兩項核實項目：確認 N-04 通知期達 60 天，並確認 R-01 交付對等仍然通過，其後以最新數據重跑整個門檻，才提出新的退場日期。

title.zh: 比較 Checkout Insights 採用群組

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE. You are a product manager reviewing a simulated Checkout Insights pilot. Use the public policy and raw merchant table. Compare the new and established merchant cohorts. Answer four checks and write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. State the rates, eligible counts, recommendation, uncertainty, and one verification step. Do not claim causation from this observational table.
brief.zh: 此為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的虛構學習模擬。你是產品經理，正檢視模擬的 Checkout Insights 試行。使用公開政策及原始商戶表。比較新商戶與既有商戶群組。回答四項檢查，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接。列明採用率、合資格人數、建議、不確定性及一項核實步驟。不得從此觀察性資料表推斷因果。

title.en: Fictional Adoption Measurement and Bounded Follow-up Policy
title.zh: 虛構採用衡量及有限度跟進政策

body.en: Observation date is 2026-10-15. The new merchant cohort means merchants whose first paid subscription started on or after 2026-07-17. The established merchant cohort means merchants whose first paid subscription started before 2026-07-17. An eligible merchant has active_paid yes and orders_30d at least 1. Feature usage means ci_views_14d at least 1, counted once per merchant. Adoption rate equals using eligible merchants divided by eligible merchants in the cohort times 100, rounded to one decimal. The minimum cohort is 12 eligible merchants. Recommend the 2-week onboarding checklist only when new eligible count is at least 12 and new adoption rate is at least 10.0 percentage points lower than the established rate. Otherwise recommend instrument logging only. This observational follow-up does not establish causation.
body.zh: 觀察日期為 2026-10-15。新商戶群組指首個付費訂閱於 2026-07-17 或之後開始的商戶。既有商戶群組指首個付費訂閱於 2026-07-17 之前開始的商戶。合資格商戶須 active_paid 為 yes，且 orders_30d 至少 1。功能使用指 ci_views_14d 至少 1，每商戶只計一次。採用率等於群組內有使用功能的合資格商戶數除以該群組合資格商戶數，再乘以 100，四捨五入至一位小數。最低群組為 12 位合資格商戶。只有當新群組合資格人數至少 12，且新群組採用率較既有群組低至少 10.0 個百分點，才建議兩星期導入清單。否則只建議儀器記錄。此觀察性跟進不建立因果關係。

expectedEvidence.en: States the table is observational and cannot prove causation. Avoids saying the checklist caused or will cause higher adoption. Limits claims to the fictional 2026-10-15 sample and the public policy thresholds.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此表為觀察性資料，不能證明因果關係。避免表示導入清單導致或將導致更高採用率。把聲明限於虛構 2026-10-15 樣本及公開政策門檻。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover includes rates, eligible counts, gap, recommendation, uncertainty and one next verification step. It can be acted on by product analytics and the merchant onboarding owner without extra interpretation.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接包括採用率、合資格人數、差距、建議、不確定性及一項下一步核實。產品分析及商戶導入負責人無需額外解讀即可行動。

exemplar.en: For the fictional 2026-10-15 sample, the new merchant cohort has 12 eligible merchants and 4 using merchants, so the adoption rate is 4 divided by 12 times 100, which is 33.3 percent. The established cohort has 18 eligible merchants and 12 using merchants, so its rate is 12 divided by 18 times 100, which is 66.7 percent. The gap is 33.4 percentage points. The policy minimum cohort is 12, and the new cohort meets it. The gap is above 10.0 points, so the bounded follow-up is the 2-week onboarding checklist for new merchants. This table is observational. It does not prove that low adoption is caused by any missing checklist. Next step: product analytics should re-run the same filters and check unique merchant usage before and during the checklist. Escalate to the merchant onboarding owner if the gap remains after two weeks.
exemplar.zh: 就虛構的 2026-10-15 樣本，新商戶群組有 12 位合資格商戶及 4 位使用商戶，因此採用率為 4 除以 12 再乘以 100，即 33.3%。既有群組有 18 位合資格商戶及 12 位使用商戶，因此比率為 12 除以 18 再乘以 100，即 66.7%。差距為 33.4 個百分點。政策最低群組為 12，而新群組符合。差距高於 10.0 個百分點，因此有限度跟進是為新商戶推行兩星期導入清單。此表為觀察性資料，不能證明低採用率由任何缺失清單造成。下一步：產品分析應以同一篩選重跑，並在清單推行前及推行期間檢查唯一商戶使用情況。若兩星期後差距仍然存在，則轉交商戶導入負責人。

feedback.en: All four checks are correct. New cohort 4 of 12 gives 33.3 percent, established 12 of 18 gives 66.7 percent, the gap is 33.4 points, and the minimum cohort of 12 plus a gap above 10.0 points correctly supports the 2-week onboarding checklist.
feedback.zh: 四項檢查全部正確。新群組 12 分之 4 為 33.3%，既有群組 18 分之 12 為 66.7%，差距 33.4 個百分點，最低群組 12 且差距高於 10.0 個百分點，正確支持兩星期導入清單。

feedback.en: You tie the rates to eligible and using counts, but no specific merchant rows are cited. Naming rows such as n01, n06, n09, n12 for new usage and e10 or e14 as established ineligible would make the working traceable to the raw table.
feedback.zh: 你把比率連繫到合資格及使用人數，但未引用具體商戶列。列明 n01、n06、n09、n12 為新群組使用，以及 e10 或 e14 為既有群組不合資格，可使工作可追溯至原始資料表。

title.en: Compare Catalog Sync adoption by catalog size cohorts
title.zh: 按商品目錄規模比較目錄同步採用群組

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE. This exercise is independent and not endorsed by SHOPLINE. You are a product manager reviewing a simulated Catalog Sync Insights rollout. Using the public policy, the raw merchant table and the fictional data steward note, compare the small catalog and large catalog cohorts. Answer four checks and write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words. State both adoption rates, eligible counts, the gap, your recommended bounded follow-up, uncertainty and one verification step. This observational table cannot establish causation.
brief.zh: 此為受 SHOPLINE 啟發的虛構學習模擬。本練習獨立進行，不獲 SHOPLINE 認可。你是產品經理，正檢視模擬的目錄同步洞察試行。使用公開政策、原始商戶表及虛構資料管理員備註，比較小型與大型商品目錄群組。回答四項檢查，並以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接。列明兩個群組的採用率、合資格人數、差距、你建議的有限度跟進、不確定性及一項核實步驟。此觀察性資料表不能建立因果關係。

title.en: Fictional Catalog Cohort Measurement and Bounded Follow-up Policy
title.zh: 虛構商品目錄群組衡量及有限度跟進政策

body.en: Observation date is 2026-11-05. Small catalog cohort means product_count 1 to 40 inclusive. Large catalog cohort means product_count 41 or more. An eligible merchant has active_paid yes and orders_30d at least 1. Feature usage means cs_views_14d at least 1, counted once per merchant. Adoption rate equals using eligible merchants divided by cohort eligible merchants times 100, rounded to one decimal. Minimum cohort condition is 10 eligible merchants. Recommend the 3-week catalog migration guide only when the large cohort has at least 10 eligible merchants and its adoption rate is at least 12.0 percentage points below the small cohort rate, where the gap is the small rate minus the large rate from the rounded rates. Otherwise recommend instrument logging only. This observational follow-up does not establish causation.
body.zh: 觀察日期為 2026-11-05。小型商品目錄群組指 product_count 介乎 1 至 40（含兩端）。大型商品目錄群組指 product_count 為 41 或以上。合資格商戶須 active_paid 為 yes，且 orders_30d 至少 1。功能使用指 cs_views_14d 至少 1，每商戶只計一次。採用率等於群組內有使用功能的合資格商戶數除以該群組合資格商戶數，再乘以 100，四捨五入至一位小數。最低群組條件為 10 位合資格商戶。只有當大型群組合資格商戶至少 10 位，且其採用率較小型群組低至少 12.0 個百分點（差距為小型比率減大型比率，以四捨五入後比率計算），才建議三星期商品目錄遷移指南。否則只建議儀器記錄。此觀察性跟進不建立因果關係。

title.en: Fictional Data Steward Note on Units and Limits
title.zh: 虛構資料管理員關於單位及限制的備註

body.en: From the fictional data steward. Units for this extract are counts, not currency. product_count counts active published products at 2026-11-05. orders_30d counts completed orders only. cs_views_14d counts successful dashboard views, at most one per merchant per day, so a merchant with any view is a using merchant. Cohort membership follows product_count only, not subscription start date. No randomized experiment was run for the rollout, so no causal conclusion can be drawn from these records. Any follow-up request should be logged and reviewed by the fictional product lead before larger rollout work.
body.zh: 來自虛構資料管理員。此摘錄的單位為計數，並非貨幣。product_count 計算 2026-11-05 當日的已發佈上架商品數。orders_30d 只計算已完成訂單。cs_views_14d 計算成功開啟儀表板的次數，每商戶每日最多一次，因此有任何瀏覽的商戶即屬使用商戶。群組劃分只依 product_count，不依訂閱開始日期。此推廣並無進行隨機實驗，因此不能從這些記錄得出因果結論。任何跟進要求應先記錄，並由虛構產品主管審核，才進行更大規模推廣工作。

label.en: What is the large catalog cohort adoption rate in percent, rounded to one decimal?
label.zh: 大型商品目錄群組採用率為百分之多少，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: What is the adoption rate gap in percentage points, small cohort rate minus large cohort rate, rounded to one decimal?
label.zh: 採用率差距為多少個百分點，以小型群組比率減大型群組比率計算，四捨五入至一位小數？

label.en: Which bounded follow-up does the policy support?
label.zh: 政策支持哪項有限度跟進？

label.en: Recommend the 3-week catalog migration guide because the large cohort has at least 10 eligible merchants and its adoption gap is at least 12.0 percentage points.
label.zh: 建議三星期商品目錄遷移指南，因為大型群組合資格商戶至少 10 位，且其採用率差距至少 12.0 個百分點。

label.en: Recommend instrument logging only because the minimum cohort condition is met but the 12.0 percentage point gap threshold is not met.
label.zh: 只建議儀器記錄，因為已符合最低群組條件，但未達 12.0 個百分點差距門檻。

label.en: Recommend instrument logging only because the large cohort has fewer than 10 eligible merchants.
label.zh: 只建議儀器記錄，因為大型群組合資格商戶少於 10 位。

label.en: Recommend a randomized experiment to prove the migration guide causes adoption.
label.zh: 建議隨機實驗，以證明遷移指南導致採用。

label.en: Which statements are supported by the supplied table and policy?
label.zh: 哪些陳述獲提供資料表及政策支持？

label.en: The small catalog cohort has 12 eligible merchants.
label.zh: 小型商品目錄群組有 12 位合資格商戶。

label.en: The large catalog cohort has 14 eligible merchants.
label.zh: 大型商品目錄群組有 14 位合資格商戶。

label.zh: 大型商品目錄群組未符合 10 位合資格商戶的最低群組條件。

label.zh: 記錄證明遷移指南導致大型商品目錄群組採用率較低。

Excluded rows are s03 and L14 with orders_30d of 0, plus s11 and L10 with active_paid no. expectedEvidence.en: Proposes concrete checks such as recomputing eligible counts against active_paid and orders_30d at least 1, confirming the cohort split at product_count 41, verifying cs_views_14d deduplication at one per merchant, confirming the 2026-11-05 observation date, and a next action such as logging instrument data, re-measuring in a later 14-day window or escalating to the fictional product lead if the gap widens.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如按 active_paid 及 orders_30d 至少 1 重新計算合資格人數、確認 product_count 41 的群組分界、核實 cs_views_14d 每商戶只計一次的去除重複規則、確認 2026-11-05 觀察日期，以及下一步如記錄儀器資料、在之後的 14 日窗口重新量度，或若差距擴大則交由虛構產品主管處理。

expectedEvidence.zh: 說明此表屬觀察性，不能建立因果關係，且不聲稱遷移指南或商品目錄規模導致大型群組比率較低。指出群組規模偏小，分別為 12 及 14 位合資格商戶，記錄屬虛構模擬，並把結論限於提供的規則、群組定義及 2026-11-05 觀察日期。

expectedEvidence.en: Actionable handover naming the decision of instrument logging only, both adoption rates 41.7 percent and 35.7 percent, the 6.0 percentage point gap, eligible counts 12 and 14, the unmet 12.0 point threshold, the causal limit, at least one verification step and an owner or escalation path such as the fictional product lead Marco Lee. Around 100 to 180 words, clear and evidence-based.
expectedEvidence.zh: 可行交接，列明只作儀器記錄的決策、兩個採用率 41.7% 及 35.7%、6.0 個百分點差距、合資格人數 12 及 14、未達的 12.0 個百分點門檻、因果限制、至少一項核實步驟，以及負責人或轉交途徑如虛構產品主管 Marco Lee。約 100 至 180 字，清晰並以證據為本。

exemplar.en: Recommendation: instrument logging only. The fictional table gives the small catalog cohort 12 eligible merchants, with 5 using Catalog Sync Insights, so 5 divided by 12 is 41.7 percent. The large catalog cohort has 14 eligible merchants, with 5 using it, so 5 divided by 14 is 35.7 percent. The gap is 41.7 minus 35.7, which is 6.0 percentage points. The minimum cohort condition is met at 14 eligible merchants, but 6.0 is below the 12.0 point threshold, so the 3-week migration guide is not supported by this rule. Excluded rows are s03 and L14 at orders_30d 0, and s11 and L10 at active_paid no. Using merchants are s01, s04, s07, s09, s13 and L02, L03, L06, L11, L15. This observational table cannot show that catalog size caused the difference. Next step: confirm the cohort split at product_count 41, re-measure after 14 days and escalate to the fictional product lead if the gap widens.
exemplar.zh: 建議：只作儀器記錄。虛構資料表顯示小型商品目錄群組有 12 位合資格商戶，其中 5 位使用目錄同步洞察，5 除以 12 為 41.7%。大型商品目錄群組有 14 位合資格商戶，其中 5 位使用，5 除以 14 為 35.7%。差距為 41.7 減 35.7，即 6.0 個百分點。最低群組條件已符合，因有 14 位合資格商戶，但 6.0 低於 12.0 個百分點門檻，故此規則不支持三星期遷移指南。被排除列為 orders_30d 為 0 的 s03 及 L14，以及 active_paid 為 no 的 s11 及 L10。使用商戶為 s01、s04、s07、s09、s13 及 L02、L03、L06、L11、L15。此觀察性資料表不能顯示商品目錄規模導致差異。下一步：確認 product_count 41 的群組分界、14 日後重新量度，若差距擴大則交由虛構產品主管處理。

feedback.en: All four checks are correct. Large cohort rate 35.7 percent (5 of 14 eligible), gap 6.0 points (41.7 minus 35.7), instrument logging only since the 6.0 point gap is below the 12.0 point threshold even though the 14 eligible merchants meet the minimum condition, and the three supported statements are selected.
feedback.zh: 四項檢查全部正確。大型群組採用率 35.7%（14 位合資格中 5 位）、差距 6.0 個百分點（41.7 減 35.7）、只作儀器記錄，因 6.0 個百分點低於 12.0 個百分點門檻，即使 14 位合資格商戶已符合最低條件；三項獲支持陳述亦正確選出。

feedback.en: You tie the arithmetic to specific records, correctly excluding s03 and L14 at orders_30d 0 and s11 and L10 at active_paid no, and list the ten using merchants including L11 and L15 with cs_views_14d at least 1. feedback.en: You clearly state that the observational table cannot show that catalog size caused the difference, which respects the steward note and avoids causal claims. feedback.en: The handover is actionable and complete at 164 words, covering the decision, both rates, the gap, eligible counts, the unmet threshold, the causal limit and a next step with escalation. body.en: All statements are fictional learning assumptions. Query date is 2026-11-02. A row is closure-ready only when claimed_status is completed, evidence_submitted_date is present and on or before due_date, evidence_verified is yes, and any required approval_reference is present. Required approval is set by the owner matrix. DS approval is required when metric_change is yes. FM approval is required when budget_hkd is 50000 or more. PC may close actions below 50000 HKD with metric_change no. CM and ES may close only within their own area when no DS or FM approval is required. An action with due_date before the query date that is not closure-ready must be escalated as overdue. Evidence after due_date does not close an action.

title.zh: 受控發佈政策

body.en: Fictional learning simulation. This policy governs the controlled handover for the Harbour East Placemaking Review. Query date for approval validity: 2026-10-15. Release owner: Ada Wong. Required-file checklist: all four files (HE-OVERVIEW, HE-STAKEHOLDER, HE-METHOD, HE-IMPACT) are required for the handover. Approved Revision Register (authoritative for approved revision): HE-OVERVIEW: R3 (approval date 2026-09-20, expiry 2026-12-31). HE-STAKEHOLDER: R2 (approval date 2026-09-12, expiry 2026-11-30). HE-METHOD: R1 (approval date 2026-08-22, expiry 2027-01-31). HE-IMPACT: no approved revision. If the manifest shows a different approval status for the register revision, the register prevails. Approval validity: a revision is valid for release only if its approval expiry date is on or after the query date. Audience-permission mapping: classification 'public' may be shared with internal-pack and partner-pack. classification 'internal' may be shared with internal-pack only. Release rule: a file may be released only if it has a valid approved revision and appears in the required-file checklist. Otherwise it is held. Hold reason must be recorded. Deliverable: a corrected controlled release manifest and hold list with applicable approval/access reasons.

exemplar.en:
Controlled Release Handover – Harbour East Placemaking Review
Query date: 2026-10-15. Release owner: Ada Wong.
Eligible files with approved revisions: HE-OVERVIEW (R3), HE-STAKEHOLDER (R2), HE-METHOD (R1). HE-IMPACT has no approved revision.
Approved revision conflict: Manifest shows HE-OVERVIEW R2 approved and R3 pending. The Controlled Release Policy states the Approved Revision Register is authoritative, so R3 is the approved revision.
Audience decision: Partner-pack may receive only public files. Therefore, HE-OVERVIEW R3 and HE-METHOD R1 can go to partner-pack. HE-STAKEHOLDER R2 is internal and may go only to internal-pack.
Release manifest:
- HE-OVERVIEW R3: internal-pack and partner-pack
- HE-STAKEHOLDER R2: internal-pack only
- HE-METHOD R1: internal-pack and partner-pack
Hold list:
- HE-IMPACT R2: held because no approved revision exists in the register and approval metadata is missing.
Next steps: Confirm with Ada Wong that the register prevails. Seek approval for HE-IMPACT or record permanent hold. Verify all expiry dates remain valid beyond query date.

受控發佈交接 – Harbour East Placemaking Review
查詢日期：2026-10-15。發佈負責人：Ada Wong。
合資格且具有獲批准修訂的文件：HE-OVERVIEW (R3)、HE-STAKEHOLDER (R2)、HE-METHOD (R1)。HE-IMPACT 沒有獲批准修訂。
批准修訂衝突：清單顯示 HE-OVERVIEW R2 已批准而 R3 待審批。受控發佈政策規定已批准修訂登記冊具權威性，因此 R3 為獲批准修訂。
受眾決定：partner-pack 僅可接收公開文件。因此，HE-OVERVIEW R3 及 HE-METHOD R1 可發送至 partner-pack。HE-STAKEHOLDER R2 為內部文件，僅可發送至 internal-pack。
發佈清單：
- HE-OVERVIEW R3：internal-pack 及 partner-pack
- HE-STAKEHOLDER R2：僅 internal-pack
- HE-METHOD R1：internal-pack 及 partner-pack
保留清單：
- HE-IMPACT R2：保留，因登記冊沒有獲批准修訂且審批元數據缺失。
下一步：與 Ada Wong 確認登記冊具權威性。為 HE-IMPACT 尋求批准或記錄永久保留。核實所有到期日在查詢日期後仍然有效。

The complete manifest matches the correct release and hold pattern.

summary.en: A strong, accurate handover: all decisions match the authoritative register and policy, with correct partner-pack restriction and hold reasoning. The main gaps are an explicit expiry-date validity check, a final checklist cross-check and an explicit fictional-scenario caveat.

title.zh: 受控發佈政策

body.en: Fictional learning simulation. This policy governs the controlled handover for the Taikoo Place Energy Retrofit Review. Query date for approval validity: 2027-03-10. Release owner: Marcus Leung. Required-file checklist: all four files (TP-ENERGY, TP-COMMUNITY, TP-WATER, TP-WASTE) are required for the handover. Approved Revision Register (authoritative for approved revision): TP-ENERGY: R3 (approval date 2027-01-15, expiry 2027-09-30). TP-COMMUNITY: R2 (approval date 2026-12-05, expiry 2027-02-28). TP-WATER: R1 (approval date 2027-02-12, expiry 2028-01-31). TP-WASTE: no approved revision. If the manifest shows a different approval status for the register revision, the register prevails. Approval validity: a revision is valid for release only if its approval expiry date is on or after the query date. Audience-permission mapping: classification 'public' may be shared with internal-pack and partner-pack. classification 'internal' may be shared with internal-pack only. Release rule: a file may be released only if it has a valid approved revision and appears in the required-file checklist. Otherwise it is held. Hold reason must be recorded. Deliverable: a corrected controlled release manifest and hold list with applicable approval or access reasons.

title.en: RAID Classification and Status Gate Policy
title.zh: RAID 分類及狀態閘門政策

body.en:
Fictional simulation policy. Status date: 2026-11-13.
Classification priority: Dependency > Issue > Risk > Assumption.
Dependency: requires external approval or deliverable from another team or party before work can proceed. Classify as Dependency even if its approval is overdue.
Issue: event already occurred and currently affects scope, schedule, cost or quality.
Risk: uncertain future event, not yet occurred.
Assumption: planning belief not yet confirmed.
Traffic-light gate:
Green: no open issues and all dependencies approved.
Amber: at least one open issue, or any pending dependency approval overdue 1 to 5 working days inclusive. No red condition.
Red: any issue with blocks_critical_path=yes, or any dependency_approval_status=rejected, or any pending dependency approval overdue 6 or more working days.
Red overrides Amber. Red escalates to Programme Sponsor. Amber escalates to Project Manager. Green is managed by workstream lead.
Log owner field is accountable owner. Escalation owner is separate.
body.zh:
虛構模擬政策。狀態日期：2026-11-13。
分類優先次序：相依關係 > 問題 > 風險 > 假設。
相依關係：需要其他團隊或第三方提供外部批准或交付物後工作才可進行。即使批准已逾期，仍分類為相依關係。
問題：事件已經發生，並目前影響範圍、時間表、成本或質量。
風險：不確定的未來事件，尚未發生。
假設：規劃信念尚未確認。
交通燈閘門：
綠色：沒有未解決問題，且所有相依關係已獲批准。
黃色：至少一個未解決問題，或任何待批相依關係逾期1至5個工作日（含首尾）。沒有紅色條件。
紅色：任何問題的blocks_critical_path=yes，或任何dependency_approval_status=rejected，或任何待批相依關係逾期6個或以上工作日。
紅色優先於黃色。紅色升級至計劃贊助人。黃色升級至項目經理。綠色由工作流負責人管理。
記錄的owner欄位為問責負責人。升級負責人另行區分。

title.zh: RAID分類及交通燈政策

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Status date 2026-11-18. Classification priority: Dependency > Issue > Risk > Assumption. Dependency: requires external approval or deliverable from another party before work can proceed. Classify as Dependency even if approval is overdue or rejected. Issue: event already occurred and currently affects scope, schedule, cost or quality. This includes a delivered item whose acceptance criteria are not signed off. Risk: uncertain future event not yet occurred. Assumption: planning belief not yet confirmed. Traffic-light gate: Green means no open issues and all dependencies approved. Amber means at least one open issue, or any pending dependency approval overdue 1 to 5 working days inclusive, or any acceptance gap open overdue 1 to 5 working days inclusive. Red means any issue with blocks_critical_path=yes, or any dependency_approval_status=rejected, or any pending dependency approval overdue 6 or more working days, or any acceptance gap open overdue 6 or more working days. Red overrides Amber. Red escalates to Programme Sponsor. Amber escalates to Project Manager. Green is managed by workstream lead. Owner field is accountable owner. Escalation owner is separate.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。狀態日期2026-11-18。分類優先次序：相依關係 > 問題 > 風險 > 假設。相依關係：需要其他方提供外部批准或交付物後工作才可進行。即使批准已逾期或被拒，仍分類為相依關係。問題：事件已經發生，並目前影響範圍、時間表、成本或質量。包括已交付但接納準則未簽署的項目。風險：不確定的未來事件，尚未發生。假設：規劃信念尚未確認。交通燈閘門：綠色指沒有未解決問題且所有相依關係已獲批准。黃色指至少一個未解決問題，或任何待批相依批准逾期1至5個工作日（含首尾），或任何接納缺口逾期1至5個工作日（含首尾）。紅色指任何問題的blocks_critical_path=yes，或任何dependency_approval_status=rejected，或任何待批相依批准逾期6個或以上工作日，或任何接納缺口逾期6個或以上工作日。紅色優先於黃色。紅色升級至計劃贊助人。黃色升級至項目經理。綠色由工作流負責人管理。owner欄位為問責負責人。升級負責人另行區分。

brief.en: Simulated Oursky QA exercise, fictional and not endorsed by Oursky. A teammate refactored the comparison inside statusFor() while tidying the latency dashboard. Continuous integration is green, yet the published contract may no longer hold at the boundary. The refactor came from engineer Leung Ho-yin (fictional). Release owner Wong Ka-yan (fictional), the QA team lead, approves or blocks the merge. Review the contract, the sample rows and the code under review, answer four questions, then write a short evidence-based handover naming the discriminating input, the assertion that catches the regression, the exact code line to restore and what you could not verify. Around 120 words is a useful guide, not a strict limit.

title.zh: 已公布的分類合約（虛構）

body.en: Simulated exercise for Oursky learners. This contract is fictional and is not an official Oursky policy. Contract for statusFor(responseMs, baseBudgetMs, jitterPct). All three arguments are plain whole numbers. Times are milliseconds, written ms, and jitterPct is a percentage. Step 1: degradedMs = baseBudgetMs x (100 + jitterPct) / 100, exact, with no rounding. Step 2: if responseMs is less than 0, return 'invalid'. Step 3: otherwise, if responseMs is greater than or equal to degradedMs, return 'degraded'. Step 4: otherwise return 'healthy'. The degraded boundary is inclusive, so responseMs exactly equal to degradedMs is 'degraded'.
body.zh: Oursky 學員模擬練習。此合約屬虛構，並非 Oursky 官方政策。statusFor(responseMs, baseBudgetMs, jitterPct) 的合約：三個參數均為整數。時間單位為毫秒（ms），jitterPct 為百分比。第一步：degradedMs = baseBudgetMs x (100 + jitterPct) / 100，精確計算，不作四捨五入。第二步：若 responseMs 小於 0，回傳 'invalid'。第三步：否則若 responseMs 大於或等於 degradedMs，回傳 'degraded'。第四步：否則回傳 'healthy'。degraded 邊界為包含式，responseMs 剛好等於 degradedMs 即屬 'degraded'。

simulationStyle.en: Review fictional software and interface changes, design regression tests, triage defects and write an evidence-based teammate handover. All source code and release decisions are simulated.

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare supplied implementation mutations against test assertions and propose a discriminating test.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按測試斷言比較提供實作改動，並提出能識別問題的測試。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare supplied implementation mutations against test assertions and propose a discriminating test.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按測試斷言比較提供實作改動，並提出能識別問題的測試。

expectedEvidence.en: The discriminating case is R-02: responseMs 750, baseBudgetMs 600, jitterPct 25, so degradedMs is 750 and the contract returns 'degraded' while the code under review returns 'healthy'. The value-adding assertion is expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded'). Only R-03, R-04, R-05 and R-06 are 'healthy' under both. The highest responseMs still 'healthy' for baseBudgetMs 940 with jitterPct 25 is 1174 ms, because 940 x 125 / 100 = 1175 and the boundary is inclusive.
expectedEvidence.zh: 能識別問題的個案為 R-02：responseMs 750、baseBudgetMs 600、jitterPct 25，degradedMs 為 750，合約回傳 'degraded'，待審程式碼回傳 'healthy'。有價值的斷言為 expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded')。在兩者下均為 'healthy' 的只有 R-03、R-04、R-05 及 R-06。baseBudgetMs 940、jitterPct 25 下仍為 'healthy' 的最高 responseMs 為 1174 ms，因為 940 x 125 / 100 = 1175 且邊界為包含式。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the contract rule degradedMs = baseBudgetMs x (100 + jitterPct) / 100 and the inclusive rule responseMs greater than or equal to degradedMs, then shows the arithmetic for R-02 (600 x 125 / 100 = 750). Explains that the current suite passes because its assertions use 1000, far above 750, and -1, so the equality boundary is never exercised.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用合約規則 degradedMs = baseBudgetMs x (100 + jitterPct) / 100 及包含式規則 responseMs 大於或等於 degradedMs，並展示 R-02 的運算（600 x 125 / 100 = 750）。說明現有套件之所以通過，是因為斷言使用 1000（遠高於 750）及 -1，從未觸及相等邊界。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Gives the exact replacement line for statusFor.js, namely 'if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return \'degraded\';', added to the existing function, then proposes expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded') plus a just-below case such as 749 returning 'healthy' and one negative case, and re-running CI. A table-driven test over all supplied rows is an acceptable alternative.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供 statusFor.js 的確切替換程式碼行，即 'if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return \'degraded\';'，加入現有函式，並建議 expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded')，再補一個略低於邊界的個案如 749 回傳 'healthy' 及一個負數個案，然後重跑 CI。以表格驅動測試覆蓋所有提供資料列亦屬可接受做法。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that the review covers only the six supplied rows and the simulated module, that no production traffic or other modules were examined, and avoids claiming any total defect or bug count elsewhere in the codebase. Notes the scenario is fictional and not endorsed by Oursky.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明審查只涵蓋提供的六列資料及模擬模組，未有檢視實際流量或其他模組，並避免聲稱程式庫其他地方有任何總缺陷或錯誤數量。指出此情境屬虛構，並非 Oursky 認可。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover with a clear decision (do not merge as is), the R-02 arithmetic as evidence, the exact assertion to add, the exact replacement line 'if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return \'degraded\';' to restore, next steps, and named ownership: escalate the merge decision to release owner Wong Ka-yan (fictional) and notify refactor author Leung Ho-yin (fictional).
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接，包含清晰決策（不應原樣合併）、以 R-02 運算為證據、要加入的確切斷言、要還原的確切替換程式碼行 'if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return \'degraded\';'、下一步，以及具名責任：把合併決策升級至發布負責人 Wong Ka-yan（虛構），並通知重構作者 Leung Ho-yin（虛構）。

exemplar.en: Handover (simulated). Decision: do not merge the refactor as it stands. The published contract says a reading exactly equal to degradedMs is 'degraded', but statusFor.js now uses responseMs > degradedMs, so the equality boundary falls through to 'healthy'. Corrected code, the exact replacement line in statusFor.js: if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return 'degraded'; that is, change the greater-than comparison to greater-than-or-equal. Evidence: sample R-02 has responseMs 750, baseBudgetMs 600 and jitterPct 25, giving degradedMs = 600 x 125 / 100 = 750. The contract returns 'degraded' and the code under review returns 'healthy'. No other supplied row sits on the boundary. The current suite stays green because it only asserts 1000, well above the threshold, and -1. Next steps: add expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded') and a just-below case (749 to 'healthy'), apply the replacement line above, then re-run CI. Ownership: send the merge decision to release owner Wong Ka-yan, QA team lead, and notify refactor author Leung Ho-yin. Uncertainty: only the six supplied rows and this one simulated module were checked, and real route traffic is not represented here.
exemplar.zh: 交接（模擬）。決策：不應原樣合併此重構。已公布合約指出剛好等於 degradedMs 的讀數屬 'degraded'，但 statusFor.js 現時使用 responseMs > degradedMs，令相等邊界跌入 'healthy'。修正後程式碼，即 statusFor.js 的確切替換行：if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return 'degraded'; 亦即是把大於的比較改為大於或等於。證據：樣本 R-02 的 responseMs 為 750、baseBudgetMs 為 600、jitterPct 為 25，degradedMs = 600 x 125 / 100 = 750。合約回傳 'degraded'，待審程式碼回傳 'healthy'。其他提供資料列均不在邊界上。現有套件仍綠燈，因為只斷言 1000（遠高於門檻）及 -1。下一步：加入 expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded') 及一個略低於邊界的個案（749 得 'healthy'），套用上述替換行，然後重跑 CI。責任：把合併決策交予發布負責人 QA 團隊主管 Wong Ka-yan，並通知重構作者 Leung Ho-yin。不確定性：只檢查了六列提供資料及此單一模擬模組，實際路線流量並未涵蓋。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: R-02 is the discriminating case, expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded') is the value-adding assertion, healthy-both is R-03, R-04, R-05 and R-06, and 1174 ms is the highest still-healthy reading for baseBudgetMs 940 with jitterPct 25. You correctly apply the inclusive boundary rule throughout.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：R-02 為能識別問題的個案，expect(statusFor(750, 600, 25)).toBe('degraded') 為有價值的斷言，兩者皆為 healthy 的是 R-03、R-04、R-05、R-06，而 baseBudgetMs 940、jitterPct 25 下仍為 healthy 的最高值為 1174 ms。你全程正確套用包含式邊界規則。

feedback.en: You cite the contract formula, show the R-02 arithmetic 600 x 125 / 100 = 750, and explain why the current suite stays green through the 1000 and -1 assertions that never touch the equality boundary. That reasoning is accurate and grounded in the supplied records.
feedback.zh: 你引用了合約公式，展示 R-02 的運算 600 x 125 / 100 = 750，並解釋現有套件為何藉 1000 及 -1 斷言保持綠燈而從未觸及相等邊界。推理準確並以提供記錄為依據。

feedback.en: You give the exact replacement line if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return 'degraded'; plus the boundary assertion and a just-below 749 case, then re-run CI. Adding a table-driven check over the six supplied rows would strengthen the regression coverage further.
feedback.zh: 你提供了確切替換行 if (responseMs >= degradedMs) return 'degraded';，加上邊界斷言及略低於邊界的 749 個案，然後重跑 CI。若能加入覆蓋六列提供資料的表格驅動檢查，將進一步強化回歸覆蓋。

feedback.en: You limit the review to the six supplied rows and the single simulated module and note that real route traffic is not represented. The 178-word handover is proportionate and raises no unsupported defect claims.
feedback.zh: 你把審查限定於六列提供資料及單一模擬模組，並指出未有涵蓋實際路線流量。178 字的交接篇幅適中，亦沒有提出無根據的缺陷聲稱。

feedback.en: The handover states a clear no-merge decision, the R-02 arithmetic as evidence, the exact line and assertion to apply, and named ownership routed to release owner Wong Ka-yan with refactor author Leung Ho-yin notified. It is actionable as written.
feedback.zh: 交接清楚列明不合併的決策、以 R-02 運算為證據、要套用的確切程式碼行及斷言，並具名把責任交予發布負責人 Wong Ka-yan，同時通知重構作者 Leung Ho-yin。內容可直接付諸實行。

summary.en: A complete, accurate review. All four structured answers match the published contract, the boundary arithmetic is correct and the handover is concise, evidenced and correctly owned.
summary.zh: 審查完整且準確。四項結構化答案均符合已公布合約，邊界運算正確，交接簡潔、有證據並具正確責任安排。

nextSteps.en: Apply the replacement line and the two new boundary assertions, then confirm CI fails before the fix and passes after it. Optionally add a table-driven test across the six supplied rows for durable boundary coverage.
nextSteps.zh: 套用替換行及兩條新增邊界斷言，並確認修正前 CI 失敗、修正後通過。可選擇加入覆蓋六列提供資料的表格驅動測試，以維持長遠的邊界覆蓋。

about.en: Oursky builds digital products and publicly describes code review, continuous integration, collaboration and privacy-aware software as part of its engineering approach.

publicValues.zh: 程式碼審查及工程品質

simulationStyle.en: Review fictional software and interface changes, design regression tests, triage defects and write an evidence-based teammate handover. All source code and release decisions are simulated.
simulationStyle.zh: 審查虛構軟件及介面改動、設計回歸測試、排列缺陷優先次序，並撰寫有證據支持的同事交接。所有程式碼及發布決策均為模擬。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Compare supplied implementation mutations against test assertions and propose a discriminating test.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。按測試斷言比較提供實作改動，並提出能識別問題的測試。

expectedEvidence.en: Finds the wrong field mapping budgetMs: row.responseMs and states that budgetMs must map to row.baseBudgetMs. Correct answers: discriminating-assertion = assert-budget-600, non-discriminating-row = rt-103, failing-assertions = [assert-budget-rt102, assert-budget-rt105] only, budget-error-ms = 580. Explains that RT-103 cannot discriminate because responseMs 940 equals baseBudgetMs 940.
expectedEvidence.zh: 找錯誤的欄位對應 budgetMs: row.responseMs，並指出 budgetMs 必須對應 row.baseBudgetMs。正確答案：discriminating-assertion = assert-budget-600，non-discriminating-row = rt-103，failing-assertions = 只有 [assert-budget-rt102, assert-budget-rt105]，budget-error-ms = 580。並解釋 RT-103 無法區分，因 responseMs 940 等於 baseBudgetMs 940。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links the decision to specific supplied records: the contract clause on budgetMs, the line budgetMs: row.responseMs, and the fact that the current suite only checks Object.keys order and typeof, so a wrong source field survives. Notes that RT-101 is the worst case, where the code returns 1200 while the contract requires 600.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄：合約中 budgetMs 的條款、budgetMs: row.responseMs 這一行，以及現有套件只檢查 Object.keys 順序及 typeof，因此錯誤來源欄位得以通過。指出 RT-101 差距最大，程式碼回傳 1200 而合約要求 600。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Gives the exact replacement line budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs and concrete value assertions, for example expect(toSignal({ routeId: 'RT-101', responseMs: 1200, baseBudgetMs: 600, jitterPct: 25 }).budgetMs).toBe(600), plus value assertions on RT-102 and RT-105, then rerun CI and hand to release owner Chan Mei-ling (fictional). Merely rerunning the existing suite is insufficient.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出確切替換行 budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs 及具體數值斷言，例如 expect(toSignal({ routeId: 'RT-101', responseMs: 1200, baseBudgetMs: 600, jitterPct: 25 }).budgetMs).toBe(600)，並對 RT-102 及 RT-105 加入數值斷言，然後重跑持續整合並交予發布負責人 Chan Mei-ling（虛構）。只重跑現有套件並不足夠。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that the scenario is fictional, that no code was executed, that only the five supplied rows were reviewed, and that downstream consumers of budgetMs and any production data are unverified. Avoids claiming a total defect count or real Oursky policy.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明情境屬虛構、並無執行程式碼、只審閱提供的五個資料列，而 budgetMs 的下游使用者及任何生產資料均未核實。避免聲稱缺陷總數或 Oursky 真實政策。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover with evidence, the decision to block the merge until the one-line fix, the calculation 900 minus 320 equals 580 ms for RT-105, residual uncertainty and next steps owned by Chan Mei-ling (fictional). Written in English or Traditional Chinese, roughly 100 to 180 words, with no strict word limit enforced.
expectedEvidence.zh: 簡潔交接，包含證據、在完成單行修正前阻止合併的決定、RT-105 的計算 900 減 320 等於 580 毫秒、剩餘不確定性，以及由 Chan Mei-ling（虛構）負責的下一步。以英文或繁體中文撰寫，約 100 至 180 字，並不嚴格執行字數限制。

exemplar.en: Evidence: the published contract requires toSignal to return budgetMs from row.baseBudgetMs. The code under review has budgetMs: row.responseMs, while the current suite only checks key order and value types, so continuous integration stays green. Decision: block the merge and request the one-line fix budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs. Rows RT-101, RT-102, RT-104 and RT-105 all expose the defect. RT-103 (responseMs 940, baseBudgetMs 940) cannot discriminate, because both sources hold the same value. Discriminating assertion: expect(toSignal({ routeId: 'RT-101', responseMs: 1200, baseBudgetMs: 600, jitterPct: 25 }).budgetMs).toBe(600) matches the contract and fails on the code under review. Calculation: for RT-105 the contract expects 900 ms and the code returns 320 ms, an absolute difference of 580 ms. Uncertainty: no code was executed here and only the supplied rows were reviewed, so downstream consumers of budgetMs are unchecked. Next steps: apply the fix, add value assertions for RT-102 and RT-105, rerun the suite, then hand to release owner Chan Mei-ling.
exemplar.zh: 證據：已公布合約要求 toSignal 的 budgetMs 取自 row.baseBudgetMs。待審程式碼為 budgetMs: row.responseMs，而現有套件只檢查鍵的順序及值類型，因此持續整合維持綠燈。決策：阻止合併，並要求作單行修正 budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs。RT-101、RT-102、RT-104 及 RT-105 均會暴露此缺陷。RT-103（responseMs 940，baseBudgetMs 940）無法區分，因兩個來源值相同。能識別問題的斷言：expect(toSignal({ routeId: 'RT-101', responseMs: 1200, baseBudgetMs: 600, jitterPct: 25 }).budgetMs).toBe(600) 符合合約，並會在待審程式碼上失敗。計算：RT-105 合約期望 900 毫秒，程式碼回傳 320 毫秒，絕對相差 580 毫秒。不確定性：此處並無執行程式碼，且只審閱提供的資料列，故 budgetMs 的下游使用者未經檢查。下一步：套用修正、為 RT-102 及 RT-105 加入數值斷言、重跑套件，然後交予發布負責人 Chan Mei-ling。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: the discriminating assertion is the RT-101 budgetMs toBe(600) case, RT-103 is the non-discriminating row because responseMs 940 equals baseBudgetMs 940, only the RT-102 and RT-105 budget assertions currently fail, and the RT-105 absolute gap is 580 ms. The wrong mapping budgetMs: row.responseMs is identified and the contract value row.baseBudgetMs is stated.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：能識別問題的斷言是 RT-101 的 budgetMs toBe(600)；RT-103 無法區分，因 responseMs 940 等於 baseBudgetMs 940；目前只有 RT-102 及 RT-105 的 budgetMs 斷言會失敗；RT-105 的絕對差額為 580 毫秒。你亦正確指出錯誤對應 budgetMs: row.responseMs，並說明合約要求 row.baseBudgetMs。

feedback.en: Evidence is tied to specific supplied records: the budgetMs clause in the published contract, the offending line budgetMs: row.responseMs, and the fact that the current suite only checks Object.keys order and typeof so the wrong source field survives CI. You also name the rows that expose the defect and explain precisely why RT-103 cannot.
feedback.zh: 證據緊扣具體提供記錄：已公布合約的 budgetMs 條款、問題行 budgetMs: row.responseMs，以及現有套件只檢查 Object.keys 順序及 typeof，令錯誤來源欄位得以通過持續整合。你亦列出會暴露缺陷的資料列，並準確解釋 RT-103 為何無法區分。

feedback.en: The handover gives the exact replacement line budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs, the concrete RT-101 value assertion, added value assertions for RT-102 and RT-105, a rerun of the suite and escalation to release owner Chan Mei-ling. A useful extra check would be asserting the full returned object for one row so key order and all four values are pinned together.
feedback.zh: 交接提出確切替換行 budgetMs: row.baseBudgetMs、具體的 RT-101 數值斷言、為 RT-102 及 RT-105 加入數值斷言、重跑套件，並轉交發布負責人 Chan Mei-ling。可再補一項檢查：對其中一列斷言完整回傳物件，令鍵序與四個數值同時被鎖定。

feedback.en: You clearly state that no code was executed, that only the supplied rows were reviewed and that downstream consumers of budgetMs remain unchecked, and you avoid claiming a defect total or real Oursky policy. Naming the scenario as fictional would make the scope limit even more explicit.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明並無執行程式碼、只審閱提供的資料列，而 budgetMs 的下游使用者仍未核實，亦沒有聲稱缺陷總數或 Oursky 真實政策。若再明言情境屬虛構，範圍界線會更清晰。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable at 159 words, with evidence, the block-merge decision, the RT-105 calculation of 900 minus 320 equals 580 ms, residual uncertainty and an owner. It reads cleanly as a teammate-facing note.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，共 159 個英文詞，包含證據、阻止合併的決定、RT-105 的 900 減 320 等於 580 毫秒計算、剩餘不確定性及負責人，作為同事交接清晰易讀。

summary.en: Complete and accurate submission. Every selected answer matches the published contract and the code under review, and the written handover supplies the discriminating assertion, the one-line fix, the non-discriminating row with reasoning, the 580 ms calculation and the limits of the evidence. No material gaps were found.
summary.zh: 提交完整且準確。所有選項均符合已公布合約及待審程式碼，書面交接亦提供能識別問題的斷言、單行修正、無法區分的資料列及其理據、580 毫秒計算，以及證據的限制。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Add one full-object assertion for a single row so key order and all four values are pinned together, and record the requested fix and rerun result against the release owner Chan Mei-ling so the merge block is traceable.
nextSteps.zh: 為其中一列加入完整物件斷言，令鍵序與四個數值同時被鎖定，並把要求的修正及重跑結果記錄在發布負責人 Chan Mei-ling 名下，使阻止合併的決定可追溯。

title.zh: LedgerLite 相容性覆蓋審查

brief.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky QA practice, not endorsed by Oursky. You are reviewing the LedgerLite web app before a fictional release. Read the supported-environment policy and the two supplied CSV tables. Decide the coverage counts, the coverage-ratio-based release gate outcome, and identify the stale observation. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Do not execute any browser. All records are synthetic.
brief.zh: 此為 Oursky 品質保證練習的虛構模擬，並非 Oursky 認可。你要在虛構發布前審查 LedgerLite 網頁應用程式。閱讀支援環境政策及兩份提供的 CSV 表。判斷覆蓋數量、按覆蓋比率決定的發布閘門結果，並找出過期觀察記錄。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫簡潔及有證據支持的交接。不要執行任何瀏覽器。所有記錄均為合成資料。

title.zh: 支援環境政策 P4

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Current policy version P4. The LedgerLite web app supports these browser families, chrome, safari, firefox, edge and samsung-internet. Device classes are desktop, tablet and phone. Only combinations listed in required-pairs.csv are in scope. A required pair is covered only when an observation record has the exact pairId, policyVersion equal to P4, and result equal to pass. Records with result fail or partial, or with policyVersion not equal to P4, do not count as coverage. Coverage ratio equals covered required pairs divided by total required pairs. Release requires coverage ratio at least 0.80.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。現行政策版本為 P4。LedgerLite 網頁應用程式支援以下瀏覽器系列：chrome、safari、firefox、edge 及 samsung-internet。裝置類別為 desktop、tablet 及 phone。只有 required-pairs.csv 所列組合屬於範圍。只有當觀察記錄具有完全相同的 pairId、policyVersion 等於 P4，且 result 等於 pass 時，該必要配對才視為已覆蓋。result 為 fail 或 partial，或 policyVersion 不等於 P4 的記錄，均不計作覆蓋。覆蓋比率等於已覆蓋必要配對數除以必要配對總數。發布要求覆蓋比率至少 0.80。

description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Handover states 6 of 10 covered, ratio 0.60, hold decision, stale OB-05, uncovered pairs, next action to re-test under P4 and re-run gate. Assigns QA lead escalation if failures persist.
expectedEvidence.zh: 交接說明 10 個中 6 個已覆蓋、比率 0.60、暫緩決定、過期 OB-05、未覆蓋配對、下一步在 P4 下重新測試並重跑閘門。若失敗持續，交由品質保證主管升級處理。

exemplar.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky QA practice. Decision: hold the LedgerLite release. Evidence: the supported-environment policy P4 lists 10 required browser and device pairs in required-pairs.csv. A pair counts only when observations.csv shows policyVersion P4 and result pass. Covered pairs are RP-01, RP-02, RP-04, RP-07, RP-08 and RP-09, so 6 of 10 are covered. OB-05 is excluded because its policyVersion is P3. OB-03, OB-06 and OB-10 do not pass. OB-06 is partial. Coverage ratio is 6 divided by 10, or 0.60. The gate threshold is at least 0.80, so 0.60 fails and the outcome is hold. Next steps: re-test RP-03, RP-05, RP-06 and RP-10 under P4, confirm result pass, then recalculate the ratio. Risk: no real browser execution was performed, so this is a documentary decision only.
exemplar.zh: 此為 Oursky 品質保證練習的虛構模擬。決策：暫緩 LedgerLite 發布。證據：支援環境政策 P4 在 required-pairs.csv 列出 10 個必要瀏覽器及裝置配對。只有當 observations.csv 顯示 policyVersion P4 且 result pass 時，配對才計數。已覆蓋配對為 RP-01、RP-02、RP-04、RP-07、RP-08 及 RP-09，即 10 個中有 6 個已覆蓋。OB-05 被排除，因其 policyVersion 為 P3。OB-03、OB-06 及 OB-10 未通過。OB-06 為 partial。覆蓋比率為 6 除以 10，即 0.60。閘門門檻為至少 0.80，因此 0.60 不合格，結果為暫緩。下一步：在 P4 下重新測試 RP-03、RP-05、RP-06 及 RP-10，確認 result pass，然後重新計算比率。風險：沒有執行真實瀏覽器，因此這僅為文件決策。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: 6 covered pairs, 4 uncovered, ratio 0.60 with a hold outcome, and OB-05 excluded as stale. The P4 rule and the 0.80 threshold are applied accurately.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：6 個已覆蓋、4 個未覆蓋、比率 0.60 及暫緩結果，OB-05 因過期被排除。P4 規則及 0.80 門檻應用準確。

feedback.en: You name the specific covered records RP-01, RP-02, RP-04, RP-07, RP-08, RP-09 and explain that OB-03, OB-06, OB-10 fail while OB-05 is excluded on P3, which is precise evidence-based reasoning.
feedback.zh: 你點名已覆蓋記錄 RP-01、RP-02、RP-04、RP-07、RP-08、RP-09，並解釋 OB-03、OB-06、OB-10 未通過而 OB-05 因 P3 被排除，推理準確且有證據支持。

feedback.en: Next steps correctly target re-testing RP-03, RP-05, RP-06, RP-10 under P4 then recalculating the ratio. You could add re-checking the 0.80 gate explicitly before release to tighten the action.
feedback.zh: 下一步正確指出在 P4 下重測 RP-03、RP-05、RP-06、RP-10 然後重新計算比率。可再明確加上發布前重新檢查 0.80 閘門以收緊行動。

feedback.en: You state it is a fictional simulation and that no real browser execution was performed, limiting the claim to documentary evidence. This is sufficient scope framing.
feedback.zh: 你說明此為虛構模擬且沒有執行真實瀏覽器，把結論限於文件證據，範圍界定充分。

feedback.en: The handover gives the hold decision, 6 of 10 covered, 0.60 ratio, stale OB-05, uncovered pairs and next actions clearly. It does not name an owner or escalation path such as the QA lead if failures persist, so add that for a fully actionable handover.
feedback.zh: 交接清楚列出暫緩決定、10 個中 6 個已覆蓋、比率 0.60、過期 OB-05、未覆蓋配對及下一步。但未列明責任人或升級路徑（例如失敗持續時交由品質保證主管），補上即可成為完全可行的交接。

summary.en: A complete and accurate documentary coverage decision for LedgerLite, with correct counts, ratio, hold outcome and stale-record identification backed by specific records. The only gap is a named owner or escalation path in the handover.
summary.zh: 對 LedgerLite 的文件覆蓋決策完整且準確，數量、比率、暫緩結果及過期記錄辨識均正確並有具體記錄支持。唯一不足是交接未列明責任人或升級路徑。

nextSteps.en: Add an explicit owner or escalation line, for example escalating to the QA lead if RP-03, RP-05, RP-06 or RP-10 still fail after P4 re-testing, and state that the 0.80 gate is re-checked before any release decision.
nextSteps.zh: 加一行明確的責任人或升級安排，例如若 RP-03、RP-05、RP-06 或 RP-10 在 P4 重測後仍失敗便交由品質保證主管處理，並說明任何發布決定前會重新檢查 0.80 閘門。

brief.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky QA practice, not endorsed by Oursky. You are reviewing the NoteWave web app before a fictional release. Then write a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Do not execute any browser. All records are synthetic.

title.zh: 支援環境政策 L4

body.en: Fictional simulation policy for Oursky QA practice. Current policy version L4. The NoteWave app supports these locales: en-HK, zh-HK, zh-CN, en-US. Supported input methods: keyboard, handwriting, voice, pinyin, cangjie. Only combinations listed in required-combos.csv are in scope. A required combo is covered only when an observation record has the exact comboId, policyVersion equal to L4, and result equal to pass. Records with result fail or partial, or with policyVersion not equal to L4, do not count as coverage. Coverage ratio equals covered required combos divided by total required combos. Release requires coverage ratio at least 0.70. All records are synthetic.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策，適用於 Oursky 品質保證練習。現行政策版本為 L4。NoteWave 應用程式支援以下地區設定：en-HK、zh-HK、zh-CN、en-US。支援的輸入法：keyboard、handwriting、voice、pinyin、cangjie。只有 required-combos.csv 所列組合屬於範圍。只有當觀察記錄具有完全相同的 comboId、policyVersion 等於 L4，且 result 等於 pass 時，該必要組合才視為已覆蓋。result 為 fail 或 partial，或 policyVersion 不等於 L4 的記錄，均不計作覆蓋。覆蓋比率等於已覆蓋必要組合數除以必要組合總數。發布要求覆蓋比率至少 0.70。所有記錄均為合成資料。

title.zh: 隔離測試資料

brief.en: You are a QA engineer in a simulated Oursky project. Review the defective cart.test.js and the run trace covering one full-suite run plus two separate isolated runs. Apply the supplied fixture isolation policy to identify shared-state contamination. Answer four questions. Then write a concise evidence-based handover (around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese) explaining the root cause, the required fixture contract and the next verification steps.
