body.en: Each test must obtain a fresh fixture from makeCartFixture() inside beforeEach. Module-level mutable state is prohibited. Resetting a shared array in afterEach or at the start of a test does not satisfy isolation because a later test could still observe residual state if the reset is skipped or fails. Inline array literals inside a test are not permitted because the factory also supplies the required metadata. Acceptance requires every observed_items_length to equal expected_items_length in both the isolated runs and the full-suite run for t1, t2 and t3.
body.zh: 每個測試必須在 beforeEach 內從 makeCartFixture() 取得全新測試資料。禁止模組層級可變狀態。在 afterEach 或測試開始時重設共享陣列並不滿足隔離，因為若重設被跳過或失敗，後續測試仍可能觀察到殘留狀態。不允許在測試內使用行內陣列字面量，因為工廠同時提供所需元數據。接納要求：在 t1、t2 及 t3 的隔離執行及完整套件執行中，每個 observed_items_length 均等於 expected_items_length。

exemplar.en:
Handover: cart fixture contamination

Decision: replace the module-level const items = []; with a per-test fixture from makeCartFixture() assigned inside beforeEach. This follows the simulated fixture isolation policy and removes order dependence.

Evidence: in cart.test.js the array is declared once at module scope and addItem mutates that array. In trace.csv run-01, t1 observes length 1, t2 observes 2 while expecting 1, and t3 observes 3 while expecting 1. The isolated runs show run-02 t2 passing with observed length 1 and the separate run-03 t3 passing with observed length 1, confirming the shared state is the cause.

Risk: other test files may share module-level fixtures. I have not executed the proposed fix or inspected production code.

Next steps: apply the beforeEach factory change, re-run each test alone and the full suite, confirm every observed_items_length equals expected_items_length, and add a regression test with two independent fixtures.

證據：在 cart.test.js 中，陣列在模組層級宣告一次，而 addItem 會變異該陣列。在 trace.csv run-01 中，t1 觀察長度 1，t2 觀察 2 但預期 1，t3 觀察 3 但預期 1。隔離執行顯示 run-02 的 t2 通過且觀察長度 1，以及獨立分開的 run-03 的 t3 通過且觀察長度 1，確認共享狀態就是原因。

風險：其他測試檔案可能共用模組層級測試資料。我沒有執行建議修正，也沒有檢查生產程式碼。

title.zh: 虛構客戶反饋編碼指引

body.en:
Fictional internal learning simulation. This codebook defines single-label categories with strict precedence for coding anonymized customer feedback excerpts about test report delivery.

Categories:
ACC (Accuracy): excerpt refers to correctness, completeness, or accuracy of test results or report data.
TML (Timeliness): excerpt refers to time taken to deliver the report, meeting a deadline, or delay in receiving results.
COM (Communication): excerpt refers to how clearly staff explained results, answered queries, or communicated findings.
OTH (Other): excerpt does not refer to ACC, TML, or COM.

Precedence rule: When an excerpt meets more than one category, assign the single highest-precedence category using this order: ACC > TML > COM > OTH. If no category applies, assign OTH. Every excerpt receives exactly one final label.

Reconciliation: Compare the current label in the data file against the final label from this codebook. If they differ, the excerpt requires a label change.
body.zh:
虛構內部學習模擬。此編碼指引為關於測試報告交付的匿名客戶反饋摘錄定義單一標籤類別，並設嚴格優先次序。

類別：
ACC（準確性）：摘錄提及測試結果或報告數據的正確性、完整性或準確度。
TML（時效性）：摘錄提及交付報告所需時間、符合截止日期或延遲收到結果。
COM（溝通）：摘錄提及員工解釋結果、回答查詢或傳達發現的清晰度。
OTH（其他）：摘錄沒有提及 ACC、TML 或 COM。

優先規則：當摘錄符合多於一個類別時，按 ACC > TML > COM > OTH 的次序分配單一最高優先類別。若無類別適用，分配 OTH。每段摘錄只獲一個最終標籤。

核對：將數據檔案中的現有標籤與本指引得出的最終標籤比較。若不同，該摘錄需要更改標籤。

feedback.zh: 四條答案全部正確。E03 按優先規則為 ACC，E04 為 TML，需更改標籤的組合（E01、E03、E04、E06）正確，最終 ACC 數目為 3。你逐段列出的最終編碼亦與編碼指引完全一致。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to the supplied excerpt wording and category definitions, citing E03 wrong sample ID versus late results, E04 long turnaround versus clear explanation, and E06 complete report versus on time, and you justify E05 as OTH because an invoice issue falls outside all three categories.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連繫到提供的摘錄文字及類別定義，引用 E03 的錯誤樣本編號對比延遲結果、E04 的較長處理時間對比清晰解釋、E06 的完整報告對比準時，並以發票問題不屬三個類別為由把 E05 合理定為 OTH。

feedback.en: Your next step of having a second coder independently apply the codebook to all six excerpts and compare labels is concrete and tests the requirement. To strengthen it, add how disagreements will be logged and resolved, and confirm the precedence order ACC > TML > COM > OTH was checked for the mixed excerpts.
feedback.zh: 你提出由第二位編碼員獨立對全部六段摘錄應用編碼指引並比較標籤，具體且能測試要求。可再加強：說明如何記錄及解決分歧，並確認已就混合類別的摘錄檢查 ACC > TML > COM > OTH 的優先次序。

feedback.en: You correctly frame this as a fictional simulation with no real certification decisions and note E05 is the only OTH excerpt. You could also state explicitly that the excerpts are synthetic and anonymized and that conclusions are limited to the supplied codebook and CSV.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出此為虛構模擬、不涉及真實認證決策，並說明 E05 是唯一 OTH 摘錄。可再明確指出摘錄屬合成及匿名，結論僅限於提供的編碼指引及 CSV。

feedback.en: The handover is concise, well within the suggested length, and a second coder can act on it directly with the per-excerpt codes, changes, evidence and next step clearly stated. Ownership sits with the second coder, which is appropriate for a taster task.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔，遠在建議長度之內，第二位編碼員可直接跟隨，逐段編碼、需更改標籤、證據及下一步均清楚列明。責任歸於第二位編碼員，對體驗任務而言合適。

summary.en: Excellent submission. The codes, change set and ACC count are all correct, with reasoning anchored to specific excerpt IDs and the precedence rule. Scope is openly limited to a fictional, synthetic scenario. Minor gains available in documenting how coder disagreements are logged and explicitly confirming the precedence check.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。編碼、需更改標籤的組合及 ACC 數目全部正確，推理緊扣具體摘錄編號及優先規則，並公開把範圍限於虛構合成情境。仍可略為補充如何記錄編碼員分歧，以及明確確認已檢查優先次序。

nextSteps.en: Add one line on how a second coder's disagreements will be recorded and escalated to the Quality Research Lead, and confirm the precedence order was verified for every mixed-category excerpt.
nextSteps.zh: 補上一句說明第二位編碼員的分歧將如何記錄並轉交品質研究主管，並確認已就每段混合類別摘錄核實優先次序。

title.en: Reconcile Multiple Labels in Synthetic Test Report Feedback
title.zh: 核對合成測試報告反饋的多重標籤

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by STC, not endorsed by it. You are a research analyst reviewing qualitative coding for a synthetic customer feedback study on test report delivery. Use the supplied multiple-label codebook to determine the correct final label set for each anonymized excerpt. Reconcile the current labels in the CSV against your findings. Answer the four questions and produce a concise evidence-based handover (around 100-180 English words or comparable Traditional Chinese) summarising your reconciliation decisions, the evidence from specific excerpt IDs, any uncertainty, and next steps for a second coder to verify.
brief.zh: 受 STC 啟發的虛構學習模擬，未獲其認可。您是一名研究分析師，為合成客戶反饋研究審查質性編碼，研究關於測試報告交付。使用提供的多重標籤編碼指引，為每段匿名摘錄確定正確的最終標籤集。根據您的發現核對 CSV 中的現有標籤。回答四條問題並撰寫簡潔的實證交接（約 100 至 180 英文詞或相若中文），概述您的核對決策、來自具體摘錄編號的證據、任何不確定性，以及由第二位編碼員核實的下一步。

title.en: Fictional Test Report Feedback Codebook (Multiple Labels)
title.zh: 虛構測試報告反饋編碼指引（多重標籤）

body.en:
Fictional internal learning simulation. This codebook defines multiple-label categories for coding anonymized customer feedback excerpts about test report delivery. An excerpt may receive one or more labels if it clearly addresses multiple categories. The final label set consists of all applicable categories. Order of labels does not matter.

Categories:
ACC (Accuracy): refers to correctness, completeness, or accuracy of test results or report data.
TML (Timeliness): refers to time taken to deliver the report, meeting a deadline, or delay in receiving results.
COM (Communication): refers to how clearly staff explained results, answered queries, or communicated findings.
OTH (Other): does not refer to ACC, TML, or COM.

Reconciliation rule: Compare the current label set in the data file with the final label set from this codebook. If they differ (missing or extra labels), the excerpt requires a label change. Each excerpt receives one final label set. If no category applies, assign OTH.
body.zh:
虛構內部學習模擬。此編碼指引為關於測試報告交付的匿名客戶反饋摘錄定義多重標籤類別。若摘錄明確涉及多個類別，可獲得多個標籤。最終標籤集由所有適用類別組成。標籤次序不重要。

類別：
ACC（準確性）：提及測試結果或報告數據的正確性、完整性或準確度。
TML（時效性）：提及交付報告所需時間、符合截止日期或延遲收到結果。
COM（溝通）：提及員工解釋結果、回答查詢或傳達發現的清晰度。
OTH（其他）：沒有提及 ACC、TML 或 COM。

核對規則：將數據檔案中的現有標籤集與本指引得出的最終標籤集比較。若不同（缺失或多餘標籤），該摘錄需要更改標籤。每段摘錄獲得一個最終標籤集。若無類別適用，分配 OTH。

title.en: Anonymized Feedback Excerpts and Current Labels
title.zh: 匿名反饋摘錄及現有標籤

body.en:
CSV format. Columns: id, excerpt, current_label. All excerpts are synthetic and anonymized.

id,excerpt,current_label
E01,"The report was accurate and arrived on time.",ACC
E02,"The staff explained the results clearly, but the report had a missing page.",COM
E03,"The sample ID was correct and the turnaround time met the deadline.",TML
E04,"The invoice was incorrect.",OTH
E05,"The results were accurate and the staff answered my questions promptly.","ACC,COM"
E06,"The report was delivered late and the explanation was unclear.",TML

Explanation: The current_label column shows the label(s) assigned by a previous coder. Some labels may be missing or incorrect according to the codebook and require reconciliation. Multiple labels are separated by a comma without spaces.

CSV 格式。欄位：id、excerpt、current_label。所有摘錄均為合成及匿名。

title.en: Bound a missing-data result for batch SB-2026-04
title.zh: 界定批次 SB-2026-04 的缺失資料結果

brief.en: This independent learning simulation is inspired by STC, a real Hong Kong testing and certification organisation, and is not endorsed by it. Review synthetic paper records for batch SB-2026-04. The QC log reports planned observations, observed PASS and FAIL counts, and missing result records. Apply fictional policy QC-MISS-01 to calculate supported lower and upper PASS-rate bounds, decide whether the batch meets the supported acceptance condition, and explain missing-record assumptions. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Do not propose lab work, chemical tests or real certification decisions.
brief.zh: 這是一項受真實香港測試及認證機構 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並未獲其認可。請審閱批次 SB-2026-04 的合成文件紀錄。品質控制紀錄列出計劃觀察數、已觀察的 PASS 及 FAIL 數量，以及缺失結果紀錄。按虛構政策 QC-MISS-01 計算支持下限及上限的合格率，判斷批次是否符合支持接納條件，並解釋缺失紀錄假設。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔及有證據支持的交接說明。不要提出實驗室工作、化學測試或真實認證決定。

title.en: Fictional policy QC-MISS-01 for supported bounds
title.zh: 用於支持界限的虛構政策 QC-MISS-01

body.en: Fictional simulation policy QC-MISS-01. A result is binary PASS or FAIL. A missing record has no recorded PASS or FAIL value. For supported bounds, the lower bound treats every missing record as FAIL and the upper bound treats every missing record as PASS. Do not use an observed-only rate or midpoint imputation. Report pass rates as percentages rounded to one decimal place. Supported acceptance requires the lower-bound pass rate to be at least 65.0%. Do not report confidence intervals or causal claims from these records.

exemplar.en: Decision: batch SB-2026-04 is not accepted within the supported range. The data table (M01-M05) gives 60 planned observations, 29 observed PASS, 13 observed FAIL and 18 missing results. Under policy QC-MISS-01, the lower bound counts all 18 missing records as FAIL, so the lower-bound PASS rate is 29 / 60 = 48.3%. The upper bound counts all 18 missing records as PASS, so the upper-bound PASS rate is (29 + 18) / 60 = 47 / 60 = 78.3%. The supported acceptance rule requires the lower bound to be at least 65.0%. Because 48.3% is below 65.0%, acceptance is not supported. Risk: the observed-only rate of 69.0% is not a supported bound. Next step: Quality records lead should verify which record IDs are missing and whether any later corrected entries exist. This is a fictional paper exercise only.

title.en: Bound mean ratings for batch SB-2026-05
title.zh: 界定批次 SB-2026-05 的平均評分界限

brief.en: This independent learning simulation is inspired by STC, a real Hong Kong testing and certification organisation, and is not endorsed by it. Review synthetic paper records for batch SB-2026-05. The QC log reports planned observations, observed rating counts on a 1 to 5 scale, and missing rating records. Apply fictional policy QC-MISS-02 to calculate supported lower and upper mean-rating bounds, decide whether the batch meets the supported acceptance condition, and explain missing-record assumptions. Prepare a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese. Do not propose lab work, chemical tests or real certification decisions.
brief.zh: 這是一項受真實香港測試及認證機構 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並未獲其認可。請審閱批次 SB-2026-05 的合成文件紀錄。品質控制紀錄列出計劃觀察數、1 至 5 的觀察評分數量，以及缺失評分紀錄。按虛構政策 QC-MISS-02 計算支持下限及上限的平均評分界限，判斷批次是否符合支持接納條件，並解釋缺失紀錄假設。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫簡潔及有證據支持的交接說明。不要提出實驗室工作、化學測試或真實認證決定。

title.en: Fictional policy QC-MISS-02 for bounded rating bounds
title.zh: 用於有界評分界限的虛構政策 QC-MISS-02

body.en: Fictional simulation policy QC-MISS-02. Ratings are integers from 1 to 5 inclusive. A missing record has no rating. For supported bounds, the lower bound assigns every missing rating the minimum value 1 and the upper bound assigns every missing rating the maximum value 5. Compute the mean rating by dividing the total sum of supported ratings by the planned observation count. Report mean ratings to two decimal places. Supported acceptance requires the lower-bound mean rating to be at least 3.50. Do not use an observed-only mean, midpoint imputation, confidence intervals or causal claims.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策 QC-MISS-02。評分為 1 至 5 的整數（含 1 及 5）。缺失紀錄沒有評分。就支持界限而言，下限將每項缺失評分設為最小值 1，上限將每項缺失評分設為最大值 5。計算平均評分時，將支持評分的總和除以計劃觀察數。平均評分報告至小數兩位。支持接納要求下限平均評分至少為 3.50。不要使用只計觀察值的平均數、中點插補、信賴區間或因果聲明。此政策僅供此虛構模擬使用。

Suggests a next action such as requesting recovery of missing records or escalating to quality lead if lower bound fails acceptance.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查：驗證計劃數量等於觀察及缺失數量之和（36+14=50），從評分數量重新計算觀察總和，並確認四捨五入至小數兩位。建議下一步行動，例如要求補回缺失紀錄，或若下限未達接納標準則上報品質主管。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Acknowledges that missing records prevent a single definitive mean and that bounds depend on the explicit worst-case and best-case assumptions in policy QC-MISS-02. Limits claims to the fictional simulation and avoids confidence intervals or causal claims.
expectedEvidence.zh: 承認缺失紀錄無法得出單一確定平均數，界限取決於政策 QC-MISS-02 的明確最壞及最佳假設。將聲明限於虛構模擬，避免信賴區間或因果聲明。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover stating lower-bound mean 2.38, upper-bound mean 3.50, decision do not accept because lower bound below 3.50, evidence from M01-M07, and next steps. Uses clear headings and is actionable.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，列明下限平均 2.38、上限平均 3.50、決定為不接納因為下限低於 3.50、來自 M01-M07 的證據及下一步。使用清晰標題並可行。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Batch SB-2026-05 planned 50 observations. Observed rating counts: 1→6, 2→8, 3→10, 4→7, 5→5, total observed 36. Missing rating records: 14 (M07). Observed sum = 6*1 + 8*2 + 10*3 + 7*4 + 5*5 = 105. Decision and calculations: Under QC-MISS-02, lower bound treats 14 missing as 1, so total sum = 105 + 14 = 119, mean = 119/50 = 2.38. Upper bound treats 14 missing as 5, so total sum = 105 + 70 = 175, mean = 175/50 = 3.50. Acceptance requires lower-bound mean at least 3.50, so decision is do not accept. Risks: Missing records prevent a single definitive mean and bounds rely on worst-case and best-case assumptions. Upper bound exactly meets 3.50 but lower bound fails. Next steps: Verify planned count 50 = 36 observed + 14 missing. Request recovery of missing records. Escalate to quality lead if unresolved. This is a fictional simulation inspired by STC and not endorsed by it.
exemplar.zh: 證據：批次 SB-2026-05 計劃 50 項觀察。觀察評分數量：1→6、2→8、3→10、4→7、5→5，觀察總數 36。缺失評分紀錄：14（M07）。觀察總和 = 6*1 + 8*2 + 10*3 + 7*4 + 5*5 = 105。決策與計算：按 QC-MISS-02，下限將 14 項缺失計為 1，總和 = 105 + 14 = 119，平均 = 119/50 = 2.38。上限將 14 項缺失計為 5，總和 = 105 + 70 = 175，平均 = 175/50 = 3.50。接納要求下限平均至少 3.50，因此決定為不接納。風險：缺失紀錄無法得出單一確定平均數，界限依賴最壞及最佳假設。上限恰好達到 3.50 但下限未達。下一步：驗證計劃數量 50 = 36 觀察 + 14 缺失。要求補回缺失紀錄。若未解決則上報品質主管。此為受 STC 啟發的虛構模擬，並未獲其認可。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct: lower-bound mean 2.38 (119/50), upper-bound mean 3.50 (175/50), do-not-accept-lower-below, and the min-1/max-5 missing assumption. Policy QC-MISS-02 is applied exactly with no sign of observed-only mean or midpoint imputation.
feedback.zh: 四項答案全部正確：下限平均 2.38（119/50）、上限平均 3.50（175/50）、不接納（下限低於標準），以及缺失計為下限 1 上限 5 的假設。政策 QC-MISS-02 應用準確，未見只計觀察值或中點插補。

feedback.en: Evidence is well grounded: you cite planned 50 observations, the observed counts 6/8/10/7/5, the observed total of 36, missing 14 (M07), and show the observed sum 105, lower 119 and upper 175. The link from each figure to the resulting bound is clear and traceable.
feedback.zh: 證據充分：你引用計劃 50 項觀察、觀察數量 6/8/10/7/5、觀察總數 36、缺失 14（M07），並展示觀察總和 105、下限 119、上限 175。每個數字與所得界限的連結清晰可追溯。

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete: confirming 36 observed plus 14 missing equals the planned 50, requesting recovery of missing records, and escalating to the quality lead if unresolved. A short note confirming the two-decimal rounding and recomputing the observed sum from the counts would make the check set fully complete.
feedback.zh: 你的檢查具體可行：確認觀察 36 加缺失 14 等於計劃 50、要求補回缺失紀錄、若未解決則上報品質主管。若補上一句確認四捨五入至小數兩位並由評分數量重算觀察總和，檢查將更完整。

feedback.en: You correctly state that missing records prevent a single definitive mean and that the bounds rest on worst-case and best-case assumptions, and you flag that the upper bound only just meets 3.50. The claim is properly limited to the fictional simulation with no causal or confidence-interval overreach.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出缺失紀錄無法得出單一確定平均數，界限依賴最壞及最佳假設，並指出上限僅恰好達到 3.50。聲明已適當地限於虛構模擬，沒有因果或信賴區間的超額推論。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, giving both bounds, the decision, the M01-M07 evidence and clear next steps under labelled headings. Ownership and escalation are named via the quality lead. No further changes needed.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明兩個界限、決定、M01-M07 證據及清晰下一步，並以標題分節。責任及轉交已指明品質主管。無需進一步修改。

summary.en: Excellent submission. All four decisions are correct, the arithmetic (105 observed sum, 119 lower total, 175 upper total) is accurate and fully sourced to records M01-M07, and the do-not-accept decision follows directly from the lower bound of 2.38 falling below the 3.50 threshold. Scope is honest about the missing records and the handover is clear and actionable.
summary.zh: 整體表現優異。四項決定全部正確，運算（觀察總和 105、下限總和 119、上限總和 175）準確並完整引用 M01-M07 紀錄，不接納的決定直接源於下限 2.38 低於 3.50 門檻。範圍說明對缺失紀錄誠實，交接清晰可行。

nextSteps.en: If you extend this work, add one line confirming the two-decimal rounding rule and recomputing the observed sum from the rating counts as a double check, and state a target date for the missing-record recovery request so the escalation has a trigger. The core analysis is already sound.
nextSteps.zh: 若要延伸此工作，可補上一句確認四捨五入至小數兩位的規則，並由評分數量重算觀察總和作覆核，同時為補回缺失紀錄的要求訂下目標日期，使上報有明確觸發點。核心分析本身已相當穩妥。

title.en: Trace draft claims to report sources
title.zh: 追溯草擬聲明至來源報告

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by STC. It is not endorsed by STC. All reports, claims and staff are fictional. You are a research analyst asked to check a short draft memo against the supplied fictional report register and citation policy. Identify any misattributed citation, select the correct current source, decide which claims remain valid, and answer one register value. Then write a concise evidence-based handover for the fictional team lead. Do not make any real certification decision.
brief.zh: 這是一項受 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 STC 認可。所有報告、聲明及人員均為虛構。你是研究分析師，須按提供的虛構報告登記冊及引用政策，核對一份簡短草擬備忘。找出錯誤引用的來源，選出正確的最新報告，判斷哪些聲明仍然有效，並回答一項登記冊數值。然後為虛構團隊主管撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接說明。不得作出任何真實認證決定。

title.zh: 虛構引用及範圍政策

body.en: Rules for this simulation. A claim is supported only when its cited report ID has a current status and the report sample_category and test_parameter match the claim exactly. The cited version must be the current version in the register. If the report ID exists but its category or parameter differs, the citation is misattributed. If no current report matches, label the claim unsupported. Surface coating claims must state the surface coating qualifier.
body.zh: 本模擬的規則。只有當引用的報告編號狀態為最新，且報告的樣本類別及測試參數與聲明完全一致時，該聲明才獲支持。引用版本必須是登記冊中的最新版本。若報告編號存在但類別或參數不同，即屬錯誤引用。若無最新報告吻合，須標示該聲明不獲支持。表面塗層聲明必須註明表面塗層限定語。

nextSteps.en: Extend the verification section to name the register columns you would re-check, including version, status and issuing unit, and add an escalation step to the team lead for any claim lacking a matching current report.

title.zh: 追溯草擬聲明至報告版本及限定語

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by STC. It is not endorsed by STC. All reports, claims and people are fictional. You are a research analyst reviewing a draft claim memo against a supplied report register and the fictional version and qualifier policy. Decide which claim is outdated and lacks the required qualifier, which corrections the memo needs, and one register value. Then write a concise evidence-based handover for the fictional team lead. No real certification decision is made.
brief.zh: 這是一項受 STC 啟發的獨立學習模擬，未獲 STC 認可。所有報告、聲明及人員均為虛構。你是研究分析師，須按提供的虛構報告登記冊及版本與限定語政策，審閱一份虛構草擬聲明備忘。判斷哪項聲明屬過時並缺少所需限定語、該備忘需要哪些更正，以及一項登記冊數值。然後為虛構團隊主管撰寫簡潔且基於證據的交接說明。不得作出任何真實認證決定。

title.zh: 虛構版本及限定語政策

body.en: This is a fictional training policy for the simulation. A claim is supported only when the cited report_id row has status current and the cited version equals the current version in the register. If the cited version is superseded, the claim is outdated and must be updated to the current version value. Any claim about a toy surface coating must include the exact qualifier surface coating. If the qualifier is missing, the claim is incomplete. The report sample_category and test_parameter must match the claim exactly.
body.zh: 這是本模擬的虛構訓練政策。只有當引用的 report_id 該行狀態為 current，且引用版本等於登記冊中的最新版本時，聲明才獲支持。若引用版本為 superseded，該聲明即屬過時，必須更新為最新版本數值。任何關於玩具表面塗層的聲明，必須包含確切限定語 surface coating。若缺少限定語，該聲明即屬不完整。報告的 sample_category 及 test_parameter 必須與聲明完全一致。

exemplar.en: The memo has two outdated claims and one missing qualifier. C-11 cites RPT-207 v1, which is superseded. The current row is RPT-207 v2 with lead 58 mg/kg. C-11 also omits the required qualifier surface coating, so it is incomplete. C-13 cites RPT-219 v3, which is superseded. The current row is RPT-219 v4 with phthalates 0.08 %. C-12 and C-14 need no change because their cited versions are current and their categories and parameters match. The current cadmium value for toy surface coating is 15 mg/kg from RPT-231 v2. Next steps: update C-11 and C-13, add the qualifier to C-11, confirm wording with the fictional team lead, and record that this is a training simulation only. No certification decision is made.
exemplar.zh: 該備忘有兩項過時聲明及一項缺少限定語。C-11 引用 RPT-207 v1，該版本已被取代。最新行為 RPT-207 v2，鉛 58 mg/kg。C-11 亦省略所需限定語 surface coating，故屬不完整。C-13 引用 RPT-219 v3，該版本已被取代。最新行為 RPT-219 v4，鄰苯二甲酸酯 0.08 %。C-12 及 C-14 無須改動，因其引用版本為最新，且類別及參數吻合。玩具表面塗層的最新鎘數值為 RPT-231 v2 的 15 mg/kg。下一步：更新 C-11 及 C-13，為 C-11 加上限定語，與虛構團隊主管確認措辭，並記錄此為訓練模擬。並無作出認證決定。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: C-11 as the outdated claim missing the surface coating qualifier, C-13 current at RPT-219 v4 with 0.08 %, the exact two-item correction set, and 15 mg/kg for cadmium. No errors detected.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：C-11 為過時且缺少 surface coating 限定語的聲明、C-13 最新為 RPT-219 v4、0.08 %、僅含兩項的更正組合，以及鎘 15 mg/kg。未發現錯誤。

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to specific rows: RPT-207 v1 superseded versus v2 current 58, RPT-219 v3 superseded versus v4 current 0.08, and RPT-231 v2 for cadmium. It also correctly justifies why C-12 and C-14 need no change because their versions are current and categories and parameters match.
feedback.zh: 推理緊扣具體記錄行：RPT-207 v1 已取代對比 v2 最新 58、RPT-219 v3 已取代對比 v4 最新 0.08，以及 RPT-231 v2 的鎘值。同時正確說明 C-12 及 C-14 無須改動，因其版本為最新且類別及參數吻合。

feedback.en: The next steps cover updating C-11 and C-13, adding the surface coating qualifier, and confirming wording with the fictional team lead. Adding an explicit instruction to re-verify the status and version fields against the register before restating any value would strengthen the check.
feedback.zh: 下一步涵蓋更新 C-11 及 C-13、加上 surface coating 限定語，以及與虛構團隊主管確認措辭。若能明確加入在重述任何數值前再次核對 status 及 version 欄位的檢查，會更完整。

feedback.en: Scope is bounded well by noting this is a training simulation only and that no certification decision is made. The reliance on the supplied register and policy as the only authoritative source is implied through the citations.
feedback.zh: 範圍界定良好，指出此僅為訓練模擬且並無作出認證決定。經引用已隱含以提供登記冊及政策為唯一權威來源。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and concise at 122 words, stating decisions, corrected values with source rows, both outdated claims, the missing qualifier, and next steps for the team lead. It is immediately actionable for the stated owner.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰簡潔，共 122 字，列明決策、附來源行的更正後數值、兩項過時聲明、缺少的限定語，以及給團隊主管的下一步，對指定負責人即時可行。

summary.en: An excellent submission. All four structured decisions are correct and the written handover matches the required evidence, reasoning and scope with clear next steps for the fictional team lead. No substantive gaps found.
summary.zh: 表現優秀。四項結構化決策全部正確，書面交接符合所需的證據、推理及範圍，並為虛構團隊主管提供清晰下一步。未發現實質缺漏。

nextSteps.en: No corrections needed. To extend the work, add an explicit check step to re-verify the status and version fields against the register before any value is restated, and note the escalation path for unresolved version conflicts.

title.zh: 審查復原證據

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE, not endorsed by the company. You are a security analyst reviewing a fictional recovery report for the SHOPLINE commerce platform. A recent incident recovery was performed. Your manager asks you to compare the recovery log and the team lead's message against the public recovery verification policy. Identify any failures in completeness, integrity or timing. Then answer four questions and prepare a concise handover for your manager. The handover must state your decisions, supporting evidence, any missing evidence and next steps. Use the supplied sources only.
brief.zh: 這是一項受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。你是一名資訊保安分析師，正在審查 SHOPLINE 商貿平台的一份虛構復原報告。最近進行了一次事故復原。你的主管要求你根據公開的復原驗證政策，比較復原記錄和團隊主管的訊息。識別在完整性、資料完整性或時效性方面的任何失敗。然後回答四條問題，並為你的主管準備一份簡潔的交接。交接必須說明你的決策、支持證據、任何缺失證據及下一步。僅使用提供的來源。

title.zh: 復原驗證政策

body.en: This fictional policy applies to all recovery reports for the SHOPLINE commerce platform. Completeness: every table in the backup manifest must have a verification record. A missing verification record means the recovery is incomplete. Integrity: for each verified table, the actual checksum must equal the expected checksum. Timing: recovery must complete within 120 minutes from the start time. If any requirement fails, the report must not be signed off. Missing verification must be resolved by obtaining the record or re-running verification. If unresolved, escalate to the security analyst.
body.zh: 本虛構政策適用於 SHOPLINE 商貿平台的所有復原報告。完整性：備份清單中的每個資料表都必須有驗證記錄。缺少驗證記錄即表示復原不完整。資料完整性：對於每個已驗證的資料表，實際校驗和必須等於預期校驗和。時效性：復原必須在開始時間後 120 分鐘內完成。如果任何要求未滿足，報告不得簽核。缺少驗證必須通過獲取記錄或重新執行驗證來解決。如果無法解決，請上報至資訊保安分析師。

exemplar.en: The recovery report is incomplete. The policy requires every table in the backup manifest to have a verification record. The recovery log shows that table T4 (inventory) has an empty verification_status, meaning no verification record exists. This is a completeness failure. Integrity and timing requirements are met: all verified tables have matching checksums, and all recovery times are under 120 minutes. The team lead's message claiming all five tables were verified is incorrect. Next steps: obtain the missing verification record for T4 or re-run verification for T4 only. If this cannot be resolved, escalate to the security analyst. Do not sign off the report until completeness is achieved.
exemplar.zh: 復原報告不完整。政策要求備份清單中的每個資料表都必須有驗證記錄。復原記錄顯示資料表 T4（inventory）的 verification_status 為空，表示沒有驗證記錄。這是完整性失敗。資料完整性和時效性要求均已滿足：所有已驗證的資料表校驗和匹配，且所有復原時間均低於 120 分鐘。團隊主管聲稱所有五個資料表均已驗證的訊息不正確。下一步：取得 T4 缺少的驗證記錄，或僅重新執行 T4 的驗證。如果無法解決，請上報至資訊保安分析師。在完整性達成之前，請勿簽核報告。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You identified T4 as the unverified table, selected completeness as the failed requirement, calculated T4 elapsed time as 105 minutes (09:15Z to 11:00Z), and chose obtaining the verification record plus escalation as the required actions.

feedback.en: You grounded each conclusion in the supplied sources, citing the policy completeness rule and T4's empty verification_status in the recovery log. You also correctly flagged that the team lead's message wrongly claims all five tables were verified.
feedback.zh: 你把每項結論連結至提供的來源，引用政策的完整性規則及復原記錄中 T4 的空 verification_status。你亦正確指出團隊主管的訊息錯誤地聲稱所有五個資料表均已驗證。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete and policy-aligned, proposing the missing T4 record or re-running verification for T4 only, then escalating if unresolved. The instruction not to sign off until completeness is achieved is a useful control check.

feedback.en: You correctly limited the failure to completeness and did not assert integrity or timing failures, noting checksums match and times fall under 120 minutes. The scenario scope is kept appropriately narrow.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把失敗限於完整性，並未聲稱資料完整性或時效性失敗，指出校驗和匹配且時間低於 120 分鐘。情境範圍保持適度收窄。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, stating the decisions, supporting evidence, the incorrect message claim, and next steps with escalation ownership. A manager could act on this directly.

summary.en: This is a complete, accurate submission. All four structured answers are correct and your written reasoning ties every decision to the policy rule and the recovery log while correctly challenging the team lead's inaccurate claim. No material gaps were found.
summary.zh: 這是一份完整且準確的提交。四條結構化答案全部正確，你的書面推理把每項決策連結至政策規則及復原記錄，並正確質疑團隊主管的不準確聲明。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: Continue applying this same practice of cross-checking structured claims against raw records. For future reports, you could also note explicitly that duration is not given in the log and that elapsed times are derived from the start and end timestamps, making your calculation method even more transparent.
nextSteps.zh: 繼續以同樣做法把結構化聲明與原始記錄互相核對。日後報告可明確指出記錄未提供持續時間，經過時間是由開始及結束時間戳推導，令你的計算方法更透明。

title.zh: 審查復原證據

brief.en: This is an independent learning simulation inspired by SHOPLINE, not endorsed by the company. You are a security analyst on a fictional commerce platform. A recovery report has arrived with a verification policy, a verification log and a message from the recovery team lead. Compare all three, decide whether the report meets the completeness, integrity and timing gates, then answer four questions and write a short evidence-based handover of about 100 to 180 English words, or comparable Traditional Chinese, to your manager with your decision, evidence, missing evidence and next steps. Use only the supplied sources.
brief.zh: 這是一項受 SHOPLINE 啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。你是一名虛構商貿平台的資訊保安分析師。一份復原報告連同驗證政策、驗證記錄及復原團隊主管的訊息送到。請比較三份文件，判斷該報告是否通過完整性、資料完整性及時效性關卡，然後回答四條問題，並撰寫約 100 至 180 個英文詞、或相若繁體中文的簡短證據交接，向主管說明你的決策、證據、缺失證據及下一步。只可使用提供的來源。

title.zh: 虛構復原驗證政策 rev 4

body.en: This fictional policy applies to every fictional recovery report for the SHOPLINE commerce platform. Gate 1 completeness: every table in the backup manifest must appear in the verification log with verification_status equal to verified. Gate 2 integrity: checksum_actual must equal checksum_expected character for character, and the comparison is case-sensitive. Gate 3 timing: elapsed_minutes = end_offset_minutes minus start_offset_minutes must be at most 45 minutes for every table. A report may be signed off only when all three gates pass. A table failing integrity must be restored again from the backup and a new checksum recorded. A table failing timing must be re-run within the limit. Failures still unresolved at the end of the incident window are escalated to the incident manager. The report must not be signed off while any gate fails.
body.zh: 本虛構政策適用於 SHOPLINE 商貿平台的每份虛構復原報告。關卡 1 完整性：備份清單中每個資料表都必須在驗證記錄中出現，且 verification_status 等於 verified。關卡 2 資料完整性：checksum_actual 必須逐字元等於 checksum_expected，比較區分大小寫。關卡 3 時效性：每個資料表的 elapsed_minutes = end_offset_minutes 減 start_offset_minutes，必須不超過 45 分鐘。只有在三個關卡全部通過時，報告才可簽核。資料完整性不合格的資料表必須從備份重新還原並記錄新的校驗和。時效性不合格的資料表必須在限時內重新執行。事故窗口結束時仍未解決的失敗事項上報至事故經理。任何關卡未通過時，報告不得簽核。

title.zh: 復原團隊主管更新

body.en: From: Recovery Team Lead. To: Security Analyst. Subject: Recovery complete, please approve. The fictional recovery for the SHOPLINE commerce platform is complete. All five tables were restored and every one has a verification record marked verified. The checksums match and each table finished well inside the 45-minute limit. The recovery team has completed all steps and we are ready to close the incident. Please approve sign-off today.
body.zh: 來自：復原團隊主管。致：資訊保安分析師。主旨：復原完成，請批准。SHOPLINE 商貿平台的虛構復原已完成。所有五個資料表均已還原，而且每個都有標示為 verified 的驗證記錄。校驗和相符，每個資料表都在 45 分鐘限時內完成。復原團隊已完成所有步驟，我們已準備好關閉事故。請於今日批准簽核。

label.en: Using the policy gates and the recovery log, which complete set of tables fails at least one requirement?
label.zh: 根據政策關卡及復原記錄，哪一組資料表完整地涵蓋了至少未通過一項要求的資料表？

label.en: What is the elapsed recovery time in minutes for table T4?
label.zh: 資料表 T4 的復原經過時間為多少分鐘？

label.en: Which statement about the recovery team lead's message is correct?
label.zh: 關於復原團隊主管訊息的哪一項陳述正確？

label.en: The message is inaccurate. T5 has a checksum mismatch and T4 exceeds the 45-minute limit, so sign-off must be refused.
label.zh: 訊息不準確。T5 校驗和不符，T4 超過 45 分鐘限時，因此必須拒絕簽核。

label.en: The message is accurate. All gates pass and the report can be signed off.
label.zh: 訊息準確。所有關卡通過，報告可以簽核。

label.en: The message is inaccurate only because one manifest table has no verification record.
label.zh: 訊息不準確，原因僅為清單中有一個資料表沒有驗證記錄。

label.en: The message is accurate about checksums, and the timing gate applies to the whole recovery rather than to each table.
label.zh: 訊息在校驗和方面準確，而時效性關卡適用於整次復原，而非每個資料表。

label.en: Which next actions does the recovery verification policy require before sign-off?
label.zh: 簽核前，復原驗證政策要求採取哪些下一步行動？

label.en: Restore T5 again from the backup and record a new checksum
label.zh: 再次從備份還原 T5 並記錄新的校驗和

label.en: Re-run the T4 recovery so its elapsed time is within 45 minutes
label.zh: 重新執行 T4 復原，使其經過時間在 45 分鐘內

label.en: Obtain the missing verification record for a manifest table

label.en: Sign off the report now and record the checksum later
label.zh: 現在簽核報告，稍後再記錄校驗和

exemplar.en: Decision: I cannot sign off the fictional recovery report. Completeness passes because all five manifest tables T1 to T5 appear in the log with verification_status verified. Two gates fail. Integrity fails for T5 payments, where checksum_actual q7r8s9t1 does not equal checksum_expected q7r8s9t0. Timing fails for T4 inventory, where end_offset_minutes 70 minus start_offset_minutes 12 gives 58 elapsed minutes against the 45-minute limit. T1, T2 and T3 pass both checked gates with elapsed times of 38, 34 and 32 minutes. The team lead's message is therefore inaccurate on both checksums and timing. Next steps: restore T5 again from the backup and record a matching checksum, re-run the T4 recovery inside 45 minutes, then re-check all three gates against the log. Escalate to the incident manager if either failure is unresolved. This assessment covers only the supplied fictional records, and the log does not pre-record elapsed time, so I calculated it from the supplied offsets.
exemplar.zh: 決定：我不能簽核這份虛構復原報告。完整性通過，因為備份清單中全部五個資料表 T1 至 T5 均以 verification_status verified 出現在記錄中。另有兩個關卡未通過。資料完整性在 T5 payments 未通過，checksum_actual q7r8s9t1 不等於 checksum_expected q7r8s9t0。時效性在 T4 inventory 未通過，end_offset_minutes 70 減 start_offset_minutes 12 得 58 分鐘，超過 45 分鐘限時。T1、T2 及 T3 均通過已檢查的關卡，經過時間分別為 38、34 及 32 分鐘。因此團隊主管的訊息在校驗和及時效性兩方面均不準確。下一步：再次從備份還原 T5 並記錄相符校驗和，在 45 分鐘內重新執行 T4 復原，然後對照記錄重新檢查三個關卡。若任一失敗未解決，上報事故經理。本評估僅涵蓋所提供的虛構記錄，而記錄沒有預先列出經過時間，故我根據提供的偏移量計算。

feedback.en: All three gates are applied correctly. You confirm completeness passes for T1 to T5, integrity fails only for T5 (q7r8s9t1 versus q7r8s9t0), timing fails only for T4 at 58 minutes against the 45-minute limit, and sign-off is refused.
feedback.zh: 三個關卡均應用正確。你確認 T1 至 T5 完整性通過，資料完整性僅 T5 未通過（q7r8s9t1 對比 q7r8s9t0），時效性僅 T4 以 58 分鐘超過 45 分鐘限時而未通過，並拒絕簽核。

feedback.en: Your reasoning cites specific supplied values, including the T5 checksum columns, the T4 offsets 12 and 70 giving 58 minutes, and the T1 to T3 elapsed times of 38, 34 and 32 minutes, then contrasts them with the team lead's claim.
feedback.zh: 你的推理引用具體提供數值，包括 T5 校驗和欄、T4 偏移量 12 及 70 得出 58 分鐘，以及 T1 至 T3 的 38、34、32 分鐘經過時間，並與團隊主管的說法對照。

feedback.en: Next steps are concrete and match the policy: re-restore T5 with a matching checksum, re-run T4 within 45 minutes, re-check all three gates, and escalate unresolved failures to the incident manager while withholding sign-off.
feedback.zh: 下一步具體並符合政策：再次還原 T5 並記錄相符校驗和、在 45 分鐘內重新執行 T4、重新檢查三個關卡，並在未解決時上報事故經理同時不簽核。

feedback.en: You correctly limit the assessment to the supplied fictional records and note that the log does not pre-record elapsed time so it had to be calculated from the offsets. The contradiction with the team lead's message is stated clearly without overclaiming beyond the sources.
feedback.zh: 你正確地把評估限於所提供的虛構記錄，並指出記錄沒有預先列出經過時間，故須由偏移量計算。你清楚指出與團隊主管訊息的矛盾，亦沒有超出來源作過度聲明。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, giving the refusal decision, per-table failing gates with values, the passing completeness gate and T1 to T3 results, required next actions and the escalation owner.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列出拒絕簽核的決定、各資料表未通過的關卡及數值、通過的完整性關卡及 T1 至 T3 結果、所需下一步以及上報責任方。

summary.en: Strong submission. All four answers are correct and the written handover accurately applies the completeness, integrity and timing gates to the fictional log, reaching 58 minutes for T4 and identifying the T5 checksum mismatch, with sign-off correctly refused. The work is within the suggested 100 to 180 English word guidance at 159 words and stays within the supplied sources.
summary.zh: 表現出色。四條答案全部正確，書面交接準確地把完整性、資料完整性及時效性關卡套用於虛構記錄，得出 T4 為 58 分鐘並找出 T5 校驗和不符，並正確拒絕簽核。作品為 159 個英文詞，符合約 100 至 180 詞的建議，且限於所提供的來源。

nextSteps.en: No further work is required for this task. If you extend it, you could add the exact remaining budget note that T4 is 13 minutes over the limit, and name the incident manager escalation path explicitly rather than only the role.
nextSteps.zh: 本任務無需進一步修改。如要延伸，可補充 T4 超限 13 分鐘的具體差距說明，並明確寫出上報事故經理的路徑，而不只是職位名稱。

title.en: Review access log retention for SHOPLINE
title.zh: 審查 SHOPLINE 存取日誌保留

brief.en: You are a security analyst supporting SHOPLINE commerce software (fictional simulation inspired by the real company, not endorsed). Review the synthetic access logs against the retention policy as of query date 2026-03-31. Legal hold takes precedence over every other rule. Classify each record as eligible for deletion or retained, and name the rule you applied. Then write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, covering decisions, arithmetic, evidence and next steps. All records and policies here are fictional and this is not legal advice.
brief.zh: 你是支援 SHOPLINE 商貿軟件的資訊保安分析師（虛構模擬，靈感來自該真實公司，未經背書）。請按保留政策審查合成存取日誌，查詢日期為 2026-03-31。法律保留優先於所有其他規則。請把每筆記錄分類為符合刪除資格或須保留，並說明所適用的規則。然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，涵蓋決策、計算、證據及下一步。此處所有記錄及政策均為虛構，本練習不構成法律意見。

title.en: SHOPLINE Access Log Retention Policy (Fictional Simulation)
title.zh: SHOPLINE 存取日誌保留政策（虛構模擬）

body.en: This fictional simulation policy applies to synthetic access logs only. The query date is 2026-03-31. Each record supplies age_days, the whole-day age at the query date. Precedence, highest first: (1) legal hold, (2) incident-linked extended retention, (3) standard retention. If legal_hold is yes, retain the record regardless of age_days. Otherwise, if incident_linked is yes, retain until age_days is 180 or more. Otherwise retain until age_days is 90 or more. A record is eligible for deletion only when its applicable threshold is met. Thresholds are inclusive. This policy is not legal advice.
body.zh: 本虛構模擬政策僅適用於合成存取日誌。查詢日期為 2026-03-31。每筆記錄直接提供 age_days，即查詢日期當日的整日年齡。優先次序由高至低：(1) 法律保留、(2) 事故相關延長保留、(3) 標準保留。若 legal_hold 為 yes，無論 age_days 為何均須保留該記錄。否則，若 incident_linked 為 yes，則保留至 age_days 達 180 或以上。否則保留至 age_days 達 90 或以上。記錄僅在符合其適用門檻時方符合刪除資格。門檻為包含式。本政策不構成法律意見。

title.zh: 法律保留確認

body.en: From: Legal Operations (fictional). To: Security Analyst. For this review, treat every record with legal_hold set to yes as subject to an active legal hold. No legal hold release events are supplied. Do not delete, schedule deletion for, or queue any legal_hold=yes record, and do not apply the standard or extended age thresholds to those records. The query date is 2026-03-31. This is a synthetic message for learning, not actual legal guidance.
body.zh: 寄件人：法律營運（虛構）。收件人：資訊保安分析師。就本次審查而言，請把每個 legal_hold 為 yes 的記錄視為處於生效法律保留之下。沒有提供任何法律保留釋放事件。不要刪除、安排刪除或排入隊列任何 legal_hold=yes 的記錄，亦不要對這些記錄套用標準或延長年齡門檻。查詢日期為 2026-03-31。本訊息為學習用合成訊息，並非實際法律指引。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.

expectedEvidence.zh: 提出具體檢查，例如重新檢視邊界列 LOG-202（89）及 LOG-204（92），與法律營運確認 LOG-203 及 LOG-206 的保留仍然生效，重新相加 120 MB 及 90 MB 的合資格大小，並確認刪除隊列僅包括 LOG-201 及 LOG-205。

exemplar.en: Deletion review as of 2026-03-31. Policy precedence: legal hold, then incident-linked extended retention at 180 days, then standard retention at 90 days. Next steps: re-read the LOG-202 and LOG-204 boundary rows, confirm both holds with Legal Operations, and queue only LOG-201 and LOG-205. This is a fictional simulation, not legal advice.
exemplar.zh: 截至 2026-03-31 的刪除審查。政策優先次序：法律保留，其次事故相關延長保留 180 天，最後標準保留 90 天。LOG-201 的 age_days 為 137，無法律保留且非事故相關，因此符合 90 天門檻，符合刪除資格，大小 120 MB。LOG-205 的 age_days 為 181 且為事故相關，因此符合 180 天門檻，符合刪除資格，大小 90 MB。合資格總大小為 210 MB。LOG-202（89 天）及 LOG-204（92 天）予以保留，因 LOG-204 需達 180 天。LOG-203（200 MB）及 LOG-206（60 MB）處於法律保留，予以保留，LOG-203 為最大的法律保留記錄。下一步：重新檢視 LOG-202 及 LOG-204 的邊界列，與法律營運確認兩項保留，並僅將 LOG-201 及 LOG-205 排入隊列。此為虛構模擬，並非法律意見。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct and consistent with the policy precedence. LOG-201 (137 days, no hold) and LOG-205 (181 days, incident-linked) are the only deletion-eligible records, totalling 210 MB, and LOG-203 is correctly named as the largest legal-hold record at 200 MB.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確，並符合政策優先次序。LOG-201（137 天，無保留）及 LOG-205（181 天，事故相關）是唯一符合刪除資格的記錄，合計 210 MB，LOG-203 亦正確指出為最大的法律保留記錄，大小 200 MB。

feedback.zh: 你對 LOG-202 及 LOG-204 邊界列提出具體檢查，並在排入隊列前與法律營運確認保留，做法良好。可再補充重新相加 120 MB 加 90 MB，並核對刪除隊列僅有 LOG-201 及 LOG-205。

feedback.en: You state this is a fictional simulation and not legal advice, which is correct. You do not explicitly note that no legal hold release events were supplied, so LOG-203 and LOG-206 are assumed to remain held, and that conclusions cover only these six synthetic records.

summary.en: Strong submission with fully correct classifications, accurate arithmetic totalling 210 MB and well-evidenced reasoning across all six synthetic records. The main gaps are acknowledging that no legal hold release events were supplied and naming the security team lead as deletion queue reviewer.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀，分類全部正確，210 MB 計算準確，六筆合成記錄的推理均有充分證據支持。主要不足在於未說明沒有提供法律保留釋放事件，以及未指出資訊保安團隊主管為刪除隊列覆核者。

body.en: This fictional simulation policy covers synthetic SHOPLINE support attachments only. The query date is 2026-06-30. Each row supplies age_days, the whole-day age at that date. Precedence, highest first: (1) legal hold, (2) verified erasure request, (3) category retention threshold. If legal_hold is yes, retain the record and never apply another rule. Otherwise, if erasure_request is yes, the record is eligible for deletion immediately. Otherwise the record is eligible for deletion only when age_days is greater than or equal to its category threshold: billing_attachment 1095, chat_transcript 365, diagnostic_log 180, marketing_image 90. Thresholds are inclusive in days. This policy is not legal advice.
body.zh: 本虛構模擬政策僅涵蓋合成的 SHOPLINE 支援附件。查詢日期為 2026-06-30。每列直接提供 age_days，即在該日期當日的整日年齡。優先次序由高至低：(1) 法律保留、(2) 已核實的刪除請求、(3) 類別保留門檻。若 legal_hold 為 yes，須保留該記錄，且不得套用其他規則。否則，若 erasure_request 為 yes，該記錄即時符合刪除資格。否則，僅當 age_days 大於或等於其類別門檻時，該記錄方符合刪除資格：billing_attachment 1095、chat_transcript 365、diagnostic_log 180、marketing_image 90。門檻以日為單位且為包含式。本政策不構成法律意見。

title.en: Fictional vendor security evidence acceptance policy
title.zh: 虛構供應商保安證據接納政策

body.en:
Fictional SHOPLINE vendor security evidence acceptance policy (learning simulation, not a real SHOPLINE policy).

Review date: 2026-11-02. All days_since_issue values are measured against this date.

Acceptance rule. An evidence item is ACCEPTED only when all three conditions hold: (1) evidence_submitted is yes; (2) the submitted evidence_type matches the required type for its control_area; (3) days_since_issue is less than or equal to validity_days.

Required type and validity by control_area: encryption_at_rest, third_party_audit, 365 days. encryption_in_transit, config_attestation, 365 days. backup_restore_test, restore_test_report, 180 days. backup_key_management, third_party_audit, 365 days. access_review, review_log, 90 days.

Scope rule. Evidence must also show covers_in_scope_systems = yes for the primary merchant database. Evidence with covers_in_scope_systems = no is a gap even when it is still current.

A vendor self_declaration is never accepted as evidence for any control_area.

Approval owner. Information Security Manager Sonia Yeung makes the final acceptance decision. Every gap must be logged in the vendor gap register and the vendor must confirm remediation within 30 days.
body.zh:
虛構 SHOPLINE 供應商保安證據接納政策（學習模擬，並非 SHOPLINE 真實政策）。

審查日期：2026-11-02。所有 days_since_issue 數值均以此日期計算。

接納規則：證據項目只有在同時符合以下三項條件時才屬 ACCEPTED：(1) evidence_submitted 為 yes；(2) 所提交的 evidence_type 與該 control_area 要求的類型一致；(3) days_since_issue 小於或等於 validity_days。

各 control_area 所需類型及有效期：encryption_at_rest 需 third_party_audit，365 日；encryption_in_transit 需 config_attestation，365 日；backup_restore_test 需 restore_test_report，180 日；backup_key_management 需 third_party_audit，365 日；access_review 需 review_log，90 日。

範圍規則：證據亦須顯示 covers_in_scope_systems = yes，即涵蓋主要商戶資料庫。covers_in_scope_systems = no 的證據即使仍在有效期內亦屬缺口。

任何 control_area 均不接受供應商 self_declaration 作為證據。

審批負責人：由資訊保安經理 Sonia Yeung 作最終接納決定。每個缺口須記入供應商缺口登記冊，供應商須於 30 日內確認補救。

title.en: Fictional vendor security evidence acceptance policy
title.zh: 虛構供應商保安證據接納政策

body.en:
Fictional SHOPLINE vendor security evidence acceptance policy. Learning simulation, not a real SHOPLINE policy.

Review date: 2026-11-16. Every days_since_issue value is measured against this date.

An item is ACCEPTED only when all three conditions hold. evidence_submitted is yes. The evidence_type matches the required type for its control_area. days_since_issue is less than or equal to validity_days. An item that fails any condition is a gap.

Required type and validity by control area. incident_response_plan requires ir_plan_doc with 365 days validity. incident_response_test requires test_report with 180 days validity. breach_notification requires breach_notification_procedure with 365 days validity. access_review requires access_review_log with 90 days validity. privileged_access_review requires access_review_log with 90 days validity.

Scope rule. Evidence must also show covers_in_scope_systems = yes for the primary merchant transaction platform. A no is a gap even when the item is current.

A vendor self_declaration is never accepted for any control_area.

Approval owner. Information Security Manager Adrian Kwok makes the final acceptance decision. Record every gap in the vendor gap register with the evidence ID, control area, required type, validity window and reason. The vendor must confirm remediation within 30 days.
body.zh:
虛構 SHOPLINE 供應商保安證據接納政策。本文件屬學習模擬，並非 SHOPLINE 真實政策。

審查日期：2026-11-16。所有 days_since_issue 數值均以此日期計算。

證據項目只有在同時符合以下三項條件時才屬 ACCEPTED。evidence_submitted 為 yes。所提交的 evidence_type 與該 control_area 要求的類型一致。days_since_issue 小於或等於 validity_days。任何一項不符即屬缺口。

各 control area 所需類型及有效期。incident_response_plan 需 ir_plan_doc，有效期 365 日。incident_response_test 需 test_report，有效期 180 日。breach_notification 需 breach_notification_procedure，有效期 365 日。access_review 需 access_review_log，有效期 90 日。privileged_access_review 需 access_review_log，有效期 90 日。

範圍規則：證據亦須顯示 covers_in_scope_systems = yes，即涵蓋主要商戶交易平台。即使證據仍在有效期內，若顯示 no 亦屬缺口。

任何 control area 均不接受供應商 self_declaration 作為證據。

審批負責人：由資訊保安經理 Adrian Kwok 作最終接納決定。每個缺口須記入供應商缺口登記冊，列明證據編號、control area、所需類型、有效期及原因。供應商須於 30 日內確認補救。

title.en: Fictional dependency contract and adapter acceptance rules

body.en: Fictional simulation for Oursky learners. The local helper normalizeTag replaces the retired string-returning helper and now returns a tagged object. Rules are applied in this order: trim both ends, lowercase, then evaluate. Empty after trim and lowercase returns kind empty. Normalized length over 12 returns kind invalid with code too_long. Any character outside a-z, 0-9 and hyphen returns kind invalid with code bad_char. Otherwise it returns kind ok with the normalized value. The adapter toDisplayLabel must map ok to the uppercase normalized value, empty to UNTAGGED, too_long to INVALID_TOO_LONG and bad_char to INVALID_BAD_CHAR. Length is checked before characters. All names and rules are fictional.
body.zh: 為 Oursky 學習者而設的虛構模擬。本地輔助函式 normalizeTag 取代已停用的字串回傳輔助函式，現時回傳標籤物件。規則按此順序應用：先修剪兩端、轉為小寫，然後評估。修剪及轉小寫後為空字串時回傳 kind empty。正規化長度大於 12 時回傳 kind invalid，code 為 too_long。任何字元不在 a-z、0-9 及連字號範圍內時回傳 kind invalid，code 為 bad_char。否則回傳 kind ok，value 為正規化值。適配器 toDisplayLabel 必須將 ok 映射為大寫正規化值、empty 映射為 UNTAGGED、too_long 映射為 INVALID_TOO_LONG、bad_char 映射為 INVALID_BAD_CHAR。長度會先於字元檢查。所有名稱及規則均為虛構。

brief.en: Fictional Oursky learning simulation, not endorsed by Oursky. A local dependency used by a cold-room label adapter changed contract. The retired helper returned number | null. The current helper readSlot returns a tagged union, and the adapter formatSlotLabel still calls toFixed on that object, so the supplied continuous integration run fails on case read-01. Review the complete supplied module and the raw case table. Answer the four checks, then write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese of around 100 to 180 words covering the defect, the corrected branch mapping, evidence from specific case ids, one boundary decision, proposed verification tests and one limitation. Return the repaired adapter as one complete importable module that keeps the exported type, the slot table and readSlot unchanged. Do not execute code.

body.en: Fictional learning simulation for Oursky learners, not endorsed by Oursky. The retired helper returned number | null. The local helper readSlot(slotKey) is now the only dependency and returns a tagged union. Rules apply in this order. Normalise the key by trimming both ends then uppercasing. If the normalised key is absent from the supplied slot table, return { kind: 'error', code: 'unknown_slot' }. A present slot with no reading returns { kind: 'empty' }. A present reading below -5.0 or above 8.0 returns { kind: 'error', code: 'out_of_range' }. Otherwise return { kind: 'ok', celsius: number }. The adapter formatSlotLabel maps ok to celsius.toFixed(1) plus one space plus uppercase C, empty to NO READING, unknown_slot to UNKNOWN SLOT and out_of_range to OUT OF RANGE. The repaired answer must be one complete importable module that still declares the exported SlotReading type, the SLOTS table and readSlot, so the file resolves every binding on its own and the public contract tests can import it. All names and rules are fictional.
body.zh: 為 Oursky 學習者而設的虛構學習模擬，並非 Oursky 認可。已停用的輔助函式回傳 number | null。本地輔助函式 readSlot(slotKey) 現時是唯一依賴，並回傳標籤聯合。規則按此順序應用。先把鍵修剪兩端再轉大寫。若正規化鍵不在提供的槽位表中，回傳 { kind: 'error', code: 'unknown_slot' }。槽位存在但無讀數時回傳 { kind: 'empty' }。讀數低於 -5.0 或高於 8.0 時回傳 { kind: 'error', code: 'out_of_range' }。否則回傳 { kind: 'ok', celsius: number }。適配器 formatSlotLabel 將 ok 映射為 celsius.toFixed(1) 加一個空格加大寫 C、empty 映射為 NO READING、unknown_slot 映射為 UNKNOWN SLOT、out_of_range 映射為 OUT OF RANGE。修正後的答案必須是一個完整可匯入的模組，仍然宣告匯出型別 SlotReading、SLOTS 表及 readSlot，令檔案自行解析所有綁定，公開合約測試可直接匯入。所有名稱及規則均為虛構。

label.en: const result = readSlot(slotKey); if (result.kind === 'ok') return result.celsius.toFixed(1) + ' C'; if (result.kind === 'empty') return 'NO READING'; return result.code === 'unknown_slot' ? 'UNKNOWN SLOT' : 'OUT OF RANGE';
label.zh: const result = readSlot(slotKey); if (result.kind === 'ok') return result.celsius.toFixed(1) + ' C'; if (result.kind === 'empty') return 'NO READING'; return result.code === 'unknown_slot' ? 'UNKNOWN SLOT' : 'OUT OF RANGE';

brief.en: Fictional Oursky simulation, not an endorsed company task. You are reviewing a small pricing helper before it is merged into an internal quoting tool. title.zh: 價格分級及重構政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional Oursky training policy, not an actual company rule. classifyBand(amountMinor, currency) maps a price in minor units to one of three bands. currency is 'HKD' or 'USD'. HKD thresholds are 30000 and 250000 minor units. USD thresholds are 4000 and 32000 minor units. An amountMinor below the first threshold returns 'basic'. From the first threshold and below the second returns 'standard'. At or above the second returns 'premium'. Values are compared in minor units only, so no currency conversion is applied. Any other currency string must throw Error('unsupported currency'). The runtime guard must test the currency string itself. Detecting an unsupported currency only by checking whether an object-literal lookup returned undefined is not sufficient, because inherited names such as 'toString' or 'valueOf' are not undefined. Refactor policy: remove duplicated logic without changing any returned band or the thrown error, add no runtime dependency, and keep the runtime currency guard.
body.zh: 此為 Oursky 虛構培訓政策，並非公司實際規則。classifyBand(amountMinor, currency) 把以最小貨幣單位表示的價格映射至三個分級之一。currency 為 'HKD' 或 'USD'。HKD 門檻為 30000 及 250000 最小單位。USD 門檻為 4000 及 32000 最小單位。amountMinor 低於首個門檻回傳 'basic'。由首個門檻起、低於第二個門檻回傳 'standard'。達第二個門檻或以上回傳 'premium'。數值只以最小單位比較，不進行貨幣換算。任何其他貨幣字串必須拋出 Error('unsupported currency')。執行期檢查必須直接比對貨幣字串本身。只靠檢查物件字面值查表是否回傳 undefined 來判斷非支援貨幣並不足夠，因為 'toString' 或 'valueOf' 等繼承名稱並非 undefined。重構政策：移除重複邏輯，不得更改任何回傳分級或所拋出的錯誤，不得新增執行期依賴，並保留執行期貨幣檢查。

label.en: Using the policy thresholds, what does classifyBand(32000, 'USD') return?

label.en: Which approach is a correct behaviour-preserving refactor of the starter module?
label.zh: 哪個做法是正確且保留行為的起始模組重構？

label.en: Introduce a per-currency threshold lookup plus one shared comparison cascade, keeping a single explicit guard that compares the currency string directly.
label.zh: 引入按貨幣查表的門檻及單一共享比較流程，並保留單一直接比對貨幣字串的明確檢查。

label.en: Keep both currency branches and only replace the numeric literals with named constants.

label.en: Merge the branches and change every < to <= so the cascade is shorter.
label.zh: 合併兩段分支，並把每個 < 改為 <=，令流程更短。

label.en: Delete the currency guard because the Currency union already limits callers at compile time.
label.zh: 刪除貨幣檢查，因為 Currency 聯合型別已在編譯期限制呼叫者。

label.en: Across the eight rows in trace-table, how many rows return 'standard'?

label.en: Which statements must hold for this refactor? Select all that apply.

label.en: Every valid (amountMinor, currency) pair keeps the same returned band.
label.zh: 每個有效的 (amountMinor, currency) 組合都保留相同的回傳分級。

label.en: A currency string outside 'HKD' and 'USD' must still throw Error('unsupported currency'), including inherited names such as 'toString'.
label.zh: 'HKD' 及 'USD' 以外的貨幣字串仍必須拋出 Error('unsupported currency')，包括 'toString' 等繼承名稱。

label.en: Every < comparison may become <= because the trace table never uses an exact threshold value.
label.zh: 每個 < 比較都可改為 <=，因為追蹤表從不使用剛好等於門檻的數值。

label.en: The runtime currency guard can be removed because TypeScript narrows the Currency union.
label.zh: 可移除執行期貨幣檢查，因為 TypeScript 會收窄 Currency 聯合型別。

label.en: A new runtime helper package must be imported to share one cascade.
label.zh: 必須匯入新的執行期輔助套件才能共用單一比較流程。

label.en: Which replacement is sufficient to reject every unsupported currency string, including 'toString'?
label.zh: 哪個替代寫法足以拒絕所有非支援貨幣字串，包括 'toString'？

label.en: Keep the explicit guard 'currency !== 'HKD' && currency !== 'USD'' that throws Error('unsupported currency'), then read the thresholds.
label.zh: 保留明確檢查 'currency !== 'HKD' && currency !== 'USD'' 並拋出 Error('unsupported currency')，然後讀取門檻。

label.en: Read const standard = TABLE[currency] and throw only when standard === undefined.
label.zh: 讀取 const standard = TABLE[currency]，只在 standard === undefined 時拋出錯誤。

label.en: Throw only when !TABLE[currency] is true, then read the thresholds.
label.zh: 只在 !TABLE[currency] 為真時拋出錯誤，然後讀取門檻。

label.en: Return 'basic' for any currency that is not found in the lookup table.
label.zh: 對查表找不到的任何貨幣回傳 'basic'。

brief.en: Fictional Oursky learning simulation, inspired by Oursky but not endorsed by it. You are reviewing a small upload helper before merge. The module already returns the correct verdicts, but a second parallel cascade repeats every check, which is hard to maintain. Deliver a complete behaviour-preserving replacement of checkFilename, the verdict for every supplied trace, tests covering each boundary, and a short evidence-based handover for the reviewer.
brief.zh: 此為 Oursky 虛構學習模擬，靈感取自 Oursky，但未獲其認可。你正審查一個小型上載輔助函數，準備合併。模組目前回傳的判定正確，但第二段平行流程重複了每項檢查，難以維護。請提交完整且保留行為的 checkFilename 替代版本、每條追蹤列的判定、涵蓋各邊界的測試，以及給審查者的簡短有據交接。

title.zh: 檔名資格及重構政策（虛構）

body.en: Fictional Oursky training policy, not an actual company rule. checkFilename(raw) trims leading and trailing whitespace, lowercases the whole string, then returns one of four verdicts in this fixed precedence: 'empty', 'unsupported-extension', 'name-too-long', 'accepted'. The extension is the substring after the last '.' in the normalised name and the base name is everything before that dot. Allowed extensions are exactly 'png', 'jpg' and 'webp'. The verdict is 'empty' when the normalised length is 0, and 'unsupported-extension' when there is no dot, when the dot is at index 0, or when the extension is not allowed. The base name holds at most 40 characters. The runtime extension guard must compare the extension string itself, by explicit comparison or Set membership, because testing an object-literal lookup for undefined never rejects inherited names such as 'toString'. Refactor policy: remove the duplicated cascade, change no verdict, add no runtime dependency, keep the guard.
body.zh: 此為 Oursky 虛構培訓政策，並非公司實際規則。checkFilename(raw) 會先移除前後空白、把整個字串轉為小寫，然後按固定優先次序回傳四個判定之一：'empty'、'unsupported-extension'、'name-too-long'、'accepted'。副檔名是正規化名稱中最後一個 '.' 之後的子字串，主檔名則是該點之前的所有內容。允許的副檔名僅為 'png'、'jpg' 及 'webp'。當正規化後長度為 0 時判定為 'empty'；當沒有點、點位於索引 0，或副檔名不被允許時，判定為 'unsupported-extension'。主檔名最多 40 個字元。執行期副檔名檢查必須直接比對副檔名字串本身，可用明確比較或 Set 成員測試，因為只檢查物件字面值查表是否為 undefined，無法拒絕 'toString' 等繼承名稱。重構政策：移除重複流程、不得更改任何判定、不得新增執行期依賴，並保留該檢查。

label.en: Which option is a correct behaviour-preserving refactor of the starter module?
label.zh: 哪個選項是正確且保留行為的起始模組重構？

label.en: Normalise once, keep one explicit extension guard that compares the extension string itself, then use one shared length check and return the verdict.
label.zh: 只正規化一次，保留單一直接比對副檔名字串的明確檢查，然後共用一次長度檢查並回傳判定。

label.en: Keep both parallel cascades and only rename the second set of variables and add comments.
label.zh: 保留兩段平行流程，只把第二組變數改名並加上註解。

label.en: Replace the explicit guard with a constant lookup, reading the extension entry and treating undefined as unsupported.
label.zh: 以常數查表取代明確檢查，讀取副檔名項目並把 undefined 視為不支援。

label.en: Change the base-name comparison so a base of exactly 40 characters becomes too long, shortening the cascade.
label.zh: 修改主檔名比較，令剛好 40 個字元的主檔名變成過長，以縮短流程。

label.en: Across the rows in trace-table, how many rows return 'accepted'?
label.zh: 在 trace-table 的所有列中，有多少列回傳 'accepted'？

label.en: Which statements must hold for this refactor? Select all that apply.
label.zh: 以下哪些陳述必須成立才算正確重構？選出所有適用項。

label.en: Every input keeps exactly the same returned verdict as the starter module.
label.zh: 每個輸入都與起始模組回傳完全相同的判定。

label.en: An extension outside 'png', 'jpg' and 'webp' must still return 'unsupported-extension', including inherited names such as 'toString'.
label.zh: 'png'、'jpg' 及 'webp' 以外的副檔名仍必須回傳 'unsupported-extension'，包括 'toString' 等繼承名稱。

label.en: No new runtime dependency may be added to share the single cascade.
label.zh: 不得為共用單一流程而新增執行期依賴。

label.en: The runtime extension guard may be removed because the TypeScript types already restrict callers.
label.zh: 可移除執行期副檔名檢查，因為 TypeScript 型別已限制呼叫者。

label.en: The maximum base-name length may be increased to 41, because no trace row sits exactly at the boundary.
label.zh: 主檔名長度上限可提高至 41，因為沒有追蹤列剛好位於邊界。

label.en: The function may throw an Error instead of returning 'unsupported-extension' for a bad extension.

expectedEvidence.en: Derives the correct verdicts from the public policy: fn-01 accepted, fn-02 accepted, fn-03 accepted, fn-04 unsupported-extension, fn-05 unsupported-extension, fn-06 unsupported-extension, fn-07 name-too-long, fn-08 accepted, fn-09 empty, fn-10 unsupported-extension, fn-11 unsupported-extension, so 4 rows are accepted. Also answers 'accepted' for '  a.B.PNG  ' because the last dot wins, and 'unsupported-extension' for the padded uppercase 41-character base ending in '.TIFF' because the extension check precedes the length check. The replacement code removes the duplicate cascade and keeps the 40-character maximum inclusive.
expectedEvidence.zh: 依公開政策推導正確判定：fn-01 accepted、fn-02 accepted、fn-03 accepted、fn-04 unsupported-extension、fn-05 unsupported-extension、fn-06 unsupported-extension、fn-07 name-too-long、fn-08 accepted、fn-09 empty、fn-10 unsupported-extension、fn-11 unsupported-extension，故 4 列為 accepted。'  a.B.PNG  ' 亦答 'accepted'，因以最後一個點為準；補上空白及大寫、主檔名 41 字元而結尾為 '.TIFF' 者答 'unsupported-extension'，因副檔名檢查先於長度檢查。替代程式碼移除重複流程，並保留 40 字元上限（含等於 40）。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the fixed precedence in policy-eligibility (empty, then unsupported-extension, then name-too-long, then accepted), the trim-then-lowercase normalisation step, the last-dot rule, the exactly-'png'/'jpg'/'webp' allowance, and the rule that an object-literal lookup for undefined cannot reject inherited names such as 'toString'. Explains that the second cascade in starter-module recomputes identical values and therefore can be deleted without changing any verdict.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用 policy-eligibility 的固定優先次序（先 empty、再 unsupported-extension、然後 name-too-long、最後 accepted）、先去除空白再轉小寫的正規化步驟、以最後一個點為準的規則、只允許剛好 'png'／'jpg'／'webp'，以及只檢查物件字面值查表是否為 undefined 無法拒絕 'toString' 等繼承名稱的規則。並解釋 starter-module 中第二段流程重算相同數值，因此刪除後不會改變任何判定。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes tests that execute every fn-01 to fn-11 row against the replacement with the verdicts listed above, plus boundary tests at base-name lengths 40 and 41, a whitespace-only string returning 'empty', '.png' and 'README' returning 'unsupported-extension', 'notes.toString' proving the guard is not a truthy lookup, and a padded uppercase input proving normalisation runs before every check. States expected outcome for each case and notes that the tests cannot be executed in this simulated review.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出測試：以替代版本執行 fn-01 至 fn-11 各列並比對上述判定，另測主檔名長度 40 及 41 的邊界、全空白字串回傳 'empty'、'.png' 與 'README' 回傳 'unsupported-extension'、'notes.toString' 證明檢查並非真值查表，以及補上空白與大寫的輸入證明正規化先於所有檢查。每項列出預期結果，並說明此模擬審查不執行測試。

Does not invent extra tools, retry logic, storage rules or company approval workflow, and states that the verdict table itself is not evidence of production behaviour.

expectedEvidence.en: Writes a concise handover that names the defect (duplicated parallel cascade in checkFilename), gives the complete replacement code, lists verdicts and the accepted count of 4, records the reasoning for the 'a.B.PNG' and '.TIFF' cases, and states a concrete next step such as the reviewer Ada Cheung confirming the tests pass in the repository before merge. Uses evidence tied to specific trace identifiers rather than vague claims.
expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡短交接：指出缺陷（checkFilename 內重複的平行流程）、提供完整替代程式碼、列出各判定及 accepted 數目 4、記錄 'a.B.PNG' 與 '.TIFF' 個案的推理，並提出具體下一步，例如由審查者 Ada Cheung 確認測試在儲存庫中通過後才合併。內容以具體追蹤編號為據，而非空泛陳述。

feedback.en: All structured answers are correct: 'accepted' for '  a.B.PNG  ' (last dot wins), 'unsupported-extension' for the padded '.TIFF' string (extension check precedes length), accepted count 4, the three correct invariants, and shared-cascade as the behaviour-preserving refactor. Your replacement normalises once, keeps a single explicit extension check via Set membership, and keeps the inclusive 40-character limit, so every fn-01 to fn-11 verdict is preserved.
feedback.zh: 所有結構化答案均正確：'  a.B.PNG  ' 答 'accepted'（以最後一個點為準）、補空白的 '.TIFF' 字串答 'unsupported-extension'（副檔名檢查先於長度）、accepted 數目 4、三項正確不變條件，以及以 shared-cascade 作保留行為的重構。替代版本只正規化一次，以 Set 成員測試保留單一副檔名檢查，並保留 40 字元上限（含等於 40），因此 fn-01 至 fn-11 的判定全部保留。

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to the supplied sources: you cite policy-eligibility for the fixed precedence and the last-dot rule, and explain that the second cascade in starter-module recomputes identical trimmed, lowercased values so it can be deleted without changing any verdict. Your note that Set membership 'rejects inherited names' correctly reflects the policy rule that an undefined lookup cannot reject names such as 'toString'.
feedback.zh: 推理緊扣提供的來源：你引用 policy-eligibility 說明固定優先次序及以最後一個點為準的規則，並解釋 starter-module 的第二段流程重算相同的去空白及小寫數值，故刪除後不改變任何判定。你指出 Set 成員測試可拒絕繼承名稱，正確對應政策中「檢查 undefined 無法拒絕 'toString' 等名稱」的規則。

feedback.en: You propose concrete checks: the eleven trace rows, base lengths 40 and 41, '.png', 'README' and 'notes.toString', covering boundaries, empty handling and the inherited-name guard. You state no code was executed, which is honest. To strengthen it, give the expected verdict for each listed case and add a whitespace-only input expected to return 'empty'.
feedback.zh: 你提出具體檢查：十一列追蹤、主檔名長度 40 及 41、'.png'、'README' 及 'notes.toString'，涵蓋邊界、空白處理及繼承名稱檢查，並說明沒有執行程式碼，態度誠實。可再為每個個案列出預期判定，並加入預期回傳 'empty' 的全空白輸入。

feedback.en: You clearly frame the exercise as fictional, state that no code was executed and that no production upload path is implied, and limit claims to the supplied policy, module and trace table. No invented tools, storage rules or approval workflow appear. This meets the scope and uncertainty expectation without needing the exact branded disclaimer wording.
feedback.zh: 你清楚說明此練習為虛構，指出沒有執行程式碼，亦不涉及任何生產上載路徑，並把所有聲明限於提供的政策、模組及追蹤表。內容沒有自行添加工具、儲存規則或審批流程。此已符合範圍及不確定性的要求，毋須逐字採用品牌免責聲明。

feedback.en: The handover names the defect precisely (duplicated parallel cascade), supplies complete replacement code, lists all eleven verdicts with the accepted count of 4 and explains the 'a.B.PNG' and '.TIFF' cases, then sets a concrete next step for reviewer Ada Cheung to confirm the suite passes before merge. Evidence is tied to specific trace identifiers rather than vague claims.
feedback.zh: 交接明確指出缺陷（重複的平行流程）、提供完整替代程式碼、列出全部十一項判定及 accepted 數目 4，並解釋 'a.B.PNG' 與 '.TIFF' 個案，最後提出具體下一步：由審查者 Ada Cheung 確認測試套件通過後才合併。內容以具體追蹤編號為據，而非空泛陳述。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced submission. All decisions match the policy, the refactor is behaviour-preserving with a correct runtime extension guard and no new dependency, and the handover is actionable. The only small gap is that your test list does not state an expected verdict per case or include a whitespace-only 'empty' case.
summary.zh: 整體提交準確且證據充分。所有決策均符合政策，重構保留行為、執行期副檔名檢查正確且未新增依賴，交接亦可行。唯一小缺口是測試清單未逐項列明預期判定，亦未包含預期回傳 'empty' 的全空白個案。

title.zh: 維持個人檔案映射相容

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by it. You are reviewing a legacy-to-new user profile migration in a simulated product studio. The shipped TypeScript mapper toNewProfile does not yet satisfy the published schema migration contract. Using the contract and the five fiction fixtures only, identify the defective behaviour, supply a complete corrected function and propose tests. No database access, no SQL migration and no code execution. Deliver the finished patch plus a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 此為受 Oursky 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你在模擬產品工作室審查舊版至新版用戶個人檔案遷移。現有 TypeScript 映射函數 toNewProfile 尚未符合已公布的資料結構遷移合約。只憑合約及五筆虛構資料，找出缺陷行為、提供完整修正函數並提出測試。不得存取資料庫、不得執行 SQL 遷移、不得執行程式碼。交付完成檔案及簡短有據交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文。

title.zh: 資料結構遷移合約（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional learning rule set, not an Oursky policy. The mapper toNewProfile converts one legacy user record into the new shape { id: string, displayName: string }.
R1: id is copied unchanged.
R2: displayName is always a non-empty string after trimming leading and trailing whitespace.
R3 precedence: a trimmed non-empty displayName wins. Otherwise use the trimmed legacyName when it is non-empty. Otherwise use the exact string 'anonymous'.
R4: the mapper is pure, never mutates the supplied record, and never throws for absent optional fields.
R5: an empty field in the fixture table means that property is absent.
body.zh:
虛構學習規則，並非 Oursky 政策。映射函數 toNewProfile 把一筆舊版用戶記錄轉為新結構 { id: string, displayName: string }。
R1：id 原樣複製。
R2：displayName 必須是去除前後空白後仍非空的字串。
R3 優先次序：去除空白後非空的 displayName 優先。否則在 legacyName 去除空白後非空時使用它。否則使用完全相同的字串 'anonymous'。
R4：此映射函數為純函數，不得改動輸入記錄，亦不得因可選欄位缺失而拋出錯誤。
R5：資料表中空白的欄位代表該屬性不存在。

title.zh: 舊版資料表（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional fixture table, five valid legacy records. Values are read exactly as written between quotes, including spaces. An empty field means the property is absent (see R5).
```csv

u-01,"  Mei Lam  ",Mei Lam
u-02,"   ","  Chan Tai Man "
u-03,,Wong Ka Yee
u-04,Ada,Ada Wong
u-05,,"   "
```
No other records exist for this review.

虛構資料表，共五筆有效舊版記錄。數值按引號內所寫原樣讀取，包括空白。空白欄位代表該屬性不存在（見 R5）。
```csv

u-01,"  Mei Lam  ",Mei Lam
u-02,"   ","  Chan Tai Man "
u-03,,Wong Ka Yee
u-04,Ada,Ada Wong
u-05,,"   "
```
本次審查不存在其他記錄。

expectedEvidence.en: Correct: the shipped mapper throws a TypeError only for u-03 and u-05, because displayName is absent and .trim() cannot be read. The corrected mapper returns { id: 'u-02', displayName: 'Chan Tai Man' }, using the trimmed legacyName, and returns 'anonymous' for u-05. The sufficient change set is guard the optional read, trim, fall back to the trimmed legacyName, then to 'anonymous'. Every returned displayName is non-empty.

Fixtures u-01 and u-04 already produce the required trimmed values.

title.en: Keep the legacy count mapper compatible
title.zh: 維持舊版數量映射相容

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by Oursky, not endorsed by it. You are a reviewer in a simulated product studio. A partially migrated inventory record set now carries two count fields, the legacy qty and the new quantity. The published migration contract fixes the precedence between them. Using only that contract, the five fictional fixtures and the shipped TypeScript mapper, find where the current mapper diverges and supply a complete corrected function with proposed tests. No database access, no SQL migration and no code execution. Deliver the finished patch and a short evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese.
brief.zh: 此為受 Oursky 啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你在模擬產品工作室擔任審查者。一批部分遷移的庫存記錄同時帶有舊欄位 qty 及新欄位 quantity。已公布的遷移合約訂明兩者的優先次序。只憑該合約、五筆虛構資料及受審的 TypeScript 映射函數，找出現有函數偏離合約之處，並提供完整修正函數及建議測試。不得存取資料庫、不得執行 SQL 遷移、不得執行程式碼。交付完成修正及簡短有據交接，可用英文或香港繁體中文。

title.zh: 舊版數量遷移合約（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional learning rule set, not an Oursky policy. toNewRecord converts one legacy record into the new shape { id: string, quantity: number }, where quantity is a count in whole units.
R1: id is copied unchanged.
R2: the returned quantity is always a finite number, never undefined and never NaN.
R3 precedence: when quantity is present and is a finite number, use that value unchanged, including 0. Otherwise, when qty is present and is a finite number, use qty. Otherwise use 0.
R4: the mapper is pure, never mutates the supplied record and never throws for absent optional fields.
R5: in the fixture table a blank field means the property is absent.
body.zh:
虛構學習規則，並非 Oursky 政策。toNewRecord 把一筆舊版記錄轉為新結構 { id: string, quantity: number }，其中 quantity 為整數單位的數量。
R1：id 原樣複製。
R2：回傳的 quantity 必須是有限數字，不得為 undefined，亦不得為 NaN。
R3 優先次序：quantity 存在且為有限數字時，原樣使用該值，包括 0。否則在 qty 存在且為有限數字時使用 qty。否則使用 0。
R4：此映射函數為純函數，不得改動輸入記錄，亦不得因可選欄位缺失而拋出錯誤。
R5：資料表中空白欄位代表該屬性不存在。

title.zh: 舊版庫存資料表（虛構）

body.en:
Fictional fixture table with five valid legacy records. Values are read exactly as written between the quotes. A blank field means the property is absent (R5). qty and quantity are counts in whole units.
```csv
id,qty,quantity
p-01,7,
p-02,,12
p-03,4,0
p-04,,
p-05,3,9
```
No other records exist for this review.
body.zh:
虛構資料表，共五筆有效舊版記錄。數值按引號內所寫原樣讀取。空白欄位代表該屬性不存在（R5）。qty 與 quantity 均為整數單位的數量。
```csv
id,qty,quantity
p-01,7,
p-02,,12
p-03,4,0
p-04,,
p-05,3,9
```
本次審查不存在其他記錄。

expectedEvidence.en: Correct resolved values are p-01=7, p-02=12, p-03=0, p-04=0, p-05=9, total 28 units. The chosen change set is the finite-number precedence one: quantity when finite (0 included), otherwise qty when finite, otherwise 0. expectedEvidence.en: The answer links the defect to the literal shipped line quantity: record.qty ?? 0, which never reads the new field, and to R3 of the migration contract. It uses the fixtures concretely: p-02 has no qty but quantity 12, p-03 has quantity 0 which is finite and must win over qty 4, p-05 has quantity 9 which must win over qty 3, and p-04 has neither field so it resolves to 0. It notes that R5 makes blank CSV fields absent properties.
expectedEvidence.zh: 答案把缺陷連繫到受審程式的實際內容 quantity: record.qty ?? 0（從未讀取新欄位）及遷移合約 R3。並具體引用資料：p-02 無 qty 但 quantity 為 12；p-03 的 quantity 為 0，屬有限數字，必須優先於 qty 4；p-05 的 quantity 為 9，必須優先於 qty 3；p-04 兩欄皆無，解析為 0。並指出按 R5，CSV 空白欄位代表屬性不存在。

feedback.en: All four structured answers are correct and your patch applies R3 precedence exactly: quantity when finite including 0, then qty when finite, then 0. The resolved values 7, 12, 0, 0, 9 and the total of 28 units match the five fixtures, and the helper keeps the function pure with no NaN, undefined or input mutation.

feedback.en: You tie the defect to the shipped line that reads only qty and cite R3, then ground each case in specific records: p-02 quantity 12 with no qty, p-03 quantity 0 beating qty 4, p-05 quantity 9 beating qty 3, and p-04 resolving to 0. Adding an explicit note that R5 makes blank CSV fields absent properties would make the fixture reading fully self-contained.

feedback.en: Your tests cover the five ids with exact expected quantities, the quantity-only 0 case that must not fall through, both fields absent returning 0, and the check that the input object is unchanged. These are concrete, repeatable and derived from the contract rather than from execution, which is exactly what the brief asks.
feedback.zh: 你的測試涵蓋五筆 id 及其確定預期數量、只有 quantity 為 0 而不得向下回退的情況、兩欄皆無而回傳 0，以及呼叫後輸入物件不被改動的檢查。測試具體、可重複，並由合約推導而非倚賴執行程式碼，完全符合任務要求。

title.en: Reconcile regional forecast versions and duplicate orders

brief.en: You support a fictional ASMPT-inspired demand planning simulation. This is an independent learning exercise, not endorsed by ASMPT, and all records are synthetic. Regional planners submitted forecast versions and an order extract for two spare-part SKUs across three November 2026 weeks. Apply fictional planning rule FR-07 to reconcile the latest regional forecasts with deduplicated confirmed demand, then write a short handover covering your reconciled totals, the records you used, how you treated duplicates, superseded versions and pending orders, and the checks you recommend before planning review.

managerRole.zh: 需求規劃團隊主管（虛構）

title.zh: 虛構規劃規則 FR-07

body.en: Fictional planning rule FR-07, used only in this simulation. Horizon weeks are W1 = 2026-11-02, W2 = 2026-11-09 and W3 = 2026-11-16. All quantities are pieces. For each SKU and week, count only the latest forecast version, which is the highest version number for that region, SKU and week. Superseded versions are excluded. For confirmed demand, include only rows with status confirmed and count each order_id once even when the extract repeats that order_id. Reconciled demand for a SKU and week is the greater of the summed latest regional forecasts and the deduplicated confirmed quantity.
body.zh: 虛構規劃規則 FR-07，僅用於本模擬。規劃期為 W1 = 2026-11-02、W2 = 2026-11-09 及 W3 = 2026-11-16。所有數量單位為件。每個 SKU 及每週只計入最新預測版本，即該地區、SKU 及週別中版本編號最高者，被取代的版本不計入。已確認需求只包括狀態為 confirmed 的記錄，同一 order_id 即使重複出現亦只計一次。某 SKU 某週的核對需求，為各區最新預測之和與去重後已確認數量兩者中的較大值。

SMT-NOZ-1140。W1 F-007 200 加 F-008 80 等於 280，已確認 O-104 90 加 O-105 90 等於 180，故取 280。W2 為 0。W3 預測 F-009 130，O-106 仍屬 pending 須排除，故為 130。合計 410 件。

title.zh: 虛構規劃規則 FR-12

body.en: Fictional planning rule FR-12, used only in this simulation. Horizon weeks are W1 = 2026-12-07, W2 = 2026-12-14 and W3 = 2026-12-21. All quantities are pieces. Only forecast rows with status frozen are counted. Draft rows are excluded. If a SKU and week has more than one frozen row, sum those frozen rows. For orders, only rows with status confirmed can contribute. A pending row never contributes. If any row for an order_id has status canceled, that entire order_id contributes zero even when another row for the same order_id is confirmed. Count each contributing order_id once. Net confirmed demand is the sum of contributing confirmed rows. Reconciled demand for a SKU and week is the greater of the summed frozen forecast and the net confirmed demand.
body.zh: 虛構規劃規則 FR-12，僅用於本模擬。規劃期為 W1 = 2026-12-07、W2 = 2026-12-14 及 W3 = 2026-12-21。所有數量單位為件。只有狀態為 frozen 的預測記錄才計入，狀態為 draft 的記錄不計入。若同一 SKU 及同一週有多於一條 frozen 記錄，則把該些 frozen 記錄相加。訂單方面，只有狀態為 confirmed 的記錄可計入。狀態為 pending 的記錄永不計入。若同一 order_id 有任何一條記錄的狀態為 canceled，該 order_id 整體計為零，即使同一 order_id 另有記錄狀態為 confirmed。每個計入的 order_id 只計一次。淨已確認需求為所有計入 confirmed 記錄的總和。某 SKU 某週的核對需求，為 frozen 預測總和與淨已確認需求兩者中的較大值。
