brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by ASMPT and not endorsed by the company. You are the inbound exception planner in this exercise. Three PCB panel deliveries arrived today and goods-in has confirmed the counts. Using the exception policy and the arrival extract, work out the uncovered shortfall for each line, decide which lines need a supplier short-shipment notice, set the documentary follow-up order, identify any escalation, and write a short evidence-based handover for your team lead. All figures are simulated.
brief.zh: 此為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構模擬，未獲該公司認可。你在本練習中擔任來貨例外規劃員。今日有三批電路板面板到貨，收貨部已確認數量。請根據例外政策及到貨摘錄，計算每條線的未覆蓋短缺、判斷哪些線須發供應商短裝通知、排定文件跟進次序、指出任何升級需要，並為團隊主管撰寫簡短的證據為本交接。所有數字均為模擬。

title.zh: 虛構來貨例外政策

body.en:
Fictional inbound exception policy for this simulation.

Definitions. Committed units are the purchase order quantity. Received units are the counted units at goods-in. Reserved units are counted units pre-allocated to the named work order and unavailable for other demand. Free-to-use units equal received units minus reserved units. Uncovered shortfall equals committed units minus free-to-use units, floored at zero. A line is a short shipment only when received units are below committed units.

Notice rule. Raise a supplier short-shipment notice, SSCN, when received units are below 98.0% of committed units. At or above 98.0% the shortfall is minor and is logged only, with no SSCN and no escalation.

Priority. Tier 1 applies when uncovered shortfall is above zero and days to line start is 3 or fewer. Tier 2 applies when uncovered shortfall is above zero and days to line start is 4 or more. Tier 3 applies when uncovered shortfall is zero.

Owners. The inbound exception planner raises SSCNs and owns Tier 1 and Tier 2 follow-up, and escalates to the Supply Chain Manager when one line uncovered shortfall exceeds 600 units. Tier 3 lines close with no notice.
body.zh:
本模擬的虛構來貨例外政策。

定義。承諾數量為採購訂單數量。到貨數量為收貨時點算的數量。保留數量為已預留給指定工作單、不可用作其他需求的點算數量。可用數量等於到貨數量減保留數量。未覆蓋短缺等於承諾數量減可用數量，最低為零。只有當到貨數量低於承諾數量時，該線才屬短裝。

通知規則。當到貨數量低於承諾數量的 98.0% 時，須發出供應商短裝通知（SSCN）。達到或高於 98.0% 屬輕微短缺，只須記錄，不發 SSCN，亦不升級。

優先次序。當未覆蓋短缺高於零且距開線日數為 3 日或以下，屬第一級。當未覆蓋短缺高於零且距開線日數為 4 日或以上，屬第二級。當未覆蓋短缺為零，屬第三級。

title.en: Late inbound shipment with substitute eligibility
title.zh: 來貨延遲與替代料可用性

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by ASMPT and not endorsed by the company. You are the inbound exception planner in this exercise. Three PCB part deliveries arrived late and goods-in has finalised the counts. Using the exception policy, the arrival extract and the approved substitute register, calculate each line net uncovered shortfall, decide which lines need a supplier late-delivery notice, confirm how many substitute units may be allocated, set the documentary follow-up order, identify any escalation, and write a short evidence-based handover for your team lead. All figures are simulated. Do not contact any supplier.
brief.zh: 此為受 ASMPT 啟發的虛構模擬，未獲該公司認可。你在本練習中擔任來貨例外規劃員。三批電路板零件延遲到貨，收貨部已確定數量。請根據例外政策、到貨摘錄及認可替代料登記冊，計算每條線的淨未覆蓋短缺、判斷哪些線須發供應商延遲交貨通知、確認可分配的替代件數、排定文件跟進次序、指出任何升級需要，並為團隊主管撰寫簡短的證據為本交接。所有數字均為模擬。請勿聯絡任何供應商。

title.zh: 虛構延遲來貨例外政策

body.en:
Fictional late-delivery exception policy for this simulation. All quantities are in units.

Definitions. Committed units are the purchase order quantity. Received units are the counted units at goods-in. Line shortfall equals committed units minus received units, floored at zero. days_late is a supplied whole number of days. A line is a late shipment when days_late is 1 or more.

Substitution. A substitute may be allocated only when the register lists an approved substitute for that part. Approved substitution units equal the smallest of the line shortfall, the substitute available units on that line, and the per-line substitution cap in the register. Net uncovered shortfall equals line shortfall minus approved substitution units. A part recorded as 'none' in the register has no approved substitute and no substitution units may be allocated.

Notice rule. Raise a supplier late-delivery notice, SLDN, only when days_late is 2 or more and received units are below committed units. Otherwise the line is logged with no SLDN.

Priority. Tier 1 applies when net uncovered shortfall is above zero and days_to_line_start is 3 or fewer. Tier 2 applies when net uncovered shortfall is above zero and days_to_line_start is 4 or more. Tier 3 applies when net uncovered shortfall is zero.

Owners. The inbound exception planner raises SLDNs and owns Tier 1 and Tier 2 follow-up, and escalates to the Supply Chain Manager only when a single line net uncovered shortfall exceeds 500 units. Tier 3 lines close with no notice. No supplier contact is made in this simulation.
body.zh:
本模擬的虛構延遲來貨例外政策。所有數量單位為件。

定義。承諾數量為採購訂單數量。到貨數量為收貨時點算的數量。線別短缺等於承諾數量減到貨數量，最低為零。days_late 為提供的整數日數。當 days_late 為 1 或以上，該線屬延遲來貨。

替代。只有在登記冊列出該料的認可替代料時，才可分配替代料。認可替代件數等於以下三者最小：線別短缺、該線的替代料可用件數、登記冊的每線替代上限。淨未覆蓋短缺等於線別短缺減認可替代件數。登記冊中記為 'none' 的料沒有認可替代料，不得分配任何替代件數。

通知規則。只有在 days_late 為 2 或以上且到貨數量低於承諾數量時，才須發出供應商延遲交貨通知（SLDN）。否則只作記錄，不發 SLDN。

優先次序。當淨未覆蓋短缺高於零且 days_to_line_start 為 3 日或以下，屬第一級。當淨未覆蓋短缺高於零且 days_to_line_start 為 4 日或以上，屬第二級。當淨未覆蓋短缺為零，屬第三級。

責任人。來貨例外規劃員負責發出 SLDN 及第一、第二級跟進，並僅在單一線的淨未覆蓋短缺超過 500 件時升級至供應鏈經理。第三級線直接結案，毋須通知。本模擬不會聯絡任何供應商。

expectedEvidence.en: Final outputs are 160 units total net uncovered shortfall, SLDNs for PO-5120 and PO-5133 only, follow-up order PO-5120 then PO-5133 then PO-5147, 120 approved substitute units for PO-5120, and no escalation for PO-5120. expectedEvidence.zh: 最終結果為淨未覆蓋短缺總數 160 件、僅 PO-5120 及 PO-5133 須發 SLDN、跟進次序為 PO-5120 然後 PO-5133 然後 PO-5147、PO-5120 的認可替代件數為 120、PO-5120 毋須升級。各線淨未覆蓋短缺為 PO-5120 60、PO-5133 100、PO-5147 0。接受以正確單位表述、並清楚連結至提供列數的這些數值。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.

expectedEvidence.en: Cites the arrival extract rows L1, L2 and L3 and the register rows PN-4410, PN-5502 and PN-6620. Shows PO-5120 shortfall 180 with substitution min(180, 400, 120) = 120, PO-5133 shortfall 100 with register 'none' so no substitution, PO-5147 shortfall 60 with substitution min(60, 90, 60) = 60. Explains PO-5147 has no SLDN because days_late is 1 and that PO-5133 has an SLDN even though days_to_line_start is 6.
expectedEvidence.zh: 引用到貨摘錄 L1、L2、L3 列及登記冊 PN-4410、PN-5502、PN-6620 列。展示 PO-5120 短缺 180，替代為 min(180, 400, 120) = 120，PO-5133 短缺 100 且登記冊記為 'none' 故不替代，PO-5147 短缺 60，替代為 min(60, 90, 60) = 60。解釋 PO-5147 因 days_late 為 1 而不發 SLDN，並說明 PO-5133 雖 days_to_line_start 為 6 仍須發 SLDN。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.

expectedEvidence.en: Concrete checks such as confirming the 120 substitute units of PN-4410S are physically allocatable to PO-5120 under the cap, verifying the second-count figures in the arrival extract, asking goods-in to confirm the cause of each shortfall, filing the two SLDNs with the planner as owner, and rechecking the L3 count before closing it as Tier 3. Escalation route to the Supply Chain Manager is named only for a net uncovered shortfall above 500 units.
expectedEvidence.zh: 具體檢查，例如確認 PN-4410S 的 120 件替代料在生效上限下實際可分配給 PO-5120、核實到貨摘錄的第二次點算數字、請收貨部確認各線短缺原因、由規劃員提交兩份 SLDN，以及在以第三級結案前復核 L3 的點算。升級至供應鏈經理的路徑僅在淨未覆蓋短缺超過 500 件時才列明。

expectedEvidence.en: An actionable handover to the inbound planning team lead with line references, the per-line calculations, the SLDN decision, the Tier 1 to Tier 3 order, the no-escalation conclusion, and next steps with owners. Clear and bounded in length, around 100 to 180 English words or comparable Chinese.
expectedEvidence.zh: 致來貨規劃團隊主管的可行交接，列明線別引用、各線計算、SLDN 決定、第一級至第三級次序、毋須升級的結論，以及含責任人的下一步。篇幅清晰適中，約 100 至 180 英文字或相若中文。

exemplar.en:
Handover to the inbound planning team lead, simulation only.

Evidence and calculations. From the arrival extract, L1 PO-5120 PN-4410 shows committed 1800 and received 1620, so the shortfall is 180. The register lists PN-4410S with cap 120 and the line shows 400 available, so approved substitution is min(180, 400, 120) = 120 and net uncovered is 60. L2 PO-5133 PN-5502 shows shortfall 100 and the register records 'none', so net uncovered is 100. L3 PO-5147 PN-6620 shows shortfall 60 and substitution min(60, 90, 60) = 60, so net uncovered is 0. Total net uncovered is 160 units.

Decisions. SLDNs are required for PO-5120 at 3 days late and PO-5133 at 5 days late. PO-5147 is 1 day late and received below committed, so it is logged only with no SLDN. Priority is PO-5120 Tier 1, then PO-5133 Tier 2, then PO-5147 Tier 3 closed. The 60-unit net uncovered shortfall on PO-5120 is within the 500-unit limit, so I own the follow-up and raise no escalation.

Unconfirmed items and next steps. The cause of each shortfall is unconfirmed and no supplier has been contacted. I will file the two SLDNs, confirm the 120 PN-4410S units are actually allocatable to PO-5120, and recheck the L3 count before closing that line.
exemplar.zh:
致來貨規劃團隊主管的交接，僅為模擬。

證據與計算。根據到貨摘錄，L1 PO-5120 PN-4410 承諾 1800、到貨 1620，短缺為 180。登記冊列出 PN-4410S，上限 120，該線可用 400，故認可替代為 min(180, 400, 120) = 120，淨未覆蓋短缺為 60。L2 PO-5133 PN-5502 短缺 100，登記冊記為 'none'，淨未覆蓋短缺為 100。L3 PO-5147 PN-6620 短缺 60，替代為 min(60, 90, 60) = 60，淨未覆蓋短缺為 0。三線淨未覆蓋短缺總數為 160 件。

決策。PO-5120 延遲 3 日及 PO-5133 延遲 5 日須發 SLDN。PO-5147 延遲 1 日且到貨低於承諾，只作記錄，不發 SLDN。優先次序為 PO-5120 第一級，然後 PO-5133 第二級，然後 PO-5147 第三級結案。PO-5120 的淨未覆蓋短缺 60 件未超過 500 件上限，由我負責跟進，不提出升級。

未確認事項及下一步。各線短缺原因尚未確認，亦未聯絡任何供應商。我會提交兩份 SLDN、確認 PN-4410S 的 120 件確實可分配給 PO-5120，並在結案前復核 L3 的點算。

feedback.en: All five required outputs are correct: total net uncovered shortfall 160 units, 120 substitute units for PO-5120, SLDNs for PO-5120 and PO-5133 only, order PO-5120 then PO-5133 then PO-5147, and planner-owned Tier 1 follow-up with no escalation. The per-line arithmetic of 60, 100 and 0 is also right.
feedback.zh: 五項必要結果全部正確：淨未覆蓋短缺總數 160 件、PO-5120 可分配 120 件替代料、僅 PO-5120 及 PO-5133 須發 SLDN、次序為 PO-5120 然後 PO-5133 然後 PO-5147，以及由規劃員負責第一級跟進且毋須升級。各線 60、100、0 的計算亦正確。

feedback.en: You cite the L1 to L3 arrival rows and the PN-4410, PN-5502 and PN-6620 register rows, and show the correct min() substitution logic on each line. You also explain why PO-5147 gets no SLDN at 1 day late while PO-5133 still needs one.
feedback.zh: 你引用了 L1 至 L3 到貨列及 PN-4410、PN-5502、PN-6620 登記冊列，並展示各線正確的 min() 替代邏輯。你亦解釋了 PO-5147 因延遲 1 日而不發 SLDN，而 PO-5133 仍須發出。

feedback.en: Concrete next steps are present: filing the two SLDNs, confirming the 120 PN-4410S units are physically allocatable under the cap, and rechecking the L3 count before Tier 3 closure. You also note the 500-unit escalation threshold is not met for PO-5120.
feedback.zh: 具體下一步齊備：提交兩份 SLDN、確認 PN-4410S 的 120 件在生效上限下確實可分配，以及在以第三級結案前復核 L3 點算。你亦指出 PO-5120 未達 500 件的升級門檻。

feedback.en: You mark the handover as simulation only, state that the shortfall cause is unconfirmed and that no supplier has been contacted, and avoid claiming any resolution beyond the policy. This keeps the claims properly bounded.
feedback.zh: 你標明交接僅為模擬、指出短缺原因尚未確認且未聯絡任何供應商，並未主張超出政策的處理結果，範圍界定恰當。

feedback.en: The handover is clear and actionable, with line references, per-line calculations, the SLDN and tier decisions, the no-escalation conclusion and named next steps for the planner. Length is well within a usable range.
feedback.zh: 交接清晰可行，包含線別引用、各線計算、SLDN 及級別決定、毋須升級的結論，以及由規劃員負責的下一步。篇幅亦在可用範圍之內。

summary.en: An accurate and complete submission. Every calculated figure, notice decision, priority order and ownership outcome matches the exception policy, and the handover is bounded and actionable. No material gaps were found.
summary.zh: 提交準確且完整。所有計算數字、通知決定、優先次序及責任結果均符合例外政策，交接範圍清晰且可行。未發現重大缺漏。

nextSteps.en: You could strengthen the verification section by assigning each check an explicit owner and due point, for example goods-in confirming the cause of each shortfall before the SLDNs are filed. Adding that the second-count figures were already verified as final would close the remaining evidence loop.
nextSteps.zh: 你可為每項檢查指定明確責任人及時限，例如由收貨部在提交 SLDN 前確認各線短缺原因，以強化核實部分。補充說明第二次點算數字已核實為最終數字，可補完餘下的證據鏈。

Apply the fictional stock policy to age each lot, choose the eligible action for each lot, and identify which lots need extra escalation or approval. title.en: Fictional stock aging and action policy 2026
title.zh: 虛構庫存庫齡及行動政策 2026

body.en:
Fictional simulation policy, not an ASMPT policy. Effective for the review dated 2026-11-02.
P1 Age days = review date minus receipt date, counted in whole days.
P2 Classes and eligible actions: A is 0 to 90 days inclusive, routine handling. B is 91 to 180 days inclusive, eligible action Monitor, planner note only. C is 181 to 365 days inclusive, eligible action Redeploy, requires planner and engineering sign-off. D is above 365 days, eligible action Scrap review, requires two approvers, operations manager and finance controller.
P3 A lot with issued_qty_last_90_days = 0 is slow-moving. Slow-moving lots in Class C or Class D must also be escalated to the inventory review board.
Only the classes listed carry an eligible action. No disposal is performed in this exercise.
body.zh:
虛構模擬政策，並非 ASMPT 政策。適用於 2026-11-02 的檢視。
P1 庫齡日數 = 檢視日期減收貨日期，以整日計算。
P2 級別及合資格行動：A 為 0 至 90 日（含首尾），例行處理。B 為 91 至 180 日（含首尾），合資格行動為「監察」，只需規劃員備註。C 為 181 至 365 日（含首尾），合資格行動為「重新調配」，須規劃員及工程簽核。D 為超過 365 日，合資格行動為「報廢檢視」，須兩名批核人：營運經理及財務總監。
P3 若 issued_qty_last_90_days = 0，該批次屬慢流動。C 級或 D 級的慢流動批次另須轉交庫存檢視委員會。
只有上述級別帶有合資格行動。本練習不執行任何處置。

expectedEvidence.en: Correct ages in whole days from the 2026-11-02 review date: LOT-4471 110 days Class B, LOT-4482 206 days Class C, LOT-4490 286 days Class C, LOT-4503 423 days Class D, LOT-4517 66 days Class A, LOT-4525 368 days Class D. exemplar.en: Review date 2026-11-02, ages counted in whole days from receipt under P1. LOT-4517 is 66 days, Class A, routine. LOT-4471 is 110 days, Class B, so eligible action Monitor with a planner note and no escalation, since Class B is never escalated. LOT-4482 is 206 days, Class C, eligible action Redeploy with planner and engineering sign-off, and it is not slow-moving at 140 pieces issued. LOT-4490 is 286 days, Class C and slow-moving at 0 pieces issued, so Redeploy plus escalation. LOT-4503 is 423 days and LOT-4525 is 368 days, both Class D, so Scrap review with operations manager and finance controller approval, plus escalation because both are slow-moving. Scrap review extended value is 9,600 + 27,300 = 36,900 HKD. Uncertainty: all policy, records and staff are fictional and not endorsed by ASMPT, no disposal is authorised, and the review board has not met. Next step: re-confirm receipt dates and issued quantities in the stock system, then route the C and D lots for sign-off.

feedback.en: The 166-word handover gives per-lot decisions, the calculation method, evidence references, approval and escalation owners, the open uncertainty and a next step. It is actionable and well organised.

summary.en: Strong submission. All four structured answers and the written handover are accurate, evidence-linked and clearly scoped, with correct ages, actions, escalation set and 36,900 HKD Scrap review value.

title.zh: 審查老化及凍結狀態庫存

brief.en: You are supporting an independent learning simulation inspired by ASMPT. All records, policies and staff below are fictional and this exercise is not endorsed by ASMPT. Review the fictional component lot extract as at the fixed review date 2027-01-15. Apply the fictional stock policy to age each lot and choose the eligible action, accounting for hold-status exceptions. Answer the four questions, then write a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words covering calculations, decisions, evidence, uncertainty and next steps. No disposal is performed and nothing is authorised by this exercise.
brief.zh: 你正支援一項受 ASMPT 啟發的獨立學習模擬。以下所有記錄、政策及人員均屬虛構，本練習未獲 ASMPT 認可。請按固定檢視日期 2027-01-15，審查虛構的零件批次摘錄。套用虛構庫存政策為各批次計算庫齡並選出合資格行動，並考慮凍結狀態例外。回答四條問題，然後以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，涵蓋計算、決策、證據、不確定性及下一步。本練習不執行任何處置，亦不授權任何行動。

title.en: Fictional stock aging and hold policy 2027
title.zh: 虛構庫存庫齡及凍結政策 2027

body.en: Fictional simulation policy, not an ASMPT policy. Review date is fixed at 2027-01-15. P1 Age days = review date minus receipt date, in whole days. P2 Classes and standard eligible actions: A is 0 to 90 days inclusive, routine handling. B is 91 to 180 days inclusive, Monitor with planner note only. C is 181 to 300 days inclusive, Redeploy with planner and engineering sign-off. D is above 300 days, Scrap review with operations manager and finance controller approval. P3 Hold status overrides standard action. If hold_status is quality_hold, eligible action is Hold for quality release and the lot must be escalated to Quality Assurance. If hold_status is engineering_hold, eligible action is Monitor and the lot must be escalated to the Engineering Review Board. If hold_status is none, standard action applies. No disposal is performed in this exercise.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策，並非 ASMPT 政策。檢視日期固定為 2027-01-15。P1 庫齡日數 = 檢視日期減收貨日期，以整日計算。P2 級別及標準合資格行動：A 為 0 至 90 日（含首尾），例行處理。B 為 91 至 180 日（含首尾），監察並由規劃員備註。C 為 181 至 300 日（含首尾），重新調配並由規劃員及工程簽核。D 為超過 300 日，報廢檢視並由營運經理及財務總監批核。P3 凍結狀態凌駕標準行動。若 hold_status 為 quality_hold，合資格行動為「凍結待品質放行」，並須轉交品質保證。若 hold_status 為 engineering_hold，合資格行動為「監察」，並須轉交工程檢視委員會。若 hold_status 為 none，則套用標準行動。本練習不執行任何處置。

title.en: Fictional note on hold status handling
title.zh: 凍結狀態處理虛構備註

body.en: Fictional note, not an ASMPT document. Hold status is evaluated before any standard class action. A quality_hold lot is never redeployed or scrapped until Quality Assurance releases it. An engineering_hold lot is monitored and escalated to the Engineering Review Board. Escalation does not change the approval roles stated in the policy. The review board has not met, so no outcome is known at handover. The review date is fixed at 2027-01-15 and receipt dates are exactly as recorded in the lot extract.

expectedEvidence.zh: 提供清晰交接，列明決策（各批次行動）、證據（批次編號、庫齡、價值、凍結狀態）、轉交途徑（品質保證、工程、營運經理、財務總監）及下一步。按適用情況指出責任或轉交。接受簡潔專業的英文或繁體中文交接。

exemplar.en: Sources: fictional stock policy 2027 and lot extract as at 2027-01-15. Review date fixed 2027-01-15. Age days = review date minus receipt date. LOT-5612 receipt 2026-06-20 gives 209 days, Class C by age but hold_status quality_hold overrides to Hold for quality release and QA escalation. LOT-5645 receipt 2026-11-20 gives 56 days, Class A, but quality_hold overrides to Hold for quality release and QA escalation. So QA escalation for LOT-5612 and LOT-5645. Lots eligible for Scrap review are LOT-5634 (Class D, 339 days, value 25500) and LOT-5656 (Class D, 528 days, value 15200). Total scrap review value 40700 HKD. LOT-5623 is engineering_hold, so Monitor and escalate to Engineering Review Board. LOT-5601 is Class B, Monitor only. Next steps: confirm hold status with QA and Engineering, check receipt dates against extract, and obtain required approvals before any action. Uncertainty: review board has not met and no outcome is known. This is a fictional exercise, no disposal authorised.
exemplar.zh: 來源：虛構庫存政策 2027 及 2027-01-15 批次摘錄。檢視日期固定為 2027-01-15。庫齡日數 = 檢視日期減收貨日期。LOT-5612 收貨日 2026-06-20，庫齡 209 日，按庫齡屬 C 級，但 hold_status quality_hold 凌駕為凍結待品質放行並轉交品質保證。LOT-5645 收貨日 2026-11-20，庫齡 56 日，屬 A 級，但 quality_hold 凌駕為凍結待品質放行並轉交品質保證。因此 LOT-5612 及 LOT-5645 須轉交品質保證。合資格報廢檢視的批次為 LOT-5634（D 級，339 日，價值 25500）及 LOT-5656（D 級，528 日，價值 15200）。報廢檢視總值 40700 HKD。LOT-5623 為 engineering_hold，因此監察並轉交工程檢視委員會。LOT-5601 屬 B 級，僅監察。下一步：與品質保證及工程確認凍結狀態、對照摘錄核實收貨日期，以及在任何行動前取得所需批核。不確定性：檢視委員會尚未開會，結果未明。本練習屬虛構，不執行任何處置。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. LOT-5612 is 209 days, LOT-5645 takes the quality-hold action, QA escalation covers LOT-5612 and LOT-5645, and the scrap-review lots LOT-5634 and LOT-5656 total 40700 HKD. You also correctly applied the hold-status override for LOT-5623 and kept LOT-5601 as Class B monitor only.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。LOT-5612 為 209 日，LOT-5645 採用凍結待品質放行行動，轉交品質保證涵蓋 LOT-5612 及 LOT-5645，報廢檢視批次 LOT-5634 及 LOT-5656 合計 40700 HKD。你亦正確為 LOT-5623 套用凍結狀態凌駕規則，並把 LOT-5601 保留為 B 級僅監察。

feedback.en: You link each decision to specific records, citing receipt dates 2026-06-20 and 2026-11-20, the quality_hold status and the extended_value_hkd figures 25500 and 15200. The explanation of how hold status overrides the age class is clear and correct.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連繫到具體記錄，引用收貨日期 2026-06-20 及 2026-11-20、quality_hold 狀態，以及 extended_value_hkd 的 25500 及 15200。凍結狀態如何凌駕庫齡級別的解釋清晰正確。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete, covering confirmation of hold status with QA and Engineering, checking receipt dates against the extract and obtaining required approvals before any action. You could add recomputing the age days against the fixed 2027-01-15 review date as an explicit check.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體，涵蓋與品質保證及工程確認凍結狀態、對照摘錄核實收貨日期，以及在任何行動前取得所需批核。你可再加入按固定檢視日期 2027-01-15 重算庫齡作為明確檢查。

feedback.en: You correctly note that the review board has not met so no outcome is known, that no disposal is authorised and that this is a fictional exercise. Claims stay within the supplied policy and data without inventing real ASMPT positions.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出檢視委員會尚未開會因此結果未明、不授權任何處置，以及本練習屬虛構。聲明保持於提供的政策及數據範圍內，並無虛構真實 ASMPT 情況。

feedback.en: The handover gives per-lot decisions, supporting evidence and escalation routes to QA and Engineering, so a reviewer can act on it directly. Naming the operations manager and finance controller approval for the scrap-review lots would complete the ownership picture.
feedback.zh: 交接列出各批次決策、支援證據及轉交品質保證與工程的途徑，審閱者可直接跟進。若為報廢檢視批次列明營運經理及財務總監批核，責任歸屬會更完整。

summary.en: An accurate, well-evidenced submission. All four answers match the policy, the reasoning cites the correct records and the handover is clear and actionable at 158 words.
summary.zh: 提交準確且證據充分。四項答案均符合政策，推理引用正確記錄，158 字的交接清晰可行。

nextSteps.en: Add an explicit age recomputation against the fixed review date and name the operations manager and finance controller approvals for the scrap-review lots.

title.zh: FY2025 能源盤點範圍政策

body.en:
Fictional learning policy for FY2025 energy inventory boundary.
1. Include any electricity record where the landlord holds operational control of the meter, regardless of who is billed.
2. Include shared services procured and controlled by the landlord, even when costs are recharged to tenants.
3. Exclude tenant-controlled direct utility accounts where the tenant holds the account and operational control.
4. Include vacant units where the landlord retains operational control.
5. Reporting unit is kWh. This synthetic policy is for the learning simulation only and makes no legal reporting claim.
body.zh:
虛構學習政策：FY2025 能源盤點範圍。
1. 凡業主擁有電錶營運控制權的用電記錄，不論帳單由誰支付，均納入範圍。
2. 由業主採購及控制的共用服務，即使費用轉嫁租戶，均納入範圍。
3. 租戶持有帳戶及營運控制權的直接公用事業帳戶，排除在外。
4. 業主保留營運控制權的空置單位，納入範圍。
5. 報告單位為 kWh。此合成政策僅供學習模擬之用，並不構成法律報告聲明。

exemplar.en: Boundary review for FY2025 synthetic electricity records. Applying the published policy, operational control determines inclusion. Included records are E-01, E-03, E-04, E-05, E-07 and E-08, totalling 41,800 kWh. Excluded records are E-02 and E-06, totalling 13,100 kWh. E-05 shared chiller is included because the landlord controls procurement and operation, even though costs are recharged to tenants. Verification checks include confirming operational control evidence for each meter, reviewing recharge agreements for E-05, and testing vacant unit E-04 control evidence. Recompute totals independently. Missing evidence includes tenant account ownership documents and recharge contracts. This is a fictional learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties and makes no legal reporting claim. Handover ready for Ada Cheung.
exemplar.zh: FY2025 合成用電記錄的範圍檢視。按已公布政策，營運控制權決定是否納入。納入記錄為 E-01、E-03、E-04、E-05、E-07 及 E-08，合共 41,800 kWh。排除記錄為 E-02 及 E-06，合共 13,100 kWh。E-05 共用製冷機納入，因為業主控制採購及營運，即使費用轉嫁租戶。核實檢查包括確認每個電錶的營運控制權證據、審閱 E-05 的轉嫁協議，以及測試空置單位 E-04 的控制權證據。另行重算總量。欠缺證據包括租戶帳戶擁有權文件及轉嫁合約。此為受太古地產啟發的虛構學習模擬，並不構成法律報告聲明。交接已為 Ada Cheung 準備。

feedback.en: All classifications are correct. You excluded E-02 and E-06 and included E-01, E-03, E-04, E-05, E-07 and E-08, with included total 41,800 kWh and excluded total 13,100 kWh, matching the policy rules on operational control and recharged shared services.
feedback.zh: 所有分類正確。你排除 E-02 及 E-06，納入 E-01、E-03、E-04、E-05、E-07 及 E-08，納入總量 41,800 kWh、排除總量 13,100 kWh，符合營運控制權及共用轉嫁服務的政策條款。

feedback.en: You grounded the decision in the policy logic, explaining that landlord procurement and operational control drive inclusion for E-05 despite tenant recharge, and you correctly separated tenant-controlled direct accounts. Naming the specific record IDs strengthens the traceability.

feedback.en: The checks are concrete and test the stated requirements: confirming operational control evidence per meter, reviewing the E-05 recharge agreement, testing vacant unit E-04 control evidence, and independently recomputing totals. feedback.zh: 核實檢查具體並測試相關要求：逐錶確認營運控制權證據、審閱 E-05 轉嫁協議、測試空置單位 E-04 控制權證據，以及另行重算總量。可考慮加入各項檢查的負責人或向 Ada Cheung 升級的路徑。

feedback.en: You correctly limited the work to a fictional learning simulation, avoided any legal reporting claim, and flagged missing evidence such as tenant account ownership documents and recharge contracts. This is exactly the scope discipline required.
feedback.zh: 你正確把工作限於虛構學習模擬，避免任何法律報告聲明，並指出欠缺證據，例如租戶帳戶擁有權文件及轉嫁合約。範圍界定恰當。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable for a reporting lead, covering decisions, both totals, the E-05 rationale, verification steps and scope limits. Your 114-word submission sits comfortably within the 100 to 180 word guide.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，適合匯報主管跟進，涵蓋決策、兩項總量、E-05 理據、核實步驟及範圍限制。你的 114 字作品恰在 100 至 180 字指引之內。

summary.en: Excellent submission. Every classification, total and rationale matches the boundary policy, and the handover is clear, evidence-linked and properly scoped to the synthetic exercise. The structured answers and written work are consistent with each other.
summary.zh: 表現優異。所有分類、總量及理據均符合範圍政策，交接清晰、連結證據，並恰當地限於合成練習。結構化答案與書面作品互相一致。

nextSteps.en: To strengthen future handovers, add an owner or escalation line for each verification check so the reporting lead can act without a follow-up. You could also note any assumption about how the recharged E-05 cost sits versus the reported kWh boundary.

title.zh: FY2026 物料盤點範圍政策

body.en: Fictional learning policy for FY2026 material inventory boundary. Scope unit is kgCO2e. Include any material purchase where procurement control is held by the property team (procured_by = property_team) and the material is used for common areas, back-of-house, or property-team-organised events (used_for = community_event or marketing_event). Exclude purchases where procurement control is held by tenants or external vendors, even if the event is property-team-organised or costs are recharged. Reporting unit is kgCO2e. Conversion factors: paper 1.2 kgCO2e/kg, textile 3.5 kgCO2e/kg, plastic_signage 6.0 kgCO2e/kg, electronics 25 kgCO2e/unit, catering_material 2.0 kgCO2e/kg. This synthetic policy is for the learning simulation only and makes no legal reporting claim.
body.zh: 虛構學習政策：FY2026 物料盤點範圍。範圍單位為 kgCO2e。凡採購控制權由物業團隊持有（procured_by = property_team），且物料用於公用地方、後勤區域或物業團隊主辦活動（used_for = community_event 或 marketing_event），均納入範圍。採購控制權由租戶或外部供應商持有的採購，即使活動由物業團隊主辦或費用轉嫁，均排除在外。報告單位為 kgCO2e。轉換系數：paper 1.2 kgCO2e/kg、textile 3.5 kgCO2e/kg、plastic_signage 6.0 kgCO2e/kg、electronics 25 kgCO2e/unit、catering_material 2.0 kgCO2e/kg。此合成政策僅供學習模擬之用，並不構成法律報告聲明。

exemplar.en: To Rachel Wong, Sustainability reporting lead. Fictional FY2026 material boundary review. Applying the boundary policy, included records are M-01, M-02, M-04, M-05 and M-08. Excluded records are M-03, M-06 and M-07. M-03 and M-07 are tenant-controlled purchases. M-06 is excluded because the external event vendor holds procurement control, even though the community event is property-team-organised and costs may be recharged. Included footprint: M-01 1,200 kg x 1.2 = 1,440 kgCO2e. M-02 85 kg x 3.5 = 297.5 kgCO2e. M-04 45 kg x 6.0 = 270 kgCO2e. M-05 12 units x 25 = 300 kgCO2e. M-08 60 kg x 3.5 = 210 kgCO2e. Total included 2,517.5 kgCO2e. Excluded total: M-03 768 kgCO2e + M-06 400 kgCO2e + M-07 360 kgCO2e = 1,528 kgCO2e. Verification: confirm M-06 vendor contract for procurement control, and reconcile included total to the purchase ledger. Missing evidence: actual contracts and factor provenance. This is a synthetic exercise with no legal reporting claim.

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to specific records and policy clauses, showing each conversion step and why tenant or vendor controlled purchases fall outside the boundary. brief.en: Swire Properties is running a fictional refurbishment pilot. Supplier Verdant Alloy Works Ltd claims recycled aluminium content for three batch claims. title.zh: 再生成分證據清單政策

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Review date is 2026-11-02. Purchase order grade is AL-6061-RC. A recycled-content claim is complete only if all four checklist items are present and valid. One, supplier declaration dated on or after 2025-05-02 and on or before 2026-11-02. Two, third-party chain-of-custody certificate with expiry date on or after 2026-11-02 and material grade AL-6061-RC. Three, batch reconciliation record with recycled_input_kg and delivered_batch_kg in kg and a signer_role of quality_officer. Four, mill certificate with expiry date on or after 2026-11-02 and recycled_content_pct by mass. Claims with any missing, expired or unsupported item are held.

body.en: Fictional instruction from the sustainability analyst team lead. Use review date 2026-11-02. Prepare a vendor evidence-completeness checklist for C-1, C-2 and C-3. exemplar.en: Vendor evidence handover for Verdant Alloy Works Ltd, review date 2026-11-02. Claim C-3 is complete and recommended for approval. Records R-109, R-110, R-111 and R-112 are valid. R-111 shows 2200 kg recycled input in a 4000 kg batch, which supports 55 percent by mass. Claim C-1 is held. R-102 expired on 2026-10-31 and R-101 was issued before 2025-05-02. Claim C-2 is held. R-106 expired on 2026-11-01, one day before the review date. R-107 supports only 51 percent by mass from 3060 kg divided by 6000 kg, not the claimed 68 percent. Next steps: ask the supplier quality officer for a valid chain-of-custody certificate and a revised batch reconciliation for C-2, escalate expired certificates to the procurement category manager, and record the hold decision. These records are fictional and do not confirm any real certification.
exemplar.zh: Verdant Alloy Works Ltd 供應商證據交接，審核日期 2026-11-02。聲明 C-3 完整，建議批准。記錄 R-109、R-110、R-111 及 R-112 均有效。R-111 顯示 4000 kg 批次中有 2200 kg 再生投入，支持按質量 55 percent。聲明 C-1 暫停。R-102 於 2026-10-31 過期，R-101 於 2025-05-02 前簽發。聲明 C-2 暫停。R-106 於 2026-11-01 過期，即審核日期前一天。R-107 由 3060 kg 除以 6000 kg 只支持按質量 51 percent，而非聲稱的 68 percent。下一步：要求供應商品質主任為 C-2 提供有效監管鏈證書及修訂批次對帳，把過期證書轉交採購類別經理，並記錄暫停決定。此等記錄屬虛構，並不確認任何真實認證。

feedback.en: All four decision points are correct. You identified C-3 as the only complete claim, held C-1 and C-2, and computed 51 percent from 3060 kg divided by 6000 kg, correctly applying the 2026-11-02 review date and the four-item checklist.
feedback.zh: 四個決策點全部正確。你指出 C-3 是唯一完整聲明，暫停 C-1 及 C-2，並由 3060 kg 除以 6000 kg 算出 51 percent，正確套用 2026-11-02 審核日期及四項清單。

feedback.en: You tied each decision to specific records, citing R-102 expiry 2026-10-31, R-101 issued before 2025-05-02, R-106 expiry 2026-11-01, R-107 values 3060 and 6000, and R-111 values 2200 and 4000. The reasoning clearly explains why C-1 and C-2 fail while C-3 passes.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決定連結至具體記錄，引用 R-102 到期日 2026-10-31、R-101 於 2025-05-02 前簽發、R-106 到期日 2026-11-01、R-107 數值 3060 及 6000，以及 R-111 數值 2200 及 4000。推理清楚說明 C-1 及 C-2 失效而 C-3 通過的原因。

feedback.en: Your next steps are concrete, requesting a valid chain-of-custody certificate and a revised batch reconciliation for C-2, escalating expired certificates to the procurement category manager, and recording the hold. Naming the supplier quality officer as the follow-up owner strengthens the plan.
feedback.zh: 你的下一步具體，為 C-2 要求有效監管鏈證書及修訂批次對帳，把過期證書轉交採購類別經理，並記錄暫停決定。指明供應商品質主任為跟進責任人使計劃更完整。

feedback.en: You state the records are fictional and do not confirm any real certification, which appropriately limits the claims. You also treat the holds as requests for further evidence rather than final rejection.
feedback.zh: 你說明記錄屬虛構，並不確認任何真實認證，恰當地限制了聲明範圍。你亦把暫停視為要求補充證據，而非最終拒絕。

feedback.en: The handover reads clearly with claim statuses, the 3060 divided by 6000 equals 51 percent calculation, and the escalation path, making it ready for the review owner. It stays concise at 134 words.
feedback.zh: 交接內容清晰，列明聲明狀態、3060 除以 6000 等於 51 percent 的計算及轉交途徑，方便審核責任人使用。全文 134 字，簡潔得宜。

summary.en: Your submission is fully accurate. C-3 is complete, C-1 and C-2 are correctly held, the 51 percent calculation and next action are right, and the handover names owners and escalation clearly. No weaknesses found in the supplied evidence.

nextSteps.en: Keep the checklist-table format for future vendor reviews so each claim shows its four evidence items at a glance. Maintain the practice of pairing every hold with a specific replacement document request and a named owner.
nextSteps.zh: 日後審核供應商時可沿用清單表格格式，讓每項聲明的四項證據一目了然。並保持每項暫停決定均附上具體補交文件要求及指明責任人的做法。

title.zh: 核對包裝可追溯性供應商證據

brief.en: Swire Properties is running a fictional packaging traceability review for a tenant fit-out pilot. Supplier GreenLoop Packaging Ltd submits three packaging claims, P-1, P-2 and P-3. As the sustainability analyst, compare each claim against the packaging traceability evidence checklist as at 2026-11-16. Produce a vendor evidence-completeness checklist and an approval or hold decision for each claim. Finish with a concise handover for the review owner. This is an independent learning simulation and is not endorsed by Swire Properties.
brief.zh: 太古地產正為一項租戶裝修試點進行虛構包裝可追溯性審核。供應商 GreenLoop Packaging Ltd 提交三項包裝聲明：P-1、P-2 及 P-3。作為可持續發展分析師，請按包裝可追溯性證據清單，截至 2026-11-16 比較每項聲明。製作供應商證據完整清單，並為每項聲明作出批准或暫停決定。最後為審核責任人撰寫簡潔交接。此為獨立學習模擬，不獲太古地產背書。

title.zh: 包裝可追溯性證據清單政策

body.en: Fictional simulation policy. Review date is 2026-11-16. Purchase order packaging grade is RPET-70. A packaging traceability claim is complete only if all four items are present and valid. One, supplier declaration issued on or after 2025-05-16 and on or before 2026-11-16. Two, third-party traceability certificate with expiry on or after 2026-11-16 and packaging_grade RPET-70. Three, batch traceability record with recovered_input_kg and shipped_packaging_kg in kg and signer_role traceability_officer. Four, converter certificate with expiry on or after 2026-11-16 and recovered_content_pct by mass. Supported recovered content percentage equals recovered_input_kg divided by shipped_packaging_kg multiplied by 100, rounded to one decimal place. A claim is unsupported when the declared recovered_content_pct is higher than that percentage. Claims with any missing, expired, mismatched or unsupported item are held.
body.zh: 虛構模擬政策。審核日期為 2026-11-16。採購訂單包裝等級為 RPET-70。只有四項全部齊備並有效，包裝可追溯性聲明才算完整。一、供應商聲明簽發日期須為 2025-05-16 或之後，並在 2026-11-16 或之前。二、第三方可追溯性證書到期日須為 2026-11-16 或之後，且 packaging_grade 為 RPET-70。三、批次可追溯記錄須載有以 kg 計的 recovered_input_kg 及 shipped_packaging_kg，簽署角色為 traceability_officer。四、轉換商證書到期日須為 2026-11-16 或之後，並列明按質量計的 recovered_content_pct。支持性再生成分百分比等於 recovered_input_kg 除以 shipped_packaging_kg 再乘以 100，四捨五入至一個小數位。若聲明的 recovered_content_pct 高於該支持百分比，聲明即屬無依據。任何項目缺失、過期、不符或無依據，聲明即暫停。

feedback.zh: 你正確指出數字屬虛構，亦沒有聲稱真實再生成分。若補充此為不獲公司背書的獨立學習模擬，且結論限於截至 2026-11-16 的所提供記錄，便完全符合範圍要求。

summary.en: A strong, accurate submission: every decision, the 68.0 percent calculation and the evidence citations are correct, and the handover is actionable. Minor gaps remain in stating the explicit expiry and declaration windows, the simulation disclaimer and the named review owner.

title.en: Track water intensity against the 2025 interim target
title.zh: 追蹤用水強度相對 2025 年中期目標的進度

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties, not endorsed by the company. You are a sustainability analyst for fictional Harbour View Mall. Track 2025 water intensity against the 2024 baseline and 2026 target. Use the tracking policy and input data. Prepare a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, with decisions, calculations, evidence, missing-data handling and next steps.
brief.zh: 此為受太古地產啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。你是虛構港灣景商場的可持續發展分析師。按 2024 年基準及 2026 年目標追蹤 2025 年用水強度。使用追蹤政策及輸入數據。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，列明決策、計算、證據、缺失資料處理及下一步。

title.zh: 用水強度目標簡報

body.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties, not endorsed by the company. Fictional Harbour View Mall set a 2024 baseline water intensity of 48000 m3 water and 3200000 visitor entries. The 2026 target is a 12% reduction in litres per 1000 visitor entries against the 2024 baseline. The 2025 interim target is a 6% reduction. Reporting period is January to July 2025. Scope rules and missing-data handling are in the tracking policy. Prepare a concise handover.
body.zh: 此為受太古地產啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。虛構港灣景商場的 2024 年基準用水強度為 48000 立方米用水及 3200000 訪客人次。2026 年目標是相對 2024 年基準，每 1000 訪客人次用水公升數減少 12%。2025 年中期目標為減少 6%。報告期為 2025 年 1 月至 7 月。範圍規則及缺失資料處理載於追蹤政策。請準備簡潔交接。

title.en: Harbour View Mall synthetic water and activity data
title.zh: 港灣景商場合成用水及活動數據

body.en:
Fictional input data for Harbour View Mall. Values are synthetic. CSV:

Units: water_m3 is cubic metres. activity_units is visitor entries. Missing activity_units means the month cannot be used for intensity under the policy.
body.zh:
虛構港灣景商場輸入數據。數值為合成資料。CSV：
record_id,period,water_m3,activity_units,water_status,activity_status
B2024,2024 full year,48000,3200000,actual,actual
M202501,2025-01,3800,260000,actual,actual
M202502,2025-02,3500,240000,actual,actual
M202503,2025-03,4100,280000,actual,actual
M202504,2025-04,3900,270000,actual,actual
M202505,2025-05,4200,290000,actual,actual
M202506,2025-06,4000,275000,actual,actual
M202507,2025-07,4150,,actual,missing
單位：water_m3 為立方米。activity_units 為訪客人次。缺少 activity_units 表示該月不能按政策用於強度計算。

title.zh: 用水強度追蹤政策

body.en: Fictional tracking policy. Intensity equals total water in litres divided by total visitor entries, expressed per 1000 entries. Baseline is 2024 full calendar year. Reporting period is January to July 2025. Include a month only when both water_m3 and activity_units are present and status is actual or estimated. If activity_units is missing, exclude that month from both numerator and denominator and disclose the exclusion. Estimated water is included but flagged provisional. Round intensity to the nearest whole litre per 1000 entries. Variance equals actual intensity minus interim target. Positive variance means worse than target. Do not claim causation.
body.zh: 虛構追蹤政策。強度等於總用水公升數除以總訪客人次，並以每 1000 人次表示。基準為 2024 年完整曆年。報告期為 2025 年 1 月至 7 月。只有在 water_m3 及 activity_units 均存在，且狀態為 actual 或 estimated 時，才可納入該月。若 activity_units 缺失，須從分子及分母同時剔除該月，並披露剔除事項。estimated 用水可納入但標示為暫定。強度四捨五入至每 1000 人次最接近的整數公升。差異等於實際強度減中期目標。正差異表示差於目標。不得作出因果聲明。

exemplar.en: Handover. This is a fictional simulation inspired by Swire Properties and not endorsed by the company. Source B2024 gives 48000 m3 and 3200000 visitor entries. Baseline intensity is 48000000 L divided by 3200000 entries, or 15000 L per 1000 entries. For January to July 2025, policy excludes M202507 because activity_units is missing. In-scope records M202501 to M202506 sum to 23500 m3 and 1615000 entries. Reporting intensity is 23500000 L divided by 1615000 entries, or 14551 L per 1000 entries after rounding. The 2025 interim target is 6% below baseline, or 14100 L per 1000 entries. Actual intensity is 451 L per 1000 entries above target, so performance is behind. Next steps are to obtain M202507 activity data, verify meter status, and disclose the July exclusion in the next report. Owner is the sustainability analyst. Escalation is the facilities manager for meter verification.
exemplar.zh: 交接。此為受太古地產啟發的虛構模擬，並非由該公司認可。來源 B2024 顯示 48000 立方米及 3200000 訪客人次。基準強度為 48000000 公升除以 3200000 人次，即每 1000 人次 15000 公升。就 2025 年 1 月至 7 月，政策剔除 M202507，因其 activity_units 缺失。範圍內記錄 M202501 至 M202506 合計 23500 立方米及 1615000 人次。報告期強度為 23500000 公升除以 1615000 人次，四捨五入後為每 1000 人次 14551 公升。2025 年中期目標為基準以下 6%，即每 1000 人次 14100 公升。實際強度高出目標每 1000 人次 451 公升，因此表現落後。下一步是取得 M202507 活動數據、核實水錶狀態，並在下次報告披露 7 月剔除。負責人為可持續發展分析師。轉交設施經理作水錶核實。

title.en: Track waste intensity against the 2025 interim target
title.zh: 追蹤廢物強度相對 2025 年中期目標的進度

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by Swire Properties, not endorsed by the company. You are a sustainability analyst for fictional Island East Mall. Track 2025 waste intensity against the 2024 baseline and the 2025 interim target. Baseline is 180000 kg of waste and 3000000 attendees for 2024. The 2025 interim target is a 10% reduction in kg of waste per 1000 attendees against the 2024 baseline. Reporting period is January to June 2025. Scope rules and missing-data handling are in the tracking policy. Prepare a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese, around 100 to 180 words, with decisions, calculations, evidence, missing-data handling and next steps.
brief.zh: 此為受太古地產啟發的獨立學習模擬，並非由該公司認可。你是虛構東島商場的可持續發展分析師。按 2024 年基準及 2025 年中期目標追蹤 2025 年廢物強度。2024 年基準為 180000 公斤廢物及 3000000 訪客人次。2025 年中期目標是相對 2024 年基準，每 1000 訪客人次的廢物公斤數減少 10%。報告期為 2025 年 1 月至 6 月。範圍規則及缺失資料處理載於追蹤政策。以英文或香港繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接，列明決策、計算、證據、缺失資料處理及下一步。

title.zh: 廢物強度追蹤政策

body.en: Fictional tracking policy. Intensity equals total waste in kilograms divided by total attendees, expressed per 1000 attendees as kg per 1000 attendees. Baseline is 2024 full calendar year. Reporting period is January to June 2025. Include a month only when both waste_kg and attendees are present and status is actual or estimated. If attendees is missing, exclude that month from both numerator and denominator and disclose the exclusion. Estimated waste is included but flagged provisional. Round intensity to the nearest whole kg per 1000 attendees. Interim target is a 10% reduction from baseline intensity, rounded to nearest whole kg. Variance equals actual intensity minus interim target. Positive variance means worse than target. Do not claim causation.
body.zh: 虛構追蹤政策。強度等於總廢物公斤數除以總訪客人次，並以每 1000 人次多少公斤表示。基準為 2024 年完整曆年。報告期為 2025 年 1 月至 6 月。只有在 waste_kg 及 attendees 均存在，且狀態為 actual 或 estimated 時，才可納入該月。若 attendees 缺失，須從分子及分母同時剔除該月，並披露剔除事項。estimated 廢物可納入但標示為暫定。強度四捨五入至每 1000 人次最接近的整數公斤。中期目標是相對基準強度減少 10%，並四捨五入至最接近的整數公斤。差異等於實際強度減中期目標。正差異表示差於目標。不得作出因果聲明。

exemplar.en: Evidence: Baseline record B2024 shows 180000 kg waste and 3000000 attendees for 2024, giving 60 kg per 1000 attendees. Monthly records M202501 to M202505 provide waste and attendee data. M202506 has waste 17000 kg but missing attendees, so it is excluded from both numerator and denominator under the tracking policy. Decision: Reporting-period waste totals 77000 kg across 1200000 attendees, giving 64 kg per 1000 attendees. The 2025 interim target is 54 kg per 1000 attendees (10% below baseline). Variance is +10 kg per 1000 attendees, so Island East Mall is behind the interim target. Risks: June 2025 attendance is missing, estimated March 2025 waste is provisional, and no causation is claimed. Next steps: confirm June attendance data with the data owner, verify March estimate, and recheck rounding.
exemplar.zh: 證據：基準記錄 B2024 顯示 2024 年 180000 公斤廢物及 3000000 訪客人次，即每 1000 訪客人次 60 公斤。月記錄 M202501 至 M202505 提供廢物及訪客數據。M202506 有 17000 公斤廢物但訪客人次缺失，故按追蹤政策從分子及分母同時剔除。決策：報告期廢物總計 77000 公斤，訪客總數 1200000，即每 1000 訪客人次 64 公斤。2025 年中期目標為每 1000 訪客人次 54 公斤（較基準低 10%）。差異為 +10 公斤，因此東島商場落後於中期目標。風險：2025 年 6 月訪客數據缺失，2025 年 3 月估計廢物屬暫定，且不作出因果聲明。下一步：向數據負責人確認 6 月訪客數據，核實 3 月估算，並重新檢查四捨五入。

feedback.en: The handover is concise at 127 words and covers decisions, evidence, risks and next steps with a named data owner. Naming an escalation contact would make it fully actionable for a colleague.

summary.en: The submission is accurate and well evidenced. Baseline, reporting-period intensity, interim target and variance are all correct, and June 2025 is properly excluded. Minor gaps remain in escalation ownership and in stating the data is synthetic.

nextSteps.en: Add an explicit escalation note to the sustainability team lead if June attendance is not supplied, and state once that all figures are synthetic and do not represent real company results.
nextSteps.zh: 若 6 月訪客數據未能提供，加入明確的轉交可持續發展團隊主管註記，並註明所有數字屬合成資料，不代表真實公司成果。

title.en: Tree-test review and navigation regrouping for ticket and journey labels
title.zh: 票務及行程標籤的樹狀測試檢視與導覽重新分組

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by MTR passenger information apps. Not endorsed by MTR Corporation. You are a UX designer on the Journey Hub prototype, a fictional navigation shell for ticket and journey labels. Researchers ran a five-task tree test with 165 participants. Raw results are in doc-tree-test-csv. Acceptance rules are in doc-policy. Deliver a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. State the failing group, its rate, the required structural fix, the measurable re-test check, and any evidence you still need. Do not edit the raw CSV.
brief.zh: 本任務為受港鐵乘客資訊應用程式啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非由港鐵公司認可。你是 Journey Hub 原型的用戶體驗設計師，該原型是虛構的票務及行程標籤導覽框架。研究人員以 165 名參與者完成五項樹狀測試任務。原始結果見 doc-tree-test-csv，驗收規則見 doc-policy。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的精簡交接說明，列明未達標組別、其比率、所需結構性修正、可量度重測檢查，以及仍需要的證據。請勿修改原始 CSV。

title.zh: Journey Hub 樹狀測試任務

body.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by MTR passenger information apps, not endorsed by MTR Corporation, and not an MTR policy. Journey Hub is a fictional prototype navigation shell. Decision owners for this exercise are the fictional information architecture owner and the fictional content design owner. The tree test measured where participants looked first for five ticket, journey and station tasks. Your handover must recommend one navigation grouping and one measurable check, then name who owns the next step and what would trigger escalation to the fictional product lead.
body.zh: 本任務為受港鐵乘客資訊應用程式啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非由港鐵公司認可，亦非港鐵政策。Journey Hub 是虛構的原型導覽框架。本練習的決策負責人為虛構的資訊架構負責人及虛構的內容設計負責人。樹狀測試量度參與者在五項票務、行程及車站任務中首先查看的位置。你的交接須建議一個導覽分組及一項可量度檢查，並列明下一步的負責人，以及觸發轉交虛構產品主管的條件。

title.zh: 公開樹狀測試驗收規則

body.en: Rules for the Journey Hub prototype. Fictional. The first-attempt success rate of a top-level group equals the sum of first_attempt_success for that group divided by the sum of participants for that group, shown as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. A group is underperforming when its rate is strictly below 70.0 percent. At most one structural fix applies per underperforming group per cycle. If the most common wrong destination group differs from the group itself, move the group's task labels into that wrong destination's top-level group. If the most common wrong destination group is the group itself, merge the task labels into the parent group. Renaming a label is never a structural fix. After a move, re-run the tree test with at least 20 new participants per moved task label and accept the change only when the moved labels reach at least 70.0 percent first-attempt success.
body.zh: Journey Hub 原型規則，屬虛構內容。某頂層組別的首次嘗試成功率，等於該組別 first_attempt_success 總和除以該組別 participants 總和，以百分比表示並四捨五入至一位小數。比率嚴格低於 70.0% 即屬未達標。每個週期對每個未達標組別最多套用一項結構性修正。若最常見錯誤目的地組別與該組別本身不同，便把該組別的任務標籤移入該錯誤目的地的頂層組別。若最常見錯誤目的地組別就是該組別本身，便把任務標籤合併至其母組別。僅更改標籤名稱不屬於結構性修正。移動後，須為每個已移動任務標籤以至少 20 名新參與者重測，且只有在已移動標籤達至少 70.0% 首次嘗試成功率時才接納該改動。

label.en: Using doc-tree-test-csv and the public rule, what is the first-attempt success rate of the Buy tickets group, in percent to one decimal place?
label.zh: 根據 doc-tree-test-csv 及公開規則，Buy tickets 組別的首次嘗試成功率是多少（百分比，一位小數）？

label.en: Which top-level group is the only underperforming group under the public rule?
label.zh: 根據公開規則，哪個頂層組別是唯一未達標的組別？

label.en: Which single structural fix does the public rule require for that group in this cycle?
label.zh: 根據公開規則，本週期對該組別須實施哪一項結構性修正？

label.en: Move both Buy tickets task labels into Plan journey
label.zh: 把兩個 Buy tickets 任務標籤移入 Plan journey

label.en: Merge both Buy tickets task labels into the parent group
label.zh: 把兩個 Buy tickets 任務標籤合併至母組別

label.en: Rename both Buy tickets task labels without moving them
label.zh: 只更改兩個 Buy tickets 任務標籤名稱而不移動

label.en: No structural change is required this cycle
label.zh: 本週期無須任何結構性改動

label.en: Which measurable check verifies the change under the public rule?
label.zh: 根據公開規則，哪項可量度檢查可核實該改動？

label.en: Re-run the tree test with at least 20 new participants per moved task label and require at least 70.0 percent first-attempt success on the moved labels
label.zh: 為每個已移動任務標籤以至少 20 名新參與者重測，並要求已移動標籤達至少 70.0% 首次嘗試成功率

label.zh: 每個已移動任務標籤以 5 名新參與者重測，並要求至少 50%

about.en: MTR Corporation operates railway and related businesses. Its public profile provides the context for a passenger-facing digital experience simulation.

simulationStyle.en: Design a fictional journey-planning or station-information interface using supplied user findings and accessibility requirements. No real station safety decision is made.
simulationStyle.zh: 以提供的用戶研究及無障礙要求設計虛構行程規劃或車站資訊介面，不涉及真實車站安全決策。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Interpret a small tree-test result and recommend a navigation grouping with a measurable check.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。解讀小型樹狀測試結果，並建議資訊分組及可量度檢查。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

description.en: Correctly applies the supplied rules and calculations. Interpret a small tree-test result and recommend a navigation grouping with a measurable check.
description.zh: 正確應用提供的規則及計算。解讀小型樹狀測試結果，並建議資訊分組及可量度檢查。

expectedEvidence.en: States 52.9 percent (37 divided by 70, rounded to one decimal place) for Buy tickets. Identifies Buy tickets as the only group strictly below 70.0 percent, supported by Plan journey 84.0 percent (42 of 50), Stations and access 84.0 percent (21 of 25) and Help 80.0 percent (16 of 20). Requires moving both Buy tickets task labels into Plan journey because the most common wrong destination group differs from the group itself. Rejects renaming alone and rejects merging into the parent.
expectedEvidence.zh: 指出 Buy tickets 為 52.9%（37 除以 70，四捨五入至一位小數）。確認 Buy tickets 是唯一嚴格低於 70.0% 的組別，並以 Plan journey 84.0%（50 分之 42）、Stations and access 84.0%（25 分之 21）及 Help 80.0%（20 分之 16）支持。因最常見錯誤目的地組別與該組別本身不同，須把兩個 Buy tickets 任務標籤移入 Plan journey。拒絕僅改名，亦拒絕合併至母組別。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links each decision to specific supplied records, namely rows T-01 and T-02 for the Buy tickets totals (participants 40 plus 30 equals 70, first_attempt_success 22 plus 15 equals 37, most_common_wrong_destination_group Plan journey) and cites the doc-policy threshold, move rule and rename limitation. Explains the calculation method rather than asserting a rate.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把每項決策連結至具體提供記錄，即以 T-01 及 T-02 列得出 Buy tickets 總數（participants 40 加 30 等於 70，first_attempt_success 22 加 15 等於 37，most_common_wrong_destination_group 為 Plan journey），並引用 doc-policy 的門檻、移動規則及改名限制。解釋計算方法，而非僅宣稱比率。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes the doc-policy re-test, at least 20 new participants per moved task label, accepted only at 70.0 percent or above on the moved labels. Adds at least one concrete next check such as a second tree-test round on the same five titles, first-click or path observation, or a follow-up check that Plan journey findability did not fall below 70.0 percent for T-03.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出 doc-policy 的重測，即每個已移動任務標籤至少 20 名新參與者，且已移動標籤須達 70.0% 或以上才接納。另加至少一項具體後續檢查，例如就同五項標題進行第二輪樹狀測試、首次點擊或路徑觀察，或跟進檢查 T-03 在 Plan journey 的可尋性沒有低於 70.0%。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Labels the case as a fictional simulation, not MTR policy. Notes the limits of 165 participants and one test round, no per-group segment breakdown, no data on assistive-technology users, and no post-change evidence. Avoids claiming a real station or ticketing outcome, and separates the 52.9 percent observation from the unproven post-move result.
expectedEvidence.zh: 標明此個案為虛構模擬，並非港鐵政策。指出 165 名參與者及單一測試輪次的限制、沒有分組別細分、沒有輔助科技使用者資料，亦沒有改動後證據。避免宣稱真實車站或票務結果，並把 52.9% 的觀察與未經證實的移動後結果區分。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Gives a short structured handover with the calculation, the single required fix, the measurable acceptance check, and named owners. Assigns the move to the fictional information architecture owner, the re-test to the fictional content design owner, and states the escalation trigger, for example the moved labels staying below 70.0 percent after one re-test cycle.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提供簡短且具結構的交接，包含計算、單一所需修正、可量度驗收檢查及具名負責人。把移動指派給虛構資訊架構負責人，把重測指派給虛構內容設計負責人，並列明轉交條件，例如已移動標籤在一個重測週期後仍低於 70.0%。

exemplar.en: Fictional Journey Hub simulation, not MTR policy. From doc-tree-test-csv, Buy tickets has 70 participants (T-01 40, T-02 30) and 37 first-attempt successes (22 plus 15), giving 37 divided by 70 equals 52.9 percent, strictly below the doc-policy threshold of 70.0 percent. Its most common wrong destination group is Plan journey, which differs from the group itself, so the rule requires moving both Buy tickets task labels into Plan journey. No rename-only fix is allowed. The other groups pass, Plan journey 84.0 percent, Stations and access 84.0 percent, Help 80.0 percent, so T-03 to T-05 stay unchanged. Measurable check, re-run the tree test with at least 20 new participants per moved label and accept only at 70.0 percent or above. Information architecture owner applies the move. Content design owner runs the re-test. Escalate if the moved labels stay below 70.0 percent after one cycle. Evidence gaps, one round, 165 participants, no assistive-technology breakdown, no post-change data.
exemplar.zh: 虛構 Journey Hub 模擬，並非港鐵政策。根據 doc-tree-test-csv，Buy tickets 有 70 名參與者（T-01 為 40，T-02 為 30），首次嘗試成功 37 次（22 加 15），即 37 除以 70 等於 52.9%，嚴格低於 doc-policy 的 70.0% 門檻。其最常見錯誤目的地組別為 Plan journey，與該組別本身不同，故規則要求把兩個 Buy tickets 任務標籤移入 Plan journey，不得只改名了事。其他組別達標，Plan journey 為 84.0%，Stations and access 為 84.0%，Help 為 80.0%，因此 T-03 至 T-05 維持不變。可量度檢查方面，為每個已移動標籤以至少 20 名新參與者重測，且只在達 70.0% 或以上時接納。資訊架構負責人執行移動，內容設計負責人執行重測。若已移動標籤在一個週期後仍低於 70.0%，即上報。證據缺口包括只有一輪測試、165 名參與者、沒有輔助科技使用者細分，亦沒有改動後資料。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You state Buy tickets at 52.9 percent (37 of 70), identify it as the only group below 70.0 percent, require moving both labels into Plan journey because the most common wrong destination differs from the group, and reject renaming.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。你指出 Buy tickets 為 52.9%（70 分之 37），確認它是唯一低於 70.0% 的組別，並因最常見錯誤目的地與該組別不同而要求把兩個標籤移入 Plan journey，同時拒絕僅改名。

feedback.en: You tie the result to T-01 and T-02 with the participant and success totals and show the division method rather than asserting a rate. The doc-policy threshold, move rule and rename limitation are all referenced, and passing groups are supported by their own figures.
feedback.zh: 你把結果連結至 T-01 及 T-02 的參與者與成功次數，並展示除法過程而非只宣稱比率。你亦引用 doc-policy 的門檻、移動規則及改名限制，並以各自數據支持達標組別。

feedback.en: The required re-test is stated precisely, at least 20 new participants per moved label with acceptance at 70.0 percent or above, and the escalation trigger is clear. The handover would be stronger with one extra check, such as confirming T-03 findability in Plan journey has not dropped below 70.0 percent after the move.
feedback.zh: 所需重測說明準確，即每個已移動標籤至少 20 名新參與者並以 70.0% 或以上為接納標準，轉交條件亦清晰。若能加一項額外檢查會更好，例如確認移動後 T-03 在 Plan journey 的可尋性沒有低於 70.0%。

feedback.en: You correctly label the case as a fictional simulation rather than MTR policy, and you name the real gaps, one round, 165 participants, no assistive-technology breakdown and no post-change data, while keeping the 52.9 percent observation separate from the unproven post-move outcome.
feedback.zh: 你正確標明此個案為虛構模擬而非港鐵政策，並列出實際缺口，包括單一輪次、165 名參與者、沒有輔助科技使用者細分及沒有改動後資料，同時把 52.9% 的觀察與未經證實的移動後結果區分。

feedback.en: The handover is compact and actionable with the calculation, the single fix, the measurable check and named owners for the move and the re-test. The escalation trigger of moved labels staying below 70.0 percent after one cycle is stated explicitly.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，包含計算、單一修正、可量度檢查，以及移動與重測的具名負責人。已移動標籤在一個週期後仍低於 70.0% 的轉交條件亦明確列出。

summary.en: A complete and accurate handover. The calculation, the underperforming group, the required move into Plan journey and the re-test rule are all correct, and the scenario limits are acknowledged. Only the verification plan is slightly thin because it lacks one extra follow-up check.
summary.zh: 這是一份完整而準確的交接。計算、未達標組別、須移入 Plan journey 的修正及重測規則均正確，情境限制亦獲承認。唯一稍弱之處是核實計劃未包含額外的一項後續檢查。

nextSteps.en: Keep the current decisions and add one supporting check, for example a second tree-test round on the same five labels or a check that T-03 findability in Plan journey stays at or above 70.0 percent after the move. No other changes are needed.
nextSteps.zh: 保留現有決策，並加入一項輔助檢查，例如就同五項標籤進行第二輪樹狀測試，或檢查移動後 T-03 在 Plan journey 的可尋性維持在 70.0% 或以上。其他內容無須改動。

title.en: Station facility tree-test review and navigation regrouping
title.zh: 車站設施樹狀測試檢視與導覽重新分組

brief.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by MTR passenger information apps. Not endorsed by MTR Corporation and not an MTR policy. You are a UX designer on the Station Wayfinding prototype, a fictional navigation shell for station facility labels. Researchers ran a six-task tree test. Raw results are in doc-facility-tree-csv. Acceptance rules are in doc-policy. Decision owners are the fictional information architecture owner and the fictional content design owner. Escalate to the fictional product lead if a moved label is still below 70.0 percent after two re-test cycles. Deliver a concise written handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words. Name the failing group, its rate, the required structural fix, the measurable re-test check, and any evidence you still need. Do not edit the raw CSV.
brief.zh: 本任務為受港鐵乘客資訊應用程式啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非由港鐵公司認可，亦非港鐵政策。你是 Station Wayfinding 原型的用戶體驗設計師，該原型是虛構的車站設施標籤導覽框架。研究人員完成六項樹狀測試任務。原始結果見 doc-facility-tree-csv，驗收規則見 doc-policy。決策負責人為虛構的資訊架構負責人及虛構的內容設計負責人。若已移動標籤在兩個重測週期後仍低於 70.0%，須轉交虛構產品主管。請以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的精簡交接說明，列明未達標組別、其比率、所需結構性修正、可量度重測檢查，以及仍需要的證據。請勿修改原始 CSV。

title.zh: Station Wayfinding 樹狀測試任務

body.en: Fictional learning simulation inspired by MTR passenger information apps, not endorsed by MTR Corporation and not an MTR policy. Station Wayfinding is a fictional prototype navigation shell whose top-level groups sit under a parent group named Station info. The tree test measured where participants looked first for six station facility, access, fare and assistance tasks. Decision owners are the fictional information architecture owner and the fictional content design owner. If a moved task label still falls below 70.0 percent after two re-test cycles, escalate to the fictional product lead.
body.zh: 本任務為受港鐵乘客資訊應用程式啟發的虛構學習模擬，並非由港鐵公司認可，亦非港鐵政策。Station Wayfinding 是虛構的原型導覽框架，其頂層組別隸屬於名為 Station info 的母組別。樹狀測試量度參與者在六項車站設施、通道、票務及協助任務中首先查看的位置。決策負責人為虛構的資訊架構負責人及虛構的內容設計負責人。若已移動任務標籤在兩個重測週期後仍低於 70.0%，須轉交虛構產品主管。

title.zh: 公開樹狀測試驗收規則

body.en: Rules for the fictional Station Wayfinding prototype. A top-level group's first-attempt success rate equals the sum of first_attempt_success for that group divided by the sum of participants for that group, shown as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. A group is underperforming when its rate is strictly below 70.0 percent. At most one structural fix applies per underperforming group per cycle. If the most common wrong destination group differs from the group itself, move every task label of that group into that wrong destination's top-level group. If the most common wrong destination group is the group itself, merge that group's task labels into the parent group. Renaming a label is never a structural fix. After a move, re-run the tree test with at least 20 new participants per moved task label and accept the change only when the moved labels reach at least 70.0 percent first-attempt success.
body.zh: Station Wayfinding 虛構原型規則。某頂層組別的首次嘗試成功率，等於該組別 first_attempt_success 總和除以該組別 participants 總和，以百分比表示並四捨五入至一位小數。比率嚴格低於 70.0% 即屬未達標。每個週期對每個未達標組別最多套用一項結構性修正。若最常見錯誤目的地組別與該組別本身不同，便把該組別的每個任務標籤移入該錯誤目的地的頂層組別。若最常見錯誤目的地組別就是該組別本身，便把該組別的任務標籤合併至母組別。僅更改標籤名稱不屬於結構性修正。移動後，須為每個已移動任務標籤以至少 20 名新參與者重測，且只有在已移動標籤達至少 70.0% 首次嘗試成功率時才接納該改動。

title.en: Microcopy standard S1 and S2 for route-save confirmation
title.zh: 路線儲存確認的微文案標準 S1 及 S2

body.en: S1 Confirmation content. A route-save confirmation must contain the route_id exactly as stored, the destination station name in the locale of the string, the undo label and the undo window. The undo label is exactly Undo in English and 復原 in Chinese. The undo window must be stated as the exact number of seconds stored in undo_window_seconds followed by seconds in English and 秒 in Chinese. Minutes wording is not accepted. S2 Bilingual equivalence. English and Traditional Chinese strings must carry identical route_id, destination station and window value. S3 Brand limit. Do not add offers, prices or promises beyond the saved route.
body.zh: S1 確認內容。路線儲存確認必須包含資料中所儲存的 route_id、字串所屬語言的目的地站名、復原標籤及復原時限。復原標籤英文須為 Undo，中文須為 復原。復原時限須以 undo_window_seconds 中所儲存的秒數表示，英文後接 seconds，中文後接 秒。不接受以分鐘表述。S2 雙語對等。英文及繁體中文須帶有相同的 route_id、目的地站名及時限值。S3 品牌限制。不得加入已儲存路線以外的優惠、價格或承諾。

about.en: MTR Corporation operates railway and related businesses. Its public profile provides the context for a passenger-facing digital experience simulation.

expectedEvidence.en: Correctly applies S1 and S2. For R-204 the compliant pair is M4 because it contains route_id R-204, destination Tsuen Wan and 荃灣, the undo label Undo and 復原, and the window 300 seconds and 300 秒. M2 lacks the required destination. M3 uses minutes which S1 rejects. M1 lacks route_id, destination and seconds. The required complete edit set for M1 is add route_id and destination in each locale, replace Tap here and 點按此處 with Undo and 復原, and state the window as 300 seconds and 300 秒. The undo window for R-204 is 300 seconds.
expectedEvidence.zh: 正確應用 S1 及 S2。就 R-204 而言，合規組合為 M4，因其包含 route_id R-204、目的地 Tsuen Wan 及荃灣、復原標籤 Undo 及 復原，以及時限 300 seconds 及 300 秒。M2 欠缺所需的目的地。M3 使用分鐘，S1 不接受。M1 欠缺 route_id、目的地及秒數。M1 所需的完整編輯組為加入每個語言的 route_id 及目的地，將 Tap here 及 點按此處 改為 Undo 及 復原，並以 300 seconds 及 300 秒 表示時限。R-204 的復原時限為 300 秒。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Connects each decision to specific supplied records. M4 is supported by the candidate draft table. R-204 destination Tsuen Wan and 荃灣 come from the route CSV. The 300 second window comes from undo_window_seconds for R-204 in the CSV and is required by S1. M2 fails because S1 requires the destination station name and M2 omits it. M3 fails because S1 rejects minutes wording. M1 fails on route_id, destination, undo label and window. Bilingual equivalence is supported by S2.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把每項決策連結至具體提供記錄。M4 由候選草稿表支持。R-204 的目的地 Tsuen Wan 及荃灣來自路線 CSV。300 秒時限來自 CSV 中 R-204 的 undo_window_seconds，且為 S1 所要求。M2 失敗因 S1 要求目的地站名而 M2 省略。M3 失敗因 S1 不接受分鐘表述。M1 在 route_id、目的地、復原標籤及時限方面失敗。雙語對等由 S2 支持。

Also check that no offers or prices were added per S3.
expectedEvidence.zh: 提出檢查，例如按路線 CSV 核對每個語言的 route_id、目的地及時限值是否相同，確認標籤 Undo 及 復原 準確無誤，確認單位為 seconds 及 秒，並以雙語螢幕閱讀器測試修正後字串。另按 S3 檢查沒有加入優惠或價格。

expectedEvidence.zh: 撰寫簡潔交接，列明 R-204 的修正雙語字串、M1 的編輯、來自路線 CSV 及草稿表的證據、核實檢查，並註明 Ada Lau 為用戶體驗內容主管負責簽核。

exemplar.en: Repaired bilingual confirmation for R-204: English 'Route R-204 to Tsuen Wan saved. Undo within 300 seconds.' Chinese '路線 R-204 往荃灣已儲存。300 秒內可復原。' This satisfies S1 and S2. Evidence: route R-204 and destination Tsuen Wan and 荃灣 come from the route record CSV. The undo window 300 seconds comes from undo_window_seconds for R-204. The labels Undo and 復原 are required by S1. Draft M4 already meets this standard. Draft M1 requires three edits, add route_id and destination, replace Tap here and 點按此處 with Undo and 復原, and state the window as 300 seconds and 300 秒. Draft M2 lacks destination. Draft M3 uses minutes which S1 rejects. Verification: confirm both locales share the same route_id, destination and window value, check the exact labels, and run a bilingual screen reader test. Owner: Ada Lau, UX content lead. Uncertainty: this is a fictional simulation inspired by MTR Corporation, not endorsed by it, using only supplied records.
exemplar.zh: 路線 R-204 的修正雙語確認：英文「Route R-204 to Tsuen Wan saved. Undo within 300 seconds.」中文「路線 R-204 往荃灣已儲存。300 秒內可復原。」此符合 S1 及 S2。證據：route R-204 及目的地 Tsuen Wan 與荃灣來自路線記錄 CSV。復原時限 300 秒來自 R-204 的 undo_window_seconds。標籤 Undo 及 復原 為 S1 所要求。草稿 M4 已符合此標準。草稿 M1 需要三項編輯，加入 route_id 及目的地，將 Tap here 及 點按此處 改為 Undo 及 復原，並以 300 seconds 及 300 秒 表示時限。草稿 M2 欠缺目的地。草稿 M3 使用分鐘，S1 不接受。核實：確認兩個語言有相同的 route_id、目的地及時限值，檢查標籤準確無誤，並進行雙語螢幕閱讀器測試。負責人：Ada Lau，用戶體驗內容主管。不確定性：此為受港鐵公司啟發的虛構模擬，未獲其認可，只使用提供的記錄。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct: M4 is the compliant pair, set-a is the complete M1 repair, the R-204 undo window is 300 seconds, and both locales must match. Your repaired English and Chinese strings correctly carry route_id R-204, destination Tsuen Wan and 荃灣, the labels Undo and 復原, and the 300 seconds and 300 秒 window.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確：M4 為合規組合，set-a 為 M1 的完整修正，R-204 復原時限為 300 秒，兩個語言須一致。你修正後的英文及中文字串正確帶有 route_id R-204、目的地 Tsuen Wan 及荃灣、標籤 Undo 及復原，以及 300 seconds 及 300 秒 時限。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to specific supplied sources: the route CSV for R-204 and the 300 second window, the draft table for M4, and S1 and S2 for the labels and bilingual equivalence. You also explain clearly why M1, M2 and M3 fail, citing the missing destination and the rejected minutes wording.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連結至具體提供來源：路線 CSV 支持 R-204 及 300 秒時限，草稿表支持 M4，S1 及 S2 支持標籤及雙語對等。你亦清楚解釋 M1、M2、M3 失敗的原因，並指出欠缺目的地及不接受分鐘表述。

feedback.en: Your checks on matching route_id, destination and window across locales, exact labels, and a bilingual screen reader test are concrete and testable. Add a unit check that each locale states seconds and 秒 rather than minutes, plus a confirmation that no offers or prices were introduced under S3, to make the plan fully complete.
feedback.zh: 你核對兩個語言的 route_id、目的地及時限值、標籤準確無誤，以及雙語螢幕閱讀器測試，具體而可驗證。再補上單位檢查，確認兩個語言均以 seconds 及 秒 而非分鐘表述，並按 S3 確認沒有加入優惠或價格，核實計劃便更完整。

feedback.en: You clearly state this is a fictional simulation inspired by MTR Corporation and not endorsed by it, and that only supplied records are used. That properly limits the claim and acknowledges the synthetic setting.
feedback.zh: 你清楚指出此為受港鐵公司啟發的虛構模擬，未獲其認可，並只使用提供的記錄。這恰當地限制了聲明範圍並承認虛構情境。

feedback.en: The handover is concise and actionable, giving the repaired bilingual string, the edits from M1, the CSV and draft table evidence, the verification checks, and Ada Lau as UX content lead for sign-off. No further action is needed here.
feedback.zh: 交接簡潔可行，列明修正後雙語字串、M1 的編輯、路線 CSV 及草稿表證據、核實檢查，以及 Ada Lau 為用戶體驗內容主管負責簽核。此部分無需再作補充。

summary.en: An accurate and well-sourced submission. All four decisions are correct, the repaired bilingual confirmation meets S1 and S2, and the handover names the owner and limits claims to the fictional scenario. The only small gap is that verification does not explicitly confirm the seconds and 秒 unit or the S3 no-offers check.
summary.zh: 整體準確且證據充分。四項決策全部正確，修正後的雙語確認符合 S1 及 S2，交接亦列明負責人並把聲明限於虛構情境。唯一小缺口是核實部分未明確確認 seconds 及 秒 單位，以及未按 S3 檢查是否加入優惠。

nextSteps.en: Keep the repaired string as delivered. If you want a fully airtight handover, add one line to verification stating the unit is checked as seconds and 秒 and that no offer or price text was added under S3.
nextSteps.zh: 保留已交付的修正字串。如要交接更嚴密，可在核實部分加一句，說明已檢查單位為 seconds 及 秒，並確認沒有按 S3 加入任何優惠或價格文字。

title.zh: 修正雙語行程提示訂閱微文案

brief.en: Fictional simulation inspired by MTR Corporation and not endorsed by it. You are the UX designer on a passenger app. The team drafted bilingual microcopy for a journey-alert opt-in. Review the supplied microcopy standard, the journey records and the candidate strings. Deliver a repaired bilingual opt-in confirmation for journey J-108 and a concise handover of about 100 to 180 words in English or Traditional Chinese. State each edit, the exact source evidence, any uncertainty and your verification checks. Use only the supplied fictional data. Do not use real passenger data.
brief.zh: 此為受港鐵公司啟發的虛構模擬，未獲港鐵公司認可。你是乘客應用程式的用戶體驗設計師。團隊已為行程提示訂閱起草雙語微文案。請審查提供的微文案標準、行程記錄及候選字串。為行程 J-108 交付修正後的雙語訂閱確認，並以英文或繁體中文撰寫約 100 至 180 字的簡潔交接。列明每項編輯、具體來源證據、任何不確定性及核實檢查。只使用提供的虛構資料。不要使用真實乘客資料。

title.zh: 行程提示訂閱微文案標準

body.en: S1 Confirmation content. A journey-alert opt-in confirmation must contain the journey_id exactly as stored, the departure station name in the locale of the string, the numeric lead time with the unit minutes in English and 分鐘 in Chinese, and the opt-out label exactly Turn off alerts in English and 關閉提示 in Chinese. S2 Bilingual equivalence. The English and Traditional Chinese strings must carry the same journey_id, the same numeric lead time and the same departure station, with the station name rendered in the string's locale. S3 Brand limit. Do not add offers, prices, guarantees or promises beyond the supplied journey information. Do not state a repeating interval.
body.zh: S1 確認內容。行程提示訂閱確認須包含資料中所儲存的 journey_id、字串所屬語言的出發站名、以英文 minutes 及中文 分鐘 為單位的數值時限，以及訂閱關閉標籤，英文須為 Turn off alerts，中文須為 關閉提示。S2 雙語對等。英文及繁體中文須帶有相同的 journey_id、相同的數值時限及相同的出發站，站名以字串所屬語言表示。S3 品牌限制。不得加入已提供行程資訊以外的優惠、價格、保證或承諾。不得陳述重複間隔。

exemplar.en:
Repaired confirmation for journey J-108, using journey-csv row J-108 and candidate pair D2. D2 omits the departure station in both locales, which breaks S1. Add Admiralty to the English string and 金鐘 to the Chinese string, keeping journey_id, the 15 minute lead time and the exact opt-out label.

Final English: 'Journey J-108 from Admiralty saved. Alerts 15 minutes before departure. Turn off alerts.' Final Chinese: '行程 J-108 由金鐘已儲存。出發前 15 分鐘通知。關閉提示。'

D3 breaks S2 because the Chinese string says 15 秒 while the English string says 15 minutes. D4 breaks S3 because 'every 15 minutes' is a repeating interval, not a lead time before departure. D1 omits journey_id, station and lead time and uses an unsupported action label.

Verification: confirm both locales contain J-108, the same value 15, the locale station and the exact labels, and that no offers or prices were added. Uncertainty: the CSV covers only fictional records J-108, J-215 and J-342, so other journeys are unverified. Next step: send the repaired pair and these checks to the UX content lead.
exemplar.zh:
行程 J-108 的修正確認，採用 journey-csv 的 J-108 列及候選字串 D2。D2 在兩個語言均欠缺出發站，違反 S1。請在英文字串加入 Admiralty，在中文字串加入 金鐘，並保留 journey_id、15 分鐘時限及精確關閉標籤。

最終英文：'Journey J-108 from Admiralty saved. Alerts 15 minutes before departure. Turn off alerts.' 最終中文：'行程 J-108 由金鐘已儲存。出發前 15 分鐘通知。關閉提示。'

D3 違反 S2，因中文字串為 15 秒，而英文字串為 15 minutes。D4 違反 S3，因 'every 15 minutes' 屬重複間隔，並非出發前的時限。D1 欠缺 journey_id、出發站及時限，並使用不支援的動作標籤。

核實：確認兩個語言均含 J-108、相同的數值 15、該語言的出發站及精確標籤，且沒有加入優惠或價格。不確定性：CSV 只涵蓋虛構記錄 J-108、J-215 及 J-342，其他行程未經核實。下一步：把修正字串及這些檢查交予用戶體驗內容主管。

feedback.en: All four decisions are correct. You identified D3 as the S2 breach (English 15 minutes against Chinese 15 秒), chose set-a as the complete D2 repair, and returned 20 for J-215 and 45 as the three-record total. The repaired pair keeps journey_id J-108, the 15 minute lead time and the exact opt-out labels in both locales.
feedback.zh: 四項決策全部正確。你指出 D3 違反 S2（英文 15 minutes 對中文 15 秒），選出 set-a 作為 D2 的完整修正，並回覆 J-215 為 20、三筆總和為 45。修正字串在兩個語言均保留 journey_id J-108、15 分鐘時限及精確關閉標籤。

feedback.en: Reasoning is tied to named sources: the journey-csv row for J-108 supplies Admiralty and 金鐘, and you explain why D1, D3 and D4 fail against S1, S2 and S3 respectively. Each rejected draft is linked to a specific rule, so a reviewer can trace every edit.

feedback.en: Your checks are concrete and testable: matching J-108 in both locales, the same value 15, the locale station, the exact labels and the absence of offers or prices. Sending them to the UX content lead before release gives a clear owner and gate.

summary.en: A complete, accurate submission. All structured answers match the supplied records and rules, and the repaired J-108 pair satisfies S1, S2 and S3. title.en: Plan Round 1 of a wayfinding prototype check
title.zh: 規劃尋路原型驗證第一輪

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by MTR Corporation, not endorsed by it. You are preparing Round 1 of a fictional passenger wayfinding prototype check called InterchangeNav. Read the protocol, the session list and the budget table, then choose a bounded test and a recruitment plan that satisfies every stated rule. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words covering your gate decision, session booking, cost calculation, risks and next steps. Do not claim that any study has been run. All policies, budgets and records here are fictional.
brief.zh: 本任務是以港鐵公司為靈感的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你正籌備名為 InterchangeNav 的虛構乘客尋路原型驗證第一輪。請閱讀驗證協議、節次清單及預算表，然後選出有限度測試及符合所有既定規則的招募計劃。以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的精簡且以證據為本的交接，內容涵蓋門檻決定、節次預約、成本計算、風險及下一步。不得聲稱已進行任何研究。此處所有政策、預算及記錄均屬虛構。

title.zh: InterchangeNav 第一輪驗證協議（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, not endorsed by any operator. Round 1 covers exactly one task, T1: in the InterchangeNav prototype the participant must locate the correct interchange step to the next departure platform. Measure: first-tap accuracy, a correct interchange step chosen on the participant's first tap. Pass gate: at least 8 of the 10 participants achieve first-tap accuracy on T1. No other measure, including completion time, forms part of the gate. Participants: 10 adults, each attending exactly one session. At least 4 participants use the screen-reader profile, and every booked session must offer screen-reader support. Book one Cantonese session and one English session. Where several slots qualify, book the earliest start time for each language. Round 1 has not been run.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，並非任何營運商認可。第一輪只涵蓋一個任務 T1：在 InterchangeNav 原型中，參加者須找出前往下一班列車月台的正確轉車步驟。量度：首次點選準確度，即參加者第一次點選便選中正確轉車步驟。通過門檻：10 位參加者中至少 8 位在 T1 達到首次點選準確度。其他任何量度，包括完成時間，均不屬於門檻的一部分。參加者：10 位成人，每人只出席一節。至少 4 位參加者使用螢幕閱讀器設定，而每一節已預約節次都必須提供螢幕閱讀器支援。預約一節廣東話節次及一節英語節次。若多個節次都符合條件，每種語言預約最早開始時間者。第一輪尚未進行。
