Total budget is 4,100 HKD (2,500 incentive at 250 x 10, 700 room hire at 350 x 2, 900 assistive set-up at 450 x 2). Multi answer is task-t1-only, screen-reader-both and incentive-250.
expectedEvidence.zh: 門檻為 10 位參加者中至少 8 位在 T1 第一次點選即正確，且不包含時間量度。預約為 S-01 加 S-03。預算總額 4,100 港元（津貼 250 x 10 為 2,500，場地 350 x 2 為 700，無障礙設定 450 x 2 為 900）。多選答案為 task-t1-only、screen-reader-both 及 incentive-250。

description.en: Connects decisions to specific supplied records and explains the reasoning.
description.zh: 把決策連結至具體提供記錄，並解釋推理。

expectedEvidence.en: Links the gate to round1-protocol, the booking to S-01 and S-03 in round1-sessions (open, screen_reader, earliest per language, S-05 held and therefore excluded), and each cost to B-01, B-02 and B-03 in round1-budget with the arithmetic shown.
expectedEvidence.zh: 把門檻連結至 round1-protocol，把預約連結至 round1-sessions 的 S-01 及 S-03（open、screen_reader、每種語言最早，S-05 為 held 故排除），並把各項成本連結至 round1-budget 的 B-01、B-02 及 B-03，並展示計算。

description.en: Proposes concrete checks and next actions that test the stated requirements.
description.zh: 提出具體檢查及下一步，以測試聲明要求。

expectedEvidence.en: Proposes recording first-tap accuracy per participant for T1 only, confirming all four screen-reader participants attend a session with screen-reader support, reconciling spend against 4,100 HKD, and rejecting any added timing measure. Escalates to the research lead if fewer than 8 of 10 pass.
expectedEvidence.zh: 建議只為 T1 逐位記錄首次點選準確度，確認全部四位螢幕閱讀器參加者出席具螢幕閱讀器支援的節次，核對開支與 4,100 港元一致，並拒絕加入任何時間量度。若 10 位中少於 8 位通過，須轉交研究主管。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: States that Round 1 has not been run, so the gate result and any usability conclusion are unknown, and that the protocol, slots and budget are fictional simulation assumptions that make no claim about real stations or real passengers.
expectedEvidence.zh: 說明第一輪尚未進行，因此門檻結果及任何易用性結論均屬未知，並說明協議、節次及預算均為虛構模擬假設，不會對真實車站或真實乘客作出任何聲明。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Concise handover naming the decision (single-task T1 check), the gate, the two booked sessions, the 4,100 HKD total with its three components, the main uncertainty and the next actions with the research lead as owner.
expectedEvidence.zh: 精簡交接列明決定（只測 T1 單一任務）、門檻、兩節已預約節次、4,100 港元總額及其三項組成、主要不確定性，以及由研究主管負責的下一步。

exemplar.en: Decision: run Round 1 as a single-task check on T1, the interchange step to the next departure platform, using first-tap accuracy as the only gate measure (round1-protocol). Gate: at least 8 of the 10 participants must make a correct first tap. I excluded any timing measure because the protocol defines no timing gate. Recruitment: book S-01 (Monday 10:00, Cantonese, screen_reader, capacity 6) and S-03 (Tuesday 10:00, English, screen_reader, capacity 6), the earliest qualifying slots per language in round1-sessions. S-05 is held and S-04 has no screen-reader support, so both are excluded. Budget: 10 incentives at 250 HKD is 2,500, room hire 2 x 350 is 700, assistive set-up 2 x 450 is 900, total 4,100 HKD (round1-budget). Risk: Round 1 has not been run, so the gate outcome is unknown. Next step: confirm the 10 participants against the profile rules, record first-tap accuracy per participant, and escalate to the research lead if the gate is not met.
exemplar.zh: 決定：第一輪只就 T1（前往下一班列車月台的轉車步驟）進行單一任務檢查，並以首次點選準確度作為唯一門檻量度（round1-protocol）。門檻：10 位參加者中至少 8 位第一次點選即正確。我排除任何時間量度，因為協議並無定義時間門檻。招募：預約 S-01（週一 10:00，廣東話，screen_reader，容量 6）及 S-03（週二 10:00，英語，screen_reader，容量 6），即 round1-sessions 中每種語言最早且符合條件的節次。S-05 為 held，S-04 沒有螢幕閱讀器支援，兩者均排除。預算：10 份津貼以 250 港元計為 2,500，場地 2 x 350 為 700，無障礙設定 2 x 450 為 900，總額 4,100 港元（round1-budget）。風險：第一輪尚未進行，門檻結果未知。下一步：按參加者條件確認 10 位人選，逐位記錄首次點選準確度，若未達門檻則轉交研究主管。

feedback.en: All decisions are correct: gate is 8 of 10 first-tap successes on T1 only, booking is S-01 plus S-03, and the total of 4,100 HKD is right. You also correctly excluded any timing measure and identified S-05 as held and S-04 as lacking screen-reader support.
feedback.zh: 所有決策均正確：門檻為 T1 首次點選 10 位中至少 8 位成功，預約為 S-01 加 S-03，總額 4,100 港元亦正確。你亦正確排除任何時間量度，並指出 S-05 為 held、S-04 缺乏螢幕閱讀器支援。

feedback.en: You tie each decision to round1-protocol, round1-sessions and round1-budget and show the arithmetic (250 x 10, 350 x 2, 450 x 2). The reasoning for the earliest per-language slots and the held exclusion is explicit and defensible.
feedback.zh: 你把每項決策連繫至 round1-protocol、round1-sessions 及 round1-budget，並展示計算（250 x 10、350 x 2、450 x 2）。每種語言最早節次及排除 held 的推理清晰且合理。

feedback.en: You propose recording first-tap accuracy per participant and escalating to the research lead if the gate fails, which is concrete. Add an explicit check that all four screen-reader participants land in a session with screen-reader support, and reconcile actual spend against 4,100 HKD.
feedback.zh: 你建議逐位記錄首次點選準確度，並在未達門檻時轉交研究主管，做法具體。可再加入明確檢查，確認全部四位螢幕閱讀器參加者均獲編入具螢幕閱讀器支援的節次，並核對實際開支與 4,100 港元一致。

feedback.en: You correctly state Round 1 has not been run so the gate outcome is unknown. Strengthen this by noting the protocol, slots and budget are fictional simulation assumptions that make no claim about real stations or passengers.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出第一輪尚未進行，故門檻結果未知。可再補充協議、節次及預算均為虛構模擬假設，不會對真實車站或乘客作出任何聲明。

feedback.en: This is a concise, actionable handover naming the single-task T1 scope, the gate, both booked sessions, the 4,100 HKD total and its three components, the uncertainty and next steps with the research lead as owner.
feedback.zh: 這是一份精簡且可行的交接，列明只測 T1 的範圍、門檻、兩節已預約節次、4,100 港元總額及其三項組成、不確定性，以及由研究主管負責的下一步。

summary.en: A complete and accurate submission. Every structured answer and the reasoning match the supplied protocol, session list and budget, and the handover is clear and evidence-based. Minor gains remain in stating the fictional-simulation boundary and tightening verification checks.
summary.zh: 提交完整且準確。所有結構化答案及推理均符合提供的協議、節次清單及預算，交接清晰且以證據為本。尚可在說明虛構模擬界線及收緊核實檢查方面略作補充。

nextSteps.en: Add two verification items: confirm all four screen-reader participants are booked into a screen-reader-supported session, and reconcile spend against 4,100 HKD. Also state that the scenario and figures are fictional simulation assumptions with no claim about real stations or passengers.
nextSteps.zh: 加入兩項核實：確認全部四位螢幕閱讀器參加者均編入具支援的節次，並核對開支與 4,100 港元一致。同時說明情境及數字均為虛構模擬假設，不會對真實車站或乘客作出任何聲明。

title.zh: 規劃 AlertClear 第一輪原型驗證

brief.en: Independent learning simulation inspired by MTR Corporation, not endorsed by it. You are planning Round 1 of a fictional passenger alert-comprehension prototype called AlertClear. Read the protocol, session list and budget table, then choose a bounded test and a recruitment plan that satisfies every stated rule. Deliver a concise evidence-based handover in English or Traditional Chinese of about 100 to 180 words covering your gate decision, session booking, cost calculation, risks and next steps. Do not claim that any study has been run. All policies, budgets and records here are fictional.
brief.zh: 本任務是以港鐵公司為靈感的獨立學習模擬，並非該公司認可。你正籌備名為 AlertClear 的虛構乘客警示理解原型驗證第一輪。請閱讀驗證協議、節次清單及預算表，然後選出有限度測試及符合所有既定規則的招募計劃。以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的精簡且以證據為本的交接，內容涵蓋門檻決定、節次預約、成本計算、風險及下一步。不得聲稱已進行任何研究。此處所有政策、預算及記錄均屬虛構。

title.zh: AlertClear 第一輪驗證協議（虛構）

body.en: Fictional learning simulation, not endorsed by any operator. Round 1 covers exactly one task, T1: in the AlertClear prototype the participant must read a service-alert panel and select the correct action for their journey. Measure: alert comprehension accuracy, a correct action selected for the affected journey on the participant's first attempt. Pass gate: at least 9 of the 12 participants achieve alert comprehension accuracy on T1. No other measure, including reading time, forms part of the gate. Participants: 12 adults, each attending exactly one session. At least 5 participants use the screen-reader profile, and every booked session must offer screen-reader support. Book one Cantonese session and one English session. Where several slots qualify, book the earliest start time for each language. Round 1 has not been run.
body.zh: 虛構學習模擬，並非任何營運商認可。第一輪只涵蓋一個任務 T1：在 AlertClear 原型中，參加者須閱讀服務警示面板，並為其行程選出正確行動。量度：警示理解準確度，即參加者第一次嘗試便為受影響行程選中正確行動。通過門檻：12 位參加者中至少 9 位在 T1 達到警示理解準確度。其他任何量度，包括閱讀時間，均不屬於門檻的一部分。參加者：12 位成人，每人只出席一節。至少 5 位參加者使用螢幕閱讀器設定，而每一節已預約節次都必須提供螢幕閱讀器支援。預約一節廣東話節次及一節英語節次。若多個節次都符合條件，每種語言預約最早開始時間者。第一輪尚未進行。

description.en: Acknowledges missing evidence and limits claims to the fictional scenario and assumptions.
description.zh: 承認欠缺證據，並把聲明限於虛構情境及假設。

expectedEvidence.en: Explicitly acknowledges the scenario is fictional and no study has been run. Avoids claiming real MTR endorsement or actual passenger outcomes. States that the gate and budget are planning assumptions only.
expectedEvidence.zh: 明確承認情境為虛構且尚未進行任何研究。避免聲稱獲港鐵公司認可或實際乘客結果。指出門檻及預算僅屬規劃假設。

description.en: Writes an actionable handover with decisions, evidence and applicable ownership or escalation.
description.zh: 撰寫可行交接，列明決策、證據及適用責任或轉交。

expectedEvidence.en: Delivers a concise handover in English or Traditional Chinese around 100 to 180 words covering gate decision, session booking, cost calculation, risks and next steps. Assigns ownership or escalation, for example to the UX Research Lead, and lists the next action.
expectedEvidence.zh: 以英文或香港繁體中文提交約 100 至 180 字的精簡交接，涵蓋門檻決定、節次預約、成本計算、風險及下一步。列明責任或轉交對象，例如用戶研究主管，並列出下一步行動。

exemplar.en: Evidence: The protocol sets T1 as the only task and the gate at least 9 of 12 participants achieving alert comprehension accuracy. Sessions S-11 (Mon 09:30, Cantonese, screen_reader) and S-13 (Tue 09:30, English, screen_reader) are the earliest qualifying slots and both support screen_reader. Budget lines B-11 to B-13 give 12 x 300 + 2 x 400 + 2 x 500 = 5400 HKD. Decision: Book S-11 and S-13, recruit 12 adults including at least 5 screen-reader users, and treat 9 of 12 as the pass gate. Risks: S-11 or S-13 could become held, and the screen-reader participant count may fall short. Next steps: Confirm both slots remain open and screen_reader equipped, verify at least 5 screen-reader recruits, and recheck the 5400 HKD sum before sessions. Owner: UX Research Lead. No study has been run.
exemplar.zh: 證據：協議將 T1 定為唯一任務，門檻為 12 位參加者中至少 9 位達到警示理解準確度。節次 S-11（週一 09:30，廣東話，screen_reader）及 S-13（週二 09:30，英語，screen_reader）是最早符合資格的時段，且兩者均支援 screen_reader。預算項目 B-11 至 B-13 給出 12 x 300 + 2 x 400 + 2 x 500 = 5400 港元。決定：預約 S-11 及 S-13，招募 12 位成人，其中至少 5 位使用螢幕閱讀器，並以 12 分之 9 為通過門檻。風險：S-11 或 S-13 可能變為 held，且螢幕閱讀器參加者人數可能不足。下一步：確認兩個節次仍為 open 並配備 screen_reader、核實至少 5 位螢幕閱讀器參加者，並在節次前重新核對 5400 港元總額。負責人：用戶研究主管。尚未進行任何研究。

feedback.en: All four answers are correct. The gate is stated as at least 9 of 12 on T1, the budget is computed as 12 x 300 + 2 x 400 + 2 x 500 = 5400 HKD, and the booking names S-11 and S-13 as the earliest qualifying screen_reader slots.
feedback.zh: 四個答案全部正確。門檻為 T1 達到 12 分之 9，預算計算為 12 x 300 + 2 x 400 + 2 x 500 = 5400 港元，預約亦指出 S-11 及 S-13 為最早符合資格的 screen_reader 節次。

feedback.en: You cite the protocol gate clause, session rows S-11 and S-13, and budget lines B-11 to B-13, which grounds each decision in supplied records. To strengthen it, name why S-12 and S-14 fail the screen_reader rule and why S-15 and S-16 are excluded by the held status and earliest-time rule.
feedback.zh: 你引用了協議門檻條款、節次 S-11 及 S-13，以及預算項目 B-11 至 B-13，把每項決策連結至提供記錄。可再補充 S-12 及 S-14 因不符合 screen_reader 要求而被排除，以及 S-15 及 S-16 因 held 狀態及最早時間規則而被排除。

feedback.en: Your checks on slot status, screen_reader staffing, the 5 screen-reader recruit minimum and rechecking 5400 HKD are concrete and pre-session. Add a dry run of the alert panel with a screen reader so the T1 task itself is validated before participants attend.
feedback.zh: 你對節次狀態、screen_reader 配置、至少 5 位螢幕閱讀器參加者及重新核對 5400 港元的檢查具體且在節次前進行。可再加入以螢幕閱讀器預先測試警示面板，讓 T1 任務本身在參加者出席前獲得驗證。

feedback.en: You correctly state that no study has been run, which avoids overclaiming results. Make the fictional framing explicit and note that the 9 of 12 gate and the 5400 HKD figure are planning assumptions rather than real MTR findings.
feedback.zh: 你正確指出尚未進行任何研究，避免誇大結果。可明確指出情境屬虛構，並說明 12 分之 9 門檻及 5400 港元僅屬規劃假設，而非真實港鐵研究結果。

feedback.en: This is a clear, well-ordered handover at 137 English words. It covers the gate decision, booking, cost calculation, risks and next steps, and names the UX Research Lead as owner, giving a reader everything needed to act.
feedback.zh: 這是一份清晰有序的交接，共 137 個英文字。內容涵蓋門檻決定、節次預約、成本計算、風險及下一步，並指明用戶研究主管為負責人，讀者可據此行動。

summary.en: Strong submission. All structured answers are correct and the handover is concise, evidence-linked and within the suggested length. The main gaps are explaining the excluded slots by name and adding an explicit fictional and planning-assumption caveat.
summary.zh: 整體表現優秀。所有結構化答案均正確，交接精簡、連結證據且符合建議長度。主要缺口在於未逐一說明被排除節次的原因，以及未明確加入虛構及規劃假設的聲明。

nextSteps.en: Before Round 1, add one line explaining why S-12, S-14, S-15 and S-16 are excluded, add a screen-reader dry run of the alert panel, and state plainly that the gate and budget are fictional planning assumptions. Keep ownership with the UX Research Lead.
nextSteps.zh: 在第一輪前，加入一行說明 S-12、S-14、S-15 及 S-16 被排除的原因，加入以螢幕閱讀器預先測試警示面板，並清楚指出門檻及預算屬虛構規劃假設。責任繼續由用戶研究主管負責。
